tei:div.tei:p: byaḥ/bka'agu/ //spya chi/hā sdu 77/mesbya 'jiciXng060jib jing 505533 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog

ga — — — — — — — —6 rtswa ci cho4 thi ri ci ci jibye/ 3khung me (ri go ldoX mo dang — riX ca3/— rdze ri 'i ༷༷4kyi /༷ga /zhe —33 rngo paX ——— ———54〉 noji 'iX ——— sno tsa rta/ nga snga ༷ co ri13)//zhe ru nga pa'i pi ba sker thabasathe0hūḥ/bya/sa/ —— 1 ཿ dza nga rgya ci nga mi dzilta4 mong ————— 2——— ——————— gyi la4 stogo lte 3 ga 4gā'i rngumi 411 nya —— rigadape mkhangag ci

grangs nyung mi rigs skad yig gi sna zhing gsum mi dpe tshogs/zhing grong dang zhing pa gsar pa/zhing pa'i gtug bsher rgyag thabs/then yung yon gyis gtso sgrig byas/bkra bhas sgrig bsgyur byas/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dkar chagale'u dang po/ sa zhing 'gan gtsang len dang sa zhing do dam skor/ 1(dang po)rang rgyal gyis deng skabs spyod pa'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len dang do dam skor la bca' khrims dang khrims srol gang dag yod/ 1(gnyis)rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims nang zhing pa'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang char gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/ 4(gsum)sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byed par go rim gang dag brgyud dgos/ 4(bzhi)rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims nang sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi dus yun gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/ 7(lnga)sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gan rgyar don tshan gang dag 'dus/8(drug)zhing pa grong rdal chung bar gnas spar te khyim gzhis chags pa'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len thad gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/ 9(bdun)zhing pa chus btsugs pa'i grong khyer du gnas spos ba'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len thad gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/11(brgyad)dud tho dang 'gan gtsang len sa zhing gi 'brel ba ci zhig yin/ 121

(dgu)'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa 'ing legs sgrig byed mi chog pa'i thad nas gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/ 13(bcu)tang dang rgyal khab kyis zhing sde'i bud med kyi 'gan gtsang len sa zhing la srung skyong byed pa'i thad nas gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/ 15(bcu gcig)'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing rgyun 'dzin byas chog gam/ 17(bcu gnyis)slob grwa chen mo'i nang rgyugs 'phrod pa'i zhing sde'i slob mar 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing mu mthun du bskyur ram/ 19(bcu gsum) sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed par rtsa don gang dag brtsi spang bya dgos/ ༄ 20(bcu bzhi)spyod stangs gang dag ni sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed pa'i khrod dbang char btsan 'dzul byas pa dang khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod yin/ 22(bco lnga)sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis zhing dud kyi sa zhing skor skyod byed pa'i phan khe blangs chog gam/ 24(bcu drug)rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims nang sa zhing skor skyod byed pa'i gan rgya 'jog par gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/ 25(bcu bdun)sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod 2 byed pa'i gan rgyar nang don gang dag 'dus yod/ 27

(bco brgyad)rang khyim gyi 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing sde ba gzhan pa'i sde mir bshug sprod 'gan len dang bogs gtong byas chog gam/ 27(bcu dgu) 'gan gtsang len sa zhing bshug sprod byas na gnad don gang dag la do snang byed dgos/ 29(nyi shu)'gan gtsang len sa mang ma rkang du bzhag nas khe las sgrub chog gam/ 31(nyer gcig)sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis rang sde ba'i sa rgod rang dgar gzhan sa'i mir 'gan gtsang sprod byas chog gam/32(nyer gnyis)'gan gtsang len gron dngul mtho drags pa'am yang na dma' drags na thag gcod ji ltar bya dgos/ 33(nyer gsum)sa zhing 'gan gtsang len thad kyi rtsod gling gnad don thabs lam gang dag brgyud de thag gcod dgos/ 34(nyer ba'i)'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang char gnod 'tshe btang ba'i bya spyod gang dag la dmangs 'gan 'khur dgos/ 38(nyer lnga)srid gzhung dpon rigs kyis rang dgar zhing pa'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang cha bsgyur bcos byed pa'am yang na med par bzos tshe 'gan 'khri ci zhig 'khur dgos/ 40(nyer drug)rang rgyal sa zhing bca' khrims la ga'i rtsa'i rtsa don gang dag yod/ 413

(nyer bdun)rgyal khab kyis rmo zhing srung skyong thad gtan 'bebs gang dag byas yod/ 43(nyer brgyad)gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing srung skyong khul du bya ba gang dag bsgrubs pa'i bya spyod gtan 'gog bya rgyu/ 46(nyer dgu) 〈〈sa zhing do dam skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉nang zhing pa'i sa zhing bsdus spyod byas par thob 'os pa'i skyin gsab sprod pa'i thad gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/ 50(sum cu)bsdus spyod sa zhing gi skyin gsab gron dngul sogs dbang mkhan dang spyod mkhan su yin/ 54(so gcig)rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims nang zhing pa'i sdod khang rgyab par sa zhing spyod pa'i thad gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/ 56(so gnyis)sde dmangs kyi khang sa'i bkol dbang thad gtan 'bebs ji ltar gtan khel byas yod/ 57(so gsum)rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims nang khyim mtshes 'brel ba'i sa zhing las rtsod gleng byung ba thag gcod pa'i thad gtan khel ji ltar byas yod/ 59(so bzhi)khang rnying bshug ste khang gsar las par zhib bsher chog mchan brgyud dgos sam/ 62le'u gnyis pazhang sde'i dpya khral bcos bskur dang zhing pa'i khur bo dze yang tu gtong ba'i skor/ 65(gcig)zhing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur thad bca' khrims dang srid jus kyi gzhi 'dzin sa gtso bo gang dag yod/ 65(dīnyis)krung dbyang gis zhing pa'i khur bo je yang du gtong ba'i

skor la yig cha gang dag bzos yod/ 67(gsum) don rer gros re zhes pa'i go don ci/ 69(bzhi) don rer gros re yi don ni ci zhig gi don yin/ 69(lnga) 66don rer gros re yi las ga'i gros rim gyi rtsa don ci yin/ 70(drug) don rer gros re yi las ga'i gros rim gyi go rim ci yin/ 70(bdun) don rer gros re nang bsdu ba'i ngal rtsol pa ni gang dag yin/72(brgyad)64don rer gros re yi dngul gtong las zhugs thad kyi 'os 'gan je yang du gtong ba'i srid jus ji lta bu yin/ 72(dgu) don rer gros re yi dngul gtong las zhugs byed pa'i grangs tshad ga tshod yin/ 73(bcu) don rer gros re yi ma dngul do dam dang bkol spyod ji ltar bya dgos/ 73(bcu gcig)gtan 'bebs byas pa'i dngul gtong las zhugs kyi tshad las brgal tshe ji ltar bya/ 74(bcu gnyis)khrims ltar sa rgod slog par dpya khral ji ltar bsdu dgos/ 75(bcu gsum)gnas tshul gang 'dra'i 'og nas zhing las dpya khral mi sprod pa'i srid jus longs su spyad chog gam/ 75(bcu bzhi)rgyal khab kyis zhing las dpya khral nyung 'phri dang med par bzo stangs thad blang bya ci zhig bton yod/ 75(bco lnga)zhing par gron dngul gang byung du bsdu mi chog pa'i bca' khrims kyi gzhi 'dzin sa ci yin/ 76(bcu drug)zhing par gang byung du chad pa gcod mi chog pa'i bca' 5

khrims kyi gzhi 'dzin sa ci yin/ 77(bcu bdun)zhing par gang byung du cha gses brgyab mi chog pa'i bca' khrims kyi ga'i 'dzin sa ci yin/ 78(bco brgyad)zhing par gang byung du ma dngul rub bsdus byas mi chog pa'i bca' khrims kyi gzhi 'dzin sa ci yin/ 79(bcu dgu)zhing pa 'ing las 'gan bcol nang btsan thabs kyis zhugs su bcug mi chog par bca' khrims kyi gzhi 'dzin sa ci yod/ 80(nyi shu)zhing las dang 'brel ba'i rin gong dang gron sdud gang dag khrims 'gal la ngos 'dzin rgyu yin/ 80(nyer gcig)zhing pas khang pa las na gron dngul gang dag sprod dgos/ 82(nyer gnyis)zhing las khral sdud dang 'ing las dang 'brel ba'i rin gong / gron sdud spyi gsal lam lugs /bcas kyi bye brag gi blang bya ci yin/ 83(nyer gsum)zhing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur gyi mi chog pa brgyad ci yin/ 83(nyer bzhi)ci zhig la zhing pa'i khur bo je yang du gtong ba'i srid jus dang 'gal ba'i 'dems shog gcig gis khas mi len pa'i lam lugs zer/ 86(nyer lnga)krung dbyang gis rang re'i zhing pa mnyam las sman bcos gsar ba'i lam lugs nang zhugs par srid jus gang dag bton yod/ 86(36ra drug)zhing sde'i mnyam las sman bcos gsar ba'i lam lugs

kyi dngul gsog tshad gzhi ga tshod yin/ 88(nyer bdun)krung dbyang gis zhing sde'i dbul phongs khyim tshang la sman bcos rogs skyob lag bstar byed pa'i srid jus ci yin/ 89(nyer brgyad)krung dbyang gis zhing par dpya khral bcos bsgyur sngon gyi khral dngul chad 'gyangs sdud len byed pa'i thad srid jus ci 'ig bton yod/ 90(nyer dgu)khur bo je yang du gtong ba'i srid jus dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod gang dag la nges par 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded bya dgos/ 91(sum cu) zhing par khral dngul sdud skabs 'dzin yig mi sprod ba'i bya spyod gang la 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded bya dgos/ 91(so gcig)zhing sde'i khral dngul bcos bsgyur srid jus kyi gtan 'bebs dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod gang dag la nges par du 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded bya dgos/ 92(so gnyis)zhing par btsan thabs kyis cha gses rgyag pa'i bya spyod gang dag la 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded bya dgos/ 93(so gsum)khur bo je yang du gtong ba'i srid jus dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod gang dag la chad pa lci mo gcod pa'am yang na chad pa je lci ru gtong dgos/ 94(so bzhi) khur bo je yang du gtong ba'i srid jus dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod gang dag la chad pa yang mo gcod pa'am yang na je yang du gtong ba dang med par gtong dgos/ 95le'u gsum pa/ sde dmangs rang skyong dang sde don spyi bsgrags skor/ 796

(gcig)rang rgyal bca' khrims nang sde dmangs rang skyong gi nang don dang rnam pa gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/ 96(gnyis)sde dmangs u yon lhan khang la sde dmangs la dngul chad gcod pa'i dbang cha yod dam/ 97(gsum) sde dmangs gan rgya gzhir bzung ste sde dmangs la chad gcod byas chog gam/ 98(bzhi)bya spyod gang dag ni sde dmangs kyis thad kur 'dems bsko ’byed pa dang 'gal ba yin/ 98(lnga)sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi skabs brjes rjes skabs sngon mas skabs gsar bar rtsis tho brgyud sprod ma byas na ji ltar bya/ 99(drug)sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi skabs brje 'dems bsko bya bar sus 'go 'dzin bya dgos/ 101(bdun)bdam bya'i 'os mi 'dems bsko'i nang zhugs chog gam/ 102(brgyad)dmigs bsal gnas tshul 'og nas 'dems shog skong mi thub pa dang 'phen mi thub na ji ltar bya/ 103(dgu)'dems dmangs kyis phyed ka mi zin pa'i 'dems shog 'phen thabs der rtsis 'gro yod dam/ 104(bcu)bdam bya'i 'os mir 'dems shog phyed ga'ang mi longs na bdams thon byung thub bam/ 105(bcu gcig)bdams thon byung grangs de dgos nges gdam grangs las nyung na ji ltar bya/ 105(bcu gnyis)bdams thon byung ba'i mi grangs kyis sde dmangs u yon lhan khang 'dzugs pa'i mi grangs mi longs na ji ltar bya/ 1068

(bcu gsum)sde dmangs kyi tsu'u krang chung ba de sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis gtan khel byas chog gam/ 106(bcu bzhi)sde ba'i rtsis gnyer pa de sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gyis gtan khel byas chog gam/ 106(bco lnga)sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gyis rtsis gnyer pa'i 'gan gcig lcogs su 'khur chog gam/ 107(bcu drug)sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi khongs mir gnas tshul gang dag yod tshe sde dmangs kyis las stegs las 'bab pa'i re ba bton chog 107(bcu bdun)sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi khongs mi las stegs las 'bab par gtan 'bebs gang dag yod/ 108(bco brgyad)sde dmangs kyis 'dems bsko byed thabs la rgyab 'gal byas pa'i bya spyod thag gcod par gtan 'bebs gang dag yod/ 109(bcu dgu)sde dmangs rang skyong sgrig lam dang sde dmangs gan rgya gtan la 'bebs na gtan 'bebs gang dag brtsi srung bya dgos/ 111(nyi shu)sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi skabs brjes rjes tham ka brgyud sprod byed par dus tshon gtan khel yod dam/ 112(nyer gcig)sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis sde dmangs kyis khral dngul chad 'gyangs byas par kha g.yar te tham ka ma sprad na chog gam/ 112(nyer gnyis)sde don gang dag nges par du khrims ltar spyi bsgrags bya dgos/ 1139

(nyer gsum)krung dbyang gis sde don spyi bsgrags thad blang bya gang dag bton yod/ 114(nyer bzhi)krung dbyang gis sde don spyi bsgrags lam lugs gang dag 'dzugs pa'i blang bya bton yod/ 116(nyer lnga)zheng sde'i nor don spyi gsal la nang don gang dag 'dus sam 117(nyer drug)sde ba'i nor don spyi gsal byed par dus tshod kyi gtan 'bebs gang dag brtsi srung bya dgos/ 120(nyer bdun)nor don spyi gsal la rnam pa gang dag spyod dgos sam/120(nyer brgyad)sde ba'i nor don spyi gsal byed na go rim gang dag brgyud dgos sam/ 121(nyer dgu)sde ba'i dmangs gtso dngul don do dam tsho chung la lta skul gyi dbang cha gang dag yod dam/ 122(sum cu)sde dmangs la nor don spyi gsal khrod lta skul gyi dbang cha gang dag yod dam/ 122(so gcig)srid gzhung dang 'brel yod sde khag gis sde ba'i nor cisrid spyi gsal byed pa'i bya 'gul khrod las 'gan gang dag 'khur dgos sam/ 123(so gnyis)sde ba'i las byed pas rang gi gnyen tshan la rtsis gnyer pa'i 'gan 'khur du bcug na 'grig gam/ 124le'u bzhi pa/ thon skyed bdag gnyer dang yid rton dngul bun gyi skor gleng ba/ 125(di/ga)rang rgyal gyis deng skabs spyod pa'i zhing las thon skyed

gnyer skyong thad bca' khrims dang khrims srol gang dag yod/125(gnyis)rang re'i zhing par sa bon rdzun ma dang spus zhan las gyong gun bzos na gun gsab ji ltar len dgos/ 130(gsum)rang re'i zhing pa mi sger gyis spyi gnod med pa'i zhing las thon rdzas kyi dpang bsher yi ge re zhu byed thub bam/131(bzhi)rgyal khab kyis zas rigs srog chags la spyad mi chog pa'i phyugs sman dang 'dres sbyor dngos rdzas gang dag gtan khel byas yod dam/ 131(lnga)nga tsho zhing pas mngag tho'i zhing las gong du spel bar gnad don gang dag la do snang byed dgos/ 134(drug)nga tsho zhing pas zhing las khor yug srung skyong thad kyi gtan 'bebs gang dag brtsi srung bya dgos/ 136(bdun)sa khul gang dag nas gang 'dod du sog ma mer bsregs mi chog pa yin/ 138(brgyad)nga tsho zhing pas sman bcos kyi bed med dngos ro nyo 'tshong byas chog gam/ 139(dgu)nga tsho'i zhing pa spun zlas thon skyed dang ar las khrod rig rdzas rnyed na ji ltar bya/ 140(bcu)nga tsho zhing pas thon skyed gnyer skyong byed par gan rgya'i bca' khrims gang dag shes dgos/ 141(bcu gcig)gan rgyar nang don gang dag 'dus dgos/ 142(bcu gnyis)'gyur rten dang mngag rten gnyis la khyad par yod dam/11

145(bcu gsum)〈〈gan rgya'i bca' khrims〉〉nang gan rgya rtsis 'gro med par gtong ba'am yang na gan rgya bsgyur bcos dang rtsis med du gtong bar gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/ 146(bcu ba'i)zhing las 'gan len gan rgya bsgyur bcos dang mtshams 'jog pa'i thad gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/ 148(bco lnga)rang byung gnod 'tshe las gan rgya lag bstar byed mi thub na'ang gan 'gal 'gan 'khri khur dgos sam/ 149(bcu drug)sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gan rgya'i thad nas rtsod gleng byung tshe ji ltar bya dgos/ 150(bcu bdun)thon skyed thon rdzas phyir 'tshong byed na bya spyod gang dag la 'joms dgos/ 150(bco brgyad)rdzun rdzus zhan gsum gyi thon rdzas skyel 'dren dang bdag 'dzin do dam byed pa de yang khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod yin nam/ 151(bcu dgu)nga tsho zhing pa spun zlas sa zhing bed spyod bdag dbang de ma rtsar btang chog gam/ 152(nyi shu)ci zhig la btsan thabs rang bzhin gyis thon rdzas dpang dngos ra sprod pa'i lam lugs zer/ 152(nyer gcig)bya spyod gang dag ni rin gong sger sdom gyi bya spyod la gtogs pa yin nam/ 153(nyer gnyis)rang rgyal zhing sde yid rton dngul bun gyi zhing dud kyi dngul grangs nyung ba'i dngul bun la 'brel yod kyi 12 bca' khrims dang srid jus gang dag yod/ 154lko

(nyer gsum)zhing dud kyi dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun la gzhi rtsa'i srid jus gang dag yod/ 155(nyer bzhi)zhing dud kyi dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun gyi re 'dun zhu na cha rkyen gang dag tshang dgos/ 156(nyer lnga)zhing dud kyi dngul grangs nyung ba'i dngul bun gyi dus yun dang grangs tshad thad bye brag gi gtan 'bebs yod dam/ 157(nyer drug)zhing pa'i dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun gyi skyed ku'i tshad dang sdom rtsis thad gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/ 158(nyer bdun)dmangs khrod nas dngul bun gtong len byed par bca' khrims kyis srung skyong byed dam/ 159(nyer brgyad)skyed ka mtho ba'i dngul bun ji ltar thag gcod dgos/ 160(nyer dgu)skyed ka ma rtsa'i nang bzhag ste yang bskyar skyed ka len pa der bca' khrims kyis srung skyong byed dam/ 161le'u lnga pa/ grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba dang khe dbang srung skyong skor/162(gcig)nga tsho zhing pa grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba'i khe dbang srung skyong thad gzhi 'dzin sa'i khrims yod dam/ 162(gnyis)rang re'i zhing pas sger gnyer khe las nas gla rgyug skabs(ngal rtsol bca' khrims〉spyad 'thus sam/ 164(gsum)skabs 'phral las bzo pas dngos gzhi'i las bzo pa dang 'dra mtshungs kyi thob cha longs su spyad chog gam/ 13

164(bzhi)rgyal khab kyis zhing pa grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba'i tshul min tshad bkag gang dag med par bzo ba'i blang bya bton yod/ 165(lnga)rgyal khab kyis zhing pa las mi'i gla phogs chad 'gyangs dang 'phri gcog byed pa'i gnad don thag gcod par srid jus ci zhig bton yod/ 166(drug)ngal rtsol bca' khrims khrod kyi gla phogs 'phri gcog dngalha rkyen med chad 'gyangs zhes pa'i go don ci yin/ 167(bdun)rang re'i zhing pas sger gnyer khe las nas gla brgyab ste las rmas byung ba'am yang na las rigs nad phog na ji ltar bya/ 169(brgyad)rgyal khab kyis zhing pa las mi'i ngal rtsol gan rgya'i gnad don thad gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/ 169(dgu)rang re'i zhing pa las mis mi bkol sde tshan dang ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog skabs don bya gang dag la do snang byed dgos/ 169(bcu)ar las gan rgyar nang don gang dag 'dus/ 171(bcu gcig)mi bkol sde tshan gyis rang re'i zhing pa las mir gan rgya'i nang shi gson gyi don tshan kha dan byas chog gam/171(bcu gnyis)mi bkol sde tshan la ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog skabs66gta' ma'i dngul mibasdu dbang yod dam/ 173(di/ gsum)rgyal khab kyis ngal rtsol gan rgya'i tshod spyod dus yun

thad gtan 'bebs gang dag byas yod/ 173(bcu bzhi)zhing pa'i gan rgya'i lam lugs kyi las bzo pa'i ngal rtsol gan rgya'i dus yun gtan khel ji ltar bya dgos/ 174(bco lnga)grong khyer dud thor bsgyur ba'i zhing pa'i gan rgya'i lam lugs kyi las bzo pas mi bkol sde tshan dang dus yun gtan khel med pa'i ngal rtsol gan rgya bzhag chog gam/174(bcu drug)khe las de la bstud mar lo bcu yan bya ba bsgrubs pa'i skabs 'phral las bzo pas dus yun gtan khel med pa'i ngal rtsol gan rgya bzhag chog gam/ 175(bcu bdun)rang re'i zhing pa las mi dang mi bkol sde tshan gnyis kyi bar ngal rtsol 'brel ba dngos chags rjes/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis ched mngags ngal rtsol gan rgya mi 'jog par 'gor 'gyangs byas na ji ltar bya/ 175(bco brgyad)mi bkol sde tshan gyis gnas tshul ji 'dra'i 'og ngal rtsol gan rgya med par btang chog 176(bcu dgu)mi bkol sde tshan gyis gnas tshul gang dag 'og ngal rtsol gan rgya med par btang mi chog pa yin/ 177(nyi shu)ngal rtsol par nad byung ba dang gzhung don ched min par rmas skyon phog pa'i sman bcos dus yun gtan khel ji ltar byas yod/ 178(nyer gcigaterang re'i zhing pa las mis gnas tshul gang dag 'og mi bkol sde tshan la ngal rtsol gan rgya med par gtong ba'i brda brgyab chog gam/ 17815

le'u dang po/ sa zhing 'gan gtsang len dang sa zhing do dam skor/(dngapo) rang rgyal gyis deng skabs spyod pa'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len dang do dam skor la bca' khrims dang khrims srol gang dag yod/rang re'i rgyal khab ni khrims lugs kyi rgyal khab cig yin pas/ lugs mthun sgos sa zhing spyod pa dang der gces spras byed pa/ rmo zhing la dngos gnas srung skyong byed pa bcas ni nga tsho'i gzhi rtsa'i rgyal jus yin/ mig sngar/rang re'i rgyal khab kyis deng skabs spyod pa'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len dang do dam skor la bca' khrims dang khrims srol gtso bo 'di dag yod de/ gcig ni rtsa khrims yin/ rtsa khrims ni rgyal khab kyi rtsa ba'i khrims lugs yin pas der bca' khrims kyi nus pa che shos yod pa dang / rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen thog gtan la phab pa zhig yin/ rtsa khrims kyi don tshan dgu pa dang don tshan bcu ba ni sa zhing gi 'brel ba legs sgrig byed pa'i skor la ched du gtan 'bebs byas pa zhig yin/ gnyis ni bca' khrims yin/ de ni rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen nam yang na de'i rgyun las u yon lhan khang gis gtan la phab pa yin/ 〈〈dmangs khrims spyi srol〉〉nang sa zhing rgyu nor skor gyi 'brel ba legs sgrig byed pa'i rtsa ba'i khrims lugs gtan la phab yod/ 〈〈sa zhing do dam skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉nang sa zhing gi 'brel ba legs sgrig byed pa'i skor gyi khrims lugs gtso bo khyon yongs nas gtan la phab yod pa dang / 〈〈zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi ba/'a

khrims〉nang zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byed pa'i 'brel ba legs sgrig byed pa'i skor gyi khrims lugs gtso bo khyon yongs nas gtan la phab yod/gzhan yang /( zhing las skor gyi bca' khrims snya dang (nags tshal skor gyi bca' khrims〉 rtswa thang skor gyi bca' khrims〉 〈chu'i skor gyi bca' khrims 〉〈nya las skor gyi bca' khrims 〉〈sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi rtsa 'dzugs skor gyi bca' khrims 〉〈rin gong gang mthor 'tshong ba'i skor gyi bca' khrims 〉〈gan rgya'i skor gyi bca' khrims〉〈sus 'jon de 'gug dang su 'jon de len skor gyi bca' khrims〉〈grong khyer 'char 'god skor gyi bca' khrims〉〈nyes khrims〉bcas tshang ma tshad mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi 'brel ba legs sgrig byed pa'i nang don dang 'brel yod/ gsum ni srid 'dzin khrims srol te/ de ni rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis rtsa khrims dang bca' khrims nang gtan la phab pa'i dbang mtshams ltar bzos pa ma zad/ rgyal yongs nas lag bstar byas pa red/ dper na rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis khyab bsgrags byas pa'i 〈sa zhing do dam skor gyi bca' khrims lag bstar byed pa'i khrims srol〉dang〈gzhi rtsa'i zhing sa srung skyong byed pa'i skor gyi khrims srol〉〈grong khyer gyi sa khang bdag khongs gsar spel dang gnyer skyong do dam byed pa'i skor gyi khrims srol〉 〈nags tshal skor gyi bca' khrims lag bstar byed pa'i khrims srol〉/〈nags shing dang nags sa'i dbang gtogs tho 'god dang do dam byed thabs〉〈 rmo zhing bdag bzung gron dngul gyi skabs spyod khrims srol〉〈 sa zhing slar slog skor gyi gtan 'bebasasogs 〉lta bu/ bzhi ni sa gnas rang bzhin gyi khrims srol/ de ni zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyi mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen dang de'i rgyun las u sbyan lhan khang gis rtsa khrims dang bca' khrims/ srid 'dzin khrims srol

bcas dang mi 'gal ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen 'og gtan la phab pa zhig ste/rang sa gnas nas spyod pa zhig yin/ dper na hran tung dmangs chen rgyun las u yon lhan khang 'thad pa byung ba'i 〈sa chu srung 'dzin skor gyi bca' khrims lag bstar byed thabs 〉dang 〈sa zhing do dam skor gyi bca' khrims lag bstar byed thabs〉 〈 zhing sde'i thun mong dpal 'byor 'gan len byed pa'i gan rgya dang do dam srol yig〉〈 nags tshal thon khungs do dam skor gyi srol yig〉〈sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi rtsa 'dzugs skor gyi bca' khrims lag bstar byed thabs〉 〈sa zhing tho 'god byed thabs 〉sogs lta bu/ lnga ni sa zhing dang zhing las do dam sde khag gi srid 'dzin sgrig srol yin/ bca' khrims dang khrims srol dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang bcas kyis gtan la phab pa'i dbang mtshams ltar/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi khongs gtogs kyi sa zhing do dam sde khag dang zhing las do dam sde khag gis de'i 'gan dbang gi khyab khongs nang sa zhing do dam dang sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi srid 'dzin sgrig srol dang mdzub ston dang bka' rgya bcas khyab bsgrags byas chog dper na rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs thon khungs sde khag gis khyab bsgrags byas pa'i 〈sa zhing gi spyi'i bed spyod dang spyi'i 'char 'god las kur shugs snon pa'i skor gyi brda tho 〉dang / zhing las pu'u yis khyab bsgrags byas pa'i 〈sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi 'brel ba brtan brling yong ba dang legs bsgyur byed pa'i bsam 'char skor gyi brda tho 〉sogs yod/ drug ni sa gnas srid gzhung gi sgrig srol/'ing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyi srid gzhung gis dbang skur gnang ba ltar sa gnas srid 'dzin gyi sgrig srol gtan 'bebs byas chog pa ste/ dper na hran tung zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gis khyab bsgrags byas pa'i〈〈rmo zhing bdag skyong byed pa'i skor gyi skabs spyod gtan 'bebs〉〉sogs lta bu/ 3

(gnyis) rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims nang zhing pa'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang char gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/〈snang sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan lnga pa'i nang zhing sde'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mir rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis 'gan gtsang sprod byed pa'i zhing sde'i sa zhing khrims ltar 'gan gtsang len byed dbang yod pa dang / rtsa 'dzugs gang zhig dang mi sger su zhig gis zhing sde'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mi'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byed dbang 'phrog bcom dang khrims 'gal gyi sgo nas tshod 'dzin byas mi chog pa gtan la phab yod cing / da dung thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mi ni zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byed pa'i bdag po yin pas/ thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis sa zhing 'gan gtsang sprod byed skabs/ khyim tshang sde tshan yin pa'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs nyid kyi khongs mi re rer bgo skal yod pa dang / 'ing sde'i sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang cha'i mdun du/ thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mi yod do cog la pho mo'i dbye ba dang mi rigs kyi khyad par ci yang med par 'dra mnyam yin/ rtsa 'dzugs gang zhig dang mi sger su jig gis byed thabs ci zhig spyad de kho tsho'i dbang cha 'di 'phrog bcom byas mi chog la/ khrims 'gal gyis kho tshos bdag tu bzung ba'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi dbang char 'gal rkyen bzo ba dang tshod 'dzin byed pa sogs ci yang byas mi chog pa bcas gtan la phab yod/go (gsum) sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byed par go rim gang dag brgyud da sa/〈zhing sde'i sa blang 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan ba/ dgu pa'i nang sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byed par gsham gyi go rim dag

brgyud dgos pa gtan 'bebs byas yod de/(1) rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mi'i sde dbyings dris tshogs las 'gan gtsang len byed pa'i bya ba'i tsho chung 'dems ba bya (1)dri/gan gtsang len gyi bya ba'i tsho chung gis bca' khrims dang khrims srol gyi gtan 'bebs ltar 'gan gtsang len gyi jus gzhi gtan 'bebs byas pa ma zad khyab bsgrags bya dgos/(3) khrims ltar rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor gyi khongs mi'i sde dmangs krolha tshogs 'tshogs te/ 'gan gtsang len gyi jus gzhir gros bsdur ༵ )/snan/ gtsang len gyi jus gzhi spyi bsgrags gyi sgo nas rtsa 'dzugs dang lag bstar bya dgos/(5) 'gan gtsang len byed pa'i gan rgya 'jog dgos/ sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi rtsa don dang don tshan 'di'i gtan 'bebs/ da dung sa gnas so so'i lag len dngos ltar/ sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byed par spyir btang du gsham gyi go rim dag la brtse 'jog bya dgos te/ gcig ni 'gan gtsang len gyi bya ba'i tsho chung 'dems bsko bya ba/ 'gan gtsang len byed pa'i bya ba'i tsho chung ni/ spyir btang du sde tsho'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci dang thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang bcas kyi khongs mi kha shas dang grangs ka nges can gyi sde dam ngas 'thus mi las grub pa zhig yin pa dang / de sde dmangs kyis 'dems bsko bya dgos shing / khongs mi'i bdam bya'i 'os mi 'dems sgrug byed pa'i bye brag gi byed thabs de sa gnas so sos bye brag gi gnas tshul dang zhing pa mang tshogs kyi bsam 'char ltar gtan 'khel byas chog gnyis ni 'gan gtsang len gyi jus ga'i 'god pa ma /da

khyab bsgrags bya dgos/ 'gan gtsang len byed pa'i bya ba'i tsho chung bdams thon byung rjes/ las 'gan gtso bo ni 'gan len gyi jus gzhi 'god pa de yin/ 'gan gtsang len gyi bya ba'i tsho chung gis nges par du 〈zhing sde'i sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims 〉dang 'brel yod kyi bca' khrim sa dang khrims srol bcas la tan tig gis slob sbyong bya dgos pa ma zad/ 'brel yod kyi bca' khrims dang khrims srol ltar 'gan gtsang len gyi jus ga'i 'god pa dang / da dung rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mi'i nang spyi bsgrags byas te/ sde dmangs yongs la 'gan gtsang len gyi jus gzhir rgyus lon byed du 'jug dgos/ 'gan gtsang len gyi jus ga'is bca' khrims dang khrims srol la rgyab 'gal byas mi chog pa dang / sde ba'i sgrig srol dang lugs srol gyis bca' khrims gtan 'bebs kyi tshab byas mi chogagasum ni sde dmangs gros tshogs thog 'gan gtsang len gyi jus gzhir gros bsdur byas te 'thad pa 'byung dgos/ 'gan gtsang len gyi jus gzhi khyab bsgrags byas rjes/ dus tshod nges can 'ig gi nang du nges par du rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mi'i sde dmangs gros tshogs bsdus te/ 'gan gtsang len gyi jus gzhir gros bsdur byas te 'thad pa 'byung dgos/ 'gan gtsang len gyi jus gzhir sde dmangs gros tshogs kyi khongs mi'i sum cha'i gnyis yan dang yang na sde dmangs 'thus mi'i sum cha'i gnyis yan 'thad pa 'byung dgos/ bzhi ni 'gan gtsang len gyi jus ga'i rtsa 'dzugs dang lag bstar bya dgos/ 'gan gtsang len gyi jus gzhi las gtan 'bebs byas pa'i rtsa don dang byed thabs dang blang bya bcas ltar/ sa zhing 'gan gtsang len de zhing khyim re rer thon dgos/ lnga ni 'gan gtsang len gyi gan rgya 'jog dgos/ 'gan gtsang len gyi jus gzhi ltar sa zhing 'dīn gtsang len byas rjes/ sde ba'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs dang

'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gan rgya bzhag ste/'gan gtsang len bya ba yongs 'grub bya dgos/ 'gan gtsang len gyi bye brag gi bya ba de 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi bya ba'i tsho chung gis 'gan 'khur dgos mod/ 'on kyang gan rgya 'jog mkhan ni nges par du 'gan gtsang sprod byed ma khan phyogs yin dgos te/ dus rgyun du thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs yin dgos/ 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyi 'thus mi dus rgyun du thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'gan khur mi sna (cha kha shas su sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin yin pa dang )'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi 'thus mi ni sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i khyim tshang gi khyim bdag yin dgos/ 'gan gtsang len gyi gan rgya'i yi ge de bskyar dpar gsum byas nas 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs dang 'gan gtsang len phyogs gnyis re res gcig re 'dzin dgos pa dang / 'ing sde'i 'gan gtsang len gyi gan rgya'i do dam pu'u yis yig tshags nang gcig nyar tshags bya rgyu/(bzhi) rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims nang sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi dus yun gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/〈ling sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan nyi shu pa'i nang rmo zhing gi 'gan gtsang len dus yun ni lo sum cu dang / rtswa sa'i 'gan gtsang len dus yun ni lo sum cu nas lo lnga bcu bar/ nags sa'i 'gan gtsang len dus yun ni lo sum cu nas lo bdun cu bar bcas gtan 'bebs byas yod/ nags shing khyad par can gyi nags sa'i 'gan gtsang len dus yun de rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nags las srid 'dzin gtso skyong sde khag gis chog mchan bkod rjes dus yun je ring du btang chog bca' khrims kyi gtan 'bebs 'di las 'di ltar dbye ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni ngo bo mi 'dra ba'i sa 'ing la ma dngul gtong ba dang phan cha dang dus bkag brtas

kyi khyad par yod par ga'igs pas/ sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang char sngar bas phan pa yod pa red/(lnga) sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gan rgyar don tshan gang dag 'dus/〈'ang sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan nyer gcig pa'i nang sa zhing 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis nges par du sa zhing 'gan gtsang len phyogs dang yig thog rnam pas 'gan len gan rgya 'jog dgos pa gtan la phab yod cing / 'gan len gan rgyar nges par du gsham gyi don tshan dag 'dus dgos te/(1) 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs dang 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi ming dang / 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyi 'gan khur mi sna'i ming dang 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi 'thus mi'i ming dang sdod gnas bcas 'bri dgos/(2) 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing gi ming dang chags gnas/ rgya khyon/ spus ga'i rim pa bcas 'bri dgos/tshe (3/'a/na gtsang len byas pa'i dus bkag dang mtshams 'jog pa'i zla sa( dī) tāgasna /gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing gi spyod yul gsal por 'bri dgos/(5) 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs dang 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi khe dbang dang 'os 'gan gsal por byed dgos/(6) 'gan 'khri dang 'gal na ji ltar bya dgos pa 'bri dgos/ 'dir lhag tu nan bshad byed dgos pa zhig ni/ 'gan len gan rgya ni 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs dang 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi khe dbang dang 'os 'gan gyi 'brel ba gsal ston byed mkhan zhig yin pa ma zad bca' khrims kyi nus pa ldakā pa'i yig cha 'ig yin la/ 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis khrims ltar thun

mong la dbang ba'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byed pa'i lugs mthun gyi gzhi 'dzin sa dang / do bdag phyogs gnyis kyis khe dbang dang 'os 'gan kha dan byed pa'i 'dzin yig gal chen yang yin/ dud tshang res sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len byas rjes/ nges par du yig thog rnam pa'i gan rgya 'jog dgos/ gal te ngag thog rnam pa'i gan rgya bzhag tshe/ rtsod gleng 'dra byung na phyogs gnyis kyis ngag thog nas bshad pa las 'dzin yig med pas/ bden dpang 'tshol sdud dang 'gan 'khri dbye 'byed byed dka' ba red/ yig thog rnam pa'i gan rgya ba'ag tshe/ do bdag phyogs gnyis kyis tan tig sgos gan rgya lag bstar byed pa dang / phan tshun la lta skul byed par phan pa ma zad/ rtsod gleng 'byung tshe thag gcod byed par yang phan pa yod pa red/(drug) zhing pa grong rdal chung bar gnas spar te khyim gzhis chags pa'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len thad gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/〈'ing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan nyer drug pa'i nang 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i dus yun nang / 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi khyim mi gang bo grong rdal chung bar gnas spar te gzhis chags na/nges par du 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi 'dod mos ltar sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i bdag gnyer dbang cha bskyur ba'am yang na khrims ltar sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed du 'jug dgos/ 1999lor/ krung gung krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis khyab bsgrags byas pa'i 〈grong rdal chung ba skyon bral ngang 'phel bar skul 'ded gtong ba'i skor gyi bsam 'char thor bu〉las gsal bor bstan don/grongaral du gzhis chags pa'i zhing par rang nyid kyi 'dod mos ltar sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha bskyur ba ma zad/ khrims ltar skyin tshab yod pa'i sgo nas skor rgyug byed du 'jug dgos/ 'dir bsdud

pa'i grong rdal chung bar sgrig ga'i tshang ba'i grong rdal dang rdzong rim pa'i grong khyer dang rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sdod gnas grong rdal dang rdzong rim pa man gyi grong rdal chung ba bcas 'dus pa yin/ da dung chus btsugs pa'i grong khyer las gzhan pa'i grong rdal dang grong khyer gzhan pa tshang ma〈zhing sde'i sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan nyer drug pa'i nang gtan la phab pa'i grong rdal chung ba'i khyab khongs nang gtogs pa yin/ rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims nang 'di lta bu'i bkod sgrig byas pa'ang gtso bo grong rdal chung bar song nas thon la sa ang gnyis pa dang gsum par zhugs pa'am yang na zhing las la brel skabs zhing las byed pa dang / zhing las khom skabs su zhing las min pa'i thon las gnyer ba'i zhing pa mang shos shig gi grong rdal chung ba'i bya ba gnas skabs tsam yin pas/ brtan brling min par 'dang brgyab pa red/ mig sngar rang rgyal gyi grong rdal chung ba'i spyi tshogs 'gan srung la ma lugs 'thus tshang min pas/ grong rdal chung bar song ba'i zhing pa bya ba'i dka' khag la 'phrad tshe/ gal te zhing sde ru 'gan gtsang len byed pa'i sa zhing med na/ 'tsho ba'i yongs khungs med par 'gro bas/ spyi tshogs kyi gnad don bzos pa red/ de bas rgyal khab kyi bca' khrim sa las 'gan len dus yun nang 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi khyim mi gang bo grong rdal chung bar song nas gzhis chags na/ 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang bskyur dgos pa'i re 'dun bton na/'ganagatsang sprod phyogs kyis nges par du bskyur ba las phyir sdud mi chog pa dang / 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed 'dod na/ 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis skor skyod byed du 'jug dgos/ 'gan gtsang len phyogs la zhing las min pardi sdus ka dang yang na yong sgo'i 'byung khungs yod de/ 'gan gtsang len

byas pa'i sa zhing phyir sprod 'dod yod tshe/ 'gan gtsang spyod phyogs kyis nges par du dang lhan bya dgos pa ma zad/ khrims ltar sa'an par 'gan len byed du 'ju/ /du/)/ zhing pa chus btsugs pa'i grong khyer du gnas spos ba'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len thad gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/〈'ing sde'i sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan nyer drug pa'i nang 'gan len dus yun nang / 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi khyim mi gang bo chus btsugs pa'i grong khyer ru gnas spos te/ zhing las min pa'i dud thor bsgyur bar/ 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi rmo zhing dang rtswa sa phyir 'asan gtsang sprod phyogs la sprod dgos pa gtan la phab yod/ 'gan satsang len phyogs kyis phyir ma/ sprad na/ 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi rmo 'ing dang rtswa sa phyir sdud byas chog bca' khrim sa kyi don tshan 'di lta bu 'ig gtan 'bebs byas don ni grong khyer ru spyi tshogs 'gan srung lam lugs phal cher btsugs zin pas/ grong khyer ru bskyod pa rnams kyis de 'brel gyi spyi tshogs 'gan srung longs spyod byas chog par dmigs pa yin/'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis gal te sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang cha mu mthud du longs su spyad yo da tshe phyogs gnyis ga'i the phan thob thub mod/ yin na'ang rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor nang khul du gsar du 'phar mi khag gcig la 'debs zhing med pa ma zad/ spyi tshogs 'gan srung yang longs su spyod mi thub pas/ ma/tha' ma ra 'dra mnyam yong mi thug red/der brten/ gnas tshul 'di lta bu'i 'og bca' khrims nang 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis nges par du rmo 'ing dang rtswa sa phyir sprod pa'i blang bya bton yo da/ 'dir mnyam 'jog dgos sa gnyis yod de/ gcig ni 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi khyim mi gang bo chus btsugs pa'i grong khyer ru gnas spos1 ༵ ma

zad/ zhing las min pa'i dud thor bsgyur tshe/ da gzod nges par du 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i rmo 'ing dang rtswa sa phyir 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs la sprod pa dang / kho chos sprad tshe 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis spyod gzod 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi rmo zhing dang rtswa sa phyir sdud chog gnyis ni nges par du phyir sprod dgos pa'i 'gan gtsang len sa zhing la rmo 'ing dang rtswa sa gnyis 'dus pa las/ de'i nang nags sa mi 'dus/mi (brgyad) dud tho dang 'gan gtsang len sa zhing gi 'brel ba ci zhig na/ rang rgyal gyis deng skabs spyod pa'i dud tho'i lam lugs ltar na/ dud tho rang sde bar yod na/ rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mir gtogs/ der brten/ res skor gnyis pa'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len rgyun sring byed skabs/ dud tho 'ing sde ru med na 'gan gtsang len gyi sa zhing med/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis spel ba'i 2001lo'i yig cha ang6pa ste(rgyal sridaspyi khyab khang gis mchan bkod bsgyur sprod byas pa'i spyi bde pu'u yi grong rdal chung ba'i dud tho'i lam lugs bcos bsgyur byed par skul 'ded gtong ba'i bsam 'char skor gyi brda tho〉las grong rdal chung bar gzhis chags par chog mchan thob pa'i mi snas 'bru snum mkho 'don 'brel ba'i 'gro lugs bsgrub mi dgos pa dang / rang nyid kyi 'dod mos ltar/ sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha bskyur chog pa dang / khrims ltar bsgyur sprod byas kyang chog nyapa gtan la phab yod/ de ni deng skabs spyod pa'i〈zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan nyer drug pa'i 'brel yod gtan 'bebs dang gcig mtshungs red/ deng skabs grong khyer dang grong rdal gyi dud thor bsgyur ba yin na/ sde ba'i thun mong dadiX 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing btsan

thabs kyis phyir sdud mi chog(dgu) 'gan gtsang spyod phyogs kyis 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa 'ing legs sgrig byed mi chog pa'i thad nas gtan 'bebs dzi ltar byas yod/sngon chad sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi 'brel ba brtan brling min pa dang / de'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni sa zhing 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis srid 'dzin gyi byed thabs spyad de yang dang bskyar du 'gan gtsang len gyi sa 'ing legs sgrig byas pas/ gnad don mi nyung ba zhig 'khyer yong 'ing zhing par bsam 'char chen po yod pa red/ da dung zhing pas dus yun ring por 'ing las gnyer ba'i brtson sems la phog thug btang ba dang / las byed pa kha shas kyis sa zhing legs sgrig byas par kha g.yar te sger phan blangs pas/'gal rkyen gsar ba bslangs pa red/ der brten/ 〈zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan nyer bdun pa'i nang /'gan len dus yun nang 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis 'gan gtsang len gyi sa 'ing legs sgrig byas mi chog pa gtan la phab yod/ dus mtshungs su 'gan len dus yun nang / rang byung gnod 'tshe las 'gan gtsang len sa zhing la sator brlag tshabs chen bzos pa sogs dmigs bsal gnas tshul 'og zhing dud kha shas bar 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i rmo zhing dang rtswa sa 'os 'tshams sgos legs sgrig byed dgos na/ nges par du rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mis sde dmangs gros tshogs 'tshogs te khongs mi'i sum cha'i gnyis yan dang yang na sde dmangs 'thus mi'i sum cha'i gnyis yan 'thad pa byung ba ma zad/ 'ang(grong rdal )mi dmangs srid gzhung dang rdzong rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'ing las sogs srid 'dzin gtso skyong sde khrag la yar zhu byas te chog mchan 'god dgos/ 'gan len gan rgya'i nang legs sgrig byas mi chog pa'i kha dan bzhag yod na/ de ltar bsgrub da/lha pa

bcas gtan la phab yod/ bca' khrims kyi gtan 'bebs 'di ltar na/gcig ni 'gan len dus yun nang 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis rtsa don steng nas 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa 'ing legs sgrig byas mi chog deng phyin mi sa'i bar 'gal ba byung tshe/ gtso bo nges par du bskyur yod pa'i sa zhing dang /khrims ltar sa rgod slog pa'i sa zhing / 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis rang mos sgos phyir sprad pa'i sa 'ing / khrims ltar sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed pa sogs thabs lam la brten nas thag gcod pa las/ srid 'dzin gyi byed thabs la brten nas 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing legs sgrig byas mi chog gnyis ni dmigs gyi gnas tshul 'og legs sgrig byed dgos na nges par du khrims ltar legs sgrig byed dgos/(1) rang byung gnod 'tshe byung ba sogs dmigs bsal gnas tshul 'og da gzod 'gan gtsang len gyi sa zhing kha shas legs sgrig byas chogadamigs bsal gyi gnas tshul ci lta bu zhig yin par yang khrims ltar 'grel ba nan po brgyag pa las/ rang 'dod sgos 'grel ba brgyab mi chog(2) khyim tshang kha shas bar legs sgrig byas pa las/ khyab khongs rgya bskyed de legs sgrig byas mi chog(3) legs sgrig byas chog pa'i sa cing 'asan gtsang len la rmo zhing dang rtswa sa las nags sa mi 'dus/(4) legs sgrig kha shas kyis nges par du bca' khrims dang khrims srol gyi go rim la brtsi srung nan mo byed dgos pa ste/ thog mar nges par du rang re'i thun mo nga dpal 'byor khongs mi'i sde dmangs gros tshogs kyi sum cha'i gnyis yan dang yang na sde dmangs 'thus mi'i sum cha'i gnyis yan 'thad pa byung dgos pa dang / 'ang(grong rdal)mi dmangs srid gzhung la yar zhu byas te /sdu mchan bkod rjes/ rdzong rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gi zhing las

srid 'dzin gtso skyong sde khag la yar zhu byas te chog mchan 'god du 'jug dgos/ gsum ni 'gan len gan rgya de kha dan byas zin pa'i 'gan len gan rgya'i dus yun nang legs sgrig byas mi chog pa dang / rgyu rkyen gang rung la brten nas 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa 'ing legs sgrig kyang byas mi chog(bcu) tang dang rgyal khab kyis zhing sde'i bud med kyi 'gan gtsang len sa zhing la srung skyong byed pa'i thad nas gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod tang dang rgyal khab kyis zhing sde'i bud med kyi 'gan gtsang len sa 'ing la srung skyong byed par sngar nas gtsigs mthong chen po byas pa red/2001lo'i zla1par/ krung gung krung dbyang gzhung las thing dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gzhung las thing gnyis kyis〈zhing sde'i bud med kyi sa zhing 'gan gtsang len khe dbang la srung skyob byed pa'i skor gyi brda tho〉ste 2001lo'i gzhung las thing gyi yig cha ang9pa bkram te/ 'ing sde'i bud med kyi 'gan gtsang len sa zhing srung skyob byed pa'i dgos gal rang bzhin la ngos zin thob tshad mthor 'degs bya dgos pa'i blang bya bton yod/ da dung zhing sde'i sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i khrod/ pho mo 'dra mnyam yin pa'i rtsa don nges par du rgyun srung bya rgyu dang / bud med la snang chung byed pa'i lta stangs ci yang 'dzin ma chog pa nan gyis bstan yod/ bud med kyi khe dbang srung skyong byed pa'i skor gyi bca' khrims kyi don tshan sum cu pa'i nang / zhing sde ru 'gan 'khri'i sa zhing dang bza' 'bru'i dmigs zhing sogs dang / da dung chog mchan bkod pa'i khang sa sogs dbye bgo byas yod par/ bud med dang skyes pas khe dbang 'dra mnyam sgos longs spyod byed pa las/ bud med kyi lugs mthun khe dbang la gnod 'tshe btang mi chog pa gtan la phab yod/ zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrimasakyi don tshan drug pa'i nang /zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byed par bud med dang skyes pas1 /dra

mnyam gyi khe dbang longs su spyod dgos pa dang / 'gan len byed pa'i khrod nges par du bud med kyi lugs mthun khe dbang srung skyong byed dgos pa dang /rtsa 'dzugs gang 'ig dang mi sger su zhig gis bud med kyis longs su spyod 'os pa'i sa ling 'gan gtsang len gyi dbang cha 'phrog bcom dang der gnod 'tshe btang mi chog pa gtan la phab yod/ sa cha kha shas su sa zhing 'gan gtsang len khrod tshad mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas bud med la snang chung byed pa dang / bud med kyi khe dbang la gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i gnad don yo da par dmigs nas bca' khrims kyi don tshan 'di gtan la phab pa zhig red/ zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrimasakyi don tshan sum cu pa'i nang / 'gan len dus yun nang / bud med su zhig gnyen sgrig byas te/ gnas sa nas 'gan gtsang len gyi sa zhing ma blangs pa'i sngon du/ 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis de'i 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing phyir sdud mi chog bud med su cig bza' tshang kha bral ba'am yang na khyo ga tshe las 'das te/ sngar rang sdod gnas la 'tsho bar rol ba'am yang na sngar sdod gnas la ma sdad na'ang gnas sa nas 'gan gtsang len gyi sa cing blangs med na/ 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis de'i sngar 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing phyir sdud mi chog pa gtan la phab yod/ krung dbyang gis byed thabs ci zhig spyad kyang rung / 'ing sde'i gnas yul 'grims pa'i bud med la 'gan gtsang len gyi sa zhing yod par khag theg byed dgos pa dang / bu las bu mo med pa dang / bur sri zhu sgrub pa'i nas pa med pa'am yang na bu mos sri zhu'i 'os 'gan 'khur dgos pa'i khyim tshang dang / skyes pa mo khyim la yong ste thon skyed dang 'tsho ba rol ba bcas kyis sde dmangs dang 'dra mnyam yin pa'i thob cha longs su spyod dgos pa nan gyis bstan yod/16

(bcu gcig) 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing rgyun 'dzin byas chog gam/thog mar/ 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa 'ing rgyun 'dzin skor gyi gnad don la nges par du bye brag gi gnad don la bye brag gis dbye 'ib byas pa ltar/ 〈zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrim/sa〉kyi don tshan bco lnga pa'i nang / khyim tshang gis 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i 'gan gtsang len phyogs ni rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor gyi zhing dud yin pa gtan la phab yod/ don tshan 'di'i gtan 'bebs la gzhigs na/ khyim tshang gis 'gan gtsang len byas pa ni khyim tshang sde tshan byas te sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang cha blangs pa yin pas/ 'gan len dus yun nang khyim tshang gi mi su dang khongs mi su zhig shi na'ang des sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha de rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i thad gnad don mi thon pa byed dgos/ khyim mi gang bo shi tshe sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi dbang cha med par bzo dgos pa ste/ 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing phyir sdud dgos/ 〈zhing sde'i sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan lnga pa'i nang / zhing sde'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mir khrims ltar rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis 'gan gtsang sprod byas pa'i zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byed pa'i dbang cha yod pa dang / rtsa 'dzugs gang zhig dang mi sger su zhig gis zhing sde'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mi'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len dbang cha 'phrog pa dang khrims 'gal ngang tshod 'dzin byas mi chog pa gtan la phab yod/ bca' khrims kyi don tshan 'dir gzhigs na/ zhing sde'i thun mong dpal 'byor sde ba'i nang khul gyi mi re rer skal yod pa'i khyim tshang gi 'gan gtsang len ni zhing sde'i thun mong dpyal

'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mi'i khe dbang 'ig yin pas/ sngar 'gan gtsang len byed ma khan gyi mi shi tshe/ 'gan gtsang len bya 'thus kyi thob thang yod pa'i rgyun 'dzin mkhan gyis spyod gzod sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha rgyun 'dzin byas chog pa dang / rgyun 'dzin mkhan de thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mi min na/ sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha'i rgyun 'dzin khe dbang lo ngas su spya da mi chog de ltar byas na de min khongs mi ga'an pa'i khe dbang la gnod 'tshe bzo srid/〈zhing sde'i sa cing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan so gcig pa'i nang / nab/sa sa 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i 'gan len mi sna shi tshe/ de'i rgyun 'dzin mkhan gyis 'gan len dus yun nang 'gan len rgyun 'dzin byas chog pa gtan la phab yod/ 'di gtso bor nags sar ma rtsa ba'ag pa'i dus yun ring ba dang phan 'bras thon tshad dal ba'i khyad par can gyi rang bzhin la dmigs pa yin/ 'di nas lhag tu nan bshad byed dgos pa 'ig ni/khyim tshang gis 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i nags sa de rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mi yin kyang min kyang rung / 'gan len dus yun nang tshang mas 'gan len rgyun 'dzin byas chog gnyis nas 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i phan 'bras skor te/ 'ing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims kyi don tshan so gcig pa'i nang / 'gan gtsang len byed mkhan la 'thob 'os pa'i 'gan len gyi phan 'bras de rgyun 'dzin bca' khrims kyi gtan 'bebs ltar rgyun 'dzin bya dgos pa gtan la phab yod/gtan 'bebs 'dis gtso bor 'gan len mkhan gyi 'gan len phan 'bras de de'i shul rdzas la gtogs pas/ nges par du rgyun 'dzin bca' khrims kyi gtan 'bebs ltar rgyun 'dzin bya dgos par dmigs pa yin/18

(bcu gnyis) slob grwa chen mo'i nang rgyugs 'phrod pa'i zhing sde'i slob mar 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing mu mthud du bskyur ram/〈dmangs khrims spyi srol〉dang rgyal khab kyi 'brel yod yig cha'i dgongs don ltar na/ slob grwa che ba dang ched tshan slob grwa chen mo ru rgyugs 'phrod pa'i zhing sde'i slob ma slob grwa ru sdod pa'i skabs der/ gtso bor khyim tshang gis gso skyong byed bzhin pa ma zad/ slob sbyong gi gron dngul cung mtho la / khyim tshang mang shos kyi yong sgo'i 'byung khungs yang gtso bor 'gan gtsang len gyi sa zhing gnyer skyong byas par brten yod/ kho tsho'i 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing de nges par du〈zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi 'gan len dus yu na nang / 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing phyir sdud mi chog mipa'i skor gyi bca' khrims gtan 'bebs dang krung dbyang gi mi je mang du song rung sa zhing je mang du mi gtong ba dang / mi je nyung du song rung sa zhing je nyung du mi gtong ba'i skor gyi srid jus gtan 'bebs ltar/ kho tsho'i 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing rang 'jags dgos/ gtan 'bebs 'di'ang ha cang lugs dang mthun pa zhig red/ yin na'ang kho tsho mthar phyin rjes 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa 'ing mu mthud du su 'jog gam yang na phyir sdud pa'i gnad don gyi skor de nga tshos logs su bkar nas bshad pa'i dgos pa che ste/ gal te kho tsho mthar phyin rjes grong khyer la gnas spos ba dang / ltos bcas kyis brtan 'jags kyi bya ba dang dpal 'byor yong sgo yod la/ pha ma'i gso skyong la brten mi dgos pa dang / 'gan len gan rgya'i dus yun lon tshe/ nges par du de'i 'gan gtsang len sa zhing phyir sdu dgos/ gal te kho tsho mthar phyin rjes phyir rang yul la log pa dang / yang na grong khyer ru las rgyug pa mi tsam la sa/ brtan 'jags kyi bya ba dang dpal 'byor yong sgo med cing / ༵༵na

len gan rgya'i dus yun yang lon med tshe/ kho tsho'i 'gan gtsang len sa zhing mu mthud du kho tshor 'jog dgos/(bcu gsum) sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed par rtsa don gang dag brtsi srung bya dgos/〈zhing sde'i sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan so gsum pa'i nang / tsa sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed par nges par du gsham gyi rtsa don dag brtsi srung bya dgos te/(gcig)'dra mnyam sgos gros mol byas pa dang rang mos yin pa/ rin tshab yod pa bcas kyi sgo nas skor skyod byed dgos la/ rtsa 'dzugs gang zhig dang mi sger su zhig gis 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed par btsan gnon dang bkag 'gog byas mi chog (gnyis)sa zhing bdag dbang gi ngo bo dang sa zhing gi zhing las spyod sgo bsgyur bcos byas mi chog (bzhi)skor skyod kyi dus yun de 'gan len dus yun gyi lhag 'phro'i dus yun las brgal mi chog (bzhi)skor skyod dang len byed mkhan la nges par du zhing las gnyer skyong byed pa'i nus pa ldan dgos/ (lnga)cha rkyen 'dra mtshungs kyi 'og tu/ rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mir sngon thob dbang cha yod pa bcas gtan la phab yod/ bca' khrims kyi gtan 'bebs 'dir gzhigs na/ sa zhing skor skyod thad kyi rtsa don rgyun srung byed par nges par du gsham gyi gnad don 'gar do snang byed dgos te/ gcig ni 'dra mnyam sgos gros sol byas ṅgi dang /dī mo/ yin pa/ rin tshab yod pa bcas yin/ der bye brag gis go na ba(1 )da skor/ skyod byed pa'i do bdag phyogs gnyis ka 'dra mnyam gyi da~Xs don gtso bdag gi 'brel ba yin dgos pa dang / skor skyod kyi rnam

pa dang nang don/ cha rkyen dang dus yun sogs phyogs gnyis gas gros mol byas te( sgri/nado khe drodapa gyu/gas gnyis ka rang mos yin pa dang / pha rol pos btsan gnon dang yang na btsan skul byas mi chog(3) sa cing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed na/ 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis nges par du thob cha len dgos pa dang / thob cha'i grangs 'bor dang ster sprod kyi dus tshod dang rnam pa sogs ni phyogs gnyis gas gros mol byas te gtan khel bya rgyu/(4) rtsa 'dzugs gang 'ig dang mi sger su zhig yang na 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs dang zhang(grong rdal)mi dmangs srid gzhung dang de'i las byed mi sna tshang mas btsan gnon dang the gtogs byas mi chog gnyis ni sa zhing bdag dbang dang 'ing bkol sa ling gi spyod sgo bsgyur mi chog gsum ni skor skyod kyi dus yun de nges par du 'gan len dus yun nang khul du gtan khel bya rgyu/ skor skyod gan rgya'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i skor skyod dus yun de 'gan len gan rgya'i nang lag bstar ma byas pa'i lhag 'phro'i dus yun las brgal mi chog ste/ 'gan len gan rgya bzhag pa nas brtsis pa'i 'das song gi dus tshod 'then dgos/ dper na/ lo30yi 'gan len gan rgya bzhag ste lo16'gor rjes skor skyod byas tshe/ skor skyod kyi dus yun de 'phro ma'i lo14las brgal mi chog pa ste/ sngar 'gan len gan rgya'i dus tshod lhag ma der brten pa yin/ bzhi ni skor skyod de gtso bor zhing pa'i khyim tshang bar skor skyod byas pa yin pas skor skyod dang len mkhan la zhing las gnyer skyong byed pa'i nus pa yod dgos/ lnga ni cha rkyen 'dra mtshungs kyi 'og tu rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mir sngon thob dbang cha yod dgos/ sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed par da~X spyan

mkhan gnyis yan yod pa dang / skor skyod kyi gron dngul dang dus yun dang nang don sogs kyi phyogs nas cha rkyen 'dra mtshungs yin na/ rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mir nges par du sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang cha thob dgos pa dang / de ni thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mis sa zhing khe dbang longs spyod byed par srung skyod byed pa dang / skor skyod byas pa las sa zhing rtsod gleng mi 'byung ba'i ched du na/(bcu bzhi) spyod stangs gang dag ni sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed pa'i khrod dbang char btsan 'dzul byas pa dang khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod yin/sa gnas kha shas kyis sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed pa'i khrod zhing pa'i lugs mthun khe dbang la gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i snang tshul yod par gzhigs nas/ (zhing sde'i sa mang 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan so lnga pa'i nang / smyo 'gan len dus yun nang / 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis rang phyogs kho nas 'gan len gan rgya med par btang mi chog pa dang / mang kha nyung len la kha g.yar te 'gan gtsang len phyogs la btsan shugs kyis bskyur du 'jug pa'am yang na sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang cha bsgyur bcos byed du bcug mi chog la/ bza' 'bru'i dmigs 'ing dang 'gan 'khri'i sa zhingasogs la kha g.yar te 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing phyir bsdus pa dang sus 'jon de 'gug dang sgrub 'gan gtsang len bcas byas mi chog pa/ 'gan gtsang len gyi sa zhing phyir bsdus te dngul chad kyi tshab byas mi chog pa bcas gtan la phab yod/ bca' khrims 'dir gzhigs na/ gsham gyi sgrub stangs bzhi'i bo/ ༵ zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed

pa'i khrod 'ing pa'i khe dbang la gnod 'tshe thebs pa dang bca' khrims khrims sro la dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod la gtogs pa ste/ gcig ni rang phyogs kho na ste lhag pa ra du 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis 'gan len gan rgya med par bzos pa/ gnyis ni mang kha nyung len la kha g.yar te 'gan gtsang len phyogs la sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha bskyur ba'am yang na bsgyur bkod byed du 'jug pa/ gsum ni bza' 'bru'i dmigs zhing che 'gan 'khri'i sa 'ing sogs la dbye bar kha g.yar te 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa 'ing phyir bsdus pa dang sus 'jon de 'gug dang sgrub 'gan gtsang len byas pa/ 1997lor/ krung dbyang gis krung dbyang gis zhing gnyis la ma lugs milag bstar dang dar spel du mi gtong bas/ /zhing gnyis lam 'u gas lag bstar byas med pa'i sa khul gyis lag bstar mi byed pa dang /lag bstar byas zin pa yis nges par du krung dbyang gi sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi srid jus ltar tan tig gis dag ther bya dgos pa gtan la phab yod/ba'i ni 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa cing phyir bsdus te chad dngul gyi tshab byed pa/ 'gan gtsang len khyim tshang gis thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs la chad dngul yod pa dang / phyir skyin tshab sprod pa'i nus pa yod na/ nges par du dus bkag ltar phyir sprod dgos/ gtan nas phyir mi sprod na/ 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis khrims ltar mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug byas chog 'gan gtsang len khyim tshang la dpal 'byor gyi dka' khag yod pas skyin tshab sprod thabs med na/ 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis byed thabs spyad de 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi dka' khag thag gcod byas chog mod/ yin na'ang 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing phyir bsdus te chad dngul gyi tshab byas te kho tsho'i dka' khag je lci ru btang mi chog gong gi spyod stangs bzhi bo rmi sa cha kha shas kyis sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong da~X cha

skor skyod byed pa'i khrod ling pa'i khe dbang la gnod 'tshe btang ba dang bca' khrims khrims srol dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod yin pas/ nges par du khrim sa ltar 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded bya rgyu/(bco lnga) sde dmangs yu yon lhan khang gis zhing dud kyi sa zhing skor skyod byed pa'i phan khe blangs chog gam/mi chog ste/ 〈ling sde'i sa cing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan so drug pa'i nang / smyo sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha bshug sprod 'gan len byed pa'i gron dngul dang bogs dngul/bshug sprod gron dngul sogs ni nges par du do bdag phyogs gnyis kyis gros mol byas te gtan khel bya dgos/ skor skyod byas pa'i phan khe yod tshad 'gan gtsang len phyogs la dbang ba dang / rtsa 'dzugs gang 'ig dang mi sger su 'ig gis bkag nyar dang 'then 'jal byas mi chog pa gtan la phab yod/〈zhing sde'i sa cing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan nga brgyad pa'i nang / zu rtsa 'dzugs gang zhig dang mi sger su 'ig gis rang 'dod sgos sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed pa'i phan khe bkag nyar dang 'then 'jal byas mi chog la/ gal te byas tshe nges par du phyir sprod rgyu gtan la phab yod/ gtan 'bebs 'di dag la gzhigs nas/ sa zhing skor skyod byed pa'i do bdag phyogs gnyis ni 'dra mnyam gyi dmangs don gtso bdag yin pas/ mnyam du sa zhing skor skyod byed pa'i bye brag gi rin 'bab dang gtong sprod kyi dus tshod/ gtong sprod kyi rnam pa bcas gtan khel byed mkhan yin la/ gzhan pa'i rtsa 'dzugs gang 'ig dang mi sger su zhig gis btsan thabs sgos phyogs gcig la dang len byed du 'jug pa'am yang na phyogs gnyis gas gtan khel byas pa'i skor skyod kyi rin 'a~X khas len byed du mi 'jug pa bcas byas mi chog skor skyod kyi khe phan

de rnam pa mi 'dra ba 'gas mtshon pa ste/ bshug sprod 'gan len byas pa'i bshug sprod 'gan len gyi gron dngul dang / bogs gtong byas pa'i bosas dngul/ bshug sprod byas pa'i bshug sprod gron dngul dang / ma rkang ba'ag pa'i ma rkang gi khe 'bab bgos pa la sa thob pa'i ma dngul bcas yo da/ khe phan 'di dag nges par du 'gan gtsang len phyogs la dbang dgos shing / de las ga'an pa'i rtsa 'dzugs dang mi sger su zhig gis rang 'dod sgos 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha bkag nyar dang 'then 'jal byas mi chog sde dmangs u yon lhan khang 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs yin na'ang / 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi 'ing pa'i dud tshardo gi sdir skyod khe phan blangs mi chog la/ gal te blangs zin tshe/ nges par du (ba/ drur+sha shā/rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims nang sa zhing skor skyod byed pa'i gan rgya 'jog par gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/〈〈zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉kyi don tshan so bdun pa'i khod tshan dang po'i nang / ra sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed par bshug sprod 'gan len dang bogs gtong / phan tshun brje ba/ bshug sprod dang yang na rnam pa gzhan pa ltar skor skyod byed pa'i byed thabs spyad tshe/ do bdag phyogs gnyis kyis nges par du yig thog rnam pa'i gan rgya 'jog dgos/ bshug sprod kyi rnam pa spyad de skor skyod byas na/ nges par du 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs 'thad pa byung dgos pa dang / bshug sprod 'gan len dang bogs gtong / phan tshun brje ba'am yang na gzhan pa'i rnam pa ltar skor skyod byas na/ nges par du 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs la 'char zin yar zhu bya dgos pa gtan la phab yod/ gtan 'bebs 'dir gzhigs nas/ sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sdusar

skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed skabs/ thog mar/ nges par du yig thog rnam pa'i gan rgya 'jog dgos/ sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed pa de do bdag phyogs gnyis kur 'brel ba yo da la/tha na do bdag phyogs gsum pa'i khe phan la'ang 'brel ba yod pas/ dang len mkhan la sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang cha thob pa ma zad 'gan len sa zhing bdag bzung dang skor skyod byed skabs/ do bdag gi khe dbang la khag theg byed pa dang / deng phyin thon srid pa'i rtsod gleng thag gcod par bden dpang 'don sprod bya ched/ sa ling 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed skabs do bdag phyogs gnyis kyis nges par du yig thog rnam pa'i gan rgya 'jog dgos/ gnyis nas 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs 'thad pa byung ba'am yang na 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs la 'char zin sprod rgyu/ sa cing 'gan gtsang len byas rjes/ 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis 'gan gtsang len phyogs la gan rgya'i 'os 'gan lag bstar bya rgyu'i skul 'ded byed dbang yod pas/ sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha bsgyur bkod byas tshul shes pa'i dgos pa yod la/'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis sa ling 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byas na/ nges par du 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs la gnas tshul rgyus lon byed du 'jug dgos/ gcig ni bshug sprod 'gan len dang bogs gtong / phan tshun brje ba/ ma rkang 'jog pa sogs kyi rnam pa spyad de skor skyod byas na/ 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis khrims ltar skor skyod byas rjes nges par 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs la 'char zin yar sprod bya rgyu/ gnyis ni bshug sprod rnam pas skor skyod byas na/ 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs 'thad pa byung ba brgyud spyod gzod skor skyod bya rgyu/'dī /sa nan bshad byed dgos pa zhig ni/ 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs la

'char zin yar zhu byed na'ang 'dra/ 'gan gtsang len phyogs 'thad pa byung du 'jug na'ang 'dra/ tshang mar nges par du yig thog rnam pas gan rgya bzhag ste/ slad phyin rtsod gleng 'dra byung tshe nam yang bden dpang yod par bya rgyu/(bcu bdun) sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed pa'i gan rgyar nang don gang dag 'dus yod/〈〈'ing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉kyi don tshan so bdun pa'i khod tshan gnyis pa'i nang / sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer /nga dbang cha skor skyod byed pa'i gan rgyar gsham gyi khod tshan dag 'dus (1/) do bdag phyogs gnyis ga'i ming dang sdod gnas dang /(shā) skobye /da byed pa'i sa zhing gi ming dang chags gnas/ rgya khyon/spus ga( 3)rnyi ra skyo/ rnyi/da pa'i dus yun dang mtshams 'jog pa'i dus chod/(4) skor skyod byed pa'i sa zhing gi spyod sgo/(5) do bdag phyogs gnyis kyi khe dbang dang 'os 'gan/(6) skor skyod byed pa'i rin 'bab dang gtong sprod byed stangs/(7) khrims 'gal 'gan 'khri/ 'di nas bstan dgos pa zhig ni/skor skyod byed pa'i dus yun de 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i lhag 'phro'i dus yun las brgal mi rung ('gan gtsang len byas pa'i 'gan len dus yun nang rdokā bstar byas zin pa'i dus tshod 'then rjes lhag ma'i dus tshod kyi dus yun (37 brgyad) rang khrim gyi 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing sde ba gzhan pa'i sde mir bshug spyod 'gan len dang bogs gtong byas chog gam/byas chog ste/ 〈zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi ༵༵'a

khrims〉kyi don tshan so dgu pa'i khod tshan dang po'i nang / 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis dus yun nges can zhig gi nang sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha kha shas sam yang na tshang ma phyogs gsum par bshug sprod 'gan len nam yang na bogs gtong byas chog pa dang / de lta na'ang 'gan gtsang len phyogs dang 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyi 'gan len 'brel ba mi 'gyur ba gtan la phab yod/ gtan 'bebs 'dir ga'igs nas/ dang len byed mkhan gyi phyogs nas bltas na/ phyogs gsum pa de rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mi yin chog la/ sde tshan dang mi sger gzhan pa yin yang chog mod/ 'on kyang mnyam 'jog dgos sa 'ig ni/ sa zhing bshug sprod 'gan len byas pa'am yang na bogs gtong byas rjes/'gan gtsang len phyogs dang 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyi 'gan len 'brel ba mi 'gyur/ yang gcig bshad na/ gal te khyod kyis 'gan gtsang len sa zhing de sde ba gzhan pa'i mir bshug sprod 'gan len dang yang na bogs gtong byas na'ang / khyod dang rang sde ba'i 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyi 'gan len 'brel ba de mi 'gyur zhing / khyod kyis nges par du sngar bzhin rang sde ba'i 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs la bzhag pa'i kha dan 'os 'gan lag len bya rgyu dang /khrims ltar 'brel yod dpya khral gyi 'os 'gan 'khur rgyu/ khyod kyis kyang phyogs gsum pa dang bshug sprod 'gan len dang bogs gtong byed pa'i gan rgya'i steng des khyed kyi tshab byas te 'khur 'os pa'i 'os 'gan 'khur ba'i kha dan bzhag chog de las shes thub pa ni/ sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i bdag gnyer dbang cha bshug sprod 'gan len dang bogs gtong byas na/ do bdag phyogs gnyis kyis nges par du yig thog rnam pa'i gan rgya bzhag ste/rang so so'i khe dbang dang 'os 'gan gsal bor byed dgos pa dang / 'gan ga~X len sa zhing gi dpya khral khur bo ji ltar dbye bgo byed pa gsal bor

bshad de/ rjes kyi rtsod gleng mi 'byang ba bya rgyu/(bcu dgu) 'gan gtsang blon sa zhing bshug sprod byas na gnad don gang dpya kā rdo ṭā kā nākā kār+shadi/ gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan zhe gcig pa'i nang / 'gan gtsang len phyogs la zhing las min pa'i las rigs sam yang na yong sgo'i 'byung khungs brtan po zhig yod tshe/ 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs 'thad pa byung ba brgyud/ sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha kha shas sam yang na tshang ma ga'an pa'i zhing las thon skyed gnyer mkhan gyi zhing khyim la bshug sprod byas chog la/ zhing khyim 'di dang 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs la 'gan len 'brel ba gsar ba zhig 'dzugs dgos pa dang / sngar gyi 'gan gtsang len phyogs dang 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis sa 'ing 'di'i stong gi 'gan len 'brel ba mtshams 'jog dgos pa gtan 'bebs byas yod/ gtan 'bebs 'dir ga'igs tshe/ bca' khrims nang 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis rang bdag sgos sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha bshug sprod byas chog pa red/ yin na'ang sa cing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer dbang skyong cha bshug sprod byed pa'i cha rkyen la do snang byed dgos te/ gsham gyi cha rkyen 'di dag dang mthun tshe spyod gzod bshug sprod byas chog gcig ni 'gan gtsang len phyogs la nges par du zhing las min pa'i las rigs sam yang na yong sgo'i 'byung khungs brtan po zhig yod dgos/ 'di ni gtso bor dbul phongs zhing khyim kha shas kyis kha tsha dgos gtug sgos khral don 'jal dgos pa sogs rgyu rkyen gyi dbang gis rang nyid kyi 'tsho rten te sa zhing bshug sprod byas pas/'tsho ba'i 'gan srung med pa dang las rigs med pa'i mi 'khyar par gyur bar dmigs pa red/ der brten/ bca' khrims nang 'gan gtsang len spra/sa

la cing las min pa'i las rigs sam yang na gzhan pa'i 'tsho ba'i 'byung khungs brtan po zhig yod pa'i cha rkyen 'og da gzod de'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha bshug sprod byas chog pa gtan 'bebs byas yod/ gnyis ni nges par du 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs 'thad pa byung dgos/ sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha bshug sprod byas rjes/ 'gan gtsang len phyogs dang 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis sa ling de'i steng gi 'gan len 'brel ba dang 'brel yod kyi khe dbang dang 'os 'gan bcas kyi mtshams 'jog dgos pa ma zad/ dang len byed ma khan phyogs dang 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis 'gan len 'brel ba gsar ba 'dzugs dgos/ 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs 'thad pa ma byung bar sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha bshug sprod byas tshe/ 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyi khe dbang la 'gan srung thob dka' ba red/ da dung / 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs 'thad pa byung ba brgyud/'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis khral don sogs rgyu rkyen gyi dbang gis/ sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha bshug sprod byas te/ khyim tshang gi 'tsho bar shugs rkyen thebs su mi 'jug pa byas chog 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis nges par du 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi skor skyod 'dod mos la brtsi 'jog bya rgyu dang / 'dir kha g.yar te 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis khrims ltar sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i bdag gnyer dbang cha bshug sprod byed par bkag 'gog byas mi chog gsum ni dang len mkhan ni nges par du zhing las thon skyed gnyer mkhan gyi zhing khyim yin dgos/ tshad bkag 'di'i cha rkyen la nang don gnyis 'dus te/ gcig ni bshug sprod byed pa'i dang len mkhan ni nges par du zhing las thon skyed gnyer mkhan gyi zhing khyim yi/ ༵ las/ bzo las sogs thon las gzhan pa gnyer mkhan yin mi chog pa

ste/ bzo tshong khe las sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha dang len mkhan du 'gyur mi thub/ gnyis ni dang len mkhan ni nges par du 'ing khyim yin pa las/ sde tshan dang mi sger gzhan pa dang len mkhan du 'gyur mi thub/ mjug mthar nan bshad byed dgos pa zhig ni/ sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i bdag gnyer dbang cha bshug sprod byas rjes/ do bdag gis tho 'god byed pa'i re ba bton na/ tho 'god yar zhu byas chogatho 'god ma byas na/ phyogs gsum par 'gran rgol dang yag yag byas mi chog(nyi shu) 'gan gtsang len sa zhing ma rkang du bzhag nas khe las sgrub chog gam/chog mod/ 'on kyang nges par du zhing las mnyam las thon skyed gnyer mkhan yin pa las/ bzo tshong las gnyer skyong byed mkhan yin mi chog〈mang sde'i sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan zhe gnyis pa'i nang / 66'gan gtsang len so po'i bar la zhing las dpal 'byor gong du spel ched/ rang mos mnyam 'brel sgos sa zhing 'gan len gnyer skyong ma rkang du bzhag nas/ zhing las mnyam las thon skyed kyi bya las sgrub chog pa gtan la phab yod/ don tshan 'dis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i sa zhing 'gan len gyi gnyer skyong dbang cha ma rkang du 'jog par khyad chos gsum ldan de/sacig ni ma rkang du ba'ag pa'i gtso bdag de zhing khyim kho nar gtogs pa dang / zhing khyim bar la rang mos mnyam 'brel yin dgos pa ste/ zhing khyim bar rang so sos sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha ma rkang du 'jog pa dang / sde tshan gzhan pa dang mi sger gyis ma rkang du bzhag pa yin na 'di'i nang du mi 'dus/ gnyis ni sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha ma rkang du ba'ag pa'i dmigs yul ni zhing las dpal 'byor gong spel du gtong rgyu yin pa las/ bzo tshong las gnyer skyong byeswā pya'i

las 'gul spel ba'i ched min/ gsum ni ma rkang du bzhag rjes kyi gnyer skyong byed stangs ni zhing las mnyam las thon skyed gnyer ba ste/ mnyam las khang gi rnam pa gtso yin pa'i mnyam 'brel rang bzhin gyi mnyam 'brel tshogs pa 'dzugs pa las/ bzo tshong dang khe las sogs khe las rtsa 'dzugs btsugs mi chog 'di gtso bor zhing khyim gyi sa 'ing 'gan len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha ma rkang du bzhag nas khe las bsgrubs pa dang bsgrubs nas kyang zhing khyim la yong sgo mi dman pa thob na legs mod kyang / gal te khe las gnyer skyong byas pa yag po ma byung par/ khe las kyi ma rtsa jib ste/ zhing khyim gyis ma rkang du bzhag pa'i sa zhing 'gan len gyi gnyer skyong dbang cha de ma rtsa rdib par zhib rtsis rgyag pa'i rgyu nor la brtsis tshe/ zhing khyim gyis 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sa zhing shor srid pas/ kho tsho'i 'tsho bar shugs rkyen thebs pa ma zad/ stabs ma legs na zhing sde'i spyi tshogs brtan brling yong bar yang shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs par dmigs pa red/(nyer gcig) sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis rang sde ba'i sa rgod rang dgar gzhan sa'i mir 'gan gtsang sprod byas chog gam/mi chog 〈〈zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉kyi don tshan zhe brgyad pa'i nang / khyim tshang gis 'gan len byed par mi 'tsham pa ste sa rgod 'dus pa'i rgod bzhi'i mi'agan len thad gtan 'bebs byas pa gsham ltar/ tsa 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis 'ing sde'i sa zhing de rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs la 'gan gtsang sprod byas pa phud gzhan pa'i sde tshan dang yang na mi sger gyis 'gan len byas na/ sngon la nges par du rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mi'i sde dmangs gros tshogs las sum cha'i gnyis yan gyi khongs mi dang yang na sde dmangs 'thus merdi snam cha'i gnyis yan 'thad pa byung dgos pa ma zad/ zhang(grong rdal)mi

dmangs srid gzhung la zhus te chog mchan 'god du 'jug dgos pa gtan la phab cing / dus mtshungs su rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs phud sazhan pa'i sde tshan dang yang na mi sger gyis 'gan len byas na/ nges par du 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi yid rton gnas tshul dang gnyer skyong nus par zhib bsher byas rjes/ da gzod 'gan len gan rgya 'jog dgos pa gtan la phab yod de las gsal bor shes thub pa ni/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis rang dgar rang sde ba'i sa rgod gzhan sa'i mir 'gan gtsang sprod byed rgyu de bca' khrims nang gtan nas mi chog pa red/ 'dir nan gyis bshad dgos pa zhig ni/ tsa rgod bzhi ste rang re'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs la 'gan gtsang sprod byas pa phud gzhan pa'i sde tshan dang yang na mi sger gyis 'gan len byas na/ 'gan len gan rgya ma bzhag pa'i sngon du/ nges par du kun spyod dang mthun pa'i sgo nas 'gan len mkhan gyi yid rton gnas tshul dang gnyer skyong nus par 'ib bsher byas te/ de gzhung drang yid rton bya chog pa zhig yin min dang / der ma dngul dang yang na ma dngul grabs gsog byed pa'i nus pa yod med/ 6 'gan gtsang len byas kyang bcos skyong mi byed par/ brgyud sprod byas te skabs bstun khe bzang rig pa'i ngan sems yod med sogs la brtag dgos/ 'gan gtsang len phyogs la yid rton tshad bzang ba dang / gnyer skyong nus pa legs po zhig ldan pa khag theg byas rjes/da gzod de dang 'gan len gan rgya 'jog rgyu/(nyer gnyis) 'gan gtsang len gron dngul mtho drags pa'am yang na dma' drags na thag gcod ji ltar bya dgos/'gan gtsang len gron dngul mtho drags pa'am yang na dma' drags te tshang ma 'dra mnyam ma byung ba dang / de las rtsod gleng byung tshe nges par du gros rngo/la byas te thag gcod dgos/ gal te gros sol byas pa brgyud thag gardotā ma

thub na/ 'dum gcod las khungs dang yang na mi dmangs khrims khang brgyud de 'dum sgrig byas chog gal te 'gan len gan rgya bzhag kyang 'dra mnyam ma yong ba zhig yin tshe/ 〈dmangs khrims spyi srol〉gyi gtan 'bebs ltar/'dum gcod las khungs dang yang na mi dmangs khrims khang gdan zhu byas te bsgyur bcos sam rtsis med du gtong du bcug chog ches mtho'i mi dmangs khrims khang gis〈zhing sde'i 'gan len gan rgya'i thad kyi rtsod don zhib gcod byed pa'i gnad don 'ga'i skor gyi bsam 'char〉khrod bstan don/ 'gan len dmigs tshad kyi mtho dma' ltar bye brag gis dbye zhib byed pa dang /gtso bor dmigs tshad de don dngos dang mthun min la zhib bsher bya dgos/'gan len dmigs tshad spyir btang du 'gan len sa zhing gi lo sngon ma3gyi cha snyoms kyi thon tshad(yang na thon rin)de ga'ir 'dzin pa ma zad/ lurges mthun gyi thon 'phar bsdur tshad la dmigs te gtan khel bya dgos pa yin/gal te 'gan len dmigs tshad phal cher lugs mthun yin na/ 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis 'gan len dmigs tshad je mthor gtong ba'i re ba bton kyang / mi dmangs khrims khang gis rgyab skyor mi byed pas/ nges par du sngar gyi 'gan len gan rgya'i 'gan len dmigs tshad srung 'dzin bya rgyu/(nyer gsum) sa zhing 'gan gtsang len thad kyi rtsod gling gnad don thabs lam gang dag brgyud de thag gcod dgos/sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang cha las byung ba'i rtsod gleng zhes pa ni/ do bdag bar sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i bkol spyod dbang cha dang yong sgo/ skor skyod/ legs sgrig phyir bsdu ba dang 'gan len gan rgya lag bstar byed pa sogs kyi thad nas byung ba'i rtsod gleng la bstan pa yin/ gal te sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha'i thad nadī snying gi rtsod gleng 'dra byung tshe/ zhing pa spun zlas ji ltar thag gcod byed

dam/ 〈zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan nga gcig pa'i nang / 6 sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha'i thad nas rtsod gleng 'dra byung tshe/ do bdag phyogs gnyis kyis gros mol byas pa brgyud thag gcod byas chog la/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang dang 'ang(grong rdal)mi dmangs srid gzhung sogs gdan zhu byas te 'dum sgrig thag gcod byas kyang chog do bdag gros mol byed pa dang 'dum sgrig byed par mi 'thad pa dang yang na gros mol dang 'dum sgrig byed ma thub na/ zhing sde'i sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len gyi 'dum gcod las khungs la 'dum gcod byed pa'i re 'dun zhus chog la/ thad kur du mi dmangs khrims la zhu gtug byas kyang chog pa gtan la phab yod/ bca' khrims 'di'i gtan 'bebs la gzhigs nas/ thabs lam ba'i brgyud de sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha'i thad kyi rtsod gleng gnad don thag gcod byas chog gcig ni do bdag gis gros mol byas te thag gcod pa/ gros mol byas te thag bcad na do bdag gis spyad pa'i dus tshod dang sems shugs/ gron dngul bcas je nyung du gtong thub pa dang / 'gal ba zhi bar phan pa red/ gnyis ni 'dum sgrig byas te thag gcod pa/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang dang 'ang(grong rdal)mi dmangs srid gzhung sogs gdan zhu byas te 'dum sgrig thag gcod byed pa dang / 'dum sgrig thag gcod byas na nges par du do bdag phyogs gnyis ka rang mos yin pa'i rmang ga'i'i steng 'dum sgrig bya rgyu/ do bdag 'dum sgrig byed par mi 'thad pa'am yang na 'dum sgrig gros mthun byed thabs med na/'dum sgrig de pham par brtsi dgos/ 'dum sgrig gros mthun yong ba'i yi ge ba'ag kyang rung / do bdag phyogs gcig gis 'dum sgrig gros mthun yi ge lag bstar byed pa'i go rim khrod blo 'gyod skyes tshe/ lag bstar byed mtshams ba'ag chog pa dang / gnas tshul 'di lta bu'i 'og yang 'dum sgrig phaX snar

brtsi dgos/ 'dir nan bshad dgos pa zhig ni/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang dang 'ang(grong rdal)mi dmangs srid gzhung gis 'dum sgrig byed na nges par du do bdag gis rang mos sgos re zhu byas pa'i sngon 'gro'i 'og 'dum sgrig byed pa las/ do bdag la btsan thabs kyis 'dum sgrig dang len byed du 'jug mi rung / shang dang sde ba rim pa'i rtsa 'dzugs las gzhan/ do bdag gis rang mos sgos gzhan pa'i rtsa 'dzugs dang mi sger la rtsod gleng 'dum sgrig thag gcod byed pa'i re 'dun zhus chog gsum ni 'dum gcod la brten nas thag gcod byed pa/ do bdag bar gros mol dang 'dum sgrig byed par mi 'thad pa 'am yang na gros mol dang 'dum sgrig brgyud de rtsod gleng thag gcod ma thub na/ 'ing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi 'dum gcod las khungs la 'dum gcod byed rgyu'i re 'dun zhus chog zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang cha'i rtsod gleng 'dum gcod byed pa ni dmigs bsal gyi dpal 'byor rtsod gleng 'dum gcod byed pa zhig yin pas/ 'dum gcod bca' khrims nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i spyir btang gi dpal 'byor rtsod gleng gi 'dum gcod dang mi 'dra/ rang rgyal gyi 'dum gcod bca' khrims nang / 6 'dum gcod thad nas 'dum gcod thengs gcig lam lugs lag bstar byed pa ste/ 'dum gcod byas rjes/ do bdag gis rtsod gling sna gcig de yang bskyar 'dum gcod dam yang na mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug byas tshe/ 'dum gcod u yon nam yang na mi dmangs khrims khang gis dang len byas mi chog pa gtan la phab yod/ yin na'ang 'ing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha'i dmigs bsal rang bzhin la dmigs nas/ rang rgyal 'dum gcod bca' khrims kyi don tshan don bdun pa'i nang ngal rtsol rtsod gleng dang zhing las thun mo nga dpal 'byor nang khuX lto zhing las 'gan len gan rgya'i rtsod gleng thad gtan 'bebs gzhan
