'ig gtan la phab yod/ gtan 'bebs 'di'i nang grong gseb kyi thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs nang khul gyi sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha'i rtsod gleng la 'dum gcod bca' khrims bkol mi 'tshams pa gsal bor bstan yod/ 'ing sde'i sa jing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha'i rtsod gleng dang spyir btang gi dpal 'byor rtsod gleng 'dum gcod byed pa'i khyad par gtso bo ni/(1) yar zhu byed pa'i go rim mi 'dra ba/ 'ing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha'i 'dum gcod kyi khongs su gtogs tshe/ do bdag la 'dum bcod gros mthun gyi yi ge 'jog mi dgos shing / do bdag phyogs gcig gis yar zhu byas tshe/ 'brel yod kyi 'dum gcod las khungs kyis de ma nyid du dang len byas chog(2) 'dum gcod las khungs mi 'dra ba/ zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i 'dum gcod las khungs kyi sgrig bkod de 'dum gcod bca' khrims nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i 'dum gcod las khungs dang mi 'dra zhing / mig sngar sa gnas so po'i byed stangs mi 'dra bas/ sa gnas kha shas su rdzong dang zhang rim pa gnyis nas btsugs yod pa dang / sa gnas kha shas su rdzong rim pa gcig pu nas btsugs yo da/(3) 'dum gcod byas pa'i phan nus mi 'dra ba/ do bdag zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i 'dum gcod las khungs kyis 'dum gcod byas par mi 'thad na/ khrun thag yi ge 'byor ba'i nyin nas nyin sum cu'i nang mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug byas chog dus yun brgal rag bar tu zhu gtug ma byas tshe/ khrun thag yi ge la bca' khrims kyi phan nus thon pa yin/ 'di yang gtso bo 'ing pa'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang char sngar bas srung skyong gang legs bya ched yin/ mig sngar/ sa pa/sa

so so'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi 'dum gcod las khungs phal cher rdzong dang zhang(grong rdal)rim pa gnyis kyi zhing las gtso skyong sde khag la khongs gtogs kyi gnyer skyong do dam las khungs nang btsugs yod cing / srid 'dzin rang ba'in zhugs chen ldan pa dang / don dngos su 'ang(grong rdal)srid gzhung gi 'dum sgrig las khungs dang 'dra mtshungs yin/ bzhi ni zhu gtug byed pa/ do bdag gros mol byed par mi 'thad la/ 'dum gcod byed par yang mi 'thad na/ thad kur mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug byas te/zhu gtug rnam pas rang rang nyid kyi sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha srung skyong bya dgos/ mnyam 'jog dgos sa 'ig ni/ sus 'jon de 'gug dang pham 'tshong rgyag pa/ spyi bsgrags sgos gros mol byed pa sogs kyi rnam pas rtsod ba'i sogs sa zhing 'gan len byas tshe/ do bdag gis 'gan len gan rgya'i khrod rtsod gleng thag gcod stangs dang khongs gtogs kyi 'dum gcod las khungs sam yang na khrims khang bcas kyi kha dan bzhag chog la/ 'brel yod kyi 'dum gcod las khungs dang mi dmangs khrims khang gis nges par du do bdag gi 'dod blo brtsi 'jog byas te/ khrims ltar 'dum gcod byed pa dang yang na zhu gtug byed pa'i gyod gzhi dang len bya rgyu/ phyogs 'di ni khyim tshang gis 'gan len byas par mi 'dra ba yin/(nyer bzhi) 'gan gtsang spyod phyogs kyis sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang char gnod 'tshe btang ba'i bya spyod gang dag la dmangs 'gan 'khur dgos/〈〈zhing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉kyi don tshan nga bzhi pa'i nang / 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs la gsham gyi bya spyod las gcig yod tshe/ nges par du gnod 'tshe gtong mtshams 'jog pa dang / rgyu dngos phyidi spyag pa/ sngar don slar gso ba/ gnod 'tshe med par gtong ba/ nyen

la rtsa med du gtong ba/ gyong gun 'jal ba sogs dmangs don 'gan 'khri 'khur dgos pa gtan 'bebs byas yod/(1) 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis khrims ltar thon skyed gnyer skyong gi bdas dbang longs su spyod par the gtogs byed pa/(2) bca' khrims 'di'i gtan 'bebs dang 'gal te 'gan len sa 'ing phyir bsdu ba dang legs sgrig byed pa/(3) 'gan gtsang len phyogs la btsan thabs kyis sa 'ing 'gan satsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed du 'jug pa'am yang na bkag 'gog byed pa/(4) mang kha nyung len la kha g.yar te 'gan gtsang len phyogs la btsan thabs kyis sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha bskyur ba'am yang na bsgyur bcos byed du bcug ste sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi sanyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed pa/(5) bza' 'bru'i dmigs 'ing dang 'gan 'khri'i sa zhing misogs su dbye ba rgyu mtshan du byas te 'gan gtsang len sa zhing phyir bsdus rjes sus 'jon de 'gugs kyi sgo nas 'gan len byed du 'jug pa/(6) 'gan gtsang len sa 'ing phyir bsdus te chad dngul gyi tshab byed pa/(7) bud med kyis khrims ltar longs su spyod pa'i gzhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang cha 'phrog pa dang gnod 'tshe gtong ba/(8) sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang char gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i bya spyod gzhan rigs/ khrims srol 'di'i nang spyod dung 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis gong gi bya spyod dag byung ba las 'gan 'khur ba'i dmangs don 'gan 'khri 'khur stangs gtan 'bebs byas yod de/ gcig ni gnod 'tshe gtong mtshams 'jog pa/ gnyis ni rgyu dngos phyir sdi/ pa/

gsum ni sngar don slar gso ba/ bzhi ni gnod 'tshe med par bzo ba/ lnga ni nyen kha rtsa med du gtong ba/ drug ni gyong gun 'jal ba bcas so/(nyer lnga)srid gzhung dpon rigs kyis rang dgar zhing pa'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang cha bsgyur bcos byed pa'am yang na med par bzos che 'gan 'khri ci zhig 'khur dgos/〈〈'ing sde'i sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉kyi don tshan dgu pa'i nang / rgyal khab kyis thun mong gi sa zhing bdag dbang mkhan gyi lugs mthun khe dbang srung skyong dang / 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyi sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang char srung skyong bya rgyu yin pas/rtsa 'dzugs gang zhig dang mi sger su zhig gis gnod 'tshe btang mi chog pa gtan la phab yod/ 'dis rgyal khab kyi las khungs dang de'i las byed mi snas grong gseb kyi thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis rang re'i khongs mi'i 'dod blo rang bdag gtan 'bebs dang 'gan len jus ga'i lag bstar byed par srung skyong bya dgos pa dang / 'brel yod kyi rgyal khab las khungs dang de'i las byed mi snas 'brel yod kyi srid jus dang bca' khrims kyi gnad don/ don dngos kyi bkol spyod bcas kyi go rim la mdzub ston byas chog mod/'on kyang 'gan dbang bkol te sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len la the gtogs byas mi chog pa dang / 'gan len gan rgya bsgyur bcos dang med par bzo ba sogs de bas kyang byas mi chog pa'i blang bya bton yod/ der brten/ 〈snang sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan re gcig pa'i nang / zu rgyal khab kyi las khungs dang de'i 'brel yod kyi las byed mi snas 'gan dbang bkol te 'ing sde'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len la the gtogs byed pa dang / 'gan len gan rgya bsgyur bcos dang med par bzo ba/ 'gan ga~X len phyogs kyis khrims ltar longs su spyod pa'i thon skyed gnyer skyong gi

rang bdag dbang char the gtogs byed pa/ yang na btsan thabs kyis 'gan gtsang len phyogs la sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang cha skor skyod byed du 'jug pa'am yang na bkag 'gog byed pa sogs sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gnyer skyong dbang char gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i bya spyod bcas las 'gan gtsang len phyogs la gyong kun bzos tshe/ nges par du kun gsab spro da pa sogs kyi 'gan 'khri 'khur dgos pa dang / gnas tshul tshabs chen yin na gong rim las khungs dang yang na de ga'i las khungs kyis thad kur 'gan 'khri mi snar srid 'dzin nyes chad gcod dgos rgyu/ nyes tshad lon rigs la khrims ltar nyes 'gan bda' 'ded bya rgyu bcas migatan la phab yod/'dir bstan dgos pa zhig ni/ 'gan 'khri 'di rigs ni rgyal khab kyi skyin tshab sprod pa'i skor gyi bca' khrims nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i srid 'dzin gyi skyin tshab sprod pa'i 'gan 'khrir gtogs pa yin/ rgyal khab kyi skyin tshab sprod pa'i skor gyi bca' khrims nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ rgyal khab kyi skyin tshab sprod pa de skyin tshab ma dngul sprod pa'i rnam pa gtso yin pa dang /rgyu nor phyir slog pa dang sngar dbyibs slar gso thub na/ rgyu nor phyir slog pa dang yang na sngar dbyibs slar gso byas chog gnas tshul tshabs chen yin na/gong rim las khungs sam yang na de ga'i las khungs kyis thad kur 'gan 'khri mi snar srid 'dzin nyes chad gcod rgyu/ nyes tshad lon rigs la nyes 'gan bca' khrims kyi don tshan sum brgya dang dgu cu go bdun pa ltar/ thad kur 'gan 'khri mi snas 'gan dbang gang byung du bkol spyod byas pa'i nyes 'gan bda' 'ded bya rgyu/po(nyer drug) rang rgyal sa zhing bca' khrims la gzhi rtsa'i rtsa don gang dag drong/ rgyal sa zhing bca' khrims kyi ga'i rtsa'i rtsa don ni nga tsho tshang stuX sa

'ing gsar spel dang bed spyod/ srung skyong dang do dam bcas byed skabs rgyun srung byed dgos pa'i rtsa don yang yin la/ gtso bor gsham gyi phyogs 'ga' yod de/ gcig ni sa zhing gi spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi dbang lam lugs srungaskyob bya rgyu/ 〈sa 'ing do dam skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan gnyis pa'i khod tshan gnyis pa'i nang 6 krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyis lag tu bstar ba'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi dbang lam lugs te/ dmangs yongs la dbang ba'i lam lugs dang ngal rtsol mang tshogs thun mong la dbang ba'i lam lugs migatan 'bebs byas yod/ sa 'ing spyi dbang lam lugs ni rang rgyal sa zhing lam lugs kyi rmang ga'i dang srog shing yin/ gnyis ni lugs mthun gyi sa zhing rgyu nor srung skyong byed pa/ 'di ni dmangs don rgyu nor gyi khe dbang gal chen zhig dang / rang rgyal dmangs khrims kyi rtsa don de sa zhing bca' khrims khrod gtan 'bebs byas pa'i bye brag gi mtshon bya yin/ gsum ni rmo zhing srung skyong byed pa/ 'di ni zhing las dang rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor brtan brling ngang 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i rmang gzhi yin/ bzhi ni lugs mthun sgos sa zhing bed spyod byed pa/ 'di ni rang rgyal gyi ga'i rtsa'i rgyal jus shig yin/ lnga ni gcig gyur sgos sa zhing do dam byed pa/ rgyal yongs kyi sa zhing gcig gyur sgos do dam byed pa dang / grong khyer dang grong gseb kyi sa zhing gcig gyur sgos do dam byed pa mngon 'gyur byas na/ de ni phan nus ldan pa'i sgo nas sa zhing bed spyod rtsa 'dzugs dang mthun sbyor byed pa'i dgos mkho yin pa dang / sa ling 'brel ba khyon yongs dang phugs ring ba/ go rim yod pa bcas kyi sgo nas legs sgrig byed pa'i dgos mkho yin la/ rgyal khab kyi sa zhing bcos bsgyur byed pa'i dgos mkho'ang yin/ drug ni skyin tshab yod pa'i sgo nas sa zhing bed spyod byed pa/ sbyin tshab yod pa'i sgo nas sa zhing bed spyodwa ༵ lag bstar byas na sa zhing lugs mthun ngang bed spyod par phan pa

dang / sa byung thon khungs legs babyu ra dang sgrig bkod byed par skul 'ded btang na/ phyi phyogs la sgo 'byed pa dang / ma rtsa nang 'dren byed pa/ grong khyer 'ardogs skrun byed pa'i ma dngul gyi 'byung khungs rgya bskyed pa bcas la phan pa (k+tar/ bdun) rgyal lab kyis rmo zhing srung skyong thad gtan 'bebs gang dag byas yod/rmo zhing ni 'ing las lo tog sna tshogs 'debs bya'i sa 'ing la bstan pa yin/ rang rgyal gyi rmo zhing la / dngos gnas 'debs ba'in pa'i sa 'ing dang gsar du sbol 'debs byed pa'i sa 'ing / dbyar nyal 'ing / res skor sa 'ing sogs dang / zhing la sa 'o tog 'debs pa gtso byas te/ bar tu sil tog gi sdong bo dang dar shing / yang na gzhan pa'i yong sgo yod pa'i sdong bo kha shas btsugs yod pa/ lo3yan btabs pa'i gram kha'i 'ing dang mtsho kha'i gram stong / rdzing ngogs kyi chu 'ing sogs/ nya rdzing dang ldum 'ing / lho phyogs su zhing la smi1las chung ba dang byang phyogs su zhing la smi2las chung ba'i chu rka dang lam dang sa zhing bcas/ bdag bzung ma byas pa'i yar sngon gyi lo3nang cing las lo tog btabs myong ba'i sa zhing dang / rmo zhing dang gzhan pa'i cing la sa la spyod pa'i sa 'ing la brtsis chog pa sogs 'dus/ rmo zhing la dngos gnas srung skyong bya ched/ 〈sa 'ing do dam skor gyi bca' khrims〉sogs bca' khrims dang khrims srol mang po las gtan 'bebs sna tshogs byas yod cing / gtso bo gsham gyi phyogs bcu gnyis yod de/ gcig ni rmo zhing bdag bzung byed par skyin gsab sprod pa'i lam lugs lag bstar bya rgyu/ zhing las min pa'i 'dzugs skrun thad chog mchan bkod pa brgyud rmo zhing bdag bzung byasan ci tsam bdag bzung byas na de tsam slog dgos pa'i rtsa don ltar/rmo 'ing bdag bzung byas pa'i sde tshan gyis bdag bzung byas pa'i rmo dīrdo gi

grangs cha dang spus ka tshang ma dang 'dra mtshungs yin pa'i rmo zhing slog pa'i 'gan 'khur dgos pa dang / rmo zhing slog pa'i cha rkyen med pa'am yang na re ba dang mi mthun na/ 'ing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyi gtan 'bebs ltar/ rmo ling slog dngul sprod rgyu dang / ched dmigs ma dngul de rmo zhing gsar ba slog par bkol rgyu/ 'ing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyi mi dam ngas srid gzhung gis nges par du rmo zhing brko slog 'char gzhi bzos te/ rmo zhing bdag bzung sde tshan gyis 'char ga'i ltar rmo cing brko slog dang yang na 'char gzhi ltar rmo ling brko slog rtsa 'dzugs byed par lta skul bya rgyu ma zad/ zhib bsher rtsis len bya rgyu/gnyis ni rdzong rim pa yan gyi sa gnas mi dmangs srid gzhung gis rmo 'ing bdag bzung sde tshan gyis bdag bzung rmo zhing gi rmo las sa rim gyi sa de gsar du slog pa'i rmo zhing dang / spus 'an sa 'ing dang yang na ga'an pa'i rmo zhing la spyad de/ sa 'ing legs bsgyur byed pa'i re 'dun zhus chog gsum ni zhing las min pa'i 'dzugs skrun thad nges par du sa cing gron chung sgos bkol spyodabyed pa dang / sa rtsod bed spyad chog na/ rmo zhing bdag bzung byas mi chog la/ spus 'an sa 'ing bed spyad chog na/ spus legs sa 'ing bdag bzung byas mi chog ba'i ni bdag bzung sa zhing steng sa dong brko ba dang dur sa las pa/ bye ma bsko ba/ rdo ba len pa/ sa sngog 'don byed pa sogs gtan 'gog bya rgyu/ lnga ni sde tshan gang zhig dang mi sger su zhig yin rung sa 'ing rang sa 'jog pa dang sa rgod du 'jog pa gtan 'gog bya rgyu/ 'gro lugs bsgrubs zin pa'i zhing las min pa'i 'dzugs skrun las ga'i'i thad rmo jing bdag bzung byas pa dang / yang na lo gcig nang mi bkol bar rmo 'debs byas na/nges par du sngar rmo zhing 'di btab myong ba'i thun mong dang yang na mi sger gyidi snro zhing slar gso byas chog la/ rmo zhing bkol ba'i sde tshan gyis rtsa

'dzugs byas te rmo 'debs byas kyang chog lo gcig yan la 'dzugs skrun a ra las kyi 'go ma brtsams na/ zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyi gtan 'bebs ltar rang sar bzhag pa'i gron dngul sprod dgos/ bstud mar lo gnyis la bsol spyod ma byas na/ sngar chog ma chan bkod pa'i las khungs kyis chos mchan bkod pa brgyud/ rdzong rim pa yan gyi mi dam ngas srid gzhung gis skyin gsab med pa'i sgo nas sa zhing bkol spyod sde tshan gyi sa zhing bkol spyod dbang cha phyir bsdu rgyu/ sa 'ing 'di sngar zhing pa thun mong gis bdag tu bzung ba yin na/ nges par du sngar gyi zhing sde'i thun mo nga dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis rmo 'ing slar gso bya dgos/ drug ni rmo 'ing gnyer skyong 'gan len byas pa'i sde tshan dang yang na mi sger gyis bstud mar lo gnyis la sa zhing rang sar bzhag tshe/ sngar 'gan gtsang sprod byas pa'i sde tshan gyis nges par du 'gan len gan rgya mtshams ba'ag ste/ 'gan gtsang sprod byas pa'i rmo 'ing phyir bsdu dgos/ bdun ni rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis byed thabs spyad de/ rmo 'ing srung skyong dang chu gtong bzo 'god kyi sgrig bkod la srung skyob byed pa/ sa zhing legs bsgyur dang lud shugs je bzang du gtong ba/ sa 'ing bye 'gyur dang tshwa 'gyur byed pa dang sa 'ing shor ba bcas 'gog dgos pa dang / rmo zhing sa rgod du 'jog pa dang rmo zhing gtor brlag byas pa'i bya spyod tha dag gtan 'gog bya rgyu/ brgyad ni phan mtho dug dma' dang dug 'dres tshad dma' ba'i 'ing sman gong du spel te/ phyogs bsdus 'gog bcos dang skye dngos 'gog bcos kyi byed thabs khyab gdal du gtong dgos/ btsog chu 'dren stangs 'u gas mthun sgos spyad de/ sa zhing dang 'ing las lo tog la sbag btsog thebs pa 'gog dgos/ dgu ni tshan rig dang mthun pa'i sgo nas lud rdzas 'jog pa dang / lud rdzas spyod tshad lugs mthun sgos gtan khel byas te/ sa zhing skam pa 'gog dgos/ skye ldadī snad

'jog tshad je mang du btang ste/ sa zhing legs bsgyur byed pa dang / sa zhing la skye ldan spus tshad 'dus tshad je mthor gtong dgos/ bcu ni gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing la rgyal khab kyi 'brel yod tshad ga'i dang mi mthun pa'i lud rdzas dang yang na grong khyer gyi gad snyigs/ 'dam rdzab 'don sprod byed pa gtan 'gog bya dgos/ bcu gcig ni gter kha sngog 'don dang lam las pa/ chu bed rgyas skrun dang ga'an pa'i bzo 'god gang zhig 'dzugs skrun byed skabs/ nges par du sa zhing rdib pa dang je dmar 'gro ba/ bye 'gyur byed pa/ sa chu shor ba/chu mgo skam pa/ rdo dud pa/ tshwa 'gyur byed pa/ 'dam rdzab du 'gyur ba/ chu log yo nga ba sogs mjug 'bras 'byung ba 'gog dgos/ bzo 'god 'dzugs skrun las sa zhing thon khungs la gtor brlag btang ste/ mang tshogs kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho bar gyong gun bzos tshe/ jus 'god dang 'dzugs skrun sde tshan gyis gnod thebs sde tshan la lugs mthun gyi skyin gsab sprod dgos pa ma zad/ bcos skyong dang slar gso byed pa'i 'gan 'khur dgos/ bcu gnyis ni zhing pas 'gan len sa 'ing dang rmo 'ing steng dur sa las pa dang khang pa rgyag pa/ bye ma brko ba/ sa len pa/ so phag sreg pa bcas byed pa gtan 'gog bya rgyu/ sde tshan gang zhig dang mi sger su zhig gis zhing sa gtor brlag dang med par bzos mi chog(nyer brgyad) gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing srung skyong khul du bya ba gang dag bsgrubs pa'i bya spyod gtan 'gog bya rgyu/sa zhing do dam la shugs snon ched/ rgyal khab kyis ga'i rtsa'i sa zhing srung skyong lam lugs lag bstar byas pa red/ gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing ni dus skabs nges can zhig gi mi 'bor dang spyi tshogs dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas las zhing las thon rdzas thad bton pa'i dgos mkho ltar/ sa zhing bed spyod thad kyi spyi'i 'di/ 'god las gtan khel byas pa ltar bdag bzung byas mi chog pa'i rmo

'ing la zer/ gzhi rtsa'i sa 'ing srung skyong khul ni ga'i rtsa'i sa zhing la khyad par can gyi srung skyong lag bstar byed pa dang / sa zhing bed spyod thad kyi spyi'i 'char 'god ltar dang khrims bkod sgrig lam ltar gtan khel byas pa'i ched bkod srung skyong khul la bstan pa yin/ 1998lo'i zla12pa'i tshes27nyin rgyal khabakyis〈ga'i rtsa'i sa zhing srung skyong byed pa'i skor gyi srol yig〉bkram te/gzhi rtsa'i sa 'ing dbye 'byed gtan 'bebs dang srung skyong byed pa/ lta skul do dam byed pa/ bca' khrims kyi 'gan khur sogs le'u dudang don tshan36gtan 'bebs gsal bo byas/ khrims srol 'di gzhir bzung ste/ rgyal khab spyas gshā rtsa'i sa zhing srung skyong khul du gsham gyi bya spyod dag gtan 'gog byas k+ta zlog ni/ gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing srang skyong khul dbye 'byed gtan 'bebs byed skabs/ sa zhing 'gan gtsajo len mkhan gyi 'gan len gnyer skyong dbang cha bsgyur mi chog 'di ni sde tshan gang zhig dang mi sger su zhig gis gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing srung skyong khul dbye 'byed gtan 'bebs byed par kha g.yar te/ sa zhing 'gan gtsang len mkhan gyi 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i gnyer skyong dbang cha bsgyur bcos byas mi chog zer ba yin/gnyis ni sde tshan gang zhig dang mi sger su zhig gis gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing bdag bzung byas mi chog chog mchan ma bkod pa'am yang na mgo bskor g.yo sgyu'i byed thabs spyad de chog mchan thob ste/ khrims 'gal gyis ga'i rtsa'i sa zhing bdag tu bzung ba dang / chog mchan thob pa'i grangs ka las brgal te/ khrims 'gal gyis ga'i rtsa'i sa zhing bdag tu bzung ba/ khrims 'gal sgos chog mchan thob ste gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing bdag tu bzung ba/ nyo 'tshong ngam yang na rnam pa gzhan pa spyad de gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing bshug sprod byed mkhan bcas la chad pa nan po gcod rgyu/ 47

gsum ni sde tshan gang 'ig dang mi sger su zhig gis gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing srung skyong khul du sa dong bsko ba dang khang ba rgyag pa/ dur sa las pa/ bye ma brko ba/ rdo len pa/ gter kha sngog 'don byed pa/ sa len pa/ bed med zog ro spungs pa'am yang na gzhi rtsa'i sa cing la gtor brlag gtong ba'i bya 'gul ga'an pa spel ba gtan 'gog bya rgyu / de'i khrod/ sa dong brko bar sdod khang rgyas 'dzugs thad sa dong spyod pa dang rigs sna tshogs kyi so phag sreg thab dang rdo thal sreg thab sogs 'dus/ khang ba las par sdod khang du spyod pa'i khang ba dang bzo las dang tshong las/ zhabs zhu'i las rigs sogs rigs sna tshogs kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho bar spyod pa'i khang ba 'dus/ rang 'dod sgos bye ma bsko ba dang rdo rdzog pa/ gter kha sngog 'don byed pa/ sa len pa bcas kyi bya spyod zhes pa ni khrims bkod sgrig lam ma brgyud par gzhi rtsa'i sa 'ing nang bye ma brko ba dang rdo sngog pa/ gter kha sngog 'don byed pa/sa len pa bcas kyi bya spyod la bstan pa yin/bzhi ni sde tshan gang 'ig dang mi sger su zhig gis gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing de nags las las rigs dang nya gso rdzong bur spyod pa gtan 'gog bya rgyu/ gong gi gtan 'bebs dang 'gal tshe/ rdzong rim pa yan gyi mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sa don srid 'dzin gtso skyong sde khag gis sngar 'debs 'dzugs kyi cha rkyen la bsgyur bcos byed pa dang bcos skyong byed pa/ slar gso ba bcas kyi bka' rgya phab pa dang / gzhi rtsa'i sa 'ing bdag bzung byas pa'i rmo zhing bko slog gron dngul gyi ldab1yan dang ldab2man gyi chad pa gcod rgyu/ nyes tshad lon rigs la khrims ltar nyes 'gan bda' 'ded bya rgyu/lnga ni sde tshan gang zhig dang mi sger su zhig gis gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing rang sar 'jog pa dang sa rgod du 'jog pa gtan 'gog bya rgyu/ rgyal srid spyi khyab kha~X pyis chog mchan thob pa'i 'dzugs skrun las gzhi gal chen thad gzhi rtsa'i

sa zhing bdag bzung byas te/ lo gcig 'gor rag bar bkol spyod mi byed pa dang yang na rmo 'debs byas chog na/ nges par du sngar gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing 'di rmo 'debs byed myong ba'i thun mong dang yang na mi sger gyis rmo 'debs slar gso byed dgos pa dang / sa zhing bkol ba'i sde tshan gyis rtsa 'dzugs byas te rmo 'debs byas kyang chog lo gcig yan la 'dzugs skrun ar las kyi 'go ma brtsams na/ nges par du zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyi gtan 'bebs ltar rang sar bzhag pa'i dngul sprod dgos pa ste/sa zhing bkol spyod dbang cha'i bshug sprod dngul gyi755man gyi bsdur tshad ltar sa zhing rang sar ba'ag dngul bsdu rgyu/ bstud mar lo gnyis la sa 'ing bkol spyod ma byas na/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis chog mchan bkod pa brgyud/rdzong rim pa yan gyi mi dmangs srid gzhung gis skyin gsab med pa'i sgo nas 'ing bkol sde tshan gyi zhing bkol dbang cha phyir bsdu rgyu/ sa zhing 'di sngar zhing pa thun mong gis bdag tu bzung ba yin na/ nges par du sngar gyi grong gseb kyi thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs la sprad de rmo zhing slar gso byas rjes/ yang bskyar gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing srung skyong khul la dbye 'byed bya rgyu/ gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i sde tshan nam yang na mi sger gyis bstud mar lo2la rmo zhing sa rgod du bskyur tshe/ sngar gyi 'gan gtsang sprod las khungs kyis 'gan len gan rgya mtshams bzhag ste/ 'gan gtsang sprod byed pa'i gzhi rtsa'i sa 'ing phyir bsdu rgyu/drug ni sde tshan gang zhig dang mi sger su zhig yin rung gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing srung skyong khul gyi srung skyong mtshon rtags la gtor brlag bzo ba'am yang na gang 'dod sgos bsgyur mi chog gtan 'bebs 'di dang 'gal tshe/ rdzong rim pa yan gyi sa gnas mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sa don srid 'dzin gtso skyong sdekhag dang yang na zhing las srid 'dzin gtso skyong sde khag gis sngar da/chos

slar gso ba'i bka' rgya phab pa dang / sgor 1000man gyi chad pa gcod rgyu/bdun ni ga'i rtsa'i sa zhing gi rmo zhing slog dngul ham bzung dang gang 'dod du spyad mi chog gzhi rtsa'i sa 'ing gi rmo 'ing slog dngul ham bzung dang gang 'dod du spyad par chad pa nan po gcod rgyu/〈〈ga'i rtsa'i sa zhing srung skyong skor gyi srol yig〉〉gi don tshan lnga pa'i nang6 sde tshan gang 'ig dang mi sger su jig yin rung gzhi rtsa'i sa 'ing srung skyong byed pa'i 'os 'gan yod pa ma zad/ gzhi rtsa'i sa zhing ham bzung dang gtor brlab byed pa dang srol yig 'di dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod gzhan pa nyes 'don dang zhu gtug byed dbang yod pa gtan la phab yod/ 'di ni zhing par ga'i rtsa'i sa 'ing srung skyong byed pa'i 'os 'gan yod la/ ga'i rtsa'i sa zhing ham bzung dang gtor brlag byed pa dang gzhi rtsa'i sa 'ing srung skyong skor gyi srol /kā dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod nyes 'don dang zhu gtug byed dbang yod zer ba na(/nyer dgu) 〈〈sa zhing do dam skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉nang zhing pa'i sa zhing bsdus spyod byas par thob thos pa'i skyin gsab spyod pa'i thad gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/sa zhing bsdus spyod ni rgyal khab dang thun mo nga dang mi sger bcas kyi bar la spyi pa'i khe phan gyi dgos mkho las byung ba jig yin la/ bca' khrims nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i sgrig lam dang skyin gsab rtsa don/ skyin gsab tshad gzhi/ bde 'god byed thabs bcas kyi ltar/ thun mong gi sa zhing bdag dbang de rgyal khab la dbang ba'i srid 'dzin bya spyod cig tu bsgyur dgos/'di yang sa zhing bsdus spyod byed par btsan thabs rang bzhin dang dgos nges rang bzhin/ skyin gsab rang ba'in nges can 'ig ldan pa yin zer ba reX/0 sa gnas so so'i sa zhing bsdus spyod byas pa'i bya ba'i lag len la

ga'igs na/ sa 'ing bsdu ba'i skyin gsab gron dngul bcags pa dang je dmar btang ste/ zhing pa'i khe dbang la gnod 'tshe gtong bar bkag 'gog bya dgos la/ sa zhing bsdu len bya yul gyi las khungs dang mang tshogs kyis har gong rgyag pa dang sa gshis rdzun zhu byed pa/ rgya khyon rgya bskyed pa dang 'brel yod sde khag gis bsdu len gyi ming g.yar te gron dngul bsdu ba dang /'ing bkol la sa khungs kyi 'gan khur je lcir gtong ba'ang bkag 'gog bya dgos/ 〈sa zhing do dam skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan zhe bdun pa'i nang sa zhing bsdus spyod byed pa'i skyin gsab gron dngul thad gtso bo gsham gyi phyogs 'ga' gtan 'bebs byas yod de/1 sa zhing gi skyin gsab gron dngul/ sa 'ing gi skyin gsab gron dngul ni rgyal khab kyis sa zhing bsdus spyod byed skabs/ sa blang bsdu len bya yu la gyi dpal 'byor gyong kun la skyin gsab sprod ched der gtong sprod byas pa'i ma dngul la zer/(1) rmo zhing bsdus spyod (sngo tshal 'debs pa'i sa zhing 'dus) byas pa'i skyin gsab gron dngul gyi tshad gzhi ni rmo zhing de bsdu len ma byas pa'i sngon gyi lo3gyi lo re'i cha snyoms thon 'bab kyi ldabaconas ldab10yin/ lo'i thon 'bab de bsdu len ma byas pa'i sngon gyi lo3gyi lo re'i thon 'bab dang rgyal khab kyis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i rin gong rtsis lugs ltar brtsi dgos/ chu bed dang chu glog bzo 'god che 'bring rigs 'dzugs skrun byed par rmo 'ing bsdusaspyod byas pa'i skyin gsab gron dngul gyi tshad gzhi de rmo zhing de bsdus spyod ma byas pa'i sngon gyi lo3gyi lo re'i cha snyoms thon 'bab kyi ldabaconas ldab8yin/ chu log 'gog pa dang chu rka las pa dang chu phud pa'i bzo 'god che rigs 'dzugs skrun byed par rmo zhing bsdus spyod byas na/ sa zhing de'i skyin gsab gron dngul de gong gi tshad gzhi las dma' yang chog 51

(2) sa zhing gzhan pa bsdus spyod byas pa'i sa zhing gi skyin gsab gron dngul gyi tshad gzhi de zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyis rmo zhing bsdus spyod byas pa'i sa zhing gi skyin gsab gron dngul gyi tshad gzhi gzhir bzung nas gtan 'bebs bya dgos/(3) grong khyer mtha' khul gyi sngo tshal 'debs zhing bsdus spyod byas na/zhing bkol las khungs kyis nges par du rgyal khab kyi 'brel yod gtan 'bebs ltar sngo tshal 'debs zhing gsar ba gsar spel dang 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i ma dngul sprod dgos/ bye brag gi tshad gzhi de zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyis rgyal khab kyis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i khyab khongs nang gtan 'bebs bya dgos/ 'dzugs skrun las khungs la sdul khab kyi gtan 'bebs las brgal te ma dngul mi sprod pa'i dbang ༵ /de/ 'god skyin gsab gron dngul/ bde 'god skyin gsab gron dngul ni rgyal khab kyis sa zhing bsdus spyod byed skabs/ bsdu len bya yul las sbyings kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho ba bde 'god byed ched der sprad pa'i ma dngul la ra/ (1) sa zhing bsdus spyod byas pa'i bde 'god skyin gsab gron dngul de bde 'god bya ba'i zhing las mi 'bor gyi grangs ka ltar brtsi dgos/ bde 'god bya dgos pa'i zhing las mi 'bor gyi grangs ka de bsdus spyod byas pa'i rmo zhing gi grangs ka bsdu len ma byas pa'i sngon gyi bsdus spyod bya yul sde tshan gyi mi res cha snyoms kyis bdag bzung byas pa'i rmo zhing gi grangs kur bgo ba ltar brtsi dgos/ bde 'god bya ba'i zhing las mi 'bor re re'i bde 'god skyin gsab gron dngul gyi tshad gzhi de rmo zhing 'di bdag bzung ma byas pa'i lo 3gyi sngo/ spra nang lo re'i cha snyoms thon 'bab kyi ldabazhenas ldab6yin/ yin

na'ang / spyi ching re bsdus spyod byas pa'i rmo zhing gi bde 'god skyin gsab gron dngul de ches mtho na'ang bsdus spyod ma byas pa'i lo3gyi sngon gyi lo re'i cha snyoms thon 'bab kyi ldab15las brgal mi chog(2) gzhan pa'i sa zhing bsdus spyod byas pa'i bde 'god skyin gsab gron dngul gyi tshad ga'i de zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyis rmo 'ing bsdus spyod byas pa'i bde 'god skyin gsab gron dngul gyi tshad ga'i gzhir bzung ste gtan 'bebs bya dgos gtan 'bebs ltar sa zhing gi skyin gsab gron dngul dang bde 'god kha gsab rogs dngul ster dgos pa dang / bde 'god bya ba'i zhing par sngar yod kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad rgyun srung byed du 'jug mi thub na/ cing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyis chog mchan bkod pa brgyud/ bde 'god kha gsab rogs dngul je mang du btang chog yin na'ang / sa 'ing skyin gsab gron dngul dang bde 'god kha gsab rogs dngul gyi spyi 'bor de sa 'ing bsdus spyod ma byas pa'i lo3gyi sngon gyi lo re'i cha snyoms thon 'bab kyi ldab30las brgal mi chogagro 3 sa cha'i thog chags pa'i dngos rigs dang ljang myug gi skyin gsab na dastudhi/sa cha'i thog chags pa 'i dngos rigs kyi skyin gsab gron dngul ni rang byung dang yang na mi thabs kyis sa zhing mnyam du sbrel te mi sger ram yang na thun mong la dbang ba'i khang pa dang chu dong / dur sa sogs sgrig bkod 'dzugs skrun byas pa las gyong gun bzos par skyin gsab sprod pa de yin/yin na'ang / sa zhing bsdu len byed pa'i jus gzhir gros mol byas rjes rang 'dod du sdong bo 'dzugs pa dang ar las 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i sgrig bkod yin tshe/ skyin gsab ci yang mi ster/ 53

(2) ljang myug gi skyin gsab gron dngul ni sa zhing bsdu len byas pa las bzos pa'i zhing pas bsdu len bya yurme gyi sa zhing steng btab pa'i zhing las lo tog smin ma thud pa'i gyong gun gyi skyin gsab la bstan pa yin/ yin na'ang / sa zhing bsdu len byed pa'i jus gzhir gros mthun byung rjes rang 'dod du zhing las lo tog dang sdong bo 'debs 'dzugs byas tshe/ skyin gsab ci yang mi ster/ bsdu len bya yul gyi sa zhing steng chags pa'i dngos rigs dang ljang myug gi skyin gsab gron dngul tshad gzhi de zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyis gtan 'bebs bya dgos/(sum cu) bsdus spyod sa zhing gi skyin gsab gron dngul sogs dbang mkhan dang spyod mkhan su yin/sa zhing gi skyin gsab gron dngul dang bde 'god kyi kha gsab rogs dngul de nges par du bca' khrims nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i spyod sgo dang sgrig lam ltar dbye bgo dang bkol spyod bya dgos/1 sa zhing gi skyin gsab gron dngul/ 〈sa zhing do dam skor gyi bca' khrims lag bstar byed pa'i srol yig〉gi don tshan nyer drug pa'i 'khod tshan dang po'i nang / 6 sa zhing gi skyin gsab gron dngul de grong gseb kyi thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs la dbang ba dang / thon skyed 'phel rgyas thad bkol dgos pa gtan 'bebs byas yod/2 bde 'god kyi kha gsab rogs dngul/ (sa zhing do dam skor gyi bca' khrims lag bstar byed pa'i srol yig〉gi don tshan nyer drug pa'i 'khod tshan gnyis pa'i nang / 6 sa zhing bsdus spyod byas pa'i bde 'god kyi kha gsab rogs dngul de nges par du ched dngul ched spyod bya dgos pa dang / gzhan par gang byung du spyad mi chog pa gtan la phab yod/ bde 'god bya dgos paX ༵ sna de grong gseb kyi thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis bde 'god

bya dgos na/ bde 'god kyi kha gsab rogs dngul de grong gseb kyi thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs la ster dgos pa dang / grong gseb kyi thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis do dam dang bed spyod bya dgos/ sde tshan gzhan nga/sa bde 'god bya dgos na/ bde 'god kyi kha gsab rogs dngul de sde tshan de nyid la ster dgos/ gcig gyur gyis bde 'god byed mi dgos na/ bde 'god kyi kha gsab rogs dngul de bde 'god bya yul la sprad de/ des rang las rang 'tshol byed pa dang / yang na bde 'god bya yul gyi bsam 'char bsdu len byas te 'thad pa byung rjes bde 'god bya yul gyi 'gan bcol gron dngul la spyod dgos/ sa zhing tshang ma bsdus spyod byas pa dang / grong gseb kyi thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi sgrig gzhi med par bzos te/ zhing las min par bsgyur b.lag bstar byed na/ de'i bsdu spyod gron dngul tshang ma 'ing las min pa'i dud bo'i mi sna'i thon skyed dang 'tsho ba bde 'god thad bkol dgos/grong gseb kyi thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs la gtong sprod byed pa'i sa 'ing gi skyin gsab gron dngul dang bde 'god kyi kha gsab rogs dngul la zhang gis do dam dang sde bas(rtsa 'dzums)bkol spyod byed pa'i rnam pa can gyi nor don ched dud btsugs te do dam byas chog grong khyer dang rdzong gi sa don srid 'dzin gtso skyong sde khag gis nges par du lta skul la shugs snon pa dang / grong gseb kyi thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis sa zhing bsdu spyod gron dngul bkol spyod byed pa'i spyi bsgrags lam lugs 'dzugs par rogs res bya dgos/ sa zhing gi skyin gsab gron dngul dang bde 'god kyi kha gsab rogs dngul gcig gyur gyis bkod sgrig dang bkol spyod byed na/'ing sde'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mi'i sum cha gnyis yan gyis 'thad pa thob dgos/3 zhing thog tu chags pa'i dngos rigs dang ljang pa'i skyin gsadī spyan

dngul/ 〈sa 'ing do dam skor gyi bca' khrims lag bstar byed pa'i srol yiganyigi don tshan nyer drug pa'i 'khod tshan pa gnyis pa'i nang / lha cing thog tu chags pa'i dngos rigs dang ljang pa'i skyin gsab gron dngul de zhing thog tu chags pa'i dngos rigs dang ljang pa bdag dbang mkhan la dbang ba gtan la phab yod/ yang gcig bshad na/ skyin gsab gron dngul 'di zhing thog tu chags pa'i dngos rigs dang ljang pa bsdu yul gyi bdag dbang mkhan la gtogs pas/ dus thog tu ma dngul 'dang nges shig bdag dbang ma khan der sprod dgos shing / des rang dbang sgos bkol spyod byas chog(so gcig) rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims nang zhing pa'i sgod khang rgyab par sa zhing spyod pa'i thad gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/rang rgyal spyi dmangs la sdod khang thad sa zhing spyod pa'i phyogs nas spyod dbang ma gtogs bdag dbang med/ 〈sa zhing do dam skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan re gnyis pa'i nang /(1) blang sde'i sde dmangs khyim tshang gcig gis sdod khang gcig spyad 'thus la/ khang sa de'i rgya khyon zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i tshad gzhi las brgal mi chog(2) zhing sde'i sde dmangs kyis sdod khang las dgos na/ nges par du zhang(grong rdal)gi sa cha spyod thabs skor gyi khyon yongs kyi 'char 'god dang 'tsham dgos pa ma zad/ sngar yod kyi khang pa gnas sa'i rmang gzhi dang sde ba'i nang gi sa stong kho na bed spyod gang thub bya dgos/(3) zhing sde'i sde dmangs kyis sdod khang las par spyod pa'i sa cha rnams 'ang(grong rdal)mi dmangs srid gzhung nas zhib bsher byas pa brgyud rdzong rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung nas chog mchan thob pa bya dgos/ de'i nang zhiX/da sa zhing spyod sa cha yod na/ nges par du 'ing pa'i zhing spyod brgyud

bkol 'gro lugs 'grim dgos/(4) 'ing sde'i sde dmangs kyis rang gi sdod khang gzhan par btsong ba'am yang na bogs mar btang rjes/ yang bskyar khang sa yar yong ba'i re 'dun zhus na der chog mchan bkod mi chog(so gnyis) sde dmangs kyi khang sa'i bkol dbang thad gtan 'bebs ji ltar gtan khel byas yod/rang rgyal gyi 'brel yod bca' khrims nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ 'ing sde'i khang sa bkol dbang de khang pa nyo 'tshong dang legs skyes su phul bar bstun nas spo bsgyur byas chog mod/ 'on kyang sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen ni khang sa bkol dbang spo bsgyur byed par khrims ltar chog mchan thob pa bya dgos/ sde dmangs kyi khang sa bkol dbang thad nas gsham gsal gyi phyogs bcu gastan /rjo /zlo ༵ /nga/ bcos bsgyur byas pa brgyud/ sngar yod sa zhing gi 'dzin yig tshang ma mi dgos pa bzo ba dang /2 khang sa gcig gyur 'char 'god sgos legs sgrig ma byas na/ nges par du zhing sde'i sa cing bcos bsgyur skabs kyi sa zhing tho 'god khyab khongs ltar gtan khel bya dgos/3 gcig gyur 'char dgod dam yang na lugs mthun 'gro lugs 'grims pa'i khang sa la/ 'char 'god dam yang na legs sgrig byas rjes gtan khel byas pa'i bkol spyod khyab khongs tshad ga'i bya dgos/4 do bdag bar khang sa bkol spyod mtshams kyi rtsod gleng byas tshe/gal te sa zhing lag khyer steng mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon gyi mtshams gsal bor bkod yod pa dang / yin na'ang ring tshad dang zheng tshad kyi rgya khyon de gsal babod byas pa'i mtshams bzhi bo'i ring tshad dang gcig mtshungs min na5/1 spo

sdur byas pa'i mtshams bzhi'i rtags mtshan phud/ nges par du mtshams ba'i'i rtags mtshan de tshad ga'i byed dgos/ gal te phyogs gcig gi sa 'ing lag khyer dang rgya khyon dngos phan tshun gcig mtshungs yin pa dang / phyogs gzhan de'i sa zhing lag khyer dang rgya khyon dngos gcig mtshungs min pa'am yang na sa zhing la ga khyer med na/ nges par du sa zhing la ga khyer dang rgya khyon dar+shas gcig mtshungs yin pa'i phyogs de'i sa zhing lag khyer tshad ga'i byed da sa/5 thun mong gis spyod pa'i khang sa de menyam spyod mkhan ga'an pa 'thad pa ma byung ba brgyud/ phyogs gcig gis sdod khang rgyab zin pa dang /gal te sdod khang las skabs mnyam spyod mkhan gzhan pas shes ba'in du bsam 'char mi mthun pa ci yang ma bton pa dang / gzhan pa'i khe dbang dang sdi pa'i khe dbang la gnod 'grog ma byas na/ mu mthud du bkol spyod byas / sde dmangs gnas spos pa ma zad khang pa bshig rjes khang sa ba'ag na/ thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis phyir bsdus te/ gcig gyur sgos bkod sgrig dang bod spyod byed dbang yod/7 ar las med pa'i khang sa steng thun mong gis spyi pa'i sgrig bkod 'dzugs skrun byas pa'am yang na gzhan pas bdag bzung byas te lo2las brgal ba dang / sdod khang las zin pa dang / khang sa bkol mkhan gyis skabs der shes ba'in du bsam 'char mi mthun pa ci yang ma bton par/ da lta phyir bsdus te bkol spyod byed pa'i re 'dun zhus na/ rgyab skyor mi byed/8 1982lor/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi〈sde ba dang grong rdal gyi sdod khang thad sa zhing spyod pa'i skor gyi do dam srol yig〉khyab bsgrags ma byas pa'i sngo/ ༵/ sde tshan dang mi sger gyis khrims ltar 'ing sde'i sger khang nyos na/

khang sa de'i bkol dbang la nges par srung skyong thob pa bya dgos/ 〈sde ba dang grong rdal gyi sdod khang thad sa zhing spyod pa'i skor gyi do dam srol yig〉khyab bsags byas rjes 'ing sde'i sger khang nyos na/ nges par du chog bkod 'gro lurges 'grims te/ khang sa bkol dbang yod pa'i dpang yig len dgos/bsher rtsis chog bkod 'gro lugs ma brgyud na/ khang sa'i bkol dbang de khang pa spo bsgyur byas pa dang bstun nas nyo bdag la sprad mi chog pa dang /khang pa nyo 'tshong de rtsis 'gro med par brtsi dgos/9 grong khyer dang grong rdal gyi zhing las dud tho min pa'i sdod dmangs kyis zhing sde'i thun mong la dbang ba'i sa zhing spyod na/ 〈sa zhing do dam skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan zhe bzhi pa'i nang zhing spyod sa zhing brgyud bkol thad zhib bsher chog mchan 'god pa'i skor gyi gtan 'bebs ltar chog mchan 'god pa'i 'gro lugs 'grim dgos/10 khrims mthun sgos sdod khang rgyun 'dzin byas na khang sa de'i bkol dar+shang sdod khang gi bdag dbang dang bstun nas rgyun 'dzin mkhan la sprod da sa/(so gsum)rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims nang khrim mches 'brel ba'i sa zhing las rtsod gleng byung ba thag gcod pa'i thad gtan khel ji ltar byas yod/rang rgyal gyi〈〈dmangs khrims spyi srol〉〉gyi don tshan gya gsum pa'i nang /64gtan gnas dngos po khyim mtshes yin pa'i phyogs so sos/ nges par du thon skyed phan ldan dang 'tsho bar stabs bde/ mthun sgril rogs res/ 'dra ma nyam lugs mthun bcas kyi snying stobs la brten nas/ chu gcod pa dang phyir phud pa/ bgrod lam dang rlung rgyu ba sogs phyogs kyi khyim mtshes 'brel ba thag gcod legs po bya rgyu dang / khyim mtshes phyogs la gnod 'gog byas pa'am yang na gyong gun bzos tshe/ nges par du gnod 'tshe mtshams ༷/ga

dang gnod 'gog med par gtong ba dang / kun gsab sprod dgos pa bcas gtan la phab yod/ 'di ni sa zhing dang sdod khang sogs khyim mtshes 'brel ba thag gcod pa'i rtsa don rang bzhin gyi gtan 'bebs shig yin la/gtan 'bebs 'dir gzhigs nas/ zhing pa spun zla tshor gal te 'gan gtsang len sa zhing dang khang sa sogs khyim mtshes 'brel ba'i thad nas rtsod gleng byung tshe/ thog mar nges par du thon skyed phan ldan dang 'tsho bar stabs bde/ mthun sgril rogs res/ 'dra mnyam lugs mthun bcas kyi dgongs don ltar gros mol byas te thag gcod dgos/ gros 'cham ma byung na/ mi dmangs srid gzhung gis thag gcod du 'jug dgos/ mi sger bar dang mi sger dang sde tshan bar rtsod gleng byung tshe/ zhang mi dmangs srid gzhung ngam yang na rdzong rim pa yan gyi mi dmangs srid gzhung gis thag gcod dgos/ do bdag 'brel yod mi dmangs srid gzhung gis thag bcad par blo 'thad ma byung na/ thag bcad yi ge'i brda sbyor 'byor ba'i nyin nas nyin30yi nang tshun du mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug byas chog tsod gleng thag ma bcad pa'i sngon du/ phyogs gcig gis kyang sa zhing bed spyod kyi gnas bab bsgyur bcos byas mi chog rang rgyal gyi ches mtho'i mi dmangs khrims khang gi〈krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi dmangs khrims spyi srol〉lag len mthar phyinabyed pa'i gnad don 'ga'i skor gyi bsam 'char(tshod spyod)nang zhing dang sdod khang sogs khyim mtshes 'brel ba'i thad sngar bas bye brag gi gtan 'bebs byas yod de/(1) khyim mtshes phyogs gcig gis ar las rgyag pa rkyen byas te gnas skabs kyis pha rol phyogs kyi sa zhing bdag tu bzung ba dang / bdag bzung phyogs kyis gal te phyogs gnyis kyis kha dan byas pa'i khyab khongs dang spyod sgo/duswā sdukag bcas ltar bkol spyod ma byas na/ der dus thog tu yul dngos

gtsang bzo dang gnod 'gog med par bzo ba/ sngar gnas slar gso dang gun gsab sprod pa bcas kyi bka' rgya phab rgyu/(2) phyogs gcig gis rang 'dod sgos rang 'bab chu bkag bcad dam yang na sger bzung byas te pha rol po'i rgyun ldan gyi thon skyed dang 'tsho bar shugs rkyen bzos na/ pha rol por gnod pa med par bzo ba'i re 'dun zhu dbakā yod zlo dang / pha rol por gyong kun bzos tshe/ nges par du gun gsab (33 rnyims ma/ tshes phyogs gcig gis nges par du phyogs gzhan de'i sa zhing spyad de chu phud dgos na/ nges par du chog mchan thob dgos/ 'on kyang dgos nges kyi tshad bkag nang srung skyong dang byed thabs 'os 'tsham spyad de chu phud dgos pa dang / de ltar byas kyang gyong kun bzos na/ phan khe reg mkhan gyis lugs mthun sgos kun gsab sprod dgos/ khyim mtshes phyogs gcig gis lugs mthun gyi byed thabs ga'an pa spyad de chu phud chog na'ang ma spyad par/ phyogs gzhan de'i sa zhing spyad de chu phud pas phyogs de'i rgyu nor 'phro brlag tu btang ba'am yang na gtong srid par/ gzhan phyogs des gnod 'tshe gtong mkhan la nyen kha med par gtong ba dang sngar gnas slar gso byed pa/skyo gan gasnab sprod dgos pa bcas kyi re 'dun zhus na/ nges par du( /lta phyo/ hā /ci/ /nges par du khyim mtshes phyogs gcig gi sa zhing steng bgrod dgos tshe/ nges par du bgrod du 'jug dgos/ der brten nas gyong kun thebs na/ skyin gsab 'os 'tsham sprod dgos/(5) phyogs gcig gis bdag bzung byas pa'am yang na bkol spyod byed pa'i ar las dngos po'i khyab khongs nang sngar nas nges par brgyud dgos pa'i bgrod lam btod yod na/ bdag dbang mkhan dang sdu/la

dbang mkhan gyis bkag bcad byas mi chog la/ gal te bkag bcad byas te gzhan mi'i thon skyed dang 'tsho bar shugs rkyen thebs te/ ga'an mis gnod 'gog med par bzo ba'am yang na sngar gnas slar gso byed pa'i re 'dun zhus na/nges par rgyab skyor bya dgos/ yin na'ang bgrod lam gzhan pa gtod pa'i cha rkyen yod na/ bgrod lam gzhan pa btod kyang chog(6) khyim mtshes bar chu thigs pa'i rtsod gleng thag gcod skabs/ nor 'dzol yod pa'i phyogs des phyogs gzhan der gnod 'tshe bzos tshe/ der gnod 'gog med par bzo ba dang gun gsab sprod pa'i bka' rgya phab rgyu/(7) khyim mtshes phyogs gcig gis rang nyid kyis spyod pa'i sa zhing steng chu rka dang chu rdzing / sa dong sogs brko ba'am yang na smyug sdong gi cod pa rgyas te/ gzhan phyogs kyi ar las dngos po'i bde 'jags dang rgyun ldan ngang bkol spyod byed par nyen kha bzos tshe/ gnas tshul so sor dbye ste/ der nyen kha med par bzo ba dang sngar gnas slar gso byed pa/ kun gsab sprod pa bcas kyi bka' phab rgyu/(so bzhi) khang rnying bshug ste khang gsar las par zhib bsher chog mchan brgyud dgos sam/zhing pa spun zla tshos rang khyim gyi khang rnying bshug ste/ sngar gyi khang sa'i steng khang ba gsar ba las na'ang zhib bsher chog mchan nges par du brgyud dgos/ 〈sa zhing do dam skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan re gnyis pa'i nang / zhing sde'i sde dmangs kyis sdod khang las na/ zhang dang grong rdal gyi sa cha spyod thabs skor gyi khyon yongs kyi 'char 'god dang 'tsham dgos pa ma zad/sngar yod kyi khang sa dang sde ba'i nang gi sa stong kho na spyod gang thub bya dgos/zhing sde'i sde dmangs kyi sdod khang las byed du spyod pa'i sa cha rnams 'ang(grong rdaX/mi dmangs srid gzhung nas 'ib bsher chog mchan thob pa brgyud/ rdzong

rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung la zhus te chog mchan 'god du 'jug dgos pa gtan la phab yod/ don tshan don drug pa'i nang / 66zhing sde'i sde dmangs kyis chog mchan ma thob pa'am yang na mgo skor gtong thabs la brten nas chog mchan thob par byas te khrims 'gal sgos sa cha bzung spyod byas rigs la rdzong rim pa yan gyi mi dmangs srid gzhung sa don gtso skyong sde khag gis khrims 'gal ngang bzung spyod byas pa'i sa zhing phyir slog pa'i 'gan dkro rgyu dang /sa cha spyod thabs skor gyi khyon yongs kyi 'char gzhi dang 'gal te rang dgar 'ing spyod sa zhing 'dzugs skrun la mkho ba'i sa char bsgyur rigs la khrims 'gal sgos bzung spyod byas pa'i sa cha'i thog gsar du las pa'i khang pa dang sgrig bkod gzhan rnams dus bkag nang bshig tu bcug nas sa cha'i sngar yod rnam pa ji bzhin slar gso bya rgyu migatan la phab yod/ gong gi bca' khrims don tshan las shes thub pa ni/ zhing pa'i lag na yod pa'i khang sa'i bkol dbang lag khyer dang don dngos su gnas pa'i sdod khang gnyis gcig 'dra yin na/ bkol spyod lag khyer des go chod pa yin/ bkol dbang lag khyer des ma gzhi lugs dang mthun pa'i sdod khang rnying ba bshigs pa bden dpang byas rjes/ sngar gyi khang sa'i bkol dbang de de dang bstun nas gtan khel min pa'i gnas bab tu gyur ba dang / sngar gyi khang sa'i lag khyer yang de bstun gyis med par gyur 'gro/ sngar gnas steng sdod khang gsar ba las rung /sde dmangs u yon lhan khang la snyan zhu phul dgos pa dang / sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis sdod khang gsar ba las sa de rang sde ba'i sde ba'i 'char 'god dang mthun min la yang bskyar zhib bsher byas te/ don dngos kyi gnas tshul ltar zhang dang grong rdal mi dmangs srid gzhung la zhus nas zhib bsher byas rjes/ thad kur rdzong rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sa don do dam sde khag la zhus nas zhib bsher byed du 'jug dgos/ sa don do kārdo sde
sa zhisa'i ste5 par ba

le'u gnyis pa/ zhing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur dang zhing pa'i khur bo dze yang tu gtong ba'i skor/(gcig) zhing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur bad bca' khrims dang srid jus kyi gzhi 'dzin sa gtso bo gang dag yod/'ing pa spun zla tshos shes gsal ltar/ 2000lor/ rgyal khab kyis an hu'e zhing chen dang 'ing ljongs kha shas kyi rdzong56la sngon la zhing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur thad kyi tshod lta spel ba red/ de'i rjes/ krung dbyang gis gcig gyur bkod sgrig byas pa ltar/ zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer so pos gcig rjes gnyis mthud du tshod lta spel/ 'ing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur ni zhing sde ru khyim dud kyi thon tshad dang sbrel ba'i 'gan gtsang len gyi 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs lag bstar byas rjes kyi bcos bsgyur chen po 'ig yin la/ zhing sde'i dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi khyon yongs dang 'brel zhing / rgya che'i zhing pa mang tshogs kyi bde rtsar thug pa'i khe phan dang 'brel bas/ nges par du khrims ltar lag bstar bya dgos/ mig sngar zhing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur thad bca' khrims dang srid jus kyi gzhi 'dzin sa gtso bo 'di dag yod de/1 〈〈rtsa khrims〉〉yin/ rtsa khrims nang spyi dmangs kyis nges par du bca' khrims ltar dpya khral sprod pa'i 'os 'gan lag bstar bya dgos pa gsal bor bstan yod/2 〈〈zhing las skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉yin/ zhing las skor gyi ༵༵'a

khrims nang / las khungs gang zhig gis gzhung don bsgrub ched zhing pa dang yang na zhing las thon skyed gnyer skyong rtsa 'dzugs la gron dngul bsdu na nges par du bca' khrims dang khrims srol/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis dbang cha gnang ba'i sde tshan gyi gtan khel lam yang na zhing chen rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i sgrig srol lam 'u gas/ zhing chen rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis bzos pa'i sgrig srol lam 'u gas bcas ltar rgyal srid spyi khyab khang la 'char zin 'bul dgos/ gron sdud kyi khyab khongs dang tshad ga'i nges par du spyi bsgrags spel ba ma zad/ gnas tshul la gzhigs te dgos nges kyi zhib bsher dang dag gtsang bya dgos/ bca' khrims dang khrims srol/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis dbang cha gnang ba'i sde khag gi gtan khel lam yang na 'ing chen rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sgrigasrol lam lugs bcas kyi gzhi 'dzin sa med na/ las khungs gang 'ig gis gzhung don bsgrub ched du gron dngul bsdus tshe/ zhing pa dang 'ing las thon skyed gnyer skyong rtsa 'dzugasal dang len mi byed pa'i dbang cha yod/3 〈〈zhing las dpya khral skor gyi srol yig〉〉yin/ 1958lor rgyal khab kyis 'grem spel lag bstar byas shing / 1979lor yang bskyar bzo bcos dang kha gsab chen po brgyab pa'i〈zhing las dpya khral skor gyi bca' khrims〉nang zhing las dpya khral gyi khral 'jal mkhan dang bsdu len gyi khyab khongs dang khral 'bor sogs gtan 'bebs byas yod/4 krung gung krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi zhing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur skor gyi srid jus rang bzhin gyi yig cha ste/(1)2000lo'i zla3pa'izhing sde'i dbya khral bcos bsgyur thad kyi tshod lta'i bya ba spel ba'i skor gyi brda tho(krung dbyang gzhung las thing gis spel ba'i2000lo'i yig cha ang7pa)dang /66

(2) 2001lo'i za3pa'i〈zhing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur thad kyi chod lta'i bya ba snga ra bas legs par sgrub pa'i skor gyi brda tho〉(rgyal spel2001lo'i yig cha ang5ba)(3) 2002lo'i zla3pa'i(2002lor zhing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur rgya bskyed pa'i tshod lta'i bya ba legs par sgrub pa'i skor gyi brda tho〉(rgyal spel2002lo'i yig cha ang25ba) (4) 2003lo'i za3pa'i〈zhing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur thad kyi tshod lta'i bya bar sgo kun nas skul 'ded gtong ba'i skor gyi bsam 'char〉(rgyal spel2003lo'i yig cha ang12pa)dang / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi sde khag dang 'ing chen rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'brel yod yig cha sogs/dper na/ nor srid pu'u dang rgyal khab khral don spyi khyab cu'u yi zhing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur gyi tshod lta'i bya ba'i khrod kyi zhing las dpya khral thad kyi gnad don 'ga'i skor gyi bsam 'char〉〉sogs/(gnyis) krung dbyang gis zhing pa'i khur bo je yang du gtong ba'i skor la yig cha gang dag bzos yod/gang byung du gron dngul bsdu ba dang chad pa gcod pa/ cha gses rgyag pa bcas byas te zhing pa'i khur bo je ljid du gtong ba'i snang tshul rgyun mi chad pa dang / 'ing pa'i khur bo je ljid yang ljid du gtong ba de zhing sde bcos bsgyur dang gong du spel ba/ brtan brling yong bar byed pa bcas la shugs rkyen thebs pa'i gnad don 'bur thon zhig tu gyur 'dug gal te mtha' gcig tu yo bsrang ma byas tshe/ rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi bgeg rkyen du 'gyur ba dang / gzhi rim srid dbang sra brtan yong bar shugs rkyen thebs srid pas/ 'ing pas tang dang srid gzhung la bcangs pa'i brtse sems la phog thug gtong ba dang / rgyal khab yun ring bde 'godā ltod

par yang nyen kha bzo srid/ tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis zhing pa'i khur bo je yang du gtong ba'i gnad don la dmigs nas/ snga gzhug tu gsham gsal gyi yig cha gal chen 'ga' bkram pa ste/(1) 1985lo'i zla10ba'i tshes31nyin gyi〈krung gung krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'ing par gang byung du dngul khral 'gel ba dang gron dngul bsdu ba gtan 'gog byed pa'i skor gyi brda tho〉dang /(2) 1990lo'i zla7pa'i tshes3nyin gyi〈rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'ing pa'i khur bo dngos gnas je yang du gtong ba'i skor gyi brda tho〉(3) 1991lo'i zla12pa'i tshesaganyin rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis bkram dh+riXsazhing dis khur ba'i gron dngul dang ngal rtsol par do dam byed pa'i skor krol( 43471993lo'i zla3pa'i tshes19nyin(krung gung krung dbyang gzhung las thing dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gzhung las thing gyi zhing pa'i khur bo dngos gnas je yang du gtong ba'i skor gyi brel myur brda tho〉(5) 1993lo'i zla7pa'i tshes22nyin gyi〈krung gung krung dbyang gzhung las thing dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gzhung las thing gyi zhing pa'i khur bo dang 'brel las gzhi zhib bsher dang thag gcod pa'i bsam 'char skor gyi brda tho〉(6) 1996lo'i zla12pa'i tshes30nyin gyi〈krung gung krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi zhing pa'i khur bo je yang du gtong ba'i bya ba legs par sgrub pa'i skor gyi brda tho〉(krung spel1996lo'i yig cha ang13pa)(7) 2002lo'i〈krung gung krung dbyang gzhung las thing dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gzhung las thing gyi 〈mang pa'i khur bo dang 'brel ba'i gyod (las)don gyi 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded lag bstar byed pa'i skor gyi skabs spyod byed bdīkā/'grem spel byed pa'i skor gyi brda tho(rgyal srid spyi khyab gzhung las)

thing gyis spel ba'i2002lo'i yig cha ang19ba)(8) 2002lo'i zla7pa'i tshes10nyin rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gzhung las thing gyis zhing las sde khag sogs sde khag la brgyud spel byas pa'i(2002lor zhing pa'i khur bo je yang du gtong ba'i thad kyi bya ba'i bsam 'char skor gyi brda tho〉(rgyal srid spyi khyab gzhung las thing gyis spel ba'i2002lo'i yig cha ang10ba)(9) 2003lo'i zla8ba'i tshes29nyin rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gzhung las thin gyis 'ing las sde khag sogs sde khag la brgyud spel byas pa'i(2003lo'i 'ing pa'i khur bo je yang du gtong ba'i bya ba'i bsam 'char skor gyi brda tho〉(rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gzhung las thing gyis spel ba'i2003lo'i yig cha ang50ba)(gsam) don rer gros re zhes pa'i go don ci/6 dorno rer gros re zhes pa ni zhing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur yin pa dang / sna las ka gnyis med par bzos te/ bcos bsgyur sde ba'i bsdu len thob cha cha bgos byed pa'i byed thabs bkol spyod byas rjes/ dngul gsog rtsol 'jug lam lugs gsar ba zhig lag bstar byas pa red/ krung dbyang gis sde ba'i nang gi don rer gros re'i dngul gsog rtsol 'jug lam lugs ni zhing sde gzhi rim gyi dmangs gtso'i chab srid 'dzugs skrun gyi nang don gal che/ zhi~X yin pas/ nges par du dus yun ring bor rgyun skyong ba'i blang bya ba na (tāzhi/) don rer gros re :yi don ni ci zhig gi don yin/ra don rer gros re yi don ni sde ba rim pas spyi phan bya gzhag sgrub pa'i las don zhig yin/ gtso bor sde dmangs kyi 'tsho ba dang thon skyed la 'brel ba dam zab yod pa dang / nges par du sde ba'i nang gcig gyur sdidī rtsa

'dzugs dang las sgrub byed dgos pa'i 'ing las chu bed sgrig bkod dang mi phyugs 'thung chu'i sgrig bkod/ sde ba'i gzhung lam 'dzugs skrun/ sdong 'dzugs nags skrun bzo 'god sogs sde dmangs yongs la thad kur phan khe yod pa'am yang na brgyud pa'i phan khe yod pa'i spyi phan rang ba'in gyi sgrig bkod dang las gzhir bstan pa yin/(lnga) don rer gros re yi las ga'i gros rim gyi rtsa don ci yin/6 don rer gros re mithad ngal rtsol rtsol 'jug dang ma dngul gtong na/nges par du nus pas lcogs chod kyis sgrub pa dang mang tshogs la phan thogs pa/ ma bsgrubs pa'i sngon du sngon rtsis byed pa/ tshad thog nas tshod 'dzin byed pa/ don dag yod na gros sol byed pa dang / don dag med na gros mol mi byed pa/ dmangs gtsos jus thag gcod pa dang / dmangs gtso'i do dam bcas kyi rtsa don la brtsi 'jog bya dgos/ sde dmangs kyi mig snga'i khe phan la brtsi 'jog bya dgos la/ sde dmangs kyi phugs ring khe phan la'ang dmigs dgos/ sde dmangs kyi dpal 'byor theg nus la zhib 'dang zab mo brgyab ste/ sgor mo ci tsam yod na don dag de tsam bsgrub dgos/ sde dmangs kyi dmangs gtso'i dbang char brtsi 'jog gang legs byas te/ sde dmangs mang shos 'thad pa byung ba'i don dag bsgrub pa dang / 'thad pa mi byung na bsgrub mi chog don rer gros re thad dngul gsog rtsol 'jug byed pa de gtan 'jags kyi las gzhi zhig tu bsgyur te/ go skabs dang bstun nas zhing pa'i khur bo je ljid du btang mi chog(drugan don rer gros re yi las ga'i gros rim gyi go rim ci yin/6 don rer gros re yi las ku'i gros rim de nges par du gsham gyi go rim ltar gros bya dgos pa ste/70(1) thun mo nga spyi phan gyi bya gzhag bsgrubs na/ sde ba rim pa'i rtsa

'dzugs kyis dgos mkho dngos dang mang tshogs kyi re ba ltar gros ga'i 'don pa ma zad/ gtan 'bebs ltar las gzhi'i sngon rtsis jus gzhi bzos te/ sde dmangs gros tshogs sam yang na sde dmangs 'thus mi'i gros tshogs la gros cib byed par sprod dgos/ sde dmangs gros tshogs la rang sde ba'i lo na18yan gyi sde dmangs kyi phyed ka lhag zhugs dgos pa dang / yang na rang sde ba'i sum cha'i gnyis yan gyi zhing dud kyi 'thus mi zhugs te/ gros tshogs la slobs pa'i mi sna'i sum cha'i gnyis yan gyi 'thad pa byung dgos/(2) dngul gsog rtsol 'jug gi jus gzhir 'thad pa byung rjes/ sde ba rim pa'i rtsa 'dzugs kyis dngul gtong rtsol 'jug gi las ga'i dang grangs 'bor/ sde dmangs gros tshogs sam yang na sde dmangs 'thus mi'i gros tshogs las gros bsdur byas pa'i gnas tshul sogs zhing chen rim pa'i 'ing pa'i khur bo'i lta skul do dam sde khag gis gcig gyur gyis dpar ba'i〈sde ba rim pa'i thun mong spyi phan gyi bya ga'ag sgrub pa'i snyan zhu'i re'u mig〉bskangs rjes/ 'ang(grong jal)mi dmangs srid gzhung la chog mchan 'god par zhu dgosakho mjug tu thon dus/ 'ang(grong rdal so)mos rang re'i zhang gi dngul gtong rtsol 'jug gnas tshul gyi spyi bsdoms de rdzong rim pa'i zhing pa'i khur bo/ lta skul do dam sde khag la zhus te zhib bsher gtan 'bebs byed du 'jug da sa/(3) chog mchan thob pa'i dngul gtong rtsol 'ju gi las gzhi dang tshad gzhi de/ zhang(grong rdal)gnyer skyong do dam sde khag dang sde ba rim pa'i rtsa 'dzugs kyis 'brel yod gtan 'bebs ltar khyim tshang re rer bgo ba ma zad/sgo sam steng nas spyi bsgrags spel dgos/ dus mtshungs su zhing chen rim pa'i 'ing pa'i khur bo'i lta skul do dam sde khag gis gcig gyur gyis bzos pa'i zhing pa'i khur bo'i lta skul 'dzin shog bskang dgos/ sa gnas kha shas kyilha /ga

mchan thob pa'i rtsol 'jug las gzhi dang tshad ga'i de nyin15nang tshun du sde don spyi bsgrags sgo sam steng spyi bsgrags bya dgos pa bcas gtan la phab yod/ma (bdun) don der gros re nang bsdu ba'i ngal rtsol pa ni gang dag na/ 66don rer gros re las thun mong spyi phan bya ga'ag sgrub par mkho ba'i ngal las de zhing sde'i ngal rtsol nus shugs ltar 'gan bgo bya dgos/ sa gnas so so'i gtan 'bebs mi 'dra ba ste/ dper na/ hran tung zhing chen gyis zhing sde'i ngal rtsol nus shugs kyi khyab khongs ni/ pho lo18nas55bar dang / mo lo 18nas45bar yin la/ dngos zhabs dmag mi dang sngon gshegs dpa' bo'i khyim mi/ rmas skyon byung ba'i dmag mi/ phyir log dmag mi rgan pa/ slob grwa 'grims pa'i slob ma/ sbrum ma dang yang na byis pa btsas nas lo1ma lon pa'i bud med bcas kyis ngal rtsol las 'gan khur mi dgos pa gtan la phab yod/ yang dper na/ kre cang 'ing chen gyis zhing sde'i ngal rtsol nus shugs kyi khyab khongs ni/ pho lo18nas55bar dang / mo lo18nas50bar yin la/ dngos 'bas dmag mi dang rmas skyon byung ba'i dmag mi/sngon gshesas dpa' bo'i khyim mi/ gzhung don du rang srog blos btang ba dang nad la sa shi ba'i dmig mi'i khyim mi/ slob grwa 'grims pa'i slob ma/ 'char ldan bu btsa'i gshag bcos byas rjes mjug rkyen nad dang 'dus nad byung ba'i nad pa/ sbrum ma/ byis pa btsas nas lo1ma ma lon bud med sogs kyis las kur zhugs pa'i 'os 'gan ma khur na chog(brgyadan don zer gros re yi dngul gtong las zhugs thad kyi 'os 'gan dze yang du gtong ba'i srid nus ji lta bu yin/'ing sde'i lnga skyong khyim tshang dang lo70yan gyi rgan pas ma dngul gardot+ta ba'i 'os 'gan khur mi dgos/ nad byung ba dang rmas skyon byung ba

sogs kyi dbang gis ma dngul gtong ba dang ngal rtsol nang zhugs pa'i 'os 'gan khur mi thub na/ rang nyid kyis re 'dun zhus te/ sde ba'i gros tshogs sam yang na sde dmangs 'thus mi'i gros tshogs kyi phyed ka lhag 'thad pa byung tshe/'os 'gan de rigs je yang du btang chog sngon gshegs dpa' bo'i khyim mi dang rmas skyon byung ba'i dmag mi/ phyir log pa'i dmag mi rgan pa bcas la rgyal khab dang zhing chen gyi 'brel yod gtan 'bebs ltar 'os 'gan je yang du gtong ba'i gzigs skyong gnang rgyu/(dgan don der gros re yi dngul gtong las zhugs byed pa'i grangs tshad ga tshod yin/8 don rer gros re las thun mong spyi phan gyi bya ga'ag sgrub par dngul gtong las zhugs byed pa'i thad grangs tshad tshod 'dzin lag bstar byas yod la/ sa gnas so so'i gtan 'bebs mi 'dra ba ste/ dper na hran tung zhing chen gyis rtsa don steng nas lo gcig la thengs re dang / lo gcig nang sde dmangs res khur dgos pa'i don rer gros re yi ma dngul de sgor15las bsal mi chog pa dang / ngal rtsol pa res khur dgos pa'i ngal rtsol las ka10las brgal mi chog pa gtan la phab yod/ yang dper na kre cang zhing chen gyis ngal rtsol pa res lo rer khur dgos pa'i nga' rtsol las ka de3las brgal mi chog pa dang / las kur zhugs pa dang yang na sgor mos las ku'i tshab byed pa de zhing pa rang mos sgos gdam gseb byas chog pa gtan la phab yod/(shārgya) don rer gros re yi ma dngul do dam dang bkol spyod ji ltar bya sado/ re/ ra gros re :yi ma dngul de sde ba'i thun mong gi ma dngul la gtogs pas/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis bsdu len gyi 'gan khur dgos pa ma zad bkol spyod bkod sgrig bya dgos la/ zhang(grong rdal)kāhār

skyong do dam sde khag gis lta skul do dam byed pa lag bstar bya dgos/ 'ing pas ma dngul gtong ba dang las zhugs byed pa'i bya ba sgrub skabs/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis sde dmangs la zhing chen rim pa'i zhing pa'i khur bo'i lta skul do dam sde khag gis gcig gyur gyis bzos pa'i dngul btang 'byor tho dang las bkol 'dzin yig ster dgos/ lo mjug tu rtsis brgyab rjes/ sde ba rim pa'i rtsa 'dzugs kyis ma dngul dang ngal las bkol spyod byas pa'i gnas tshul de sde dmangs gros tshogs sam yang na sde dmangs 'thus mi'i gros tshogs la yar zhu bya dgos pa ma zad/ dus thog tu sgo sam steng spyi bsgrags bya dgos/(bcu gcig) gtan 'bebs byas pa'i dngul gtong las zhugs kyi tshad las brgal che ji ltar bya/khyad par can gyi rgyu rkyen med na'ang / zhing chen gyis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i dngul gtong las zhugs kyi tshad grangs las brgal ba'am yang na sgrig lam sgrig srol ltar ma bsgrubs par/ btsan thabs kyis dngul gtong las zhugs byed du bcug tshe/ sde dmangs la dngul gtong las zhugs dang len mi byed pa'i dbang cha yod/ zhing pa'i theg nus la 'dang mi rgyag par/srid skyong byas rjes kho nar bsnyegs te/ dus gang rung du zhing pa'i khur bo je ljid du gtong ba'am yang na sgrig lam sgrig srol ltar bya ba mi bsgrubs par/btsan thabs kyis dngul gtong las zhugs byed du bcug tshe/ brda khyab thog nas skyon brjod bya dgos shing / gnas tshul tshabs chen yin na/ 'brel yod kyi gtan 'bebs ltar 'gan khur mkhan gtso bo'i tang gi sgrig khrims dang srid skyong byas rjes kyi 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded bya dgos/74

go (bcu gnyis) khrims ltar sa rgod slog par dpya khral dzi ltar bsdu da sa/khrims ltar sa rgod dang gram stong slog pa'am yang na byed thabs gzhan pa brgyud de rmo 'ing gi rgya khyon rgya bskyed pa las thob pa'i yong sgo'i thad nas/ yo nga sgo yo da pa'i lo nas bzung ste lo1nas lo3nang 'ing las dpya khral mi bsdu ba dang / gnas spos yul mis sa rgod slog nas thob pa'i yong sgo de yong sgo yo da pa'i lo nas bzung ste/ lo3nas lo 5nang zhing las dpya khral mi bsdu/gram khul dang chu mdzod khul/ mtshe'u khul dang ri mtho g.yang gzar gyi ri khul bcas kyi dbul phongs zhing pas sa rgod slog nas yong sgo blangs na/ dus yun nges can zhig nang zhing las dpya khral mi bsdu/(bcu gsum) gnas tshul gang 'dra'i 'og nas zhing las dpya khral mi spyod pa'i sridacas longs su sprud chog gam/saganas so so'i cing las dpya khral med par bzos yul la mi 'dra sa yod de/ hran tung 'ing chen gyis2002lo'i zla6pa'i tshes22nyin khyab bsgrags byas pa'i〈zhing la sa khral bsdu thad kyi skabs spyod byed thabs〉kyi gtan 'bebs la gzhigs na/ gsham gyi gnas tshul 'og zhing las dpya khral sprod mi dgos pa'i srid jus longs su spyad chog ste/(1) zhing sde'i sngon gshegs dpa' bo'i khyim mi dang rmas skyon byung ba'i dmag mi/ phyir log pa'i dmag mi rgan pa bcas la zhing las dpya khral med par bzo ba'i gzigs skyong gnang dgos/ zhing sde'i khyad dbul khyim tshang dang ngal rtsol nus pa shor ba'i dbang bo skyon can la chog mchan thob pa brgyud 'os 'tsham sgos zhing las dpya khral 'phri gtong byas chog lo70yan gyi rgan par gsar du bsdu ba'i 'ing las dpya khral med par bzo rgyu/(2) 'gan gtsang len sa zhing cung mang ba'i 'bru 'debs zhir+sha /ma

chen mo'i zhing las dpya khral de sngar 'khur ba'i 'ing las dpya khral las brgal tshe/ 'os 'tsham sgos 'phri gtong byed pa'i gzigs skyong gnang rgyu/(3) khral sprod mkhan gyis 'debs 'dzugs byas pa'i zhing las lo tog la than pa sogs dang yang na rang byung gnod 'tshe gzhan pa thebs te lo legs ma byung na/ gnod thebs yang por nyung 'phri dang gnod 'tshe che bar mang 'phri/ha cang tshabs chen yin na med par bzo ba'i rtsa don ltar/ chog mchan thob rjes zhing las dpya khral nyung 'phri byed pa'am yang na med par bzo rgyu/(bcu bzhi) rgyal khab kyis zhing las dpya khral nyung 'phri dang med par bzo stangs thad blang bya ci zhig bton yod/2003lo'i zla6pa'i tshes27nyin/ 〈rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'ing las dpya khral bcos bsgyur byed pa'i chod lta'i bya bar sgo kun nas skul 'ded gtong ba'i smor gyi bsam 'charasminang 'ing las dpya khral nyung 'phri dang med par bzo stangs bsgyur bcos byed pa'i blang bya bton yod pa ste/ gnod 'tshe dang 'brel ba'i nyung 'phri dang med par bzo ba'i thad gang nus kyis sngon la nyung 'phri dang med par bzos rjes bsdu len byed dgos pa dang / spyi tshogs steng nyung 'phri dang med par bzo ba'i thad nges par du sngon la nyung 'phri dang med par bzos rjes bsdu len byed pa lag bstar byas te/ nyung 'phri dang med par bzo ba'i srid jus dus thog tu lag bstar byed par khag theg bya dgos/(bco lnga) zhing par gron dngul gang byung du bsdu mi chog pa'i bca' khrims kyi gzhi 'dzin sa ci yin/〈〈zhing las skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉nang / las khungs gang 'ig gis gzhung don bsgrub ched du zhing pa'am yang na zhing las thon skyed gnyer skyong rtsa 'dzugs la gron dngul bsdu bar nges par du bca' khrims dang khrim sa srol/rgya/spyad spyi khyab khang gis dbang cha gnang ba'i sde khag gi chod don dam yang

na zhing chen rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis bzos pa'i sgris srol gyi gtan 'bebs/ zhing chen rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis bzos pa'i sgrigasrol bcas gzhir bzung ste nges par du rgyal srid spyi khyab khang la 'char 'god yar zhu bya dgos/ dngul sdud kyi khyab khongs dang tshad gzhi de nges par du spyi bsgrags bya dgos pa ma zad/ gnas tshul la ga'igs te dgos nges kyi 'ib bsher dang gtsang bsher bya dgos/ bca' khrim/sa dang khrims sro la/rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis dbang cha gnang ba'i sde khag gi chod don dam yang na 'ing chen rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sgrig srol gtan 'bebs bcas kyi ga'i 'dzin sa med par/ las khungs gang 'ig gis gzhung don bsgrub ched du gron dngul bsdus tshe/ 'ing pa dang 'ing las thon skyed gnyer skyong rtsa 'dzugs la dang len mi byed pa'i dbang cha yod/ 〈ling pa'i khur bo'i gron dngul dang ngal la sa do dam/ skor gyi srol yig〉gi don tshan nyer gnyis pa'i nang / zhing par kha phyogs pa'i srid 'dzin las don rang ba'in gyi gron dngul bsdu bar/ las gzhi de'i sgrig bkod dang tshad ga'i gtan 'bebs dang legs sgrig byed na/ nges par du 'ing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas yan gyi mi dmangs srid gzhung gi nor srid dang dngos gong gtso skyong sde khag gis zhing pa'i khur bo'i lta sku la do dam sde khag dang mnyam du chog ma chan 'god dgos la/ las ga'i gal chen yin na nges par du rgyal srid spyi khyab khang ngam yang na 'ing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyi mi dmangs srid gzhung gi chog mchan thob dgos/(bcu drug) zhing par gang byung du chad pa gcod mi chog pa'i bca' khrims kyi gzhi 'dzin sa ci yin/〈〈ling las skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉nang / las khungs gang mas gis 'ing pa'am yang na zhing las thon skyed gnyer skyong rtsa 'dzugs la dngurnyi /da

dang nyes chad gcod na nges par du bca' khrims dang khrims srol gyi gtan 'bebs ltar gcod dgos pa dang / bca' khrims dang khrims srol nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i ga'i 'dzin sa med par/ las khungs gang zhig gis kyang zhing pa'am yang na zhing las thon skyed gnyer skyong rtsa 'dzugs la dngul chad bcad na/ 'ing pa dang zhing las thon skyed gnyer skyong rtsa 'dzugs kyis dang len ma byas na chog pa gtan 'bebs byas yod/ zhing pa'i khur bo'i gron dngul dang ngal las do dam skor gyi srol yigagi don tshan nyer brgyad pa'i nang khrims 'gal ngang zhing par dngul chad gcod pa dang rgyu nor gzhung bzhes byed pa gtan 'gog bya dgos pa gtan la phab yod/(bcu bdun) zhing par gang byung du cha gses brgyab mi chog pa'i bca' khrims kyi gzhi 'dzin sa ci yin/〈〈'ing las skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉nang las khungs gang zhig gam yang na sde tshan gang zhig gis rnam pa ci zhig spyad de zhing pa'am yang na ling las thon skyedaganyer skyong rtsa 'dzugs la cha gses brgyab mi chog pa gtan la phab yod/bca' khrims dang khrims srol nang gtan 'bebs gzhan pa yod pa phud/las khungs gang zhig gam yang na sde tshan gang zhig gis byed thabs ci zhig spyad de zhing pa'am yang na zhing las thon skyed gnyer skyong rtsa 'dzugs la mi shugs dang nor shugs dang dngos shugs 'don sprod byed pa'i re 'dun zhus tshe/ de ni cha gses brgyab pa'i khongs su gtogs pas/ zhing pa dang zhing las thon skyedaganyer skyong rtsa 'dzugs la de rigs dang len mi byed pa'i dbang cha yod/〈zhing pa'i khur bo'i gron dngul dang ngal las do dam skor gyi srol yig〉gi don tshan nyer drug pa'i nang / zhing par rin gong yod pa'i dngul 'dzin dang tshags par dang dus deb/ dpe deb sogs 'grem spel byed na/ nges par du rakā sbyas rtsa don la brtsi 'jog byed dgos pa dang / sde tshan gang 'ig gis

kyang cha gses brgyab mi chog pa gtan 'bebs byas yod/ srol yig 'di'i don tshan nyer dgu ba'i nang / rgyal khab las khungs kyi las byed mi snas zhing sde ru gzhung don lag bstar byed par mkho ba'i gron dngul de 'ing pa dang thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs la cha gses brgyab mi chog pa gtan 'bebs byas yod pa dang / srol yig 'di'i gtan 'bebs so gcig pa'i nang /srid 'dzin las khungs dang bya ga'ag sde tshan gang zhig gis kyang zhing sde ru las khungs 'dzugs pa'am dang yang na las byed mi sna bkod sgrig byed na/ der mkho ba'i gron dngul de zhing pa dang thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs la cha gses brgyab mi chog pa gtan 'bebs byas yod/(bco brgyad) zhing par gang byung du ma dngul rub bsdus byas mi chog pa'i bca' khrims kyi gzhi 'dzin sa ci yin/〈〈zhing las skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉nang zhing pa'am yang na zhing las thon skyedaganyer skyong rtsa 'dzugs la ma dngul rub bsdus byed na nges par du rang mos rtsa don lag bstar byed pa las/ btsan thabs kyis ma dngul rub bsdus byas mi chog pa gtan 'bebs byas yod/ las khungs dang sde tshan gang zhig gis kyang zhing pa'am yang na zhing las thon skyed gnyer skyong rtsa 'dzugs la btsan thabs kyis ma dngul rub bsdus byas na/ zhing pa dang zhing las thon skyed gnyer skyong rtsa 'dzugs la dang len mi byed pa'i dbang cha yod/ 〈zhing pa'i khur bo'i gron dngul dang ngal las do dam skor gyi srol yig〉gi don tshan nyer gsum pa'i nang / zhing par ma dngul rub bsdus byed na/ nges par du bca' khrims dang khrims srol/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'brel yod srid jus bcas las gtan 'bebs byas pa'i khyab khongs nang lag bstar bya dgos pa ma zad/ rang mos dang 'os 'tsham/ ma dngul gtong mkhan la phan khe ldan pa/ ma dngul bkol phyogs gtan khel byas te spyod pa bcas kyi rtsa // la

brtsi 'jog bya dgos pa gtan la phab yod/ ma dngul rub bsdus byas pa'i las ga'i'i sgrig bkod dang khyab khongs satan khel byed na/ 'ing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas yan gyi mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'char 'god gtso skyong sde khag dang cing pa'i khur bo'i lta skul do dam sde khag gi chog mchan thob par bya dgos shing / las gzhi gal chen yin na nges par du rgyal srid spyi khyab khang ngam yang na 'ing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyor+sha grong khyer bcas kyi mi dmangs srid gzhung gi chog mchan thob par bya da sa/(bcu dag) zhing pa zhing las 'gan bcol nang btsan thabs kyis zhugs su bcug mi chog par bca' khrims kyi gzhi 'dzin sa ci yod/〈〈blang las skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉nang / rgyal khab kyis 'ing la sa 'gan bcol bya gzhag gong du spel bar skul ma dang rogs skyor gnang rgyu dang /'ing las 'gan bcol thad nas rang mos rtsa don lag bstar bya rgyu/ rtsa 'dzugs gang 'ig dang mi sger su 'ig gis zhing las ngal rtsol pa dang zhing las thon skyed gnyer skyong rtsa 'dzugs btsan thabs kyis zhing las 'gan bcol nang zhugs su bcug mi chog pa gtan la phab yod/ 〈ling pa'i khur bo'i gron dngul dang ngal rtsol do dam skor gyi srol yig〉gi don tshan nyer bdun pa'i nang 'ing pa rtsa 'dzugs byas te 'gan bcol nang zhugs su bcug na/ nges par du bca' khrims dang khrims srol gyi gtan 'bebs brtsi srung bya dgos pa gtan la phab yod/(nyi shu) zhing las dang 'brel ba'i rin gong dang gron sdud gang dag khrims 'gal la ngos 'dzinargu yin/2002lo'i zla12pa'i tshes20nyin/ zhing las pu'u yis rgyal khab sdom rtseswā sdu yon lhan khang gis zhing las dang 'brel ba'i rin gong dang gron sdud bya

spyod rigs bdun khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod la gtogs pa gtan khel byas pa byib byisgrags byas shāng / 'ing las dang 'brel ba'i rin gong dang gron sdud bya sgod su/lta dīnān khye// (tis dang 'char ga'i kher 'god grong khyer dang zhing chen rim pa gzhon pa'i grong khyer bcas 'dus)dang rdzong / zhang(grong rdal)bcas kyi rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhung dang 'brel yod sde khag gis gtan khel byas pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs kyi gron sdud tshad ga'i tshang ma khrims 'gal gyi gron sdud dang gang byung du gron dngul bsdu bar gtogs pa dang / (2) 'ing chen rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'brel yod sde khag gis gtan khel byas pa'i gron sdud tshad gzhi de 'char ga'i(dngos gong)dang nor srid sde khag gi chog mchan ma brgyud na/ tshang ma khrims 'gal gyi gron sdud dang gang byung du gron dngul bsdu bar gtogs/(3) srid 'dzin gyi chog mchan 'god sa dang dpang yig ster ba'i las khungs bed spyad de/ tshong zong 'tshong rogs dang skul 'tshong byas pa dang /zhing par btsan thabs kyis 'bas zhu dang len byed du bcug pa dang / lugs mthun gyi yig cha'i ga'i 'dzin sa med par gron dngul bsdus pa tshang ma khrims 'gal gyi gron sdud dang gang byung du gron dngul bsdu bar gtogs/(4) rgyal srid spyi khyab khang dang zhing chen/ rang skyong ljongs/thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyi srid gzhung / rgyal khab dang zhing chen rim pa gnyis kyi 'char gzhi(dngos gong)dang nor srid sde khag gis gtan khel byas pa'i gron sdud tshad gzhi las brgal te gron dngul bsdus tshe/ brgal zin pa'i cha shas tshang ma khrims 'gal gyi gron sdud dang gang byung du gron dngul bsdu bar gtogs/ 81

(5) srid gzhung las khungs kyis bca' khrims dang khrims srol/ sgrig srol bcas gzhir bzung ste chog mchan 'god pa'i 'gan nus lag bstar byas te/ 'ing par bca' khrims dang khrim sa srol/ sgrig srol bcas kyi steng gsal bor bkod med la/ krung dbyang dang zhing chen rim pa gnyis kyi srid gzhung dang de'i 'char gzhi (dngos gong)dang nor srid sde khag gis chog mchan yang ma thob pa'i gron dngul tshang ma khrims 'gal gyi gron sdud dang gang byang du gron dngul bsdu bar gtogs/ga (6) ling las thon rdzas bsdu nyo byed pa'i khrod/ bsdu nyo las khungs kyis rim pa dang rin gong gnon pa'i byed thabs spyad de/ mang nyung dang spus tshad thad nas mang du 'phri gcog byas shing / 'ing par rin gong nyung ngur sprod pa'i bya spyod tshang ma rin gong khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod la gtogs/(7) glog rin gyi tshad ga'i las brgal te glog rin bsdu ba dang / glog dra bsgyur bcos khrod zhing chen rim pa'i rin gong gtso skyong sde khag gi chog mchan ma thob par gron dngul bsdu ba/ zhing chen rim pa'i rin gong gtso skyong sdekhag gis gtan khel byas pa'i tshad gzhi las brgal te gron dngul bsdu ba tshang ma rin gong khrims 'gal bya spyod la gtogs/(nyer gcig) zhing pas khang pa las na gron dngul gang dag sprod dgos/zhing pas khang pa las na gtan 'bebs ltar dpang yig gi ma gnas gron dngul sprod pa phud/ ga'an pa'i srid 'dzin las don rang ba'in gyi gron sdud la sa gzhi tshang ma med par bzos pa yin/rgyal khab gzhung las thing gyis spel ba'i2003lo'i yig cha ang50nang sa gnas gang 'ig dang sde khag gang 'ig gis rang 'dod sgos zhing pas khang pa ladī ༵'i gron sdud las gzhi dang gron sdud khyab khongs rgya bskyed pa/ gron sdud

tshad gzhi je mthor gtong ba bcas byas mi chog cing pas khang pa las par gron dngul bsdu ba'i thad sgo kun nas gtsang bsher byed dgos pa dang /gtsang bsher byas zin pa'i sa gnas kyis mig gis mi ma thong sa 'tshol zhib byed dgos/ deng phyin zhing pa rang gis sdod khang las na/ khrims ltar dpang yis ster bar gtan 'bebs ltar ma gnas gron dngul bsdu ba las ga'an/zhing par ga'an pa'i srid 'dzin las don rang bzhin gyi gron dngul ci yang bsdu mi chog pa'i blang bya bton yod/(nyer gnyis)zhing las khral sdud dang zhing las dang 'brel ba'i rin gong / gron sdud spyi gsal lam lugs bcas kyi bye zag gi blang bya ci yin/rgyal khab gzhung las thing gyis spel ba'i2002lo'i yig cha ang10ba'i nang / zhing par bsdu ba'i zhing las dpya khral zhig yin tshe/ krung dbyang dang 'ing chen rim pa gnyis kyi chog mchan dbang tshad dang go rim ltar chog mchan thob pa'i zhing las dang 'brel ba'i srid 'dzin las don rang bzhin gyi gron sdud dang tshong zong gal chen dang zhabs zhu'i rin gong tshang ma spyi tshogs la khyab bsgrags bya dgos/ spyi gsal sgo sam dang spyi gsal byang bu/ spyi gsal gyang ngos/ rin gong re'u mig sogs rnam pa brgyud de/ zhing par khral sdud dang rin gong / gron sdud bcas kyi yig cha'i gzhi 'dzin sa dang las gzhi'i ming /bsdu len tshad gzhi/ bsdu len bya yul gyi khyab khongs/ zhu gtug ther 'don byed sa'i kha par sogs nang don khyab bsgrags bya dgos/ gtan 'bebs ltar nges par spyi gsal byed dgos pa spyi gsal ma byas tshe/ 'ing par khral dngul mi sprod pa'i dbang cha yod/ci yin/(nyer gsum) zhing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur gyi mi chog pa brgyad mi2002lo'i zla)bar/ rgyal srid spyi khab khang zhing sde dpya khral sdu/sa

bsgyur bya ba'i tsho chung dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang las rigs tshul min spyod tshul yo bsrang gzhung las khang gnyis kyis mnyam du brel myur brda tho btang ste/ sa gnas so sos 'ing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur thad kyi srid jus lag bstar na/ po byas te/ 6 mi chog pa brgyad legs par bsgrub dgos pa'i blang bya ba na/(1) zhing las dpya khral gyi khral brtsis sa zhing gi rgya khyon dang lo rgyun gyi thon tshad la zhib bsher gtan 'bebs byas pa dang / zhing pa'i bsam 'char bsdu len byas te/ zhing pa'i khas len gang legs 'thob dgos la/ khral brtsis sa zhing gi rgya khyon dang lo rgyun gyi thon tshad gang byung du je mang du gtong ba dang je nyung du gtong ba sogs byas mi chog(2) zhing las khyad thon dbya khral bsdu ba'i thad nas nges par du don dngos ji bzhin du sdud len byed pa las/ rim pa re re nas las 'gan je lci ru gtong ba dang / cha gses rgyag pa sogs byas mi chog(3) sde ba'i nang don rer gros re yi dngul gtong las zhugs thad nas gtan 'bebs byas pa'i go rim dang khyab khongs ltar bsgrubs pa las/khyab khongs dang tshad bkag las brgal te/ zhing par btsan thabs kyis dngul gtong las zhugs byed du 'jug mi chog pa dang / 6 don rer gros re yi dngul ga~X las zhugs de brtan 'jags kyi gron sdud las gzhi ru de bas kyang ba// ri ma kā bgos nasabazo skrun gnyis kyis khul med par gtong ba lag bstar byed pa dang / las bzo ba bkol grangs lo re bzhin je nyung du stutang ste/ btsan thabs sgos ma dngul gyis ngal rtsol gyi tshab byed du 'jug mi /4(5) zhing pa'i sngar lo'i khral dngul chad 'gyangs gtsang bsher byed

pa'i bya ba sgrub skabs gzab gzab gang legs byas te/ dka' ngan yod pa'i 'ing par dpya khral je nyung du gtong ba dang / glo bur du gtsang bsher byas mi chog la/ srid dbang sger 'dzin gyi lag cha bkol te btsan thabs kyis bsdu len byed pa gtan 'gog bya rgyu/(6) 'ing sde'i slob grwa 'bring chung slob ma/ slob grwar zhugs pa dang /'ing pas sdod khang las pa/ gnyen sgrig tho 'god byed pa/ sgo phyir gla rgyag tu 'gro bar tshong gnyer dpang yig len pa/ 'char ldan bu btsa'i dmigs tshad 'ib bsher go rim bcas kyi khrod zhing las dang 'brel ba'i gron sdud sna tshogs la do dam byed pa bcas la shugs snon ched/ krung dbyang gis gcig gyur sgos gtan la phab pa'i gron sdud rnam grangs phud/ 'ing par gang byung du gron dngul bsdu ba dang glags btsal te gron dngul bsdu ba/ tshad ga'i las brgal te gron dngul bsdu ba bcas byas mi chog(7) zhing sde'i gnyer skyong 'bas zhu thad kyi gron sdud do dam tshad ldan du btang ste/ 'ing par chu rin bsdu bar rtsa don steng nas tshad 'jal gron sdud lag bsta ra bya dgos/ than skyon dang chu log chen po byung ste tshad 'jal sdud len byed dka' na'ang / yong sgo'i rtsa don ltar don dngos ji bzhin du cha gses rgyag pa la sa/ sngon bsdu dang don dngos la mi dmigs par mi grangs dang zhing sa'i mu'u grangs ltar chu rin cha gses brgyab mi chog(8) dus deb dang tshags par 'grem spel byed pa tshad ldan du gtong ba dang / tshad bkag tshod 'dzin dang rang mos sgos mngag nyo byed pa lag bstar byas te/ ga'i rim dang 'ing pa'i 'gan khur dngos gnas je yang du gtong ba las/ srid 'dzin gyi bka' rgya dang rim pa re rer cha gses rgyag pa'i byed thabs spyad mi chog 85
