(nyer bzhi) ci zhig la zhing pa'i khur bo dze yang du gtong ba'i srid sdus dang 'gal ba'i 'dems shog gcig gis khas mi len pa'i lam lugs ra/ 2002lo'i zla1pa'i tshes31nyin/ 'ing las pu'u dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang tshul min bya spyod yo bsrang gzhung las khang / nor srid pu'u/ rgyal khab sdom rtsis u yon lhan khang / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang khrims lugs gzhung las khang bcas kyi(2002lo'i 'ing pa'i khur bo je yang du gtong ba'i bya ba'i skor gyi bsam 'char〉(rgyal khab gzhung las khang gis spel ba'i 2002lo'i yig cha ang10ba)nang zhing pa'i khur bo je yang du gtong ba'i srid jus dang 'gal ba'i 'dems shog gcig gis khas mi len pa'i lag lugs sgo kun nas lag bstar byed pa'i blang bya bton/ zhing pa'i khur bo je yang du gtong ba'i srid jus la rgyab 'gal byas te/ tshogs pa rang bzhin gyi don rkyen dang gyod don tshabs chen nam yang na shugs rkyen chen po bzos pa'i gyod don gzhan pa bslangs pa'i rdzong dang zhang la 'brel yod kyi gtan 'bebs dang sgrig lam ltar/ dus yun nges can zhig nang phyogs bsdus rang bzhin gyi chab srid mtshan snyan dang bya dga' thob pa'i thob thang med par bzo rgyu dang / dus mtshungs su 'gan khur yod pa'i tang srid 'go khrid la dus yun nges can zhig nang 'gan nus dang rim pa 'phar ba'i thob thang med par bzo rgyu ma zad/tang gi sgrig khrims dang srid skyong sgrig khrims kyi nyes chad gcod rgyu/(nyer lnga) krung dbyang gis rang re'i zhing pa mnyam las sman bcos gsar ba'i lam lugs nang zhugs par srid cas gang dag brtan yod/2002lo'i zla10pa'i tshes19nyin gyi〈krung gung krung dbyang dang rgyal sridaspyi khyab khang gi zhing sde'i 'phrod bston bya bar sngar bas shugs snon pa'i skokā spya chod don〉(krung spel 2002lo'i yig cha yang13ba)nang zhing sde'i

mnyam las sman bcos gsar ba'i lam lugs rim bzhin 'dzugs dgos pa satan khel byas yod/ rim pa so so'i srid gzhung gis hur thag sgos zhing pa rtsa 'dzugs dang sne khrid de nad lci mo gcig gyur 'char 'god byed pa gtso yin pa'i 'ing sde'i mnyam las sman bcos gsar ba'i lam lam lugs btsugs te/gtso bor ling par 'gos nad byung ba dang sa gnas nad sogs nad lci mo phog pa las dbul phongs su gyur ba dang yang skyar dbul phongs su gyur ba'i gnad don thag gcod dgos/ zhing pa'i mnyam las sman bcos lam lugs de nges par du gnas de'i dpal 'byor spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi chu tshad dang 'ing pa'i dpal 'byor theg nus dang sman bcos gron dngul gyi dgos mkho bcas dang mthun dgos shing / rang mos rtsa don rgyun srung byas pa dang / btsan thabs dang bka' rgya phab par ngo rgol byas te/ zhing pa sger gyis gron dngul sprod pa dang thun mong gis rogs skyor byed pa/ srid gzhung gis ma dngul gyis rogs skyorakhyed pa bcas zung du sbrel ba'i dngul gsog nang rkyen lag bstar bya rgyu/'ing pas mnyam las sman bcos nang zhugs pa dang nad kyi nyen kha 'gog ched ma dngul sprod pa lag bstar byed pa'i 'os 'gan de zhing pa'i khur bo je ljid du btang bar brtsi mi rung / cha rkyen yod pa'i sa gnas kyis mnyam las sman bcos nang zhugs pa'i zhing par lo rer rgyun srol brtag dpyad thengs re byed dgos pa dang / phan nus ldan pa'i zhing pa'i mnyam las sman bcos kyi do dam sgrig srol dang spyi tshogs lta skul nang rkyen 'dzugs dgos/ sa gnas so sos sngon la tshod lta byas te/ nyams myong blangs rjes spyod gzod rim bzhin khyab gdal du gtong dgos/ 2010lor thon dus/ mnyam las sman bcos gsar ba'i lam lugs de phal cher zhing sde'i sdod dmangs yongs la khebs pa bya dgos/ dpal 'byor dar rgyas che ba'i zhing sde yis zhing pa tshong las sman bcos 'gan bcol nang zhugs par skul ma btang chog 87

(nyer drug) zhing sde'i mnyam las sman bcos gsar ba'i lam lugs kyi dngul gsog tshad gzhi ga chod yin/〈〈krung gung krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'ing sde'i 'phrod bsten bya bar shugs snon pa'i skor gyi chod don〉〉ltar/ 2003lo'i zla1pa'i tshes10nyin/ 'phrod bsten pu'u dang nor srid pu'u/ 'ing las pu'u bcas kyis〈ling sde'i mnyam las sman bcos gsar ba'i lam lugs 'dzugs pa'i skor gyi bsam 'char〉bkram ste/ 'ing pa'i mnyam las sman bcos gsar ba'i lam lugs kyi dngul gsog tshad ga'i sngar bas gsal bo byas pa ste/ zhing sde'i mnyam las sman bcos gsar ba'i lam lugs thad nas mi sger gyis gron dngul sprod pa dang thun mong gis rogs skyor byed pa/ srid gzhung gis ma dngul gyi rogs skyong byed pa bcas zung du sbrel ba'i dngul gsog nang rkyen lag ba// gāswā ༵ /spya/ nyid kyis lo rer sprad pa'i gron dngul tshad gzhi de sgor10las dma' mi chog pa dang / dpal 'byor cha rkyen bzang ba'i sa khul gyis de bstun gyis gron dngul sprod pa'i tshad gzhi je mthor btang chog zhang grong khe las kyi las bzo pa(zhing pa'i khyim tshang sde tshan byas te mnyam las sman bcos gsar ba nang zhugs pa'i mi sna mi 'dus) 'ing sde'i mnyam/ las sman bcos gsar ba'i lam lugs nang zhugs min de rdzong rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis gtan khel bya dgos/(2) cha rkyen yod pa'i zhang grong gi thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis rang sa gnas kyi mnyam las sman bcos gsar ba'i lam lu gas la rogs skyor 'os 'tsham bya dgos/ zhing sde'i mnyam las sman bcos gsar bar rogs skyor byed pa'i 'ang grong gi thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi rigs dkā ༵ dngul gtong ba'i tshad gzhi de rdzong rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung

gis gtan khel bya dgos mod/ yin na'ang thun mong gis ma dngul gtong ba'i cha shas de zhing par cha gses brgyab mi chog spyi tshogs kyi tshogs pa dang mi sger gyis 'ing sde'i mnyam las sman bcos gsar ba'i lam lugs la ma dngul gyis rogs skyor byed par skul ma/ gtong rgyu/(3) sa gnas srid gzhung gis lo rer mnyam las sman bcos gsar ba'i nang zhugs pa'i 'ing par ma dngul gyis rogs skyor byed pa'i tshad ga'i de mi rer cha snyoms kyis sgor10la sa dma' mi rung ba dang / bye brag gi rogs skyor tshad ga'i dang rim bgos 'gan khur gyi bsdur grangs de zhing chen rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis gtan khel bya dgos/ dpal 'byor cung dar rgyas che ba'i shar rgyud sa khul dang / sa gnas kyi rim pa so so'i nor srid kyis 'os 'tsham sgos ma dngul gtong tshad je mang du gtong dgos/ 2003lo nas bzung / krung dbyang nor srid kyis lo rer ched spyod ma dngul las dbus nub rgyud sa khul gyi grong khyer dang ljongs phud pa'i 'ing sde'i mnyam las sman bcos gsar pa'i nang zhugs pa'i zhing pa mi rer cha snyoms kyis sgor10de kha gsab rogs skyor byed par bkod sgrig bya rgyu/(nyer bdun) krung dbyang gis zhing sde'i dbul phongs khrim tshang la sman bcos rogs skyob lag bstar byed pa'i srid jus ci yin/〈〈krung gung krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi zhing sde'i 'phrod bsten bya bar shugs snon pa'i skor gyi chod don〉〉(krung spel2002lo'i yig cha ang13ba)nang / 'ing sde'i dbul phongs khyim tshang la sman bcos rogs skyob lam lugs lag bstar bya rgyu gtan khel gsal bo byas yod/ sman bcos rogs skyob bya yul gtso bo ni zhing sde'i lnga skyong khyim tshang dang dbul phongs zhing pa'i khyim tshang yin la/ sman bcos rogs skyob byed stangs ni rogs skyob bya yul la nad lci mo phog na sman bcos gron dngul gyi kha gsab rogs skyo/ sdus

chog la/ rogs skyor ma dngul byin te gnas de'i mnyam las sman bcos nang zhugs su bcug na'ang chog sman bcos rogs skyob ma dngul de srid gzhung gis ma dngul gtong ba dang spyi tshogs kyi las rigs khag gis rang rngo sa sgos 'al 'debs phul ba sogs byed thabs mang po spyad de grabs gsog bya rgyu/sman bcos rogs skyob ma dngul kher 'dzugs byas te/ mi sger gyis yar zhu byed pa dang / sde dmangs 'thus mi'i gros tshogs steng dpyad 'jog byas te/dmangs srid sde khag gis zhib bsher chog mchan bkod rjes/ sman bcos lalha khungs kyis 'bas zhu 'don sprod byed pa'i do dam/ sgrig srol lag bstar bya da sa/(nyer brgyad) krung dbyang gis zhing par dpya khrul bcos bsgyur sngon hākhel dngul chad 'grungs sdud len byed pa'i thad srid jus ci zhig bton gad/ rgyu rkyen gang mang gi dbang gis/ zhing pa spun zla mi nyung ba zhig gis zhing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur sngon gyi khral dngul rim pa mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas chad 'gyangs byas 'dug pa'ang yod/ 〈rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi zhing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur gyi tshod lta'i bya zer sgo kun nas skul 'ded gtong ba'i skor gyi bsam 'char〉(rgyal khab kyis spel ba'i2003lo'i yig cha ang12pa)zhes pa'i yig cha'i nang / sa gnas so sos zhing par 'ing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur sngon gyi khral dngul chad 'gyangs byas pa re zhig bsdu mtshams 'jog dgos pa dang / bcos bsgyur sngon gyi khral dngul chad 'gyangs byas yod par zhib bsher dang tho 'god rigs gang la gtogs pa bcas gsal bo bya dgos pa dang / 'brel yod srid jus kyi gtan 'bebs dang mi mthun na/zhib bsher rtsis sub byas te 'ing par bda' sprod byas mi chog nyung 'phri bya bdī /tan 'bebs dang mthun pa'i khral dngul chad 'gyangs byas par je

nyung du gtong dgos/ byung par sngar nas grub pa'i zhing las khral sdud dang srid jus kyi gtan 'bebs dang mthun pa'i zhang gcig gyur dang sde ba'i sor 'jog byas par/ sngon la sor 'jog byed pa'i byed thabs spyad de/ zhing sde'i dpal 'byor sngar bas 'phel rgyas su song ba dang zhing pa'i theg nus je drag tu song rjes spyod gzod thag gcod pa bcas gtan la phab yod/(nyer dag) khur bo rje yang du gtong ba'i srid jus dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod gang dag la nges par 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded bya dgos/ga/ma gyi gawas tshul gras kyi gcig yod tshe/ nges par du 'gan 'khri bda' r+sha)da tshong da pazlo /khur bo je yang du gtong ba'i srid jus dang 'gal ba dang / bya ba'i spyod tshul rtsub po yin pa'am yang na gtan 'bebs nang spyad pa'i byed thabs dang 'gal te/ 'ing par shi rkyen slong ba'am yang na thad kur 'ing par rmas skyon tshabs chen bzos pa/(2) zhing pa'i khur bo je yang du gtong ba'i srid jus dang 'gal te/'ing pa'i lugs mthun khe dbang la gnod 'tshe bzos pa dang / las byed pa dang mang tshogs bar 'gacho ba bslangs te tshogs pa rang bzhin gyi don rkyen nam yang na spyi tshogs brtan 'jags yong bar shugs rkyen thebs pa'i tshogs pa rang ba'in gyi don rkyen gzhan pa/(3) zhing pa'i khur bo dang 'brel te shugs rkyen chen po bzos pa'i gyod ga'i gzhan pa bcas so/(sum cu) zhing par khral dngul sdud skabs 'dzin yig mi spyod ba'i bya spyod gang la 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded bya dgos/krung dbyang gzhung las khang gis spel ba'i2002lo'i yig cha ang19bas gtan la phab pa ltar/ sa gnas so sos lag len mtha' 'khyol bye/ 1pa'i

〈dngos 'jog sgrig srol zhib mo〉zhes pa bton pa red/ dper na hran tung zhing chen lu'u krin gzhung las khang gis spel ba'i2002lo'i yig cha ang9ba'i nang / gtan 'bebs ltar 'dzin yig mi ster ba dang / gsham gyi gnas tshul las gcig yod tshe/ chod don lag bstar byed pa'i 'gan khur mkhan gtso bo dang thad gar 'gan khur ba'i mi sna gzhan par tang nang gi tha tshig kām sdung na tha tshig tshabs chen dang srid 'dzin tha tshig bcas nas nyes chad lci ga /1 shā/zhing par khral dngul bsdus te/ khral dngul bsdus tshar ba'i 'dzin yig mi ster ba dang /(2) zhing par zhing sde'i spyi phan bya gzhag gi ma dngul bsdus te/ zhing /na nor srid sde khag gis gcig gyur gyis bzos pa'i ched spyod 'dzin yig mi ra ba(/3) zhing par dngul gtong las zhugs byed du bcug ste/ zhing chen 'ing pa'i khur bo lta skul do dam sde khag gis gcig gyur gyis bzos pa'i ma dngul grabs gsog 'byor yig dang las bkol 'dzin yig mi ster ba/(4) zhing par dngul chad bcad de/ nor srid sde khag gis bzos pa'i ched spyod 'dzin yig bkol spyod ma byas pa bcas so/(so gcig) zhing sde'i khral dngul bcos bsgrur srid jus kyi gtan 'bebs dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod gang dag la nges par du 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded bya dgos/tang gi zhing sde'i khral dngul bcos bsgyur srid jus lag len mtha' 'khyol byed par khag theg bya ched/ sa gnas so sos 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded thad gtan 'bebs gsal bo byas yod/ dper na hran tung zhing chen gyis ga/shā gyi gnas tshul las gcig yod tshe/ chod don lag bstar byed pa'i

'gan khur mi sna gtso bor tang nang gi tha tshig dang srid 'dzin gyi tha tshig bsgrags pa nas nyes chad lci mo gcod rgyu dang / gnas tshul tshabs chen yin na/ tang nang gi 'gan nus dang srid 'dzin rim pa je dma' gtong ba'am sdung na 'gan nus med par gtong ba bcas kyi chad pa gcod rgyu gtan la phab da/ (1) zhing sde'i khral rtsis sa 'ing gi rgya khyon dang khral rtsis lo rgyun gyi thon tshad rdzu/ sta duji k+ta (tā ṅgi ༵ pa pya yi/ satan 'bebs dang 'ib bsher sgrig lam dang 'gal te btsan thabs kyis dngul gtong la sa zhugs byed du 'jug pa/le(3) gtan 'bebs dang 'gal te zhing sde'i spyi phan bya gzhag ma dngul sdud ༵ rnyirnyi ༵/ dngul je nyung du gtong ba dang med par bzo ba/ dus yun sring ba bcas kyi srid jus don 'khyol mi byas pa'am yang na khrims 'gal byas pa/ (5) ling sde'i khral dngul bcos bsgyu ra thad btang ba'i ma dngul bkag nyar dang gang byung du spyod pa/(6) khral gnyis 9zur snon sogs sde ba'i thun mong ma dngul snyom 'then dang bdag bzung / gang byung du spyod pa/ gcog pa bcas byas pa/(7) zhing sde'i khral dngul bcos bsgyur srid jus kyi gtan 'bebs dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod gzhan rigs/(so gnyis) zhing par btsan thabs kyis cha gses rgyag pa'i bya spyod gang dag la 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded bya dgos/'ing par btsan thabs kyis cha gses rgyag pa'i gsham gyi gnas tshul las gcig yod tshe/ chod don lag bstar mkhan gyi 'gan khur mi sna kārdo bo

dang thad kur 'gan khur gyi mi sna gzhan par tang nang gi tha tshig dang srid 'dzin tha tshig gam yang na skyon tho 'god pa'i chad pa gcod rgyu/ gnas tshul tshabs chen yin na/ tang nang gi tha tshig tshabs chen nam yang na tang nang gi 'gan nas med par bzo ba dang skyon tho 'god pa'i chad pa gcod pa nas 'gan nus len pa'i chad pa gcod rgyu/(1)gtan 'bebs dang 'gal nas mi grangs dang sa 'ing gi mu'u grangs ltar khral dngul sna tshogs cha gses rgyag pa/(2)do dam 'gan dbang bkol ba'am yang na las 'gan dmigs tshad bkram pa sogs byed thabs la brten nas/ dus deb dang tshags par/ dpe cha bcas btsan thabs kyis cha gses rgyag pa'am yang na sa bon(myu gu)dang zhing sman sogs dngos rdzas btsan thabs kyis nyo ru 'jug pa/(3)gtan 'bebs dang 'gal te 'ing pa 'gan bcol sna tshogs nang btsan gyis zhugs su 'jug pa'am yang na gta' ma'i ma dngul dang 'gan bcol ma dngul/ khag theg ma dngul bcas sdud len byed pa/(so gsum)khur bo dze yang du gtong ba'i srid nus dang 'gal ba'i bya spyotā gang dag la chad pa lci mo gcod pa'am yang na chad pa dze lci ru gtong da sa/gsham gyi gnas tshul las gcig yod tshe/ chad pa lci mo gcod pa'am yang na chad pa je lci ru gtong dgos/(1)'ib bsher byed par bkag 'gog dang ngo rgol byed pa'am yang na gtan khel byas pa'i dus tshod nang skyon cha yo bsrang mi byed pa dang /(2)nyes skyon ther 'don byed mkhan la rdung deg byed pa dang 'khon lan slog pa/ zhu gtug byed mkhan ther 'don byed pa/94(3)yang dang bskyar du zhib bsher byed pa dang khrims 'gal byed

rma khan/(4)chad pa lci mo gcod pa'am yang na chad pa je lci ru gtong dgos pa'i gnas tshul gzhan pa yod rigs/(so bzhi) khur bo je yang du gtong ba'i srid jus dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod gang dag la chad pa yang mo gcod pa'am yang na dze yang du gtong ba dang med par gtong dgos/gsham gyi gnas tshul las gcig yod tshe/ chad pa yang mo gcod pa'am yang na je yang du gtong ba dang med par bzo rgyu/(1)gnas tshul tshabs chen min pa'i rigs/(2)zhing pa'i khur bo je lci ru gtong ba'i yig cha'i gros chod dang chod don bzos te lag bstar ma byas pa/(3)rang 'gul sgos skyon cha yo bsung byas pa ma zad shugs rkyen med par bzos pa/(4)chad pa yang mo dang je yang du gtong ba'am yang na med par bzos chog pa'i gnas tshul gzhan rigs/94 95

le'u gsum pa/ sde dmangs rang skyong dang sde don sbyi bsgrags skor/(gcig)rang rgyal bca' khrims nang sde dmangs rang skyong gi nang don dang rnam pa gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/zhing sde nas sde dmangs rang skyong lag bstar byed pa'i bca' khrims kyi gzhi 'dzin sa ni rang rgyal gyi rtsa khrims yin/ rtsa khrims kyi don tshan gnyis pa'i nang krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi dbang cha tshang ma mi dmangs la gtogs pa dang / mi dmangs kyis bca' khrims kyi gtan 'bebs ltar/ thabs lam dang rnam pa sna tshogs brgyud de/ rgyal khab kyi las don la do dam dang / dpal 'byor dang rig gnas bya gzhag la do dam/ spyi tshogs las don la do dam bcas byed dgos zhes gtan la phab yod/ don tshan brgya dang bcu gcig nang grong khyer dang 'ing sde yis sdod dmangs sdod gnas khul du btsugs pa'i sdod dmangs u yon lhan khang ngam yang na sde dmangasa.u yon lhan khang ni ga'i rim mang tshogs rang bzhin gyi rang skyong rtsa 'dzugs yin pa gtan la phab yod/ rtsa khrims ltar/ rgyal yongs dmangs 'thus rgyun u lhan khang1987lo'i zla11pa'i tshes24nyin/ 〈sde dam/ngas u yon lhan khang gi rtsa 'dzugs bca' khrims(tshod spyod)〉'thad pa byung 'ing /1998lo'i zla11pa'i tshes/nyin/ bzo bcos brgyab pa'i〈sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi rtsa 'dzugs bca' khrims〉la 'thad pa byung ste/ nyin de nas brdidī lag bstar byed 'go brtsams/ 〈sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi rtsa

'dzugs bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan gnyis pa'i nang〈sde dmangs u yon lhan khang ni sde dmangs rang gis rang la do dam dang slob gso/ zhabs zhu bcas byed pa'i gzhi rim mang tshogs rang ba'in gyi rang skyong rtsa 'dzugs shig yin pas/ dmangs gtso'i 'dems bsko dang dmangs gtso'i thabs jus/dmangs gtso'i do dam dang dmangs gtso'i lta skul bcas lag bstar byed dgos〉zhes gtan la phab yod/ gtan 'bebs 'dir ga'igs na/ sde dam ngas u yon lhan khang gi ngo bo ni gzhi rim mang tshogs rang bzhin gyi rang skyong rtsa 'dzugs shig yin pa dang / sde dmangs rang skyong byed pa'i rnam pa ni dmangs gtso chen po bzhi ste/ dmangs gtso'i 'dems bsko dang dmangs kātso'i thabs jus/ dmangs gtso'i do dam/ dmangs gtso'i lta skul bcas (gnyis) sde dmangs u yon lhan khang la n+de dmangs la dngul chad gcod pa'i dbang cha yod dam/med de/ rang rgyal gyi〈srid 'dzin chad gcod skor gyi bca' khrims〉nang / srid 'dzin chad gcod ni srid 'dzin chad gcod kyi dbang cha yod pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs kyis khrims bkod 'gan dbang gi khyab khongs nang lag bsta ra byed pa zhig yin/ dngul chad gcod dbang yod pa ni gsham ltar/(1)rgyal khab srid 'dzin las khungs kyis kha gtad mis srid 'dzin do dam gyi sgrig lam la rgyab 'gal byas tshe/ khrims ltar srid 'dzin kha gtad mir dngul chad gcod pa'i bab mtshungs kyi chad pa bcad chog(2)mi dmangs khrims khang gis khrims ltar dmangs don bca' khrims la 'gal ba dang zhu gtug mkhan gyi spyi dmangs dang khrims mi 'gog pa dang gnod 'tshe gtong ba'am yang na rtsa 'dzugs gzhan par dngul chad gcod pa'i khrims 'dzin bkag sdom byas chog 97

(3)khe las kyis ngal rtsol sgrig lam dang 'gal ba'i las bzo par khrims ltar thengs gcig rang bzhin gyi dngul chad bcad chog de las gzhan pa'i sde tshan gang 'ig dang mi sger su zhig yin rung dngul chad gcod dbang med/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang ni gzhi rim mang tshogs rang ba'in dzhai shā py-i sa/sa yin pas/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang la dngul chad gcod (gsuman sde dmangs gan rgya gzhir bzung ste sde dmangs la chad gcod byas chog gam/mi chog 〈sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi rtsa 'dzugs bca' khrims〉nang / sde dmangs gan rgya de rtsa khrims dang bca' khrims/ khrims srol dang rgyal khab kyi srid jus bcas dang phan tshun 'brel ba med pas/ sde dmangs kyi lus khams khe dbang dang dmangs gtso'i khe dbang / lugs mthun rgyu nor gyi khe dbang bcas la gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i nang don yod mi chog yang gcig bshad na sde dmangs gan rgya'i nang sde dmangs la dngul chad gcod pa'i nang don yod mi chog zer ba yin/ dngul chad gcod pa'i nang don yod na/nges par rtsis 'gro med par brtsi dgos/ sde dmangs gan rgya ltar sde dmangs la dngul chad bcad tshe/ de ni khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod cig yin/(bzhi)bya spyod gang dag ni sde dmangs kyis thad gar 'dems bsko ’byed pa dang 'gal ba yin/ 〈sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi rtsa 'dzugs bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan bcu gcig pa'i nang / zu sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin dang kru'u rin gzhon pa/ u yon bcas ni sde dmangs kyis thad kur 'dems bsko byed dgos pa gtan la phab yod/ thad gar 'dems bsko byed pa zhes pa ni/ sde da~Xs kyis thad kur 'dems shog 'phen pa dang / bar du las khungs dang

rtsa 'dzugs gang yang ma brgyud par bdams thon༄khachaba'i sde dmangs u yon lhan khang la zer/ gtan 'bebs 'dir gzhigs na/ gsham gyi byed stangs 'ga' ni sde dmangs kyis thad gar 'dems bsko byed pa dang 'gal ba red/(1)dud khyim 'thus mi'i 'dems bsko/ de ni dud khyim re nas 'thus mi gcig re yong ste dud khyim 'thus mi'i gros tshogs grub rjes/ dud khyim ༷thus mi'i sdis tshogs tshogs pa las sde dmangs u yon lhan khang bdams na byuzlo k+ta sde //mangs 'thus mi'i 'dems bsko/ de ni sngon la sde dmangs kyis sde dmangs 'thus mi bdams rjes/ des sde dmangs kyi tshab byas te sde dmangs u yon lhan khang bdams thon byung ba/(3)sngon la sde dmangs kyis sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi khongs mi bdams rjes/ bdams thon byung ba'i sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi khongs mi'i khrod rjong sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin dang kru'u rin gzhon pa bdam/4 )spya sdo ༵ ṭī/gran rtsod sgos sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin bdams rjes/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gyis rtsa 'dzugs byas pa dang / sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi khongs mi ga'an pas sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gyi ming bton te/ sde dmangs gros tshogs tshogs pa brgyud 'thad pa byung ba/ gong gi 'dems bsko byed stangs tshang ma khrims dang 'gal phyir/ bca' khrims kyi srung skyong mi thob/(lnga)sde dmangs yu yon lhan khang gi skabs brjes rjes skabs sngon mas skabs gsar bar rtsis tho brgyud sprod ma byas na ji ltar bya/(sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi rtsa 'dzugs bca' khrims〉kyi gtan 'bebs ltar/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi skabs re re'i 'gan le/ /sa

yun lo gsum yin la/ skabs re re'i dus yun longs rjes dus thog tu skabs brje 'dems bsko bya dgos/ yang gcig bshad na/ lo gsum gyi 'gan len dus yu na longs rjes/ rgyu mtshan med par 'dems bsko byed yun bsring mi chog zer ba yin/ 1998lo 'i zla6pa'i tshes10nyin krung dbyang gzhung las khang dang rgyal khab gzhung las khang gis spel ba'i〈zhing sde nas sde don spyi bsgrags dang dmangs gtso'i do dam lam lugs yongs khyab tu lag bstar byed pa'i skor gyi brda tho〉nang / 6 sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci dang sde dmangs u yon lhan khang / 'dems bsko byas nas bdams thon 'byung dgos pa'i sde ba rim pa'i rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'gan khur mi sna bcas ni/ rgyal khab kyi 'brel yod bca' khrims dang tang nang gi khrims srol gyi gtan 'bebs ltar/ dus ltar dmangs gtso'i 'dems bsko lag bstar byas nas 'byung dgos dgos/rdzong(grong khyer dang chus)ud nas chog mchan ma thob pa dang / rgyu mtshan med pa'i sgo nas 'dems bsko byed yun bsrings tshe/ 'ang grong tang u dang sde ba'i tang kri pu'u/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi 'gan khur mkhan gtso bo'i 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded bya dgos pa gsal bor gtan la phab yod/ skabs gsar ba'i sde dmangs u yon lhan khang bdams thon byung rjes/ skabs sngon ma'i sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis skabs rjes ma'i sde dmangs u yo na lhan khang la rang skyong khe dbang brgyud sprod byed dgos pa dang / gal te brgyud sprod ma byas na/ mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug byas chog dper na hran tung zhing chen gyis skabs sngon ma'i sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis nges par du skabs gsar ba'i sde dmangs u yon lhan khang byung nyin nas nyin bdun nang tshun du skabs gsar ba'i sde dmangs u yon lhan khang la tham ka dang srid don gyi rtsis tho/ yig tshags rgyu cha dang gzhung las sgrig bkod sogs bsdihā (sprod bya dgos pa dang / dus yun las brgal tshe/ skabs gsar ba'i

sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug byas te/mi dmangs khrims khang gis khrims ltar thag gcod pa'i re 'dun zhus chog pa gtan la phab yo da/(drug) sde dmangs yu yon lhan khang gi skabs brje 'dems bsko bya bar sus 'go 'dzin bya dgos/〈sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi rtsa 'dzugs bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan bcu gsum pa'i gtan 'bebs ltar na/ 6 sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi skabs brje 'dems bsko bya ba de sde dmangs 'dems bsko u yon lhan khang gis mgo 'dzin bya dgos/mi dper na hran tung 'ing chen gyi sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi rtsa 'dzugs bca' khrim sa kyi lag bstar zhib phra'i nang sde dam ngas 'dems bsko u yon lhan khang gi khongs mis mi gcig bdams te sde dmangs 'dems bsko u yon lhan khang gi bya bar 'go 'dzin byed du 'jug pa gtan la phab yod/ gtan 'bebs 'dir gzhigs na/ sde dmangs 'dems bsko u yon lhan khang ni sde dmangs u yo na lhan khang gis bdams pa'i lugs mthun gyi las khungs gcig pu yin pas/ ga'an pa'i las khungs gang 'ig la'ang sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi 'dems bsko bya bar mgo 'dzin byed dbang med/ sde dmangs kyis khrims ltar dmangs gtso'i khe dbang spyod par 'gan srung dang / sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi skabs brje 'dems bsko bya ba spel bar 'gan srung bya ched/ 'ing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer so so'i sde dmangs rtsa 'dzugs bca' khrims kyi lag bstar 'ib phra'am yang na sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi 'dems bsko byed thabs tshang mar bye brag gi gtan 'bebs yod/ dper na hran tung cing chen gyis sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi skabs brje 'dems bsko bya ba de rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis rtsa 'dzugs byas te lag bstar byed dgos 10 snying /

rim pa mtshungs pa'i dmangs srid sde khag gis nyin rgyun bya bar 'gan khur dgos padang / zhang dang grong rdal mi dmangs srid gzhung gis sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi skabs brje 'dems bsko'i 'go khrid tsho chung 'dzugs dgos pa gtan la phab yod/ de'i 'gan 'khri gtso bo ni/ 'brel yod kyi bca' khrims dang khrims srol dril sgrog bya ba dang / 'dems bsko'i bya ba'i 'char gzhi 'god pa/ 'dem sa bsko'i dus tshod gtan khel bya ba/ 'dems bsko'i las don mi sna gso sbyong bya ba/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang la mdzub ston bya ba bcas yin/ 6 sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yis sde dmangs mu yon lhan khang gi skabs brje 'dems bsko bya ba'i khrod/ 'go khrid kyi srog shing nus pa 'don spel gang legs bya dgos pa bcas gtan la phab yod/ gong gi gtan 'bebs tshang ma sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi skabs brje 'dems bsko bya ba'i 'go khrid dang khrid ston dang rtsa 'dzugs lag bstar byed pa bcas la shugs snon pa'i ched yin la/ thad kur sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi skabs brje 'dems bsko bya bar 'go 'dzin byed mkhan ni sngar bzhin sde dmangs 'dems bsko u yon lhan khang dang des bdams pa'i mi gcig yin pa red/(bdun)bdam bya'i thos mi 'dems bsko'i nang zhugs chog gam/gnad don 'di'i skor nas/ sa gnas so sos〈sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi rtsa 'dzugs bca' khrims〉la gzhigs nas/ gnas de'i 'dems bsko'i byed thabs khrod bye brag gis gtan 'bebs byas yod de/ dper na hran tung zhing chen gyis sde dmangs u yon lhan khang 'dems bsko byed na/'dems dmangs kyis thad kur bdam bya'i 'os mi'i ming 'don dgos/'dems dmangs kyis bton pa'i bdam bya'i 'os mi de rtsa 'dzugs gang dang mi sgor su zhig gis legs sgrig gam yang na bsgyur bcos byas mi choga'ardo/sna dmangs rang gis bton pa'i bdam bya'i 'os mi de sde dmangs u

yon lhan khang gi khongs mi'i bdam bya'i 'os mi'i gra sgrig 'dems bsko nang 'gas pa dang / gra sgrig 'dems bsko nang bdams thon byung ba'i bdam bya'i zlos mi de sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi 'dems bsko gros tshogs kyi rtsa 'dzugs bya ba'i nang zhugs mi chog dper na krang san 'dems dmangs kyis bton pa'i bdam bya'i 'os mi yin pa dang / kho sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi khongs mi'i bdam bya'i 'os mi'i gra sgrig 'dems bsko'i las don nang zhugs chog la/ kho rang sde dam ngas u yon lhan khang gi khongs mis bdam bya'i 'os mir bdams rjes/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi 'dems bsko'i gros tshogs kyi rtsa 'dzugs nang zhugs mi chog mod/ 'on kyang kho rang sngar ba'in 'dems dmangs kyi thob thang thog nas 'dems bsko nang zhugs chog(brgyad)dmigs bsal gnas tshul 'og nas 'dems shog skong mi thub pa dang 'phen mi thub na ji ltar bya/gnad don 'di'i skor nas/ sa gnas so sos kyang bye brag gis gtan 'bebs byas yod de/ dpe( na hran tung zhing chen gyis 'dems bsko byed skabs tshang mas rang ming mi 'god pa'i 'dems shog 'phen thabs lag bstar byas te/ 'dems shog de 'dems dmangs rang gis bskang dgos pa gtan la phab yod/ 'dems dmangs ni yig rmongs pa'am yang na dbang bo skyon can yin te 'dems shog skong mi thub pa'am yang na 'dems dmangs 'dems bsko skabs su phyir song tshe/ rang gis yar zhu byas te/ sde dmangs 'dems bsko u yon lhan khang 'thad pa byung ba brgyud/ bdam bya'i 'os mi phud gzhan pa'i 'dems dmangs kyis tshab byas te 'dems shog skong ba'am yang na 'dems shog 'phen pa'i mngag bcol byas chog 'dems shog tshab skong byed par mngag bcol mkhan gyi 'dod blo dang 'gal mi chog pa dang /'dems dmangs re res mi gsum gyi mngag bcol las dang len byas 1swā 3chog

'groskyod kyi nus pa med par 'dems bsko gros tshogs kyi tshogs rar thon mi thub pa'i 'dem sa dmangs la/ 'gul skyod can gyi 'dem sa shog yig sgam btsugs te/ sde dam ngas u yon lhan khang gi khongs mis lta skul pa khrid de de'i sdod gnas la song nas 'dem sa thog 'phen tu bcug chog 'gul skyod can sdi 'dems shog 'phen pa de yang 'dems bsko'i nyin der legs 'grub bya da pyad/ gu)'dems dmangs kyis phyed ka mi zin pa'i 'dems shog 'phen thabs der rtsis 'gro yod dam/'dems dam/ngas kyis phyed ka mi zin pa'i 'dems shog 'phen thabs de rtsis 'gro med par brtsi dgos/ 〈sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi rtsa 'dzugs bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan bcu ba'i pa'i nang / 6 sde dmangs u yo na lhan khang 'dems bsko byed na/ 'dems bsko dbang cha yod pa'i sde dmangs phyed ku'i yan gyis 'dem sa thog 'phangs nas 'dems bsko byas pa de rtsis 'gro yod par brtsi dgos pa migatan la phab yod/ 6 'dem sa dbang yod pa 'i sde dam ngas kyi 'dems shog phyed ka yan yin dgos ཿzhes pa 'di ni nges par rgyun srung byed dgos pa'i khrim sa bkod mi grangs yin dgos/ bya bar kha gtad pa las mir la mi gtad pa'i kha g.yar sa ci yang btsal mi chog6 'dems bsko rtsis 'gro yo da pa zhes pa ni 'dems bsko byed pa'i khrod 'phangs pa'i 'dem/sa shog gi grangs ka de 'dems shog 'phen pa'i mi grangs dang gcig mtshungs sam yang na nyung na rtsis yod du btang ba dang / 'dems shog 'phen pa'i mi grangs las rme nga na rtsis med du btang bar bstan pa/ yin/'dems shog re las bdams pa'i mi grangs de nges par gdam bya'i mi grangs dngagacig mtshungs sam yang na de las nyung na rtsis 'gro yod par btang ba dang1 0/4nges par gdam bya'i mi grangs las mang na rtsis 'gro med par btang

bar bstan/ dbye 'byed byed thabs med pa'am yang na gtan 'bebs ltar 'dems shog bskangs med na rtsis med du btang ba dang / rtsis 'gro yod pa'i 'dems shog yin min gtan khel byed dka' na/ lta skul pas 'dems bsko u yon lhan khang la sprad de thag gcod du 'jug dgos/ 'dems bsko rtsis 'gro yo da par btang rjes/ da gzod 'dems shog 'don pa dang 'dems shog brtsi ba sogs byas chog(bcu)bdam bya'i 'os mir 'dems shog phyed ga'ang mi longs na bdams thon byung thub bam/mi thub/ 〈sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi rtsa 'dzugs bca' khrims〉kyi gtan 'bebs la gzhigs na/ bdam bya'i 'os mir 'dems shog 'phen pa ra zhugasapa'i 'dem sa dmangs phyed ka yan gyis 'dem sa shog 'phangs tshe spyod gzod bdams thon byung ba yin/ 'dems thog phyed ka yan thob pa'i mi grangs de nges pa ra 'dems pa'i mi grangs las mang tshe/ 'dems shog mang ba thob ma khan de bdams thon byung ba yin/ 'dems shog thob grangs 'dra mtshungs yin te bdams thon byung mi gtan khel byed mi thub na/ 'dems shog thob grangs 'dra ma tshungs kyi bdam bya'i 'os mir yang bskyar 'dems spya/ 'phangs te/ 'dems shog thob grangs su ma nga na de bdams thon byung ba (bcu gcig) bdams thon byung grangs de dgos nges gdam grangs las nyung na ji ltar bya/bdams thon byung mi gsum yod na'ang / nges par gdam grangs las nyung skabs/ ma 'dang ba'i go ming de re zhig stong bar bzhag chog gal te kru'u rin med tshe/ kru'u rin gzhon pas kru'u rin gyi bya ba tshab sgrub byed pa dang / kru'u rin dang kru'u rin gzhin pa'i 'gan khur mkhan re 'ig shātā tshe/

bdams thon byung ba'i sde dmangs u yon khang gi khongs mis u yon khrod mi gcig bdams te kru'u rin gyi bya ba tshab sgrub byed du 'jug chog(bcu gnyis) bdams thon byung ba'i mi grangs kyis sde dmangs u yon lhan zung 'dzugs pa'i mi grangs mi longs na ji ltar bya/bdams thon byung ba'i mi grangs gsum ma longs par/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang 'dzugs ma thub na/ nges par du 'dems shog thob grangs mang nyung gi go rim ltar mi gsum pa de kha gsab byas te/ re 'ig sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi 'gan 'khri lag bstar byed dgos/ yin na'ang / zla drug gi nang tshun du 'dems bsko byed dgos/ logs su 'dems bsko byed skabs/sngar bdams thon byung ba'i sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi khongs mi'i thob thang rtsis 'gro yod par btang ba yin/(bcu gsum) sde dmangs kyi tsu'u grang chung ba de sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis gtan khel byas chog gam/sde dmangs kyi tsu'u krang chung ba de sde dmangs rtsa 'dzugs chung ba'i gros tshogs steng bdams thon 'byung dgos/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang bdams thon byung rjes/ nges par du nyin bcu'i nang tshun du sde dmangs tsu'u krang chung ba 'dems sgrug gam yang na 'dems bsko bya dgos/(bcu bzhi) sde ba'i rtsis gnyer pa de sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gyis gtan khel byas chog gam/sde ba'i rtsis gnyer pa de sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis ming bton pa dang / sde dmangs gros tshogs nang zhugs pa'i mi grangs kyi phyed ku'i yan 'thad pa byung ba brgyud/ gtan 'bebs ltar 'brel yod 'gro lugs bsgrubs rjes spyod gzod bsko spyod byas chog106

(bco lnga) sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gyis rtsis gnyer pa'i 'gan gcig lcogs su 'khur chog gam/mi chog sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi khongs mir khrim/sa bkod rtsis gnyer pa'i thob thang yo da na/ rtsis gnyer pa'i 'gan gcig lcogs su khur chog sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gyis rtsis gnyer pa'i 'gan gcig lcogs su khur mi chog(bcu drug)sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi khongs mir gnas tshul gang dag yod che sde dmangs kyis las stegs las 'bab pa'i re ba brtan chogasde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi khongs mir gsham gyi gnas tshul las gcig yod tshe/ nges par du rang 'gul sgos sde dmangs u yo na lhan khang la la sa khur dgongs zhu bya rgyu dang / sde dam ngas gros tshogs las mang kha nyung len gyi rtsa don ltar gros bsdur thag gcod bya rgyu/ sde dmangs kyis kyang bca' khrims nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i sgrig lam ltar las stegs las 'bab pa'i re ba bton chog(1)dbang brten sger sgrub byas te/ sde dmangs khrod shugs rkyen ngan pa bzos rigs dang /(2) rang 'khri'i las 'gan snang med du bzhes ste/ sde dmangs kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho bar gyong gun nges can bzos rigs/(3)rgyal khab kyi 'char ldan bu btsa'i khrims srol dang srid jus kyi gtan 'bebs dang 'gal te btsa' skye byas rigs/(4)lugs mthun gyi rgyu mtshan ci yang med par bstud mar zla gsum la sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi bya bar mi zhugs pa'i rigs/(5)lo 'khor mo'i dpyad 'jog khrod/ sde dmangs phyed ga'i yan gyis las 'gan la blo gcig sems gcig min par 'dod pa'i rigs/ 107

(6)bca' khrim sa dang khrim sa srol/ srid jus bcas dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod ga'an rigs/(bcu bdun)sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi longs mi las stegs las 'bab par gtan 'bebs gang dag yod/sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi khongs mir sde dmangs kyis lta skul bya dgos/ sde dam ngas kyis khrims 'ga' sgrig 'gal lam yang na las gar 'gan 'dzol tshabs chen byung ba'i sde dmangs u yo na lhan khang gi khongs mi zhu gtug byed pa'am/ yang na las stegs las 'bab pa'i bsam 'char bton chog(1)rang sde ba'i lnga cha'i gcig yan gyi 'dems dmangs kyis ming byang mnyam 'god byas te/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi khongs mi las stesas la sa 'bab pa'i re 'dun zhus chog(2)las stegs las 'bab pa'i re 'dun zhu na nges par du yig thog rnam pas sde dmangs u yon lhan khang dang sa de ga'i 'ang grong mi dmangs srid gzhung la zhu dgos pa ma zad/ la sa stegs las 'bab dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gsal bo 'bri dgos/(3)sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis las stegs las 'bab pa'i re 'dun 'byor nyin nas zla gcig nang tshun du sde dmangs gros tshogs bsdus te/'dems thog 'phangs te brdas thag gcod rgyu/(4)sde dmangs u yo na lhan khang gis sde dmangs gros tshogs bsdus nas las stegs las 'bab pa'i re zhu brdas thag gcod pa dang len mi byed na/zhang grong mi dmangs srid gzhung gis sde dmangs gros tshogs bsdus te/ sde dmangs gros tshogs las 'dems shog 'phangs te brdas thag bcad chog(5)sde dmangs gros tshogs steng las stegs las 'bab pa'i re zhur gro/ sdusar dang brdas thag gcod skabs/ las stegs las 'bab pa'i re zhu

bton yul gyi sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi khongs mir gros tshogs nang zhugs pa ma zad dag 'bud byed pa'i bsam 'char 'don dbang yod/(6)sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi khongs mi las stegs las 'bab dgos na/ 'dems dmangs phyed ka yan gyi 'thad pa 'byung dgos/ brdas thag gcod pa'i go rim dang byed thabs de sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi 'dem sa bsko byed thabs nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i go rim dang byed thabs ltar bsgrub dgos/(7)brdas thag bcad pa'i mjug 'bras de sde dam ngas u yon lhan lang gis 'ang grong mi dmangs srid gzhung dang rdzong rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gi sde khag la zhus te 'char zin 'god dgos/(bco brgyad)sde dmangs kyis 'dems bsko byed thabs la rgyab 'gal byas pa'i bya spyod thag gcod par gtan 'bebs gang dag yod/〈sde dam ngas u yon lhan khang gi rtsa 'dzugs bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan bco lnga pa'i nang / tsa 'jigs skul dang lkog ngan la brten pa dang / 'dems shog rdzun bzo byed pa sogs tshul min gyi byed thabs la brten nas/ sde dmangs kyi 'dems bsko'i dbang cha dang 'dems bsko bya yul gyi dbang char gnod 'tshe bzo ba dang / sde dmangs u yon lhan khang 'dems bsko byed par gtor brlag gtong rigs la/ sde dmangs kyis 'ang dang mi rigs zhang /grong rdal bcas kyis mi dmangs 'thus ri 'i tshogs chen dang mi dmangs srid gzhung ngam yang na rdzong rim pa'i mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen gyi rgyun la sa u yon lhan khang dang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang de'i 'brel yod gtso skyong sde khag bcas la zhu gtug byed dbang yod pa dang / 'brel yod las khungs kyis nges par du brtag 'ib byed 'gan khur ba ma zad khrims ltar thag gcod dgos/ 'jigs skul dang lkog ngan la brten pa dang / 'demasdu /ga

rdzun bzo byed pa sogs tshul min byed thabs la brten nas bdams thon byung ba de rtsis 'gro med par gtong ba migatan la phab yod/ 'jigs skul zhes pa ni gsod pa dang rgyu nor rtsa brlag byed pa/ mtshan snyan brlag pa'am yang na des gyong gun thebs pa sogs byed thabs la brten nas gnon shugs byin te/sde dmangs kyis rang nyid kyi 'dod blo ltar 'dems shog 'phen mi thub par bcug pa'i bya spyod la bstan pa yin/ lkog ngan zhes pa ni/ ma dngul dang rgyu nor sogs dngos po'i khe phan gyis sde dmangs la bslu brid btang ste sde dmangs kyis rang nyid kyi 'dod blo dngos la rgyab 'gal byas te 'dems shog nang zhugs pa'am yang na 'dems bsko'i bya ba'i khrod khrims 'gal gyi bya 'gul spel ba'i spyod tshul der bstan pa yin/ 'dems thog rdzun bzo zhes pa ni 'dems bsko'i gtso 'dzin las khungs rdzun ma'i ming thog nas 'dems shog bzos te/ sde dmangs mang shos kyis 'dems shog 'phangs pa'i bdam bya'i 'os mi bdams thon byung ma thub par/ 'dems bsko bya ba rgyun lda na ngang spel bar gtor brlag btang ba'i bya spyod la bstan pa yin/ gong gi spyod tshul gsum po khrims 'gal gyi 'gran rtsod 'dems bsko'i spyod tshul yin pa ma zad/sde dam/ngas kyi 'dems bsko'i dbang cha dang 'dems bsko bya yul gyi dbang char gnod 'tshe bzos pa dang / sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi 'dems bsko'i bya spyod la gtor brlag btang ba'i nyes tshad lon rigs yin pas/bdams thon byung ba'i thob thang rtsis 'gro med par gtong ba las ga'an/gal te spyod tshul des spyi pa'i sgrig lam la gtor brlag btang tshe/ bde skyong chad gcod bya rgyu/ yin na'ang nyes khrims steng gi 'dems bsko'i byas nyes bzos grub byung med/ 110

(bcu dag) sde dmangs rang skyong sgrig lam dang sde dmangs gan rgya gtan la 'bebs na gtan 'bebs gang dag brtsi srung bya dgos/〈〈sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi rtsa 'dzugs bca' khrims〉〉kyi don tshan nyi shu ltar na/ sde dmangs rang skyong sgrig lam dang sde dmangs gan rgya gtan la 'bebs na gsham gyi gtan 'bebs nges par du brtse srung bya dgos te/(1)rtsa khrims dang bca' khrim sa/ khrims srol dang rgyal khab kyi srid jus bcas la rgyab 'gal byas mi chog pa dang / sde dmangs rang skyong gi 'gan dbang khyab khongs las brgal mi rung la / 'os 'tsham min pa'i chad gcod byed thabs sogs gtan 'bebs byas mi chog(2)sde dmangs kyi lus khams khe dbang dang dmangs gtso'i khe dbang /'u gas mthun rgyu nor gyi khe dbang bcas la gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i nang don yod mi chog sde dmangs kyi lus khams khe dbang la tshe srog khe dbang dang bde thang khe dbang / ming tho'i khe dbang / gzi brjid khe dbang sogs 'dus shing / sde dmangs kyi dmangs satso'i khe dbang la dper na/ khrims ltar gtam brjod spel ba dang / par skrun byed pa/ tshogs 'du bsdu ba/ tshogs pa 'dzugs pa/ khrom skor byed pa/ rngam ston khrom skor byed pa bcas kyi rang dbang dang / 'dems bsko'i dbang cha dang 'dems bsko bya dgos nges kyi dbang cha sogs longs su spyad 'thus/ rgyu nor khe dbang ni sde dmangs la lugs mthun sgos blangs pa'i rgyu nor bdag bzung dang bod spyod/ bgo thag gcod pa dang khe phan len pa bcas kyi dbang cha yod par bstan pa yin/(3) gtan 'bebs dbang cha de sde dmangs u yon lhan khang la gtogs pa dang / ga'an pa'i rtsa 'dzugs gang zhig dang mi sger su zhig la'ang gtan la 'bebs pa'i dbang cha med/(4)zhang mi dmangs srid gzhung la 'char 'god byed par zhu da/11/

(5)sde dmangs rang skyong sgrig lam dang sde dmangs gan rgya'i nang don de sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis khrims ltar gros bstar byas te gtan khel bya rgyu/ gong gi gtan 'bebs dang 'gal ba'i sde dam ngas rang skyong sgrig la ma dang sde dmangs gan rgya la rtsis 'gro med/(nyi shu)sde dmangs u yon lhan bang gi skabs brjes rjes tham ka brgyad spyod byed par dus chon gtan khel yod dam/yo da de/ rgyal khab gzhung las khang gis spel ba'i2001lo'i yig cha yang52pa'i nang / skabs brje 'dems bsko bya ba mjug rdzogs rjes/ skabs sngon ma'i sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis nges par du nyin10nang tshun du skabs 'di'i sde dmangs u yon lhan khang la tham ka brgyud sprod bya dgos/zhang rim pa'i mi dam ngas srid gzhung dang rdzong rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung dang dmangs srid sde khag bcas kyis sde dam/ngas u yon lhan khang gi skabs brjes rjes tham ka brgyud sprod bya bar lta skul legs po bya dgos/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi tham ka gtan nas brgyud sprod mi byed na/ bzo spel las khungs kyis 'ded sprod byed 'gan khur ba ma zad/ 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded bya dgos/(nyer gcig)sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis sde dmangs kyis khral dngul chad 'grungs byas par kha g.yar te tham ka ma sprad na chog gam/mi chog rgyal khab kyis gtan 'bebs gsal bo byas yod de/ sde dmangs u yo na lhan khang gis tham ka do dam byed pa'i gtan 'bebs dang bkol spyod dang zhib bsher sgrig lam brtsi srung nan mo bya dgos pa ma zad/mang tshogs kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho bar stabs bde bzo dgos/ khral dngul chad pa sogs la kha g.yar te/ sde dmangs kyis dmag nang du zhugs pa dang gnye1/ snag pa/ sgo phyir gla rgyag tu 'gro ba sogs 'gro lugs sgrub skabs/ sde

dmangs u yon lhan khang gi tham ka mi rgyag pa dang / yang na go skabs dang bstu na nas bza' 'khyer 'gog len bcas byas te/ cing pa'i khur bo je lci ru satan nas gtong mi rung /go (nyer gnyis)sde don gang dag nges par du khrims ltar spyi bsgrags bya da sa/〈〈sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi rtsa 'dzugs 〉〉kyi don tshan nyer gnyis pa dang don tshan bcu dgu pa'i gtan 'bebs ltar na/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis nges par dus thog tu gsham gyi las don spyi bsgags bya dgos te/(1)'ang gcig gyur 'char 'god kyi rtsis len byed thebs dang sde ba'i cha bgos thob cha'i rtsis len dang bkol da/ 'ing sde'i khral dngul bcos bsgyur steng zhang gcig gyur 'char 'god dang sde ba'i cha bgos thob cha med par bzos gnas/ lha don rer gros re yi spyi phan ma dngul rtsis len dang bkol spyod bcas dang /tsha ༷)rang sde ba'i las chag kha gsab longs su spyod pa'i mi grangs dang zed ga(3/)sde ba'i thun mong dpal 'byor las thob pa'i phan khe bkol spyod da pa(/4)sde bas slob grwa sgrub pa dang sde bas gzhung lam las pa sogs sde ba'i spyi phan bya ga'ag gi gron dngul grabs gsog byed pa'i jus gzhi/(5)sde ba'i thun mong dpal 'byor las ga'i'i rnam grangs 'dzugs pa dang 'gan gtsang len byed pa'i thabs jus/ sde ba'i spyi phan bya sa'ag gi 'dzugs skrun 'gan gtsang len byed pa'i jus gzhi/(6)sde dmangs kyi 'gan gtsang len dang gnyer skyong thad kyi jus ga'i/(7)khang sa bkol spyod thad kyi jus gzhi/ 113

(8)rgyal khab kyi 'char ldan bu btsa'i srid jus dngos 'bebs byed tshul dang slob lo ran pa'i byis pa slob grwar 'grims pa'i gnas tshul/(9)gegs skyob rgyad skyob thad sgor mo dang dngos zong gtong sprod byas pa'i ga/sdu /sdu ri/ na dang glog rin sdud len byas pa'i gnas tshal/(11)theng sde ba'i nor srid gnas tshul dang thun modro rgyu nor gyi rin thang brtan srung dang rin thang 'phar ba/ thag gcod pa bcas kyi gnas tshul/(12)sde ba'i las byed pa'i lo 'khor mo'i bya ba'i dmigs 'ben dang snro phogs dang bya dga'/ byas rjes dang las 'dzol byung ba bcas kyi gnas dul/ (13)sde dmangs u yon lhan tshogs kyis nges par du sde dmangs gros tshogs steng gros bsdur byas te thag gcod dgos snyam pa'i las don dang rang sde ba'i sde dmangs kyi khe phan la 'brel ba dang / sde dmangs kyis yongs khyab tu sems khur byed pa'i don las gzhan pa bcas so/ mdor na/ rang sde ba'i sde dmangs kyis sems khur byed pa'i gnad don gtso bo tshang ma sde dmangs la spyi bsgrags bya dgos/ gnas tshul gyi 'phel rgyas 'gyur ldog dang sde dmangs kyi re bar bstun nas/ dus thog tu sde don spyi bsgrags byed pa'i nang don legs sgrig dang je legs su btang ste/ mang tshogs kyi rtsa ba'i khe phan dang 'brel ba'i don chen gang zhig yin rung / rnam pa nges can zhig gi spra/ /lha tram̐ dmangs la spyi bsgrags bya ba dang / mang tshogs kyi lta skul dang du bton shā/ra/ gsum)krung dbyang gis sde don spyi bsgrags thad blang bya gang dag 11snang dbyang gis sde don spyi bsgrags thad gsham gyi blang bya 'ga' bton

yo da de(/1)sde don spyi bsgrags byed pa'i dmigs yul ni mang tshogs sde ba'i spyi pa 'i las /spya dang spyi phan bya gzhag la do dam dang lta skul byed par zhugs su 'jug shā ) sde sdo/na spyi bsgrags byed pa'i gtso gnad ni nor srid spyi bsgrags byed rgyu( ༵ ni// bsgrags byed pa'i nang don de mdor bsdus shing gsal bo byas te/ mang tshogs kyis don go bar stabs bde bzo dgos/(4)spyi bsgrags byed pa'i rnam pa dang byed thabs de don dngos kyi sanas tshul ltar yul bab dang bstun pa dang stabs bstun sna mang byas chog ste/dper na sgo sam steng spyi bsgrags byed pa dang / skud yod rgyang sgrog nang spyi bsgrags byed pa/ sde dmangs gros tshogs sam yang na sde dmangs 'thus mi'i gros tshogs bsdus te spyi bsgrags byed pa sogs rnam pa spyad chog sde ba re res rdos rnyir du sa gnas lhas 'tsham zhig nas ched du spyi bsgrags byed sa btsugs / ( zlo/sgro /sgra r+shakā zlordo/ pa'i dus tshod myar dgos/ spyi bsgrags bya dgos pa'i don bya de snga mo nas sde dmangs la ṭ+wā bsgrags bya dgos shing / dus bcad ltar spyi bsgrags byed pa'i rnam pa spyad kyang chog spyir btang du zla gcig gam yang na zla gnyis nang spyi bsgrags thengs gcig bya dgos pa dang /mang na yang zla gsum las brgal mi chog dus tshod kyi tshad bkag cung ring ba'i don bya la lar/ thengs re rer dus rim re legs 'grub byas chog pa ste/'phel tshul thengs gcig spyi bsgrags byed pas chog don bya chen po re legs 'grub byung rjes/ dus thog tu mang tshogs la mjug 'bras spyi bsgrags bya dgos/ 115

(6)thengs rer sde don spyi bsgrags byas rjes/ tang kri pu'u dang sde dmangs u yon lhan tshogs kyis dus thog tu tang yon gros tshogs dang sde dmangs gros tshogs sam yang na sde dmangs 'thus mi'i gros tshogs bsdus te/rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi 'dod blo dang bsam 'char la nyan dgos/ mang tshogs kyis dogs gnad bton tshe/ dus thog tu 'grel bshad rgyag dgos pa dang /mang tshogs kyis re ba bton tshe/ dus thog tu phyir lan sprod dgos/ mang tshogs mang shos 'thad pa mi yong ba'i bya ba de nges par du yo bsrang bya dgos/sde dmangs spyi pa'i las don gyi do dam nang dngos gnas zhugs su 'jug pa dang / phan nus ldan pa'i dmangs gtso'i lta skul lag bstar byas te/ phyi tshul ring lugs kyi lam du gtan nas bskyod mi rung /(nyer bzhi)krung dbyang gis sde don khyu bsgrags lam lugs gang dag 'dzugs pa'i blang bya bton yod/krung dbyang gis sde don spyi bsgrags dang dmangs gtso'i do dam lam lugs 'thus tshang du gtong ba dang / sde don spyi bsgrags dang dmangs gtso'i do dam tshad ldan can du 'gyur ba dang lam lugs can du 'gyur ba mngon 'gyur byas te/ bya bar sgrig lam yod pa dang las ka sgrub par bden dpang yod par byas nas/ 6 sgrig yig yod pa'i sgo nas las 'dzin byed pa nyamangon 'gyur bya dgos pa'i blang bya bton pa dang / 'di ni sde don bya ba legs par bsgrub pa'i gzhi rtsa'i srid jus yin/ bca' khrims dang khrims srol/ srid jus bcas gzhi 'dzin sa byas pa dang / don dngos dang dngos bkol/dngos phan bca/ rtsa rdon byas te/ gsham gyi lam lu gas 'dzugs pa dang 'thus shāka sdi /dīkā nā ༵༵/ tshogs dang sde dmangs 'thus mi'i gros tshogs/tad stun las ga'i gros rim gros tshogs bcas kyi lam lugs dang /

(2)sde ba'i tang kri pu'u dang sde dmangs u yon lhan tshogs kyis dus ltar skabs brje 'dems bsko byed pa'i lam lusas/(3)sde ba'i tang kri pu'u dang sde dmangs u yon lhan tshogs kyi lo mjug gi spyi bsdoms yar zhu byed pa'i lam lugs/(4)dmangs gtsos tang yo na dang las byed par dpyad gling byed pa'i la ma/ lu/lha/nor don do dam dang nor don bsher rtsis byed pa'i la ma lugs/(6)nor don spyi bsgrags dang nor don lta skul byed pa'i lam 'u gas/(7)sde ba'i las byed pa'i 'gan khur dus yu na dang las 'gan las bral ba'i bsher rtsis lam lugs/ mdor na/ spyi bsgrags bya dgos pa'i sde don dang dam ngas gtso'i do dam khyab khongs nang bzhag pa'i bya ba gang zhig yin rung / khrims ltar lam lugs bzo ba dang / lam lugs ltar bya ba bsgrub dgos/(nyer lnga)zhing sde'i nor don spyi gsal la nang don gang dag 'dus sam/ nor don spyi gsal ni sde don spyi gsal gyi gtso gnad yin la/1997lo'i zla12pa'i tshes16nyin rgyal khab 'ing las pu'u dang lta skul pu'u yis 'grem spel byas pa'i〈〈zhing sde'i thun mong gi dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi nor don spyi gsal skor gyi skabs spyod gtan 'bebs〉〉nang sde ba'i thun mong gi dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis nor don spyi gsal byed par gsham gyi nang don 'di dag 'dus te/1 nor don 'char gzhi/(1)nor don gtong len 'char ga'i/(2)gtan 'jags rgyu nor 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i 'char ga'i/ 117

(3)zhing las gzhi rtsa'i 'dzugs skrun gyi 'char ga'i/(4) gsar sgrub khe las dang thon khungs gsar spel la ma dngul 'jog pa'i 'char gzhi/(5)yong 'bab bgo bsha'i 'char gzhi/2 yong sgo sna tshogs/(1)sde ba ru sor bzhag byas pa dang zhang gcig gyur 'char 'god byed pa'i 'gro gron(zhing sde'i dpya khral med par bzos te sde ba ru sor bzhag byed pa dang zhang gcig gyur 'char 'god byed pa'i sa char don gcig gros gcig gi spyi phan dngul rtsa'i yong sgo)(2)ba 'gan sprod pa dang gong du sprad pa'i yong sgo/(3) thun mong gis gcig gyur bdag gnyer byed pa'i yong sgo/(4)rub bsdu byed pa'i ma dngul/(5)sa zhing gi kha gsab ma dngul/(6) rgyad skyob rogs skyor ma dngul/(7)gong rim sde khag gis gtong sprod byed pa'i ma dngul /(8)yong sgo gzhan dag3 'gro sgo sna tshogs/(1)thon skyed rang bzhin gyi 'dzugs skrun 'gro sgo(de'i nang du thon skyed rang bzhin gyi gtan 'jags rgyu nor 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i 'gro sgo 'dus/2)spyi phan phan bde las don gyi 'gro sgo(de'i nang du spyi phan rang bzhin gyi gtan 'jags rgyu nor 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i 'gro sgo 'dus)(3)sde ba'i thun mong gi dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi las byed pa'i gla phogs dang ma dngul/11/4) sne len byed pa'i 'gro sgo/

(5)thun mo nga gis gcig gyur bdag gnyer byed pa'i 'gro sgo/(6)rgud skyob rogs skyor gyi ched dmigs 'gro sgo/(7)gong du sprad pa'i shang gcig gyur 'char 'god byed pa'i 'gro sgo/(8)'gro sgo gzhan dag4 rgyu nor sna tshogs/(1)lag dngul dang dngul khang gi gsog dngul/(2)thon rdzas dngos po/(3)gtan 'jags rgyu nor/(4)phyi phyogs la ma dngul 'jog pa/(5)rgyu nor gzhan dag5 bun bdag bun lon/(1)'ing khyim phan tshun bar gyi 'gro 'ong /(2)nang khul sde khag gi 'gro song /(3)phyi rol gyi sde khag dang mi kha shas shig gi 'gro 'ong /(4)dngul khang(yid rton khang)gi dngul bun/(5)bun bdag dang bun lon ga'an dag6 yong 'bab bgo bsha'/(1)yong 'bab kyi spyi grangs/(2)khral dngul sprad pa'i grangs 'bor/(3)spyi gsog ma dngul blangs pa'i grangs 'bor/(4)spyi phan ma dngul blangs pa'i grangs 'bor/(5)phan bde'i ma dngul blangs pa'i grangs 'bor/(6)ma dngul bzhag nas skyed ka bgos pa'i grangs 'bor/(7)bgo bya gzhan dag7 zhing khyim gyis 'gan 'khur ba'i rub bsdus ma dngul dang stu spyang

glog rin/ ngal rtsol rim bsags las bya dang 'os 'gan las bya/ sgor mos ngal rtsol gyi tshab byed pa sogs kyi gnas tshul/(nyer drug) sde ba'i nor don spyi gsal byed par dus chod kyi gtan 'bebs gang dag brtsi srung bya dgos/rgyal khab zhing las pu'u dang lta skul pu'u yis1997lo'i zla12pa'i tshes16nyin〈ling sde'i thun mong dpa' 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi nor don spyi gsal skor gyi skabs spyod gtan 'bebs〉'grem spel byas pa dang / 'ing sde'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis lo stod du nor don 'char ga'i khyab bsgrags bya dgos pa dang / zla re'i dang yang na dus tshigs rer yo nga sgo dang 'gro sgo'i gnas tshul khyab bsgrags thengs gcig bya dgos pa dang lo ma jug tu rgyu nor sna tshogs dang bun bdag bun 'o na/ yong 'bab bgo bsha'/ 'ing khyim gyis 'gan khur ba'i rub bsdus ma dngul/ chu dang glog rin/ ngal rtsol rim bsasas la sa bya dang 'os 'gan las bya/ sgor rngo byin nas ngal rtsol gyi tshab byed pa'i gnas tshul sogs khyab bsgrags thengs gcig re bya dgos/dus rgyun du sde dam ngas mang che shas shig gam yang na dmangs gtso'i dngul bun do dam tsho chung gis spyi gsal bya dgos par re ba bton pa'i ched dmigs nor don bya 'gul la sde ba'i thun mong gi dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis dus ltar khyab bsgrags bya dgos pa dang / nor don bya 'gul gal chen yin na/nges par du dus ltar la sa tshan re re bzhin khyab bsgrags bya dgos/(nyer bdun)nor don spyi gsal la rnam pa gang dag spyod dgos sam/rgyal khab zhing las pu'u dang lta skul pu'u yis gtan 'bebs byas pa ste/sde ba'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis nor don spyi gsal bya dgos na/gtso bo ni nor don spyi gsal gyi tshan byang kha skong gi rnam pas sbrags yi ga bzhi/ spyagos/ nor don spyi gsal gyi tshan byang de mang tshogs 'dus sdod byed

sa'i sa khul dang la ma mdo sogs mang tshogs kyis klog bde ba'i sa char brgyas dgos / nor don spyi gsal tshan byang gi bzo dbyibs ni rdzong rim pa'i 'ing sde'i rma nyam la sa dpa' 'byor bdag gnyer do dam sde khag gis gcig gyur gotan 'bebs bya dgos/(nyer brgyad) sde ba'i nor don spyi gsal byed na go rim gang dag brgyud dgos sam rgyal khab zhing las pu'u dang lta skul pu'u yis gtan 'bebs byas yod pa ste/ sde ba'i thun mong dpa' 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis spyi gsal byed pa'i nor don rtsis khra de nges par du don dngos dang yid rton rung ba 'ig yin dgos na / sde ba'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis nor don spyi gsal ma byas pa'i sngon la/ dmangs gtso'i dngul don do dam tsho chung der zhugs su bcug nas / rgyu nor yo ngas rdzogs dang bun bdag bun lon la 'brel ba yod pa'i rtsis khrar phyogs yongs nas 'ib bsher thengs shig bya dgos la/ nor don spyi sasal gyi nang don la 'ang(grong rdal ) gi 'ing sde'i mnyam las dpal 'byor bdas gnyer do dam sde khag gis 'ib bsher dang khas len bya dgos pa dang mnyam du sde ba'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'gan 'khri pa dang dam/ngas gtso'i dngul don do dam tsho chung gi 'gan 'khri pa dang gtso bdag rtsis gnyer pa bcas la ming tho 'god du 'jug dgos/ sde ba'i thun mo nga gi dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis nor don rtsis khra'i sbrags yig sbyar rjes/ de'i 'gan 'khri pa gtso bor ched du dus tshod bkod sgrig byas te/ mang tshogs 'dri ru yo nga bar sne len dang mang tshogs kyi 'dri gzhi la lan 'debs pa/ mang tshogs kyi bsam 'char dang gros ga'i la nyan pa bcas byed du 'jug dgos/ma nga tshogs kyis nor don spyi gsal khrod tshur snang byed pa'i gnad don dus ltar thag gcod dgos pa dang / 'phral du thag gcod byed mi thub na1 ༷sal

bshad gsal bo rgyag dgos pa las/ bsam 'char bton pa'am gnad don tshur ༵༵ byed pa'i mang tshogs la btsan gnon dang 'khon lan slog pa sogs byas (k+tar dgu)sde ba'i dmangs gtso dngul don do dam tsho chung la lta skul gyi dbang cha gang dag yod dam/rgyal khab zhing las pu'u dang lta skul pu'u yis gtan 'bebs byas yod pa ste/ sde ba'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis mang tshogs kyi 'thus mi gtso bo yin pa'i dmangs gtso'i dngul don do dam btsugs nas nor don spyi gsalakhya 'gul la lta skul bya dgos/ dmangs gtso'i dngul don do dam tsho chung de sde dmangs tshogs chen dang sde dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen las 'dems bsko byas nas bdams thon 'byung dgos/ dmangs gtso'i dngul don do dam tsho chung la gsham gyi lta skul dbang cha yod de/(1)nor don spyi gsal byed pa'i gnas tshul la zhib bsher dang lta skul byed dastu| /shā ༵ /zlo kyi/ tshab byas te 'brel yod kyi nor don rtsis khrar blta ba'am zhib bsher gtan 'bebs byas te/ 'brel yod nor don gyi gnad don tshur snang byed pa'i dbang cha yod pa/(3)nor don spyi gsal khrod byung ba'i gnad don la thag gcod kyi gros gzhi 'don pa'i dbang cha yod pa/(4)rim pa gong ma'i sde khag la 'brel yod nor don do dam khrod kyi gnad don tshur snang byed pa'i dbang cha yod pa/(sum cu)sde dmangs la nor don spyi gsal khrod lta skul gyi dbang cha gang dag yod dam/12) dmangs la nor don spyi gsal khrod gsham gyi dbang cha 'di dag ldan

ṭ+wāṃ/ (1)spyi gsal byas pa'i rtsis khra la dogs 'dri dang 'dri cod byed dbang da pa( shārnyi sde/ ba'i nor srid lta skul tsho chung la mngags bcol byas te 'brel yod kyi nor srid rtsis khra dang dngos dpang la blta ba'am zhib bsher gtan 'bebs byed dbang yod/ (3)'brel yod don thog par 'brel yod nor srid gnad don la rāgrel bshad brgyag pa dang dris lan 'debs dgos pa'i re ba 'don dbang skud/ (4)rim pa bzhin du sde ba'i nor srid spyi gsal byed pa'i khrod kyi gnad spyan yar zhu bya ba dang / der bsam 'char dang gros gzhi 'don dbang cha da/ (so gcig)srid gzhung dang 'brel yod sde khag gis sde ba'i nor srid spyi gsal byed pa'i bya 'gul khrod las 'gan gang dag 'khur dgos sam/ste/ rgyal khab zhing las pu'u dang lta skul pu'u yis gtan 'khel byas yod pa (1)zhang (grong rdal) srid gzhung gis sde ba'i nor don spyi gsal bya 'gul khrod gsham gyi khrid ston dang lta skul gyi 'gan 'khri khur dgos/ gcig nas sde ba'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs de rgyal khab kyi gtan 'khel ltar nor don spyi gsal byed pa'i thad khrid ston dang lta skul bya dgos/ gnyis nas sde ba'i thun mong dpal 'byor gyi rtsa 'dzugs kyis nor don spyi gsal lam lugs 'dzugs pa dang 'thus tshang du gtong ba'i skor la khrid ston dang lta skul bya dgos/ gsum nas rim pa gong ma'i 'brel yod sde khag dang mnyam du nor don spyi gsal khrod byung ba'i gnad don thag gcod bya dgos/ 123

(2)rgyal khab kyi 'brel yod nor don spyi gsal gtan 'bebs dang 'gal ba'i sde ba'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs la zhang(grong rdal)srid gzhung gis 'gan dkri dang dus bcad nang yo bsrung byed du 'jug dgos la/dus bcad thon na'ang spyod rung yo bsrung mi byed na/ rdzong dang zhang gzhung gis 'brel yod gtan 'bebs ga'ir bzung nas 'brel yod 'gan 'khur par de bstun gyi chad pa gcod rgyu/(3)rdzong dang zhang rim pa gnyis kyi srid gzhung gis rgyal khab kyi sde ba'i las rim pa gnyis kyi srid gzhung gis rgyal khab kyi sde ba'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi nor don spyi gsal skor gyi skabs spyod gtan 'bebs de srid gzhung bya ba'i dmigs yul do dam nang du bzhag nas/ grong gseb kyi las byed par dpyad 'ib byed pa'i nang don gtso bor 'jog pa dang dus bcad ltar 'ib bsher lta skul bya rgyu/(so gnyis) sde ba'i las byed pas rang gi gnyen tshan la rtsis gnyer pa'i 'gan 'khur du bcug na 'grog gam/mi 'grig ste/ rgyal khab kyis sde ba'i las byed pa gtso bo'i thad kwa'i gnyen tshan gyis rang sde ba'i rtsis gnyer pa'i 'gan khur mi chog pa gtan la phab yod/ sde ba'i rtsis gnyer pa bsko spyod byed par sde ba'i las byed pa gtso bos 'os mi bton pa brgyud/ sde dmangs tshogs chen nam yang na sde dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen stong gros bsdur byas te 'thad pa 'byung dgos mod/'on kyang sde ba'i las byed pa gtso bos kyang gtan 'bebs 'dir rgyab 'gal byas te/ rang nyid kyi thad ma'i gnyen tshan gyis rtsis gnyer pa'i 'gan 'khur ba'i 'os mi bton pa ma zad sde dmangs tshogs chen nam sde dmangs 'thus mi'i gros tshogs la gros bsdur bya bar sprad mi chog124

le'u bzhi pa/ thon skyed bdag gnyer dang yid rton dngul bun gyi skor gleng ba/(gcig)rang rgyal gyis deng skabs spyod pa'i zhing las thon skyed gnyer skyong thad bca' khrims dang khrims srol gang dag yod/rang rgyal ni zhing las kyi rgyal khab chen po zhig yin la/ 'ing las ni rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi yin/ zhing las skor gyi khrims lu gas 'dzugs skrun byed pa ni khrims ltar rgyal khab skyong ba'i grub cha gal chen zhig yin/ bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed byas pa'i tshun du/ rgyal yongs dmangs 'thus dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang dang de'i 'brel yod pu'u u bcas kyis 'ing las dang 'ing par 'brel ba'i bca' khrims dang khrims srol/tshad ldan rang ba'in sdi yig cha4shākaX/ bkram pa dang / gtso bor gsham gyi nang don chen po gas // phyosna sa /bsdus rigs/ ()zhing las skor gyi bca' khrims/ ()'ing la sa lag rtsal khyab gdal skor gyi bca' khrim sa/ ()zhing sde'i sa 'ing 'gan gtsang len skor gyi bca' khrims/ (kyes 'ing do dam skor gyi bca' khrims/ ()sa 'ing do dam lag bstar byed pa'i smor gyi srol yig ()'ang grong khe las skor gyi bca' khrims/()rgyal mtshams phyi nang du 'gro 'ong byed pa'i srog chags dang skye dngos 'ib bsher byed pa'i skor gyi bca' khrims/ durgyal mtshams phyi nang du 'gro 'ong byed pa'i srog chags dang skye dngos 'ib bsher byed pa'i skor gyi srol yig tshad ldan can du gtong ba'i ༵༵ gyi

bca' khrims/ ()tshad ldan can du gtong ba lag bstar byed pa'i skor gyi srol yig (smotshad 'jal skor gyi bca' khrims/ (yitshad 'jal bca' khrims lag bstar byed pa'i skor gyi srol yig (misde dam ngas rtsa 'dzugs skor gyi bca' khrims/ (1zhing sde thun mong gi dbang ba'i lam lugs khe las kyi srol yig ༷zhing pa'i khur bo dang ngal rtsol do dam skor gyi srol yig ༷sde ba'i nor don spyi bsgrags thad kyi skabs spyod gtan 'bebs/ 7sde ba'i thun mo nga dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khyab khongs nang dngul gsog rtsol 'jug thad kyi skabs sbyo/ kā/nā ༵ dīkār+sha/sa dang 'brel yod rigs/ dus bon skor gyi bca' khrims/ 0skye /ngos kyi son rigs gsar pa srung skyong byed pa'i skor gyi srol yig ()skye dngos kyi pon rigs gsar pa srung skyong byed pa'i skor gyi lag bstar zhib phra/ ()zhing las lo tog gtso bo'i son rigs zhib bsher gtan 'bebs byed thabs/ ()zhing las lo tog gi sa bon thon skyed gnyer skyong byed pa'i chog 'thus dpang yig do dam byed thabs/ buzhing las lo tog gi sa bon gyi kha byang do dam byed thabs/ (nyezhing las lo tog gi tshong zong sa bon las snon byed pa'i thum shog skor gyi gtan 'bebs/ ()zhing las lo tog gtso bo'i khyab khongs skor gyi gtan 'bebs/ ()zhing las skye dngos kyi son rigs gsar pa'i dbang char btsan gnod thebs pa'i gyod ga'i thag gcod skor gyi gtan 'bebs/()zhing las skye dngos kyi son rigs gsar pa'i dbang cha las tshab byed pa'i skor gyi gtan 'bebs/ 0phyi tshong dngul gtong gi zhing las lo tog sa bon gyi khe las 'dzugs pa'i zhib mchan dang chog 'thus mchan 'god do dam skor gyi gtan 'bebs/ (yiskye dngos rims bsher skor gyi srol yig lag bstar zhib phra/ rkunargyal khab phyi nas sa bon nang 'dren byed pa/ zims bsher dang zhib mchan 'god pa'i skor gyi do dam byed thabs/ ⑫

'thus ngapa nga yig〉〉gi do dam byed thabs/ rkunagazan chas dang gzan chas sbyor rta do dam byed pa'i skor gyi srol yig nyuphyugs spyod skye dngos bzos rdzas gsar ba'i do dam byed thabs/ nyuphyugs nad sman pa'i skye dngos phra rab 'bu phra'i rigs nyar tshags dang do dam byed pa'i skor gyi tshod spyod byed thabs/ rkuspreshing mngar dang mtshe ldum 'tshol bsdu skor gyi do dam byed thabs/(4)nya las dang de 'brel yo da rigs/ (kyenya las bca' khrims/ (kyenya las gru kha'i chu khongs kyi 'grim 'grul bde 'jags do dam skor gyi srol yigaduchu thon pon myug do dam byed thabs/ ()chu thon ma rgyu dang rgyud bzang zhib bsher gtan 'bebs byed thabs/ ()nya las gru kha'i 'dzin 'thus dpang yig do dam skor gyi gtan 'bebs/ ()nya las gru kha'i gru gzings dang gru ming skor gyi gtan 'bebs/ (kyenya las gru kha'i gron sdud skor gyi gtan 'bebs/ ()nya las gru kha'i mtsho thog gi 'grim 'grul byur rkyen rtsad zhib thag gcod thad kyi sgrig srol/ (kyenya las gru kha'i mtsho 'grul lta skul dang srid 'dzin chad gcod skor gyi gtan 'bebs/ ()nya las gru kha'i skud med glog do dam skor gyi gtan 'bebs/ (smonya las kyi sbag btsog chu'i don rkyen rtsad zhib thag gcod dang sgrig lam skor gyi gtan 'bebs/ (yinya las sbag btsog don rkyen rtsad zhib dang gsal 'byed byed pa'i thob thang do dam skor gyi byed thabs/ ()mtsho thog 'grim 'grul bde 'jags skor gyi bca' khrim sa / (1nya las srid 'dzin khrims bstar dang gru gzings do dam skor gyi byed thabs/(5)thon khungs srung skyong dang khor yug srung skyong skor/ gtso bo ni/()rtswa thang skor gyi bca' khrims/ ()rtswa thang me 'gog skor gyi bca' khrims/()ri skyes srog chags srung skyong skor gyi bca' khrims/ ()ri skyes skye dngos srung skyong skor gyi srol yig 0zhing las dang ri skyes skye dngos srung skyong byed bzhi18/ ()chu skyes dang ri skyes srog chags srung skyong skor gyi lag bstar srol

srid gzhung tshang mar yang 'brel yodash+ya sa gnas khrims srol yod/(gnyis)rang re'i zhing par sa bon rdzun ma dang srus zhan las rgyang gun bzos na gan gsab dzi ltar len dgos/〈〈sa bon skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉kyi don tshan zhe gcig pa'i nang / 6 sa bon bkol spyod mkhan la sa bon spus ma'i gnad don las gyong gun bzos tshe/sa bon btsongs mkhan gyi gnyer skyong pas nges par du skyin gsab sprod dgos pa dang / skyin gsab ma dngul nang nyos pa'i sa bon gyi rin gong dang 'brel yod kyi gron dngul/ 'thob srid pa'i phan khe'i gyong gun bcas 'dus dgos pa gtan la phab yod/ 'dir bshad pa'i 'thob srid pa'i phan khe'i gyong gun zhes pa ni rgyun ldan lo 'bab kyi mu'u gcig nang thob 'os pa'i 'bru rigs kyi mang nyung de sa bon rdzun ma dang spus zhan bkol ba las thob ma thub pa dang / khyad grangs 'di ni thob pa'i phan khe'i gyong gun yin/ yang gcig bshad na/ rgyun ldan gyi gnas tshul 'og thob chog pa'i khe phan gyi gyong kun la zer/ dper na/ sa bon nyo ru song ba'i lam gla dang bdag skyong gron dngul/rdzun ma dang spus zhan gyi sa bon las thon 'bab je nyung du song ba'i gyong kun sogs yin/ gnyer skyong mkhan gyis skyin gsab sprad rjes/ sa bon thon skyed mkhan nam yang na gnyer skyong mkhan gzhan pa'i 'gan 'khrir gtogs pas/gnyer skyong mkhan gyis thon skyed mkhan nam yang na gnyer skyong mkhan gzhan parasbyin tshab bda' 'ded byed dbang yod/ 'dir khyad du zhing pa spun zla tshor gsal 'debs byed rgyu zhig yod pa ni/ nges par du sa bon nyos pa'i 'dzin byang dang bkol spyod thad kyi gsal bshad yi ge thum shog dang lhag 'phro'i sa bon bcas nyar tshags bya dgos shing / ches bzang na nyos pa'i sa bon nyung shas shig shog bu'i thum shog nang btums te/ 'tshong mkhan gyis bzhi 30 brgyab pa'i thum shog gnyis su bgos te/ nyo mkhan dang 'tshong mkhan

pas mngag tho'i zhing las gong du spel na gsham gyi gnad don 'gar ma nyam 'jog dgos te/ gcig gi mngag tho'i rnam pa dang nang don tshad ldan du gtong dgos/ mngag tho'i nang don la phyogs gnyis ga'i khe dbang dang 'os 'gan/ san rgya lag bstar byed stangs/ gan rgya dang 'gal ba'i thag gcod stangs sogs 'brel yod yig cha dang gtan 'bebs 'dus dgos/ gnyis ni mngag tho'i brjod gzhi tshad lda na du gtong dgos pa ste/ khe las dang zhing pa ni mngag tho'i brjod gzhi gtso bo yin pa gsal bor byed pa dang / sa gnas srid gzhung dang sde khag gis tshab sgrub byas mi chog la/ gan rgya 'jog par yang zhugs mi 'os/ gsum ni gan rgya'i tshad ga'i dang gan rgya'i go rim tshad ldan du gtong dgos pa ste/ rang mos dang 'dra mnyam / phan tshun gnyis phan bcas kyi rmang ga'i'i steng khrims ltar mngag tho'i gan rgya 'jog dgos/bzhi ni mngag tho ni gan rgya'am yang na spyi chings kyi 'brel ba yin pas/ rgyal khab bca' khrims kyi srung skyong thob pa yin/ mangs tho'i gan rgya bzhag pa na/ma ngag tho'i phyogs gnyis gas nges par du la ga bsta ra nan mo bya dgos/phyogs gang zhig gis tshong khrom rin gong dang gan rgya'i rin gong do mi mnyam pa las gan rgya lag bstar byed mi thub na gros mol byas te thag gcod dgos/mngag tho gan rgya bzhag pa'i phyogs gnyis ga'i khrod phyogs gang rung zhig gis rang steng gi khe phan bsam ste rgyu rkyen ci yang med pa'i sgo nas mngag tho'i gan rgyar rgyab 'gal byas te/ pha rol por gnod 'tshe bzos na/ gnod thebs phyogs kyis bca' khrims kyi thabs lam la brten nas zhu gtug thag gcod byas chog de bas/ nga tsho zhing pas mngag tho'i zhing las migong du spel na/nges par du khrims srol 'du shes dang dpal yon ldan pa'i sgos tshong gnyer ba/khrims srung gnyer skyong byed pa bcas kyi 'du shes je mthor gtong dgos/135

(druganang cho zhing pas zhing las khor yug srung skyong thad kyi gtan 'bebs gang dag brtsi srung bya dgos/zhing las khor yug la srung skyong byed pa de thad kur zhing las thon khungs dang 'ing las thon rdzas kyi spus ga nga tsho zhing pa'i 'tsho gnas dang 'phel rgyas bcas la 'brel ba yod/ 'ing las khor yug srung skyong byed pa ni nga tsho zhing pa rang nyid srung skyong byed pa dang mtshungs pas/ nga tsho zhing pa spun zla tshorme khor yugasung skyong gi bca' khrims 'du shes nges par du je drag tu gtong dgos/rang rgyal gyi khor yug srung skyong skor gyi bca' khrims dang sa gnas kha shas kyi zhing las khor yug srung skyong skor gyi srid 'dzin khrims srol ltar na/ nga tsho zhing pas gsham gyi zhing las khor yug srung skyong skor gyi bca' khrims gtan 'bebs 'di dag brtsi srung bya dgos te/(1)nags gtor rgod slog dang ri bo mer sreg pa/ rgyal khab kyis gtan 'gog byas pa'i ri zhing gsar sbol byed pa bcas gtan 'gog bya rgyu/(2)gter sngog dang bye ma bko ba/ sa len pa sogs bya 'gul spel bar/nges par du bcos skyong byed thabs spyad de/ rmo zhing 'dzin bzung dang sngo khebs la gtor brlag thebs tshad je nyung du gtong rgyu/(3)tshad las brgal te sa 'og gi chu sngog 'don byed pa gtan 'gog bya rgyu dang / mtsho nang du gtor brlag gtong ba dang chu'i thon khungs skam pa/sa ngos mar rdib pa bcas bkag 'gog bya rgyu/(4)bye ma'i nang skyes pa'i skye dngos gcod 'breg byed pa dang sa blangs nas rtswa ra'i sngo khebs la gtor brlag gtong ba gtan 'gog bya rgyu dang /zhing las sa spyod dang zhing spyod chu khungs nye 'gram du dug ldan dang gnod ldan btsog dngos spungs pa dang phyir phud pa gtan 'gog bya rgyu/ zhing sar spyod pazhi ༵༵ rdzas te mkhar grong gi gad snyigs dang rdo thal/ 'dam rdzab sogs

nges par du rgyal khab kyi tshad gzhi dang mthun dgos/(5)zhing spyod chu phung nang gad snyigs dang snam rigs kyi snyigs ro/dug 'dus gsher khu'i snyigs ro/ nad 'dus btsog chu bcas sdug pa gtan 'gog bya rgyu dang / ling kha'i chu phung khrod snum rigs nyar 'jog byas pa dang dug lda na btsog dngos nyar 'jog byas pa'i rlangs 'khor dang snod chas sbangs pa dang bkru ba gtan 'gog bya rgyu/(6)khyim bya gso ba dang zhing phyugs thon rdzas las snon byed na/ nges par du de'i gcin lud dang btsog chur gzhan pa'i bed med dngos rdzas bkol te gnod med can du bsgyur te/ zhing las khor yug la sbag btsog thebs pa med par gtong ba dang je nyung du gtong dgos/(7)sbal ba dang sbrul sogs phan 'bu dang phan bya/ phan phyugs bcas la snang skyong byas te/ ri rngon dang bsdu nyo/ phyir 'tshong bcas byed pa gtan 'a ga shā /zhi/ nga sman dang lud rdzas dang chu shog sogs zhing spyod rdzas 'gyur dngos rdzas dang skye dngos thon skyed kyi snyom sgrig sman rdzas lugs mthun sgos bkol ba dang / zhing las skye dngos kyi nad dang 'bu/ a bra dang rtswar gnod pa bcas la phyogs bsdus bcos skyong byed pa'i lag rtsal byed thabs spyod pa/dus thog tu chu shog sogs gnod ldan bed med dngos rigs phyir bsdu byed pa bcasacos te/ zhing spyod rdzas 'gyur dngos rdzas kyis sa zhing dang zhing las thon rdzas la sbag btsog thebs tshad 'gog bcos dang je nyung du gtong dgos/gong gi gtan 'bebs dang 'gal te/ zhing las khor yug la sbag btsog bzos pa dang / gnas tshul tshabs chen yin na/ gnas tshul gyi lci yang ltar dngul chad gcod pa dang skyin tshab 'jal ba/ 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded byed pa bcas bya rgyu/ sde tshan dang mi sger su zhig yin rung zhing las khor yu/ snang

skyong byed pa'i 'os 'gan yo da pa ma zad/ 'ing la sa khor yug la sbag btsog bzo ba dang gtor brlag gtong ba'i sde tshan dang mi sger ther 'don zhu satug byed dbang yod/za pyisadun)sa khul gang dag nas gang 'dod du sog ma mer bsregs mi —ga brgya ༵ kha/ ba khor yug srung skyong cus sogs pu'u u drug gis1999lo'i zla4ba'i tshes16nyin mnyam sbrel sgos(sog ma mer sreg pa dang phyogs bsdu sa bed spyod skor gyi do dam byed thabs〉bkram pa dang / de'i nang gnam gru thang dang 'grim 'grul gzhung lam/ mtho gnon glog skud lam bcas kyi nye 'gram dang zhing chen thad skyong grong khyer(tis)rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis dbye 'byed gtan 'bebs byas pa'i mnga' khongs nang sog ma mer sreg pa gtan 'gog bya dgos pa gtan la phab yod/(1)zhing chen thad skyong grong khyer (tis) rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhungagis mi 'bor 'dus sdod khul dang rim pa so so'i rang byung srung skyong khul/ rig dngos srung skyong sde tshan dang gzhan pa'i rig dngos shul gnas dang nags sa/ rtswa ra/ snum mdzod/ 'phrin skyel sgrig bkod sogs kyi ma tha' 'khor sa khul sog ma mer sreg mi chog pa'i mnga' khongs la dbye 'byed gtan 'bebs byas chog(2)sog ma mer sreg khul gyi khyab khongs/ gnam gru thang lte gnas kyi tshangs phyed la stong smis15yod pa'i rmi nga' khongs dang mgyogs bgrod gzhung lam dang lcags lam brgyud pa'i gzhogs gnyis so sor stong smisa3dang rgyal lam dang 'ing chen rim pa'i gzhung lam gyi gzhogs gnyis so sor sto nga smis1yod pa'i sa rgyud bcas nas sog ma mer bsreg chog( 13/3)gnas de'i rang byung dang mkha' dbugs sogs kyi khyad chos la

dmigs nas sog ma mer sreg khul gyi khyab khongs dbye 'byed legs sgrig byed dgos na/ cing chen thad skyong grong khyer (tis) yan gyi mi dmangs srid gzhung gis dmangs spyod rme kha' 'grul dang lcags lam sogs 'brel yod sde khag la gros mol byas te dbye 'byed gtan 'bebs bya dgos pa dang / legs smig ma byas na sngon gyi don tshan la ga bsta ra nan mo bya dgos/ gong gi gtan )bebs dang 'gal mkhan yo da na/ thad ku'i 'gan 'khri mi snar sgor20yan gyi chad pa bcad chog ma kha' rlung la sbag btsog tshabs chen bzos te/gzhung sger rgyu nor la gyong gun bzos pa'am 5/nga na mi lus shi rmas byung ba'i mjug 'bras tshabs chen bzos na/ khrims ltar nyes 'gan bda' 'ded bya rgyu/ za(brgyad)nga cho zhing pas man bcos kyi bed med dngos ro nyo 'chong byas —3 /sna /sto 2003lo'i zla6pa'i tshes26nyin bkram pa'i rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi bka' rgya a nga380nang / 〈sman bcos kyi bed med dngos ro do dam byed pa'i skor gyi srol yig〉khyab bsgrags byas pa dang / srol yig nang6 sman bcos kyi bed med dngos ro zhes pa ni sman bcos 'phrod bston las khungs kyis sman bcos dang sngon 'gog dang bde srung bcas byed pa'i khrod dang yang na gzhan pa'i 'brel yod bya 'gul spel ba'i khrod byung ba'i thad gar ram yang na thad kur ma yin pa'i sgo nas sbag btsog rang ba'in dang dug ldan can/ yang na ga'an pa'i gnod 'tshe rang bzhin lda na pa'i bed med dngos ro la zer/ srol yig nang sde tshan gang 'ig dang mi sger su 'ig yin rung sman bcos kyi bed med dngos ro bsgyur sprod dang nyo 'tshong byas mi chog pa dang /sbrag srid brgyud de bskur ba'am yang na lcags la ma dang mkha' lam brgyud nas skyel 'dren byed pa'ang gtan 'gog bya dgos pa gtan la pha13 sbyad/

gtan 'bebs de dang 'gal mkhan yod tshe rdzong rim pa yan gyi sa gnas mi dmangasasrid gzhung gi khor yug srung skyong srid 'dzin gtso skyong sde khag gis brgyud sprod dang nyo tshong phyogs gnyis/ sbrag srid brgyud de bskur mkhan/mngags 'dren mkhan bcas la khrims 'gal bya spyod 'phral du mtshams 'jog pa'i bka' phab pa dang / tha tshig sgrog pa/ khrims 'gal thob bya gzhung bzhes byed pa bcas bya rgyu dang / khrims 'gal sgos sgor5000yan thob pa yin na/ khrims 'gal sgos thob pa de'i ldab2yan dang ldabacoman gyi chad pa gcod rgyu/ khrims 'gal sgos ma thob pa'am yang na khrims 'gal sgos thob pa sgor5000man yin na/ sgor5000yan dang sgor khri2man gyi chad pa gcod rgyu/za hāgu)nga cho'i zhing pa spun zlas thon skyed dang ar las khrod rig rdzas nyad na nga k+to ༵ ༵ kha/ ba ni dpal yon ldan pa'i gna' bo'i rgyal khab cig yin pas/ lo rgyus rig gnas kyi shul dngos phun sum tshogs po yod/ rgyal khab kyis rig rdzas srung skyong thad gtsigs mthong chen po byed bzhin yod la/2002lo'i zla10pa'i tshes28nyin bskyar du bzo bcos brgyab pa'i〈rig rdzas srung skyong skor gyi bca' khrims〉bkram pa dang / 〈rig rdzas srung skyong skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan lnga pa'i nang krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab mnga'akhongs kyi sa 'og dang chu nang dang mtsho khongs bcas su lus pa'i rig rdzas yod tshad rgyal khab la dbang ba migatan la phab yod/ don tshan lnga pa'i nang spyod dung rgyal dbang rig rdzas kyi bdag dbang la bca' khrims kyi srung skyong thob yod pas/ btsan 'dzul byas mi chog pa gtan la phab yod/ yang don tshan bdun pa'i nang las khungs dang rtsa 'dzugs dang mi sger bcas la khrims ltar rig rdzas srung skyong byed pa'i 'os 'gan yod pa gtan la phab yon/40der brten/ gal te nga tsho zhing pa spun zla tshos thon skyed dang ar las

khrod rig rdzas rnyed tshe/ nges par du(rig rdzas srung skyong skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan so gnyis pa lag bstar nan mo byas te/ yul dngos srung skyong byed pa dang / gnas de'i rig rdzas srid 'dzin sde khag la yar zhu byed pa las/g.yo bslus dang lkog bgo sbas skung bcas byas mi rung / rig rdzas srid 'dzin sde khag gis yar zhu 'byor rjes/ gal te khyad par can gyi gnas tshul med na/ nges par du chu chod nyer bzhi'i nang yul dngos su thon pa ma zad/nyin bdun nang thag gcod bsam 'char 'don dgos/ rig rdzas sbas skung byas te yar zhu mi byed pa'am yang na gong sprod gtan nas mi byed la/ byas nyes su grub rigs min na/ rdzong rim pa yan gyi mi dmangs srid gzhung rig rdzasagatso skyong sde khag gis spyi bde las khungs dang mnyam du rig rdzas bda' 'ded sprod len bya rgyu dang / gnas tshul tshabs chen yin na/ sgor5000yan dang sgor50000man gyi chad pa gcod rgyu/ brku 'phrog dang g.yo bslus/lkog bgo bcas dang yang na khrims 'gal sgos rgyal dbang rig rdzas bdag bzung bya/ te/ byas nyes su grub rigs yin na/ khrims ltar nyes 'gan bda' ༵༵ spra sdi/ zhing pas thon skyed gnyer skyong byed par gan rgya'i bca' khrims gang dag shes dgos/rang rgyal gyi〈gan rgya'i skor gyi bca' khrims〉ni1999lo'i zla10pa'i tshes1nyin nas bzung lag bstar byas pa yin la/ bsdoms pas le'u93dang don tshan428yod/ 'di ni tshong ra'i brje spel tshad ldan du gtong ba dang rgyu nor 'brel ba legs sgrig byed pa'i gzhi rtsa'i bca' khrims shig yin/ nga tsho 'ing pa spun zlas skyel 'dren byed na'ang 'dra/ ar las 'dzugs skrun gyi las ka gnyer na'ang 'dra/ da dung ma dngul btang nas gdos bcas kyi la sa ka gnyer ba'am yang na sgo phyir gla rgyag tu 'gro ba sogs las gang la zhugastu sang

gan rgya dang la 'bral thabs med/ 〈gan rgya'i skor gyi bca' khrim sa〉nang bye brag gis nyo tshong gan rgya dang / chu glog rlangs gsum 'don sprod byed pa'i gan rgya/ legs skyes gan rgya/ dngul bun len pa'i gan rgya/ bogs gtong gan rgya/ dngul rtsa bogs gtong byed pa'i gan rgya/ sgrub 'gan len pa'i gan rgya/ 'dzugs skrun bzo 'god kyi gan rgya/ skyel 'dren gan rgya/ las rtsal gan rgya/ srung skyong do dam gan rgya/ mdzod bcug gan rgya/ mngags bcol gan rgya/ sgrig lam lag bstar gan rgya/ khang bar gan rgya sogs gan rgya'i rigs15gtan 'bebs byas yod/ 〈gan rgya'i skor gyi bca' khrims〉nang spyod dung gan rgya'i rnam pa gsum bye brag gis gtan la phab pa ste/ yig thog rnam pa dang ngag thog rnam pa/ rnam pa ga'an rigs bcas gsum 'dus/dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod/ nga tsho zhing pa'i thon skyed gnyer skyong gi bya 'gul ma nga thos la gan rgya'i rnam pa spyad yo/da pa ste/ dper na/ nga tsho 'ing pa spun zlas sa bon dang 'ing sman sogs thon skyed rgyu cha nyo bar/ la las gan rgya dngos 'jog pa dang la las gan rgya dngos mi 'jog na'ang / 'tshong mkhan phyogs kyis sprad pa'i 'dzin byang dang gsal bshad yi ge rtags byang sogs gan rgya'i nang don 'a brtsi ba red/ de ba'in du nga tsho 'ing pas zhing 'dus tshong ra'i nang 'bru rigs dang sngo tshal 'tshong bar yang bde 'ing mgyogs pa'i ngag thog gi gan rgya la ga bstar byed ba'in yod/ gan rgya'i bca' khrims kyi rmang ga'i'i shes bya khong du chud pa dang / gan rgya'i bca' khrim/sa kyi 'du shes chags pa/ gan rgya'i bca' khrims kyi gtan 'bebs ltar bya ba sgrub pa bcas ni/ nga tsho 'ing pa spun zlar mtshon nas bshad na ji 'dra'i gal chen 'ig red a nga / (bcu gcig)gan rgyar nang don gang dag 'dus dgos/14rdogan rgya'i skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan bcu gnyis pa'i nang /
