gan rgya'i nang don de do bdag gis kha dan byed dgos pa gtan la phab yod cing / spyir btang du gsham gyi don tshan 'ga' 'dus te/(1)do bdag gi ming dang rus ming dang sdod gnas bcas 'bri dgos/(2)dmigs tshad/ dmigs tshad zhes pa ni gan rgya'i do bdas gi khe dbang dang 'os 'gan thun mong gis bstan bya de zer zhing / dmigs tshad ni gan rgya'i nges par tshang dgos pa'i don tshan yin la/ dmigs tshad med na/gan rgya grub mi thub pa yin/ gan rgya'i dmigs tshad du rung ba ni dngos po yin chog la/ der dngos po'am yang na dngul lor 'dus pa dang / bya spyod kyis kyang rung la/ dper na ngal rtsol rigs shig 'don sprod byed pa lta bu/kā duhā shes rig hā grub 'bras yin kyang chog ste/ dper na lag rtsal brgyud sked shā lta snang nā ka/ grangs ka ni dmigs tshad kyi bye brag cig ste/ thad kur do bdag gi khe dbang dang 'os 'gan gyi che chung thag gcod pa yin/ grangs ga'i don tshan ni gan rgyar nges par mkho ba'i don tshan yin pa ma zad/ de ni ha cang gsal thag chod pa zhig yin dgos/ grangs kur nges par du khrims bkod rtsis 'jal tshad ga'i dang rtsis 'jal byed stangs bkol spyod byed dgos pa dang / gal la thug na spyod dung dngos ldo ga gi khyad par tsam yang gtan khel bya dgos/(4)spus ga dmigs tshad kyi nang gnas spus ka dang phyi gnas spus ka 'dus pa dang / spus kur tshad gzhi yod na der spyad pa'i tshad gzhi gsal 'god byed dgos pa ste/ dper na rgyal khab kyi tshad ga'i/ las sgug tshad gzhi/ sa gnas kyi tshad ga'i khe las kyi tshad gzhi sogs gsal 'god bya dgos/ tshad gzhi med na dngos dpe tham mnan nyar tshags byed pa tshad ga'ir brtsis chog pa dang / dus mtshungs su zhib bsher rtsis len byastu sna'i

dus yun gsal 'god bya dgos/(5)rin 'bab bam thob cha/ rin 'bab bam thob cha gsal 'god bya dgos pa ste/ bye brag gis kha dan byas chog la rigs bsgro gtan khel byas ༵༵ chog yin na'ang rin gong bca' khrims kyi gtan 'bebs dang 'gal —ga(6)lag bstar dus yun dang sa gnas/ byed stangs/ gan rgya lag bstar byed par dus thog lag bstar dang dus bcad lag bstar/ dus bgos lag bstar bcas su dbye chog lag bstar dus yun ni do bdag phyogs gcig gis 'os 'gan lag bstar byed pa dang / phyogs ga'an des dang len byed pa'i dus tshod kyi tshad bkag der zer ba dang / lag bstar dus yun de nges par gsal bo yin dgos pa dang / 66phyogs lhung dang6 brtson len sogs go don mi gsal ba spyad mi chog lag bstar sa gnas ni phyogs gcig gis 'os 'gan lag bstar byed pa dang / phyogs gzhan des dang len byed pa'i sa gnas der zer zhing / de ni dmigs tshad dngos po'i bdag dbang dang nyen kha spo bsgyur/ gron dngul gyi khur bo bcas dang rtsod gleng byung rjes kyi thad skyong khrims khang sogs la 'brel yod/ lag bstar byed stangs kyi nang don rgya che ste/ gtong sprod byed stangs dang skyel 'dren byed stangs/ thum shog rgyag stangs/ zhib bsher rtsis len byed stangs sogs yod/(7)khrims 'gal 'gan 'khri ste/ do bdag gis gan rgya lag bstar mi byed pa'i skabs su 'gan khur ba'i dmangs don 'gan 'khrir zer zhing /gtso bo gan 'gal ma dngul dang kun gsab ma dngul gtong sprod byed pa'i 'gan 'khri rigs gnyis 'dus/(8)rtsod gleng thag gcod thabs te/ gan rgya'i do bdag gis gan rgya'i rtsod1 nāng thag gcod stangs dang sa gnas la bstan pa yin/ thag gcod

stangs la gtso bo bar 'dum dang zhu gtug 'dus pa dang / sa gnas ni bar 'dum dang zhu gtug skor gyi thad skyong las khungs gnas sa yin/ gan rgya'i khrod rtsod gleng thag gcod pa'i don tshan la bca' khrims kyi byed nus pa'i sger tshugs rang ba'in ldan pas/ gan rgya rtsis med du btang ba dang yang na mtshams bzhag pa'am rtsis 'gro med par khyab bsgrags byas pa sogs las ci hāg spyanā kyang / rtsod gleng thag gcod pa'i don tshan de sngar bzhin rtsis 'gro da pa (3cu/ gnyis) 'gyur rten dang mngag rten gnyis la khyad par yod dam/ khyad par yod de/ bca' khrims steng 'gyur rten ni 'gan len rigs shig yin la/ de ni gan rgya'i do bdag gis gan rgya 'jog skabs sam yang na gan rgya lag bstar ma byed pa'i yar sngon du/ gan rgya lag bstar byed par srung skyong byed chen phyogs gcig gis phyogs gzhan par grangs 'bor nges can gyi ma dngul gtong sprod byas par zer/ 'gyur rten gyi nus pa gtso bo ni gan rgya lag bltar la srung skyong byed pa de yin/ nga tsho zhing pa spun zlas lobs phyogs su 'gyur rten dang 'gal tshe gan rgya bzhag zin pa bden dpang byas pa red zer ba yin/ mngag rten ni 'gyur rten dang yig 'bri gcig gis khyad par tsam las med mod/ 'on kyang nang don rtsa ba nas mi 'dra ste/ mngag rten ni gan rgya 'jog skabs sam yang na gan rgya 'grem spel ma byed pa'i yar sngon du do bdag phyogs gcig gis phyogs gzhan par grangs 'bor nges can gyi ma dngul gtong sprod byas par bstan pa yin pas/ mngag rten de don dngos su sngon btang ma dngul te/ sngon la gtong sprod byas pa'i ma dngul yin la/ de ma gzhi nas dngul bun gyi cha shas shig yin/ mngag rten la yang gan rgya bzhag pa bden dpang thub pa'i nus pa yod la/ zhing pa spun stu /sa

mnyam 'jog dgos pa zhig ni/ bca' khrims steng 'gyur rten dang mngag rten gyi khyad par ches gtso bo ni 'gyur rten de 'gyur rten gyi chad gcod la spyod pa yin/ 'gyur rten gyi chad gcod zhes pa ni'agan len skor gyi bca' khrimasanang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i'agyur rten gtong sprod byas pa'i phyogs kyis gan rgya lag bstar mi byed na/ 'gyur rten phyir sprod pa'i re ba zhu dbang med la/ 'gyur rten blangs pa'i phyogs kyis gan rgya lag bstar mi byed na/'gyur rten de'i lda ba gnyis kyi ma dngul phyir sprod dgos pade yin/ mngag rten la 'di ltar byed don med de/ de ni sngon btang ma dngul gyi rigs su gtogs pas/ gal te gan rgya lag bstar byed mi thub na/ phyogs gang zhig yin kyang mngag rten ji ba'in du phyir sprod dgos/(bcu gsum) 〈〈gan rgya'i bca' khrims〉〉nang gan rgya rtsis 'gro med par gtong ba'am yang na gan rgya bsgyur bcos dang rtsis med du gtong bar gtan 'bebasa' ltar byas yod/〈〈gan rgya'i skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉〈〈gan rgya'i skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉kyi don tshan nga gnyis pa'i nang gsham gyi gan rgya ni rtsis 'gro med par gtan la phab pa ste/ phyogs gcig gis mgo skor dang btsan thabs kyi byed thabs la brten nas gan rgya bzhag ste/ rgyal khab kyi khe phan la gnod 'tshe bzos pa/ngan jus lkog 'brel byas nas rgyal khab dang thun mong ngam yang na bar mi gsum pa'i khe phan la gnod 'tshe bzos pa/ khrims mthun rnam pas khrims 'gal gyi dmigs 'ben 'gobs srung byas pa/ spyi tshogs kyi spyi pa'i khe phan la gnod 'tshe bzos pa/ bca' khrims dang srid 'dzin khrims srol la sa 'gal nas btsan thabs rang ba'in gyis gtan 'bebs byas pa bcas so/ rtsis 'gro med pa'i gan rgya ni thog ma nyid nas rtsis 'gro med pa yin/ gan rgya la la/ /zlos bkod kyi nang don gtso bo yod pas/ do bdag gis nang don gtso

bo de gzhir bzung nas gan rgya de bsgyur bcos sam yang na rtsis med du gtong ba'i re 'dun zhus chog gsham gyi gan rgya ni bsgyur bcos sam yang na rtsis med du btang chog pa'i gan rgya yin te/ nor 'dzol chen po byung nas bzhag pa'i gan rgya dang / gan rgya 'jog skabs 'dra mnyam mi yong ba/ phyogs gcig gis mgo skor dang 'jigs skul gyi byed thabs la brten pa'am yang na gzhan mi nyen khar thug pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas/ pha rol pos rang nyid kyi 'dod blo dngos la rgyab 'gal byas pa'i gnas tshul 'og gan rgya 'jog du bcug tshe/ gnod thebs phyogs la mi dmangs khrims khang ngam yang na bar 'dum las khungs la bsgyur bcos sam yang na rtsis med du gtong ba'i re 'dun zhu dbang yod/ 'dir zhing pa spun zla tshor khyad du gsal 'debs byed rgyu zhig ni/ rtsis med du gtong ba'i dbang cha lag bstar byed yun ni lo1yin pas/ do bdag gis shes pa'am yang na rtsis med du gtong ba'i nang don nges par shes dgos pa'i nyin nas bzung ste lo1nang tshun du rtsis med du gtong ba'i dbang cha ma spyad na/ rtsis med du gtong dbang med par bzo ba yin/rtsis med du gtong ba'i rgyu rkyen yod na'ang / do bdag gis rtsis med du gtong ba'i yar zhu ma byas na/ gan rgya'i rtsis 'gro rang bzhin la shugs rkyen mi thebs pa yin/ gan rgya rtsis med du btang rjes/ gan rgya thog ma nyid nas rtsis 'gro med pa yin/ gan rgya de rtsis 'gro med par ngos bzung ba'am yang na rtsis med du btang rjes/ gan rgya de las blangs pa'i rgyu nor nges par du phyir slog dgos pa dang / phyir slog mi thub pa'am yang na slog dgos don med na/ rin gong bcags nas kha gsab bya dgos/ nor 'dzol yod pa'i phyogs kyis pha rol por bzos pa'i gyong gun tshab sprod bya dgos pa dang /phyogs gnyis gar nor 'dzol yod na/ rang so sos de 'brel gyi 'gan 'khri khur dgos/ do bdag gis ngan jus lkog 'brel byas te/ rgyal khab dastu stan

mong dang bar mi gsum pa bcas kyi khe phan la gnod 'tshe bzos tshe/ de las blangs pa'i rgyu nor de ni rgyal khab la dbang ba dang yang na thun mong dang bar mi gsum par phyir slog dgos/(bcu bzhi)zhing las 'gan len gan rgya bsgyur bcos dang mtshams 'jog pa'i thad gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/1999lo'i zla(pa'i tshes5nyin/ ches mtho'i mi dmangs khrims khang gis〈chang las 'gan len gan rgya'i rtsod gleng gyod gzhi thag gcod pa'i gnad don 'ga'i skor gyi gtan 'bebs(tshod spyod〉〉bkram ste/ zhing las 'gan len gan rgya bsgyur bcos dang mtshams 'jog pa'i thad gsham gyi gtan 'bebs 'ga' bton pa ste/(1)'gan len gan rgya'i khrod kha dan byas pa'i 'gan len ma dngul de bca' khrims dang khrims srol dang srid jus bcas kyi gtan 'bebs dang mthun na/ mi dmangs khrims khang gis srung skyong bya rgyu dang / do bdag phyogs gdīg /kā 'gan len gan rgya bsgyur bcos byed pa'i re 'dun zhus par rgya~X )/ gan /na/ gan rgya'i do bdag gis gan rgya'i khrod gan rgya bsgyur bcos byed pa'i don bya 'byung srid par kha dan byas yod na/ mi dmangs khrims khang gis zhing las 'gan len gan rgya'i rtsod gleng gyod gzhi thag gcod skabs/ kha dan de gzhir 'dzin rgyu/(3)gsham gyi gnas tshul las gcig yod de/ do bdag gis 'gan len gan rgya mtshams 'jog pa'i re ba bton na/ mi dmangs khrims khang gis rgyab skyor bya dgos/ gcig ni 'gan len gan rgya'i khrod kha dan byas pa'i gan rgya mtshams 'jog pa'am yang na med par bzo ba'i cha rkyen tshang ba/ gnyis ni 'di/ sbyan mkhan de 'gan len dus yun nang bde thang ma yong bar 'gan

len nus pa shor ba'am yang na tshe las 'das pa dang / rgyun 'dzin mkhan la'ang 'gan len nus pa med pa'am yang na rgyun 'dzin mi byed la/ brgyud sprod dang 'gan len gzhan sprod dang ma rkang du 'jog pa bcas kyang mi byed pa/gsum ni phyogs gcig gis 'gan len gan rgya'i nang kha dan byas pa'i 'os 'gan lag bstar ma byas par/ 'gan len gan rgya mu mthud du lag bstar byed thabs med pa/ bzhi ni rmo zhing gnyer skyong 'gan len byas pa'i 'gan len mkhan gyis rmo dor rgod bskyur byas pa/ lnga ni 'gan len phyogs kyis gtor brlag rang bzhin nam yang na 'phrog bcom rang bzhin gyis thon skyed gnyer skyong byed pa dang / 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis bkag sdom bslab bya btang yang ma phan pa/ drug ni 'gan len phyogs kyis gang 'dod sgos sa zhing gi spyod sgo bsgyur ba dang / 'gan gtsang sprod phyogs kyis bkag sdom bslab bya btang yang ma phan pa/(bco lnga) rang byung gnod 'che las gan rgya lag bstar byed mi thub na'ang gan 'gal 'gan 'khri khur dgos sam/rang byung gnod 'tshe byung nas gan rgya lag bstar byed mi thub na/khrims ltar 'gan 'khri'i cha shas sam yang na tshang ma med par btang chog〈gan rgya'i skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan brgya dang bcu bdun pa'i nang6 'gog thabs bral ba'i rkyen ngan las gan rgya lag bstar byed mi thub na/rkyen ngan thebs tshad ltar 'gan 'khri'i cha shas sam yang na tshang ma med par btang chog yin na'ang bca' khrims steng gtan 'bebs gzhan pa med pa phud de ltar byed dgos pa gtan la phab yod/ 'dir bshad pa'i 'gog thabs bral ba zhes pa ni sngon dpog mi thub pa dang g.yol thabs med pa ma zad/ khyad bsal byed mi thub pa'i dngos yod gnas tshul la bstan pa yin/rang byung gnod 'tshe ste/ dper na sa yom dang chu log gnam gshis stu/ pa

sogs la 'gog thabs bral ba'i rkyen ngan zhes brjod chog(bcu drug)sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gan rgya'i thad nas rtsod gleng byung che ji ltar bya dgos/nga tsho zhing pa spun zlas 'ing la sa dus skabs shor ba'i phan gnod shes pa red/ sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gan rgya'i thad nas rtsod gleng byung tshe/rgyun par thon skyed la gegs rkyen thebs pa red/ gnas tshul 'di 'drar 'phrad dus/ nga tsho 'ing pa spun zlas dus tshod dam 'dzin byas nas 'ang srid gzhung dang yang na rdzong rim pa yan gyi zhing las gtso skyong sde dag la 'dum sgrig byed pa'i re 'dun zhu dgos/ gal te 'dum sgrig byed mi 'dod pa'am yang na 'dum sgrig byed thabs bral tshe/ 'dum gcod byed pa'i re 'dun zhus chog 'dum gcod byas par mi 'thad na mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug byas chog pa dang / mi dmangs khrims khang gis bka' bcad btang ste sngon la thon skyed slar gso byed pa'i re 'dun zhus chog pa red/ gal te 'gan gtsang len phyogs kyis thon skyed slar gso byed par dngos gnas dka' khag ldan pa dang yang na thon skyed slar gso byed pa dang len mi byed na/ 'gan gtsang spro da phyogs kyis 'gan khur dang rtsa 'dzugs byas nas sngon la thon skyed slar gso bya dgos/ thon skyed slar gso byed pa'i 'gro gron nor 'dzol yod mkhan phyogs kyis 'gan khur dgos/rje(bcu r+shadun)thon skyed thon zas phyir 'tshong byed na bya spyod gang dag la 'a /sna /sa ༵/ spus kur lta skul do dam byed pa dang / thon rdzas kyi spus ga'i 'gan khur thag gcod gsal po byed pa/ 'dzad spyod pa'i khrims mthun khe dbang srung skyong byed pa bcas kyi ched du/ rgyal khab kyi〈〈bon rdzas kyi spus gzhi ༵༵'a khrims〉〉de1993lo'i zla)ba'i tshes1nyin lag bstar byas pa dang /

2000lo'i zla7pa'i tshes8nyin dag bcos byas/ 〈〈thon rdzas kyi spus ku'i bca' khrims〉〉kyi gtan 'bebs ltar na/ thon skyed thon rdzas phyir 'tshong byed na gsham gyi bya spyod 'ga' la 'dzems dgos te/(1)rdzun ma bzo ba dang dpang dngos bden pa yin pa ra 'phrod pa'i ma tshon rtags sogs mtshon rtags lkog spyod byed pa/(2)thon rdzas kyi sa gnas rdzun bzo byed pa dang / bzo grwa'i ming rdzun zlozordod pa'am yang na ga'an gyi bzo grwa'i ming dang bzo grwa'i sa gnas lkog da ༵ )tho/ na skyed dang phyir 'tshong byed pa'i thon rdzas khrod rnam pa sna tshogs 'jog pa dang rdzun ma bzhag nas/ ngo mar brdzu ba dang kha bkang thabs byed pa/ (4)rgyal khab kyis bka' rgya btang nas dor zin pa'i thon rdzas thon skyed byas mi chogami(shā)phan nus shor ba dang spus ka 'gyur zin pa'i thon rdzas phyir 'tshong byas (3tso brgyad)rdzun rdzus zhan gsum gyi thon rdzas skyel 'dren dang bdag 'dzin do dam byed pa de yang khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod yin nam/〈thon rdzas kyi spus ku'i bca' khrims〉kyi gtan 'bebs ltar na/〈thon rdzas kyi spus ma'i bca' khrims〉nang thon skyed dang phyir 'tshong byas mi chog par gtan 'bebs byas yod pa shes bzhin dang nges par shes dgos pa'i thon rdzas skyel 'dren byed pa dang / bdag 'dzin do dam byed pa/ nyar 'jog byed pa sogs la stabs bde dang cha rkyen bskrun pa dang / yang na rdzun ma ngo mar brdzus pa'i thon rdzas la rdzun bzo'i thon skyed lag rtsal 'don sprod byas na/ de'i srid 'dzin 'gan khur ni khrims 'gal yong sgo gzhung 1)/sa

byed pa ma zad chad pa gcod pa red/ nag nyes su grub tshe nyes 'gan bda' 'ded byed pa yin/(bcu dag)nga tsho zhing pa spun zlas sa zhing bed spyod bdag dbang de ma rtsar btang chog gam/de ni chog ste/ 〈mnyam 'brel khe las bca' khrims〉nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ mnyam 'brel pas dngul lor dang dngos po/ sa 'ing bed spyod bdag dbang / shes bya'i thon dbang ngam yang na ga'an pa'i rgyu nor gyi khe dbang ma rtsar btang chog la/ gong bstan ma rtsa ni mnyam 'brel pa'i khrims mthun rgyu nor dang rgyu nor khe dbang yin/(nyi shu)ci zhig la btsan thabs rang bzhin gyis thon rdzas dpang dngos ra spyod pa'i lam lugs zer/btsan thabs rang bzhin gyis thon rdzas dpang dngos ra sprod pa'i lam lugs(bsdus ming36)ni rang rgyal gyis rgyal spyi'i kun 'phrod sgrig srol ltar btsugs pa'i tshong rar zhugs chog pa'i lam lugs gsar pa 'ig yin la /rang rgyalagag10nang zhugs skabs blangs pa'i khas len gal chen zhig kyang yin/ rgyal khab dpang dngos ra sprod lta skul u yon lhan khang gis gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ 2003lo'i zla8pa'i tshes1nyin gyi rjes su/ 3bukyi dpang dngos ra sprod ma brgyud pa'i〈dkar chag〉nang gi thon rdzas de phyir 'tshong ba dang / phyir 'tshong nang 'dren byed pa/ bdag gnyer rang bzhin gyi bya 'gul khrod bed spyod bcas byas mi chog 3(kyi dpang dngos ra sprod mtshon rtags mi sbyar ba'i 'brel yod thon rdzas dang yang na3(kyi dpang dngos ra sprod mtshon rtags rdzun ma sbyar ba'i khrims 'gal bya spyod la rdung deg nan mo gtong rgyu/ khe las gnyer ba'i zhing pa spun zla rnams kyis rang rang gis gnyer brdi/ sna'i khe las chung 'bring che gsum gang yin yang nges par du mgyogs

myur ngang dpang dngos ra sprod yar zhu byas te/ rang rang gi thon rdzas la3budapang dngos ra sprod kyi mtshon rtags sbyar dgos/(nyer gcig) bya spyod gang dag ni rin gong sger sdom gyi bya spyod la gtogs pa yin nam/2003lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 1nyin nas bzung lag bstar byas shing /rgyal khab gong spel dang bcos bsgyur u yon lhan khang gis khyab bsgrags byas pa'i〈rin gong sger sdom gyi bya spyod gtan 'gog byed pa'i skabs spyod gtan 'bebs〉nang / gsham gyi bya spyod dag ni rin gong sger sdem byas pa'i bya spyod nang bstu/ ṅgi lhar/ skyong mkhan bar gros mol byed pa dang gros thag gcod pa'am snang na mthun sbyor sogs lkog 'brel rang ba'in gyis rin gong gi kha lo bsgyur (2/lha/nyer skyong mkhan gyis tshong ra'i nang kha lo bsgyur ba'i go gnas su yod pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas/ gnyer tshong khang la tshong zong 'don sprod byed skabs btsan thabs rang bzhin gyis de'i brgyud 'tshong rin gong gtan khel byas rigs/(3)gnyer skyong mkhan gyis tshong khrom nang kha lo bsgyur ba'i go gnas su yod pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas/ tshul min gyi khe chen thob rigs/(4)gnyer skyong mkhan gyis tshong ra'i nang kha lo bsgyur ba'i go gnas su yod pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas/ 'gran rtsod bya yul phyin phud pa dang der gnod 'tshe gtong ba dmigs 'ben byas te/ rin gong dma' ba'i 'grub yon gyi rin gong ltar 'tshong ba dang / yang na bar khe dang kha gsab dang legs skyes sogs byed thabs spyad de ngo bo 'gyur ba'i sgos rin gong je dmar btang ste/ tshong zong tshong ra'i phyir 'tshong rin gong de tshong zong rang sbyotā gi

'grub yon las dam 'a bar byas rigs/(5)gnyer skyong mkhan gyis tshong ra'i nang kha lo bsgyur ba'i go gnas su yod pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas/ tshong zong ngam zhabs zhu gcig mtshungs 'don sprod byed skabs/ cha rkyen 'dra mtshungs 'og gi brje spel bya yul la brje spel rin gong thad nas bar khyad yod pa'i thob cha lag bstar byas rigs/(nyer gnyis)rang rgyal zhing sde yid rton dngul bun gyi zhing dud kyi dngul grangs nyung ba'i dngul bun la 'brel yod kyi bca' khrims dang srid jus gang dag yod/zhing sde yid rton dngul bun zhes pa ni zhing sde'i dngul rtsa'i las khungs te/ zhing las dngul khang dang zhing las 'phel rgyas dngul khang / zhing sde yid rton khang bcas kyis ma dngul gsog pa dang dngul bun ster ba/ spyi sdom byed pa sogs las sgo'i bya 'gul spel ba'i spyi ming la zer/ zhing sde yid rton dngul bun dang 'brel yod kyi ga'i rtsa'i bca' khrims la gtso bor〈mi dmangs dngul khang gi bca' khrims〉dang〈tshong las dngul khang gi bca' khrims〉dang〈gan rgya'i bca' khrims〉〈'gan len bca' khrims〉〈dngul 'dzin bca' khrim sa〉sogs yod/ 'ing dud kyi dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun zhes pa ni zhing dud kyi spyi dmangs ni dngul bun sprod yul yin pa dang / zhing dud kyi mtshan snyan la ga'igs te/ dpyad bsdur gtan 'bebs byas pa'i grangs tshad dang dus yun nang zhing dud la dngul bun gtong sprod byed par gta' ma dang 'gan len ci yang mi dgos pa yin/ zhing dud kyi dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun dang 'brel ba yod pa'i khrims srol dang srid jus gtso bo ni/ 〈zhing sde yid rton khang gi zhing dud kyi dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun do dam byed pa'i skor gyi skabs spyod byed thabasanyidang〈zhi~X ༵ yid rton khang gi zhing dud kyi gcig khag gcig khur sgos dngul bun

len pa 'i do dam skor gyi skabs spyod byed thabs〉2001lo'i zla12par krung go mi dmangs dngul khang gis khyab bsgrags byas pa'i〈zhing sde yid rton khang gi cing dud kyi dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun do dam skor gyi mdzub ston bsam 'char〉sogs yin/ (zhing sde yid rton dngul bun dang lhag par du 'ing dud kyinyidangul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun las zhing sde'i dngul rtsa 'khrug por bzo ba dang zhing sde'i dpal 'byor gong du spel ba/ nga tsho 'ing pa spun zlas thon skyed gnyer skyong byed par rogs ram dang stabs bde bzo ba bcas phyogs gang thad la nus pa gal chen thon yod/(nyer gsum)zhing dud kyi dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun la gzhi rtsa'i srid jus gang dag yod/krung go mi dam ngas dngul khang gis bkram pa'i 'brel yod yig char gzhigs na/ zhing dud kyi dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun la gzhi rtsa'i srid jus 'di dag yod de/(1)'ang dang grong rnal yid rton khang gis 'ing dud sde tshan byas pa dang /zhing dud kyi yid rton dngul bun yig tshags bzos te/ zhing dud khyim tshang gi dpal 'byor gnas tshul dang dpal 'byor bya 'gul gnyer tshul sogs nang don zin bris su 'god dgos/(2)zhing sde yid rton khang du zhing dud yid rton gyi dpyad bsdur gtan 'bebs tsho chung btsugs nas/ zhing dud kyi yid rton tshad sogs rim pa bgos nas dpyad bsdur gtan 'bebs bya dgos/ tsho chung gi khongs mir yid rton khang gi mi sna dang zhing dud kyi 'thus mi gtso byas pa'i ma tshungs su/sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci dang sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gi khongs mi'ang nang du zhugs su 'jug dgos/ dpyad bsdur gtan 'bebs tsho chung gis zhing dud sger gyi mi gshis dang dngul bun phyir slog pa'i zin tho/ thostu lhad

gnyer skyong bya 'gul gyi nang don gtso bo/ gnyer skyong nus pa/ dngul bun phyir slog pa'i nus pa sogs tshad gzhir dmigs nas/ de'i yid ston tshad la dpyad bsdur gtan 'bebs bya dgos pa dang / spyir btang du phul byung dang cung bzang / chog pa bcas rim pa3du bgos te/ yid rton rim pa mi 'dra ba ltar zhing dud la yid rton gnang tshad kyang mi 'dra ba gnang dgos/(3)yid rton rim pa dpyad bsdur gtan 'bebs byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng / 'ing sde yid rton khang gis zhing dud kyi yid rton rim pa ltar/ zhing dud la dngul bun dpang yig sprod dgos/ dngul bun dpang yig blang rjes/dpang yig yod pa'i zhing dud kyis dngul grangs nyung ba'i dngul bun mkho skabs/ dngul bun dpang yig dang rtsis 'gro yod pa'i thob thang dpang yig la brten nas/ thad kur yid rton khang gi las gnyer dra tshigs steng bcad grangs nang tshun gyi dngul bun 'gro lugs sgrub chog pas/ rim pa re re nas chog mchan 'god pa'i 'gro lugs 'grims mi dgos/ zhing dud kyi dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun la thengs gcig la zhib bsher gtan 'bebs byed pa dang / nam bkol nam len byed pa/ lhag dngul tshod 'dzin dang 'khor skyod byed par spyod pa bcas kyi byed thabs spyad pas/ dngul bun dpang yig steng zhib bsher gtan 'bebs byas pa'i dngul bun gyi bcad grangs las ma brgal na/ zhing dud kyis dngul bun dgos tshe dus nam zhig la'ang yid rton khang du song nas dngul bun len pa'i 'gro lugs sgrub chog pa ma zad/ dngul bun phyir sprad rjes spyod dung mu mthud du dngul bun blangs te/ 'khor skyod byed par bkol spyod byas chog(nyer bzhi)zhing dud kyi dngul grangs gung ba'i yid rton dngul bun gyi re 'dun zhu na cha rkyen gang dag tshang dgos/15/nga dud kyi dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun gyi re 'dun zhu

ba'i zhing pa zhes pa ni zhing las dud tho yod pa dang / gtso bor zhing sde'i sa zhing rmo 'debs sam yang na zhing sde'i dpal 'byor yong sgo gzhan rigs dang 'brel ba'i thon skyed gnyer skyong gi bya 'gul spel ba'i zhing pa dang mi sger gyi gnyer skyong dud khyim sogs la bstan pa yin/ re 'dun zhu mkhan la gsham gyi cha rkyen tshang dgos te/ gcig ni yid rton khang gi las gnyer mnga' khongs su sdod pa/ gnyis ni dmangs don gyi bya spyod spel nus yod pa dang / yid rton tshad cung bzang ba/ gsum ni sa zhing rmo 'debs sam yang na rgyal khab kyi thon las srid jus gzhan pa dang mthun pa'i thon skyed gnyer skyong gi bya 'gul spel ba ma zad/ bde 'jags dang blo gtad chog pa'i dpal 'byor yong khungs shād pa/ bzhi ni dngul bun gyi ma skyed gtsang sprod byed nus yod pa bcas (nye/ rasnga)zhing dud kyi dngul grangs nyung ba'i dngul bun gyi dus yun dang grangs tshad thad bye brag gi gtan 'bebs yod dam/yod de/ 2001lor bkram pa'i〈zhing sde yid rton khang gi zhing dud kyi dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun do dam skor gyi mdzub ston bsam 'char〉dang2002lor bkram pa'i〈krung go mi dmangs dngul khang gi zhing dud kyi dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun gtong sprod dang zhing par phan pa'i zhabs zhu bya ba sngar bas legs par sgrub pa'i skor gyi brda tho〉nang / zhing sde yid rton khang gis dngul bun len pa'i re 'dun gyi 'dod mos ltar/ ma dngul gyi spyod sgo mi 'dra ba dang zung du sbrel te dngul bun gyi dus yun gtan khel bya dgos/ 'ing dud kyi spyir btang gi thon skyed gron dngul de dngul bun gyi rtsa don steng nas lo1las mi brgal ba dang / thon skyed dus yun cung ring ba'i dngul bun gzhan par thon skyed gnyer skyong bya 'gul gyi don dngos kyi dus yun ltar gtan khel bya dgos mod/ 'on kyang ches ring na'ang //chos

brgal mi chog 'ing sde yid rton khang gis zhing dud la dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun gtong sprod byed pa'i grangs tshad de yul bab dang bstun pa dang mi'i yong 'bab dang bstun pa'i rtsa don ltar dang / sa gnas so so'i 'ing sde'i dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang zhing pa'i yong sgo'i chu tshad la gzhigs nas gtan khel bya dgos/ bye brag gi gtong sprod thad nas/ dar rgyas che ba'i sa khul la sgor8000nas sgor10000bar dang / sa khul kha shas la sgor khri20000nas sgor 050000bar yin/ dar rgyas mi che ba'i sa khul la sgor3000nas sgor5000bar dang / sa khul kha shas la sgor 1000nas sgor2000bar yin/ 'ing sde yid rton khang gis ma dngul gyi bcad grangs gtan khel byas rjes/ krung go mi dmangs dngul khang rdzong(grong khyer)lag dngul khang la 'ib bsher chog mchan 'god du 'jug dgos/(nyer drug)zhing pa'i dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun gyi skyed ga'i tshad dang sgom rtsis thad gtan 'bebs dzi ltar byas yod/cing pa'i dngul grangs zhung ba'i yid rton dngul bun gyi skyed ga'i tshad de krung go mi dmangs dngul khang gis bsgrags pa'i gzhi rtsa'i tshad gzhi'i skyed kwa'i tshad ltar yin/ de ma zad bab mthun gyi nges med khyab khongs nang dmigs bsal du sprod kyi yod/ krung go mi dmangs dngul khang gi 'brel yod gtan 'bebs ltar na/ zhing sde yid rton dngul khang gi skyed ku'i tshad de rgyal khab kyi gzhi rtsa'i tshad gzhi'i skyed ga'i tshad kyi rmang gzhi'i steng505'phar ba dang / sa gnas so so'i zhing sde yid rton khang gis spyir btang du gzhi rtsa'i tshad gzhi'i skyed ku'i stong20yanas50lko'aphar ba de dngul bun lag bstar byed pa'i skyed ku'i tshad du brtsi ba yin/ 'on kyang / zhing pa'i dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun gyi skyed ga'i tshad de/ krung go mi dmangs dngul khadi spyazlo blang bya ltar na/ spyir btang du yar mi 'phar ba dang 'phar yang

nyung tsam las mi 'phar ba yin/ der grong gseb yid rton dngul khang mang shas kyis sngon la yar 'phar ba dang / de nas mar 'bab pa'i rnam pa ltar 'ing pa'i dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun gyi skyed ga'i tshad gtan 'bebs byas pa red/ dper na/ rgyal khab kyi gzhi rtsa'i tshad gci'i skyed ga'i tshad kyi chu tshad stong205'phar ba de spyir btang gi dngul bun lag bstar byed pa'i skyed ga'i tshad du brtsi ba yin la/ lag bsta ra byed pa'i skyed ga'i tshad kyi rmang gzhi'i steng50yanas20yabar mar babs pa de jing pa'i dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun gyi skyed ma'i tshad(grangs ka 'di dag dper brjod 'jog pa las don dngos skyed la'i tshad kyi chu tshad de zhing sde yid rton khang gi ma rtsa'i gnas tshul ltar gtan 'bebs byed pa red)du 'jog pa red/ gnas tshul 'di 'dra'i 'og tu/ zhing pa'i dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun gyi skyed ma'i tshad de zhing sde yid rton khang nas thob pa'i gzhan pa'i rigs kyi dngul bun las dma' ba red/ 'on kyang dngul grangs nyung ba'i yid rton dngul bun gyi sdom rtsis rgyag stangs de gzhan pa'i dngul bun dang cha 'dra ba red/(nyer bdun) dmangs khrod nas dngul bun gtong len byed par bca' khrims kyis srung skyong byed dam/zhing sde'i dpal 'byor gong du 'phel ba dang bstun nas/ nga tsho zhing pa spun zla'i bar phan tshun la dngul bun gtong len byed pa de nyin re bzhin je mang du 'gro bzhin 'dug dmangs khrod nas dngul bun gtong len byed pa der bca' khrims kyis srung skyong byed dam zer na/ rang rgyal gyi〈dmangs khrims spyi srol〉gyi don tshan dgu bcu par gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/66khrims mthun sgos dngul bun gtong len byed par bca' khrims kyis srung skyong byas pa red/ mi dmangs khrod du dngul bun len byed pa'i skyed ku'i stu| de

spyir btang du phyogs gnyis kyis gan rgya 'jog dus gtan khel byed dgos/gal te rtsod gleng byung rjes/ gtan 'bebs dang gtan khel byas pa ltar thag gcod dgos/ thag gcod pa'i rtsa don te/ gcig ni gal te dngul bdag gis sngon la skyed ka ma rtsa'i nang bzhag ste skyed ka nyis brtsegs len pa yin na/skyed ka nyis brtsegs len pa der srung skyong mi byed/ blangs zin pa'i skyed ka nyis brtsegs de dngul 'jal mkhan la phyir slog dgos/ gnyis ni dngul bun gtong len byed skabs skyed ka 'then nas ma rtsa'i nang bzhag tshe/ bskyis dngul gyi grangs ka dngos ltar sdom rtsis rgyag pa ste/ dngos su bskyis pa'i dngul grangs de ma rtsar brtsis nas skyed ka sprod dgos pa red/ gsum ni dngul bdag gis dngul bskyis mkhan gyis khrims 'gal gyis bya 'gul(dper na sho rgyag pa)spel ched du dngul skyi ba shes bzhin du dngul bskyis pa yin na/ dngul bskyi ba dang dngul bun len pa'i 'brel bar srung skyong mi byed/bzhi ni dngul bun gtong len mkhan phyogs gnyis la skyed ka gtan khel byas pa'i thad nas rtsod gleng byung yang bden dpang med na/ dngul khang gis rigs mtshungs dngul bun gyi skyed ku'i tshad ltar rtsis rgyag dgos/ lnga ni gal te dngul bdag gis dngul bun bskyis nas skyed ka mthon po len pa yin na/bca' khrims kyis srung skyong mi byed/(nyer brgyad)skyed ka mtho ba'i dngul bun ji ltar thag gtsod dgos/skyed ka mtho ba'i dngul bun ni rgyun ldan gyi skyed ku'i tshad kyi dngul bskyis pa dang dngul bun len pa'i rigs shig yin/ nga tsho spyi tshogs rnying ba brgyud nas yong ba'i zhing pa spun zla'i khrod de'i gnod pa tshabs chen thebs myong mkhan yod pa red/ ches mtho'i mi dmangs khrims khang gi〈mi dmangs khrims khang gi dngul bskyis pa dang dngul bun gyi gyod gzhi thag gcod pa'i sko/ nā bsam 'char 'ga'〉yi don tshan drug par gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar

na/ dmangs khrod kyi dngul bskyis pa dang dngul bun len pa'i skyed ka de dngul khang gi skyed ka las cung zad mtho na chog sa gnas so so'i mi dmangs khrimasakhang gis rang sa gnas kyi don dngos gnas tshul ltar bye brag gi tshod 'dzin byas chog mod/ 'on kyang ches mtho na yang dngul khang gi rigs mtshungs dngul bun gyi skyed ku'i ldab4yi yan du brgal mi chog(skyed ka rang gi tshad 'dus)tshad ga'i de las 'da' tshe brgal ba'i skyed ku'i skor der srung skyong mi byed/ gtan 'bebs 'di gzhir bzung nas bshad na/ rigs ma tshungs dngul bun las ldab4yi yan la brgal ba de ni skyed ka mtho ba'i dngul bun yin/ skyed ka mtho ba'i dngul bun yin par thag bcad pa de〈dmangs khrims spyi srol〉gyi 'brel yod gtan 'bebs ltar/ mi dmangs khrims khang gis ma rtsa dang skyed ka rtsis len byas chog(nyer dgu) skyed ka ma rtsa'i nang bzhag ste yang bskyar skyed ka len pa der bca' khrims kyis srung skyong byed dam/de la bca' khrims kyis srung skyong byed pa min/ de yang skyed ka mtho ba'i dngul bun gyi rigs shig ste/ rang rgyal gyis nam yang skyed ka mtho ba'i dngul bun dang skyed ka ma rtsa'i nang bzhag ste yang bskyar skyed ka len pa 'gog pa'i srid jus rgyun 'khyongs byed bzhin yod/ ches mtho'i mi dmangs khrims khang gi〈〈krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi dmangs khrims spyi srol〉lag len mthar phyin byed pa'i skor gyi gnad don 'ga'i bsam 'char〉gyi don tshan brgya dang nyer lnga'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ tsa spyi dmangs bar dngul skyi ba dang dngul bun len dus/ dngul bdag gis skyed ka ma rtsa'i nang bzhag ste skyed ka nyis brtsegs len pa yin na/ srung skyong byed pa min/’ 161

le'u lnga pa/ grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba dang khe dbang srung skyong skor/(gcig)nga cho zhing pa grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba'i khe dbang srung skyong thad gzhi 'dzin sa'i khrims yod dam/mig sngar/ rang re'i rgyal khab la gnas skabs su ched du zhing pa las mi'i khrims mthun khe dbang srung skyong byed pa'i skor gyi bca' khrims shig med/yin na'ang / rang re'i zhing pa grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba'i khe dbang srung skyong thad brtsi srung byed sa'i khrims yod de/ 'di nas grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba'i zhing pa spun zla tshor gcig can gnyis mtshams sbyor bya rgyu ste/(1)bca' khrims gcig ste/ 〈ngal rtsol bca' khrims〉 〈ngal rtsol bca' khrims〉ni1995lo'i zla1pa'i tshes1nyin nas bzung lag bstar byas pa zhig yin/ 1995lo'i zla8pa'i tshes/nyin rgyal khab ngal rtsol pu'u yi〈ngal rtsol bca' khrims〉lag len mthar phyin byed pa'i gnad don 'ga'i skor gyi bsam 'char te ngal rtsol pu'u yis spel ba'i1995lo'i yig cha ang309yi nang gsal bor bstan don/ grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba(bu rdzi yud)dang tshong gnyer ba'i zhing pas〈ngal rtsol bca' khrims〉spyad 'thus/ 〈ngal rtsol bca' khrims〉kyi dmigs yul ni ngal rtsol pa'i lugs mthun khe dbang srung skyong bya rgyu de yin/ 〈ngal rtsol bca' khrims〉nang ngal rtsol pas las rigs gdam pa dang ngal rtsol gla cha len pa/ ngal gso gung gseng / ngal rtsol bde 'diX dang 'phrod bsten srung skyong thob pa/ las rigs rtsal nus gso sbyong

dang du len pa/ spyi tshogs 'gan bcol dang phan bde'i lta skyong longs su spyod pa/ ngal rtsol rtsod gleng thag gcod byed pa'i re zhu byed pa sogs phyogs kyi khe dbang dang de 'brel gyi 'os 'gan sgo kun nas gtan la phab yod pa dang /ngal rtsol pa ste/ rang re'i grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba dang tshong gnyer ba'i 'ing pa spun zla 'dus pa'i zhing pas rang steng gi lugs mthun khe dbang srung skyong dang / mi bkol las khungs kyis 'ing pa las mi bkol ba'i spyod tshul tshad ldan du gtong bar bca' khrims kyi ga'i 'dzin sa 'don sprod byas yod/(2) mgo byang dmar po'i yig cha migal chen 'ig ste/ 2003lo'i zla1pa'i tshes5nyin rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gzhung las thing gyi〈zhing pa grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba'i las zhugs do dam dang zhabs zhu bya ba legs par sgrub pa'i skor gyi brda tho〉ste/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gzhung las thing gyis spel ba'i2003lo'i yig cha ang1pa'i nang bstan don/ tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis zhing pa grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba'i las zhugs gnad don la gtsigs mthong chen po bya rgyu dang / sa gnas so sos zhing pa grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba'i las zhugs do dam dang 'bas zhu bya ba legs par sgrub pa'i thad sngar bas ngos 'dzin zab mo byas te/ 'dra mnyam gyi lta sta ngas 'dzin pa dang / lugs mthun ngang sne khrid pa/ do dam 'thus tshang du gtong ba/'bas zhu legs par sgrub pa bcas kyi rtsa don ltar/ byed thabs nus ldan spyad de/ zhing pa grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba'i las zhugs do dam dang zhabs zhu bya ba khyon yongs nas legs par bsgrub pa'i blang bya bton yod/ gong gi6 gcig can gnyis ni mig sngar rang re'i zhing pa grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba'i las zhugs thad kyi srung 'khor yin/ da dung bca' khrims dang khrims srol gzhan pa 'ga' re yang yod/ rang re'i zhing pa spun zla tshos re ltos byed pa'i grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba'i zhing pa'i lugs mthun khe dbang sustu sbyang

byed pa'i skor gyi bca' khrims yang spyi tshogs yongs kyi thugs khur 'og nam zhig mngon tu 'gyur thub pa'i yid ches yod/(gnyis)rang de'i zhing pas sger gnyer khe las nas gla rgyug skabasazhungal rtsol bca' khrims〉spyad 'thus sam/spyad 'thus te/ 〈ngal rtsol bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan gnyis pa'i nang /krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab mnga' khongs kyi khe las dang sger gnyer dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs(gsham nas mi bkol las khungs zhes 'bod rgyu)dang ngal rtsol 'brel ba chags pa'i ngal rtsol pa zhig yin tshe/ ngal rtsol bca' khrims spyad 'thus pa gtan la phab yod/ spyir btang du mi bdun yan glas yod pa'i sger gnyer bzo tshong dud khyim ni sger gnyer dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs yin/(gsum)skabs 'phral las bzo pas dngos gzhi'i las bzo pa dang 'dra mchungs kyi thob cha longs su spyad chog gam/〈〈ngal rtsol bca' khrims〉〉kyi don tshan gnyis pa'i nang ngal rtsol pa zhes pa'i khyab khongs ni ha cang rgya che ba zhig ste/ dngos gzhi pa'i las bzo par go la/ skabs 'phral las bzo par yang go de bas/ dngos gzhi'i las bzo pa yin na'ang 'dra/ skabs 'phral las bzo pa yin na'ang 'dra/ mi bkol las khungs dang ngal rtsol 'brel ba chags tshe/ 'brel ba 'di nyin gcig gi dus tshod la chags pa yin na'ang / dngos gzhi'i las bzo pas spyod pa'i khe dbang de skabs 'phral las bzo par yang spyod dbang yod/ grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba'i zhing pa spun zla tshos rang nyid dang dngos gzhi'i las bzo pa'i bar khyad par yod nges snyam te/ 〈ngal rtsol bca' khrims〉nang bstan pa'i khe dbang de khrims ltar brtson len byed mi dgos/164

(bzhi)rgyal khab kyis zhing pa grong khyer ru gla rgyag tra 'gro ba'i tshul min tshad bkag gang dag med par bzo ba'i blang bya bton yod/rgyal khab kyis sa khul so so dang 'brel yod sde khag so sos khe las la zhing pa las mi bkol bar srid 'dzin zhib mchan 'god pa med par bzo rgyu dang / zhing pa grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba'i las zhugs pa'i las rigs dang las sna tshod 'dzin byed pa med par bzo rgyu/ khe las kyis rang bdag lugs mthun sgos zhing pa las mi bkol bar the gtogs byas mi chog pa bcas kyi blang bya bton yod/ zhing pa grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba'i las zhugs 'gro lugs la zhib bsher nan mo dang gtsang bsher byas te/ ched du zhing pa las mir btsugs pa'i tho 'god rnam grangs med par bzo ba dang / rim bzhin gnas skabs sdod pa'i dpang yig gcig pu'i do dam lag bstar bya rgyu/las rigs dang las sna so so dang lhag par du khyad par can gyi las rigs dang las snas re ba bton pa'i lag rtsal thob thang dang bde thang sogs cha rkyen gyi thad nas zhing par 'dra mnyam gyi lta stangs 'dzin dgos/ zhing pa grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu 'gro ba'i las zhugs dang khe las kyis mi bkol ba'i 'gro lugs sgrub skabs/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang 'brel yod sde khag gis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i dpang yig gi ma gnas dngul sdud len byas pa phud/ gron dngul gzhan pa bsdu mi chog dbang cha las brgal te zhing pa las mir srid 'dzin bya gzhag rang bzhin gyi gron sdud rnam grangs 'dzugs pa dang gron sdud tshad gzhi je mthor gtong ba gtan 'gog bya rgyu/ rim pa so so'i dngos gong dang nor don sde khag gis zhib bsher nan mo dang dngos 'bebs mtha' 'khyol byas te/byed thabs bsgyur nas zhing pa las mir gron dngul gang byung du bsdu ba gtan 'gog bya dgos/165

(lnga) rgyal khab kyis zhing pa las mi'i gla phogs chad 'grungs dang 'phri gtsog byed pa'i gnad don thag gtsod par srid jus ci zhig bton yod/rgyal khab kyis mi bkol las khungs kyis nges par du khrims ltar zhing pa las mi dang ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog dgos pa dang / de'i khrod 'brel yod ngal rtsol thob cha'i don tshan nang gla phogs sprod ba'i tshad gzhi dang rnam grangs/gla phogs sprod stangs dang dus tshod sogs nang don nges par gsal bo 'god dgos pa/ mi bkol las khungs kyis nges par du khrims bkod dngul lor rnam pas zhing pa las mir gla phogs sprod ba las/ ming thog gang rung zhig nas gla phogs sprod 'gyangs dang 'phri gcog byas mi chog pa bcas gtan la phab yod pa dang / ngal rtsol 'gan srung sde khag gis mi bkol las khungs kyis gla phogs sprod ba'i gnas tshul dang lta skul zhib bsher bya bar shugs snon pa dang / zhing pa las mi'i gla phogs sprod ba'i lta skul tshod 'dzin lam lugs 'dzugs dgos/ ling pa las mi'i gla phogs bcags pa dang chad 'gyangs byas pa'i mi bkol las khungs la dus thog tu gsab sprod byed pa'i bka' rgya phab pa dang / dus thog tu gsab sprod byed mi thub na/ chad 'gyangs kha gsab byed pa'i 'char gzhi bzos te/ dus ltar gsab sprod bya dgos/bsam gzas nas gla phogs chad 'gyangs dang 'phri gcog byas pa'i khe las de dogs yod nyes can zhig yin tshe/ khrims 'dzin las khungs la sprad de khrims ltar thag gcod nan mo bya dgos/ khe las kyis khrims ltar ma rtsa rdib pa dang khral don gtsang sprod byed skabs/ khe las kyi ma rtsa rdib pa'i skor gyi bca' khrimasakyi gtan 'bebs ltar/ zhing pa las mi'i gla phogs chad 'gyangs byed pa de gtsang sprod kyi go rim yang dang po nang 'jog dgos/ ngal rtsol gan rgya lag len byed pa'i dus skabs nang / zhing pa las mis〈ngal rtsol bca' khri/shāspyanang gtan la phab pa'i khe dbang sna tshogs longs su spyod thub/ ngal

rtsol gan rgya med par bzos rjes/ mi bkol las khungs kyis nges par du khrims ltar dpal 'byor skyin gsab ma dngul ster dgos/ 'dzugs skrun a/ra las khe las kyis cing pa las mi'i gla phogs chad 'gyangs dang 'phri gcog byed pa'i khrims 'gal bya spyod rtsad zhib bya ba gtso gnad du bzhag nas legs par sgrub pa dang / bsam gzas nas zhing pa las mi'i gla phogs bcags pa dang chad 'gyangs byas pa'i khrims 'gal bya spyod la rdung deg nan mo bya dgos/'dzugs skrun sde tshan gyis ar las khe las la bzo skrun ma dngul chad 'gyangs byas te/ ar las khe las kyis zhing pa las mi'i gla phogs dus ltar gtong sprod byed mi thub na/ 'dzugs skrun sde tshan gyi 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded bya dgos pa dang / ar las sde tshan gyis zhing pa las mi'i gla phogs chad 'gyangs byas yod na/ ar las sde tshan gyi 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded bya dgos pa bcas kyi srid jus gtan la phab yod/(drug)ngal rtsol bca' khrims khrod kyi gla phogs 'phri gcog dang6 rkyen med chad 'gyangs zhes pa'i go don ci yin/〈〈ngal rtsol bca' khrim sa〉〉kyi don tshan go gcig pa'i gtan 'bebs ltar na/ gla phogs 'phri gcog mizhes pa ni mi bkol las khungs kyis tshul ma thun gyi rgyu rkyen ci yang med par ngal rtsol par thob 'os pa'i gla phogs 'phri gcog byas par bstan yin/ (ngal rtsol pas rgyun ldan gyi ngal rtsol las 'gan grub pa'i sngon 'gro'i 'og mi bkol las khungs kyis ngal rtsol gan rgya nang gtan khel byas pa'i tshad gzhi ltar ngal rtsol par nges par sprod dgos pa'i ngal rtsol thob cha yongs rdzogs) rkyen med chad 'gyangs zhes pa ni mi bkol las khungs kyis rgyu rkyen ci yang med par gla phogs sprod ba'i dus tshod gtan khel byas pa las brgal te ngal rtsol pa'i gla phogs mi sprod bar bstan pa yin/ ngal rtsol pu'u yi〈〈gla phogs sprod ba'i skabs spyod gtan 'bo~Xkyi

'brel yod gnad don kha gsab byed pa'i skor gyi gtan 'bebs〉(ngal rtsol 'ganasang pu'u yis spel ba'i1995lo'i yig cha ang226pa)ltar na/ ngal rtsol pa'i gla phogs 'phri gcog byed par gsham gyi gla phogs 'phri gtong byas pa'i gnas tshul mi 'dus te/ gcig ni rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims dang khrims srol nang gtan 'bebs gsal bo byas yod pa/ gnyis ni khrims ltar ngal rtsol gan rgya bzhag pa'i khrod gtan khel gsal bo byas pa/ gsum ni mi bkol las khungs kyis khrims ltar bzos pa ma zad dpal 'byor las rigs 'thus mi'i lhan khang gis chog mchan thob pa'i bzo grwa'i sgrig srol dang sgrig lam khrod gtan khel gsal bo byas pa/ bzhi ni khe las gla phogs kyi spyi 'bor dang dpal 'byor phan 'bras phan tshun 'brel te/ dpal 'byor phan 'bras chag skabs/ gla phogs nges par chag dgos pa/ (yin na'ang ngal rtsol par sprod ba'i gla phogs de gnas de'i ma mtha'i gla phogs kyi tshad ga'i las dma' mi rung)/ lnga ni ngal rtsol pas don dgongs zhus pa sogs la de 'brel gyis gla phogs 'phri gcog byas pa sogs/ ngal rtsol pa'i gla phogs rkyen med chad 'gyangs byed par gsham gyi gnas tshul mi 'dus te/ gcig ni mi bkol sde tshan de mis nus shugs kyis ngo rgol byed mi thub pa'i rang byung gnod 'tshe dang 'thab rtsod sogs rgyu rkyen la 'phrad de/ dus ltar gla phogs sprod thabs med pa/gnyis ni mi bkol sde tshan la thon skyed gnyer skyong thad dngos gnas dka' khag byung ba dang / ma dngul 'khor skyod thad shugs rkyen thebs te/ rang re'i las bzo tshogs pas 'thad pa byung rjes/ gnas skabs su ngal rtsol pa'i gla phogs dus ltar sprod ma thub na chog pa dang / yun sring dus tshod kyi ches ring ba'i tshad bkag de zhing chen rim pa'i ngal rtsol sde khag gis gnas tshul dngos la gzhigs nas gtan khel bya dgos/ gnas tshul gzhan pa'i 'og gla pho/sdu /da 'gyangs byas pa tshang ma rkyen med chad 'gyangs la brtsi rgyu/

(bdun)rang de'i zhing pas sger gnyer khe las nas gla brgyab ste las rmas byung ba'am yang na las rigs nad phog na ji ltar bya/ngal rtsol pu'u yis spel ba'i1994lo'i yig cha ang118pa'i gtan 'bebs ltar na/ sger gnyer khe las kyi las bzo par las rmas byung ba'am las rigs nad phog tshe/ khe las kyis nges par du sman bcos byed pa'i 'gan 'khur dgos/ sman bcos byed pa'i mjug rdzogs pa dang / las bzo pa'i ngal rtsol nus pa kha shas shor tshe/ khe las kyis nges par du 'os 'tsham gyi bya ba bkod sgrig bya dgos pa las/ ngal rtsol gan rgya med par bzos mi chog las bzo pa'i ngal rtsol nus pa rtsa ba nas shor tshe/ khe las kyis nges par du 'brel yod gtan khel ltar kha gsab bya dgos pa ma zad/ de'i nyin rgyun gyi 'tsho ba'i gron dngul khag theg bya dgos/(brgyad)rgyal khab kyis zhing pa las mi'i ngal rtsol gan rgya'i gnad don thad gtan 'bebasa' ltar byas yod/rgyal khab kyis mi bkol las khungs kyis nges par du zhing pa las mi dang ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog rgyu dang / ngal rtsol gan rgya'i khrod ngal rtsol gan rgya'i dus yun dang bya ba'i nang don/ ngal rtsol srung skyong dang ngal rtsol cha rkyen/ngal rtsol thob cha dang ngal rtsol gan rgya dang 'gal ba'i 'gan 'khri sogs kyi nang don gtan khel gsal bo bya rgyu/ ngal rtsol 'gan srung sde khag gis zhing pa las mi'i ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog par lta skul dang zhib bsher byed shugs je cher btang ste/ dus thog tu ngal rtsol gan rgya'i rtsod gleng thag gcod bya rgyu/zhing pa las mi dang ngal rtsol gan rgya mi 'jog pa dang / mgo skor dang 'jigs skul sogs kyi byed thabs spyad de gan rgya 'jog pa/ gan rgya lag bstar mi byed pa'i mi bkol sde tshan bcas la yo bsung bya dgos pa'i bka' rgya phab pa/ zhing pa las mi'i lugs mthun khe dbang la gnod 'tshe bza~X snar

skyin gsab sprod rgyu'i bka' rgya phab pa/ mjug 'bras tshabs chen bzos par/khrims ltar thag gcod nan mo bya rgyu bcas gtan la phab yod/(dgu)rang re'i zhing pa las mis mi bkol sde tshan dang ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog skabs don bya gang dag la do snang byed dgos/〈〈ngal rtsol bca' khrim sa〉〉kyi gtan 'bebs ltar na/ rang re'i 'ing pas mi bkol sde tshan dang ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog skabs nges par du gsham gyi don byar mnyam 'jog dgos te/(1)ngal rtsol gan rgya de nges par du yig thog gi rnam pas 'jog dgos/gal te ngal rtsol rtsod gleng 'dra byung tshe/ yig thog gi gan rgyas brten khungs yod pa dang khrims dang mthun pa'i khungs lung 'don sprod byas te/ 'brel yod sde khag gis don dngos rtsad 'ib dang yin min gsal bo 'byed par stabs bde bzo thub/(2) ngal rtsol gan rgya'i nang don la gsham gyi don tshan nges par tshang dgos te/ gcig ni ngal rtsol gan rgya'i dus yun/ gnyis ni bya ba'i nang don/ gsum ni ngal rtsol 'gan srung dang ngal rtsol cha rkyen/ bzhi ni ngal rtsol thob cha/ lnga ni ngal rtsol sgrig lam/ drug ni ngal rtsol gan rgya mtshams 'jog pa'i cha rkyen/ bdun ni ngal rtsol gan rgya dang 'gal ba'i 'gan 'khri/brgyad ni mi bkol sde tshan dang kha dan byas pa'i don tshan gzhan dag(3) ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog na bca' khrims dang khrims srol/ 'dra mnyam rang mos dang gros mol gcig mthun bcas kyi rtsa don brtsi srung byas pa ma zad/ don dngos khungs ldan gyi rmang gzhi'i steng 'jog dgos/ bca' khrims dang srid 'dzin khrim sa srol dang 'gal ba'i ngal rtsol gan rgya dang /mgo skor dang 'jigs skul sogs kyi byed thabs spyad de bzhag pa'i ngal rtsol gan stab tshang ma rtsis 'gro med pa'i ngal rtsol gan rgya'i khongs su gtogs pa yin/

rtsis 'gro med pa'i ngal rtsol gan rgya de nyid la gan rgya bzhag pa'i nyin nas bca' khrims kyi gcun nus med/(bcu)ar las gan rgyar nang don gang dag 'dus/ar las gan rgyar gsham gyi nang don 'dus dgos te/ ()bzo skrun gyi khyab khongs/ (kye.ar las 'dzugs skrun gyi las yun/ ()bzo skrun gyi spus ka()bzo skrun gyi 'gro gron/ ()lag rtsal rgyu cha sprod pa'i dus tshod/ ()rgyu cha dang sgrig chas 'don sprod byed pa'i 'gan 'khri/ bum dngul gtong ba dang sdom rtsis byed pa/ ()ar las 'dzugs grub la zhib bsher rtsis len byed pa/()spus ka nyams gso khyab khongs dang spus ka khag theg dus yun/ (kyephyogs gnyis gas phan tshun rogs las byed pa'i don tshan gzhan dag(bcu gcig)mi bkol sde tshan rgyas rang de'i zhing pa las mir gan rgya'i nang shi gson rgya don tshan kha dan byas chog gam/zhing pa spun zla la la grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu song ste/ ar las 'dzugs skrun gyi las rigs khrod gla brgyab par/ ngal rtsol gan rgya'i stong mi bkol sde tshan gyis khyad du.ar las khrod rmas skyon phog pa dang shi ba/ dbang bo skyon can du btang ba sogs kyi byur rkyen la 'gan mi 'khur ba'i shi gson gyi don tshan gsal ston byas yod/ 'di'i phyogs nas zhing pa spun zla tsho sems bde la babs chog ste/ 'di lta bu'i rmas skyon byung bar 'gan mi 'khur zhes pa'i don tshan de ni phyogs gnyis ka rang mos sgos bzhag pa yin na'ang / gan rgya ris 'gro yod par gtong ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen ni gan rgya'i nang don bca' khrims dang 'gal mi chog pa dang / bca' khrims nang byas 'thus pa'i khyab khongs las brgal tshe tshang ma rtsis 'gro med pa yin te/ bca' khrims nang don tshan 'di rigs la khas len dang srung skyong mi byed/ 〈ngal rtsol bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan nga bzhi ba'i nang / mi bkol sde tshan gyis nges par du ngakā /la

par rgyal khab kyi gtan 'bebs dang mthun pa'i ngal rtsol bde 'jags dang 'phrod bston cha rkyen/ dgos nges kyi ngal rtsol 'gog srung nyer spyad bcas 'don sprod bya dgos pa gtan la phab yod/ don tshan gya brgyad pa'i nang /mi bkol sde tshan gyis bzos pa'i ngal rtsol sgrig srol lam lugs de bca' khrims dang khrims srol gyi gtan 'bebs dang 'gal yod tshe/ ngal rtsol srid 'dzin sde khag gis tha tshig sgrog pa dang / yo bsrang byed pa'i bka' rgya phab pa ma zad/ dngul chad bcad chog zhungal rtsol bca' khrims〉nang spyod dung las bzo par nad byung ba'am yang na las rmas byung tshe/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis nges par du sman bcos bya dgos pa ma zad/ sman bcos byed pa'i dus yu na nang / ngal rtsol gan rgya med par bzos mi chog las yul nas las rmas byung ba'i ngal rtsol par sman bcos byas te sangs drag tu song na'ang ngal rtsol nang zhugs mi thub pa dang / gal te mi bkol sde tshan gyis ngal rtsol 'brel ba med par bzo dgos na/ nges par du 'brel yod ngal rtsol 'gan srung dang phan bde'i lta skyong sogs kyi gtan 'bebs ltar/ 'tsho bar bkod sgrig gang legs bya dgos/ de ltar min par/ gang byung du ngal rtsol gan rgya med par bzos mi chog lhag par du ar las bzo skrun las rigs kyis 'di lta bu'i gtan khel byas mi chog 〈dmangs khrims srol yig〉gi don tshan brgya dang nyer drug pa'i nang / ar las dngos po'am yang na sgrig bkod gzhan pa dang ar las dngos po'i stong gi 'jog dngos dang 'dogs dngos bcas mar rdib pa dang brul ba/ lhung ba bcas byas te gzhan par gnod 'tshe bzos tshe/ de'i bdag bzung mkhan nam yang na do dam byed mkhan gyis nges par du dmangs don 'gan 'khri 'khur dgos zhes gtan la phab yod/ der brten/ngal rtsol gan rgya'i khrod kyi las rmas byung bar 'gan mi 'khur zhes pa'i don tshan /sna bca' khrims dang khrims srol la rgyab 'gal byas pa ma zad/ spyi

tshogs kyi spyi pa'i spyod bzang la'ang rgyab 'gal byas pa red/(bcu gnyis) mi bkol sde tshan la ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog skabasazu gta' ma'i dngul bsdu dbang yod dam/ngal rtsol pu'u yi〈〈〈krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi ngal rtsol bca' khrims〉lag len mthar phyin byed pa'i gnas don 'ga'i skor gyi bsam 'char〉(ngal rtsol pu'u yis spel ba'i1995lo'i yig cha ang309)dang ngal rtsol pu'u/ spyi bde pu'u/ rgyal yongs spyi khyab bzo tshogs lhan khang bcas kyi〈phyi tshong dngul gtong khe las dang sger gnyer khe las kyi ngal rtsol par do dam byas te las bzo pa'i lugs mthun khe dbang dngos gnas 'gan srung byed par shugs snon pa'i skor gyi brda tho〉(ngal rtsol pu'u yis spel ba'i1994lo'i yig cha ang118pa)las gtan 'bebs byas par gzhigs na/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis ngal rtsol pa dang ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog skabs/ rnam pa gang rung la brten nas ngal rtsol par 'gyur rten dang khag theg dngul/(dngos po)gta' ma'i dngul(dngos po)bcas bsdu mi chog gal te mi bkol sde tshan gyis ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog skabs gta' ma'i dngul sdud len byas tshe/ spyi bde sde khag dang ngal rtsol srid 'dzin sde khag gis dus myur tu ngal rtsol par phyir sprod pa'i bka' rgya phab rgyu/(bcu gsum)rgyal khab kyis ngal rtsol gan rgya'i chod spyod dus yun bad gtan 'bebs gang dag byas yod/tshod spyod dus yun ni mi bkol sde tshan dang ngal rtsol pas phan tshun rgyus lon dang gdam gses byed par kha dan bzhag pa'i dus yun zla drug las mi brgal ba'i rtog zhib dus yun de yin/ ngal rtsol pu'u yi1996lo'i zla10ba'i tshes31nyin spel ba'i〈ngal rtsol gan rgya'i lam lugs lag bstar byed pa'i gnad don 'ga'i skor gyi brda tho〉〉(ngal rtsol pu'u yi1996lo'i yig 1shā 3ang

354ba)nang gtan la phab pa ltar na/ ngal rtsol gan rgya'i dus yun zla(man yin na/ tshod spyod dus yun de ches ring na'ang nyin15las brgal mi chog pa dang / ngal rtsol gan rgya'i dus yun zlazhonas lo1gi man yin na/ tshod spyod dus yun de ches ring na'ang nyin30las brgal mi chog ngal rtsol gan rgya'i dus yun de lo gcig yan nas lo gnyis man yin na/ tshod spyod dus yun de nyin60las brgal mi chog tshod spyod dus yun de ngal rtsol gan rgya'i dus yun nang 'dus pa yin/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis bya ba'i las gnas la 'gyur ldog ma snang ༵༵ ngal rtsol pa rer tshod spyod dus yun thengs gcig la ma gtogs ba la ( bzlo bzhi)zhing pa'i gan rgya'i lam lugs kyi las bzo pa'i ngal rtsol gan rgya'i dus yun gtan khel ji ltar bya dgos/1995lo'i zla8pa'i tshes/nyin gyi〈ngal rtsol pu'u yi 〈 krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi ngal rtsol bca' khrims〉lag len mthar phyin byed pa'i gnad don 'ga'i skor gyi bsam 'char〉〉(ngal rtsol pu'u yis spel ba'i1995lo'i yig cha ang309)nang / mi bkol sde tshan gyis chog mchan thob pa brgyud/ de'i ngal rtsol gan rgya'i dus yun de mi bkol sde tshan dang ngal rtsol pa gnyis kyis gros mol byas te gtan khel byas chog(btso lnga)grong khyer dud thor bsgyur ba'i zhing pa'i gan rgya'i lam lugs kyi las bzo pas mi bkol sde tshan dang dus yun gtan khel med pa'i ngal rtsol gan rgya bzhag chog gam/ngal rtsol pu'u gzhung las thing gyis spel ba'i1996lo'i yig cha ang244yi gtan 'bebs ltar na/ zhing pa'i gan rgya'i lam lugs kyi las bzo pa mkhar grong dud thor bsgyur rjes/ de'i khrod las yun bsdud mar lo bcu yan lo/ ༵༵na gyis gal te mi dngos kyis dus yun gtan khel med pa'i ngal rtsol

gan rgya 'jog rgyu'i re ba bton na/ khe las kyis nges par du de dang dus yun gtan khel med pa'i ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog dgos/(bcu drug)khe las de la bskud mar lo bcu yan bya ba bsgrubs pa'i skabs 'phral las bzo pas dus yun gtan kharme med pa'i ngal rtsol gan rgya bzhag chog gam/〈〈ngal rtsol pu'u gzhung las thing gyi ngal rtsol gan rgya'i lam lugs lag bstar byed pa'i gnad don 'ga'i skor gyi snyan seng zhu ba'i bskyar yig〉(ngal rtsol pu'u yis spel ba'i1998lo'i yig cha ang88pa)ltar na/ khe las gang des rang las khungs nas bsdud mar lo bcur bya ba bsgrubs pa'i skabs 'phral las bzo pa dang mu mthud du ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog skabs/ 〈ngal rtsol skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi gtan 'bebs ltar/ gal te las bzo pas re 'dun zhus tshe/ nges par dus yun gtan khel med pa'i ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog dgos pa ma zad/ ngal rtsol gan rgya'i khrod de'i gla phogs dang 'gan bcol phan bde'i lta skyong bcas gsal bor 'god dgos/ mi bkol sde tshan dang mi gang des rgyal khab kyi gtan 'bebs ltar spyi tshogs 'gan bcol gron darnyil sprod pa ma zad/ 'brel yod kyi 'gan bcol phan bde'i lta skyong longs su da shā/cu bdun)rang re'i zhing pa las mi dang mi bkol sde tshan gnyis kyi bar ngal rtsol 'brel ba dngos chags rjes/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis ched mngags ngal rtsol gan rgya mi 'jog par 'gor 'grungs byas na ji ltar bya/1985lo'i zla8pa'i tshes/nyin ngal rtsol pu'u yis spel ba'i1995lo'i yig cha yang309nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ mi bkol sde tshan dang ngal rtsol pa'i bar ngal rtsol 'brel ba dngos chags na'ang / mi bkol sde tshan gyis bsam gzas nas ngal rtsol gan rgya mi 'jog par 'gor 'gyangs ༵༵ na/

ngal rtsol srid 'dzin sde khag gis nges par du yo bsrang bya dgos pa'i bka' rgya phab dgos/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis rkyen de las ngal rtsol par gnod 'tshe bzos tshe/ nges par du ngal rtsol pu'u yi ngal rtsol sde khag gis spel ba'i1995lo'i yig cha ang223pa ste〈〈ngal rtsol bca' khrims〉kyi 'brel yod ngal rtsol gan rgya'i gtan 'bebs dang 'gal ba'i skyin gsab sprod thabs〉nang gtan la phab pa ltar skyin gsab sprod dgos/(btso brgyad)mi bkol sde tshan gyis gnas tshul ji 'dra'i 'og ngal rtsol gan rgya med par btang chogami bsdil trī tshan gyis gsham gyi gnas tshul 'og ngal rtsol gan rgya med par ba/17 mi kā kol/ sde tshan dang ngal rtsol pa gnyis kyi gros mol gcig mthun byung rjes/ ngal rtsol gan rgya med par btang chog(2)ngal rtsol par gsham gyi gnas tshul dag yod tshe/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis rang phyogs gcig pus ngal rtsol gan rgya med par btang chog ste/ gcig ni ngal rtsol pas tshod spyod skabs su las gar bsdu ba'i cha rkyen dang mi mthun pa bden dpang byas pa/ gnyis ni ngal rtsol pas ngal rtsol gan rgya'am yang na mi bkol sde tshan gyi sgrig srol lam lugs dang 'gal ba tshabs chen bzos pa/gsum ni ngal rtsol pas las shor tshabs chen dang / sger phan g.yo zol byas te/ mi bkol sde tshan la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen bzos pa/ bzhi ni khrimasaltar nyes don 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded bya yul/(3)mi bkol sde tshan gyis gsham gyi gnas tshul 'og ngal rtsol gan rgya med par btang chog mod/ 'on kyang nges par du nyin30yi sngon la yig thog nas ngal rtsol par brda brgyag dgos/ gcig ni ngal rtsol par nad byung bzhi/ snang na gzhung don ched min pa'i rmas skyon phog ste/ sman bcos dus

yu na longs rjes/ sngar gyi bya bar zhugs mi thub la/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis bkod sgrig gzhan pa byas pa'i bya bar yang zhugs mi thub pa/ gnyis ni ngal rtsol pas bya ba'i 'gan 'khur mi thub pa dang / gso sbyong ngam yang na bya ba'i la sa gnas legs sgrig byas rjes spyod dung sngar bzhin bya ba'i 'gan 'khur mi thub pa/ gsum ni ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog skabs gzhi 'dzin sa'i gnas tshul dngos la 'gyur ldog chen po byung ste/ sngar gyi ngal rtsol gan rgya lag bstar byed thabs med pa dang / do bdag la gros mol byas pa brgyud ngal rtsol gan rgya bsgyur bar gros mol gcig mthun yong mi thub pa/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis nyin30yi sngon la yig thog rnam pas ngal rtsol par brda brgyag don ni/gnas tshul 'di dag byung rkyen ni ngal rtsol pa gcig pus nor 'khrul min pas red/ nyin30yi sngon la yig thog rnam pas brda rgyag pa des ngal rtsol par dus tshod nges can zhig sprad te/ kho tshos bya ba gsar ba 'tshol bar stabs bde bzo ba dang / glo bur du ngal rtsol gan rgya med par btang ba las 'tsho bar dka' khag 'khyer mi yong ba'i ched du yin/(bcu dgu)mi bkol sde tshan gyis gnas tshul gang dag 'og ngal rtsol gan rgya med par btang mi chog pa yin/ngal rtsol par gsham gyi gnas tshul las gcig yod tshe/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis ngal rtsol gan rgya med par btang mi chog(1)las rigs nad dam yang na gzhung don gyi ched du rmas skyon rdzog pa ma zad/ ngal rtsol gsal 'byed u yon lhan khang gis gsal 'byed byas pa brgyud ngal rtsol nus pa shor ba'am yang na phyed ka shor bar ngos bzung ba/(2)nad byung ba'am yang na gzhung don ched min pa'i rmas skyon phog tshe/gtan khel byas pa'i sman bcos dus yun nang /(3)bud med las bzo par mngal chags pa dang btsa' ba~X ltos

skabs/ nu ma sdud pa'i dus skabs bcas kyi nang /(4)bca' khrims dang srid 'dzin khrims srol nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i mi bkol sde tshan gyis ngal rtsol gan rgya med par btang mi chog pa'i gnas tshul gzhag dag(nyi shunangal rtsol par nad byung ba dang gzhung don ched min par zas skyon phog pa'i sman bcos dus yun gtan khel ji ltar byas yod/1986lo'i zla7pa'i tshes12nyin rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis spel ba'i〈〈rgyal gnyer khe las kyis ngal rtsol gan rgya'i lam lugs lag bstar byed pa'i skabs spyod gtan 'bebs〉〉kyi don tshan bcu gcig pa'i nang / khe las kyis nad byung ba'am yang na gzhung don min par rmas skyon phog pa'i las bzo par/nges par du rang re'i sde tshan nas bya ba bsgrubs pa'i dus tshod kyi ring thung ltar/ za3nas lo1ring gi sman bcos dus yun dgos/ rang re'i sde tshan nas lo20yan bya ba bsgrubs mkhan zhig yin na/ sman bcos dus yun 'os 'tsham sgos bsrings chog(nyer gcig)rang re'i zhing pa las mis gnas tshul gang dag 'og mi bkol sde tshan la ngal rtsol gan rgya med par gtong ba'i brna brgyab chog gam/gsham gyi gnas tshul las gcig yod tshe/ rang re'i zhing pa las mis dus nam zhig la yang mi bkol sde tshan la ngal rtsol gan rgya med par gtong ba'i brda brgyab chog pa ste/ ()tshod spyod dus yun nang du/ ()mi bkol sde tshan gyis drag shugs dang 'jigs skul lam yang na khrims 'gal sgos mi lus rang dbang la tshod 'dzin byed pa'i byed thabs spyad de ngal rtsol par btsan thabs bkol ba/ (kyemi bkol sde tshan gyis ngal rtsol gan rgya'i kha dan ltar ngal rtsol thob cha mi sprod ba'am yang na ngal rtsol cha rkyen 'don sprod mi byed pa/178

(nyer gnyis)rang de'i zhing pa las mir ngal rtsol gan rgya med par btang ba'i dpal 'byor skyin gsab ji ltar thob dgos/ngal rtsol pu'u yis1994lo'i zla12pa'i tshes3nyin bkram pa'i〈ngal rtsol gan rgyar 'gal ba dang med par btang ba'i dpal 'byor skyin gsab sprod thabs〉kyi gtan 'bebs ltar na/ ngal rtsol gan rgya med par btang ba'i dpal 'byor skyin gsab sprod thabs ni gsham ltar/(1)ngal rtsol gan rgya'i do bdag la gros mol byas te mos mthun byung ba brgyud/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis ngal rtsol gan rgya med par btang tshe/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis nges par du ngal rtsol pas rang sde tshan nas bya ba bsgrubs pa'i lo tshad la gzhigs te/ lo1longs pa yin na zla1gi zla phogs dang mnyam pa'i dpal 'byor skyin gsab ster dgos shing / ches mang na zla12las brgal mi rung / bya ba bsgrubs pa'i dus tshod lo1mi longs na lo1gi tshad gzhi ltar dpal 'byor skyin gsab ster dgos/(2)ngal rtsol par nad byung ba'am yang na gzhung don gyi ched du rmas skyon phog pa dang / ngal rtsol gsal 'byed u yon lhan khang gis sngar gyi bya bar zhugs mi thub pa dang / mi bkol sde tshan gyis bkod sgrig gzhan pa byas pa'i bya bar yang zhugs mi thub par ngos bzung ste ngal rtsol gan rgya med par btang tshe/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis rang sde tshan nas bya ba bsgrubs pa'i lo tshad ltar/ lo1longs pa yin na zla1gi gla phogs dang mnyam pa'i yong sgo'i skyin gsab sprod pa dang / dus mtshungs su spyod dung nges par du zla(ring gi gla phogs las mi dma' ba'i sman bcos rogs skyor gron dngul sprod dgos/nad ljid mo dang bcos thabs med pa'i nad phog par spyod dung sman bcos kha gsab rogs dngul je mang du gtong dgos shing / nad ljid mo phog par sman bcos kha gsab rogs dngul je mang du gtong tshad de sman bcos kha 1kāsnab

rogs dngul rgya505las mi dma' ba dang / bcos thabs med pa'i nad phog par je mang du gtong tshad de sman bcos kha gsab rogs dngul gyi100lkolas mi dma' ba bya dgos/(3)ngal rtsol pas bya ba'i 'gan 'khur mi thub pa dang / gso sbyong ngam yang na bya ba'i las gnas legs sgrig byas rjes sngar bzhin bya ba'i 'gan 'khur mi thub na/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis rang re'i sde tshan nas bya ba bsgrubs pa'i lo tshad ltar/ bya ba'i dus tshod lo1longs pa yin na/ zla1gi gla rdzogs dang mnyam pa'i dpal 'byor skyin gsab ma dngul sprod dgos pa dang / ches mang na zla12las brgal mi rung /(4)ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog skabs gzhi 'dzin sa'i gnas tshul dngos la 'gyur ldog chen po byung ste/ sngar gyi ngal rtsol gan rgya lag bstar byed thabs med pa dang / do bdag la gros mol byas te ngal rtsol gan rgya bsgyur bar gcig mthun byung ma thub par/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis ngal rtsol gan rgya med par btang tshe/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis ngal rtsol pas rang re'i sde tshan nas bya ba bsgrubs pa'i lo tshad ltar/ bya ba'i dus tshod lo1longs pa yin na zla1gi gla phogs dang mnyem pa'i dpal 'byor skyin gsab ma dngul sprod dgos/(5)mi bkol sde tshan ma rtsa dib la nye ste khrims bcad ltar dag ther byed pa'i dus skabs sam yang na thon skyed gnas bab la dka' khag chen po byung ste/nges par du las byed mi sna 'phri 'then bya dgos tshe/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis 'phri 'then mi snas rang sde tshan nas bya ba bsgrubs pa'i lo tshad ltar dpal 'byor skyin gsab ma dngul ster dgos/ rang sde tshan nas bya ba bsgrubs pa'i dus tshod lo1longs pa yin na/ zla1ring gi gla phogs dang mnyam pa'i dpal 'byor skyin gsab ma dngul ster dgos/ gong gi gnas tshul lnga bo ni/ mi ba/sdu ḍi tshan gyis ngal rtsol gan rgya med par btang rjes/ ngal rtsol par

gtan 'bebs ltar dpal 'byor skyin gsab ma dngul ma byin na/ dpal 'byor skyin gsab ma dngul tshang ma sprod pa phud/ da dung dpal 'byor skyin gsab ma dngul gyi305ltar tshad 'das kyi dpal 'byor skyin gsab ma dngul ster dgos pa yin/sgo sgonyer gsum)ngal rtsol pa'i dpal 'byor skyin gsab ma dngul ji ltar da da1sta/4lo'i zla12pa'i tshes3nyin gyi〈〈ngal rtsol pu'u yis dpar skrun byas pa'i〈ngal rtsol gan rgyar 'gal ba dang med par btang ba'i dpal 'byor skyin gsab sprod thabs 〉skor gyi brda tho〉〉 (ngal rtsol pu'u yis spel ba'i1994lo'i yig cha ang481)nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ngal rtsol pa'i dpal 'byor gsab dngul de mi bkol sde tshan gyis reb thengs gcig gis sprod dgos/(nyer bzhi)zhing pa brje res las bzo pa'i gan rgya'i dus yun lon te ngal rtsol gan rgya mtshams 'jog skabs khe las kyis de nyid phyir pha yul la log pa'i kha gsab rogs dngul dang 'tsho ba'i rogs dngul ji ltar spyod dgos/ngal rtsol pu'u gzhung las thing ngal rtsol gzhung las khang gis spel ba'i1996lo'i yig cha ang244pa'i gtan 'bebs ltar na/ khe las kyis ngal rtsol pu'u dang rgyal khab sdom rtsis u yon lhan khang / nus khungs pu'u bcas kyis spel ba'i1991lo'i yig cha15pa'i gtan 'bebs ltar/ zhing pa rjes res las bzo pa phyir pha yul la log pa'i kha gsab rogs dngul sprod dgos/khe las kyis nges par du〈dmangs yongs la dbang ba'i lam lugs khe las kyis zhing pa'i gan rgya'i lam lugs kyi las bzo pa bsdu spyod byed pa'i skor gyi gtan 'bebs〉kyi don tshan bcu bdun pa'i gtan 'bebs ltar/ khe las kyis nges par du zhing pa brje res las mis rang re'i khe las nardo ༵ ba

bsgrubs pa'i lo tshad ltar/ lo1longs pa rer zla1gi gla phogs kyi tshad gzhi dang mnyam pa'i 'tsho ba'i kha gsab rogs dngul sprod dgos/ 'on kyang ches mang na'ang zla12kyi gla phogs tshad gzhi las brgal mi chog gla phogs kyi tshad gzhi zhes pa ni khe las dang ngal rtsol pa gnyis kyis ngal rtsol gan rgya'i khrod kha dan bzhag pa'i ngal rtsol pa sdod pa'i las gnas(las 'gan)dang phan tshun do mnyam pa'i gla phogs kyi tshad gzhir bstan pa yin/(nyer lnga)zhing pa brje res las mir las mas byung ste ngal rtsol nus pa shor ba'i thob cha'i thad gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/ngal rtsol pu'u gzhung las thing gyis spel ba'i1996lo'i yig cha ang211pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ las rmas byung ste ngal rtsol nus pa shor ba'i zhing pa brje res las mir las rmas byung ste dbang bo skyon can du gyur ba'i gzigs skyong dngul sprod pa'i thad nas/ nges par mu mthud du〈dmangs yongs la dbang ba'i lam lugs khe las kyis zhing pa'i gan rgya'i lam lugasakyi las bzo pa bsdu spyod byed pa'i skor gyi gtan 'bebs〉kyi don tshan nyer gcig pa'i gtan 'bebs lag bstar byed dgos pa ma zad/ ngal rtsol pu'u ngal rtsol sde khag gis spel ba'i1996lo'i yig cha ang266pa'i don tshan24yi thengs gcig rang bzhin gyi mas skyon kha gsab rogs dngul dang thengs gcig rang bzhin gyi rmas skyon las zhugs rogs dngul skor gyi gtan 'bebs lag bstar byed dgos/(nyer drug) zhang grong khe las kyis ngal rtsol par ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog dgos sam/1996lo'i zla6pa'i tshes27nyin gyi〈zhing las pu'u dang ngal rtsol pu'u yi zhang grong khe las kyis ngal rtsol gan rgya'i lam lugs lag bstar byed pa'i skor gyi di/2 tho〉〉(zhing las thon skyed rgyu chas khe las kyis spel ba'i1996lo'i yig

cha ang5ba) nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ zhang grong khe las yod do cog gis ngal rtsol pa dang khrims ltar ngal rtsol gan rgya 'jog dgos/(nyer bdun)mi bkol sde tshan gyis ngal rtsol gan rgyar rgyab 'gal byas che ngal rtsol par gan gsab gang dag spyod dgos/ngal rtsol pu'u yi1995lo'i zla8ba'i tshes10nyin khyab bsgrags byas pa'i〈〈krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi ngal rtsol skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi 'brel yod ngal rtsol gan rgya'i gtan 'bebs dang 'gal ba'i skyin gsab sprod thabs〉nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis gsham gyi gnas tshul 'og ngal rtsol par gnod 'tshe bzos tshe/ ngal rtsol par gun gsab 'di dag nges par sprod dgos te/(1)mi bkol sde tshan gyis bsam gzas nas ngal rtsol gan rgya mi 'jog par 'gor 'gyangs byas pa ste/ ngal rtsol pa bsdu spyod byas rjes bsam gzas nas gtan 'bebs ltar ngal rtsol gan rgya mi 'jog pa dang ngal rtsol gan rgya'i dus yun lon rjes bsam gzas nas dus thog tu ngal rtsol gan rgya nu/ ma thud du mi 'jog pa dang /(2)mi bkol sde tshan gyi dbang gis ngal rtsol gan rgya rtsis 'gro med par btang ba dang / yang na ngal rtsol gan rgya'i kha shas rtsis 'gro med par btang ba/ (3)mi bkol sde tshan gyis gtan 'bebs dang rgyab 'gal byas pa'am yang na ngal rtsol gan rgya'i kha dan dang 'gal te bud med las bzo pa'am yang na lo na ma son pa'i las bzo pa'i lugs mthun khe dbang la gnod 'tshe btang ba/ (4)mi bkol sde tshan gyis gtan 'bebs dang rgyab 'gal byas pa'am yang na ngal rtsol gan rgya'i kha dan dang 'gal te ngal rtsol gan rgya menā snar

btang ba/ gong gi gnas tshul bzhi'i gun gsab bye brag gis sprod thabs ni/gcig ni ngal rtsol pa'i gla phogs kyi yong sgor gyong gun bzos na/ ngal rtsol par nges par thob 'os pa'i gla phogs kyi yong sgo ltar ngal rtsol par gun gsab sprod pa ma zad/ nges par thob 'os pa'i gla phogs yong sgo'i255yi skyin gsab gron dngul bsnan dgos/ gnyis ni ngal rtsol pa'i ngal rtsol srung skyong thob char gyong kun bzos na/ rgyal khab kyi gtan 'bebs ltar ngal rtsol pa'i ngal rtsol srung skyong gi phogs snon dang spyod chas kha gsab bya dgos/ gsum ni ngalartsol par las rmas byung ba dang sman bcos thob char gyong gun thebs na/rgyal khab kyi gtan 'bebs ltar ngal rtsol par las rmas dang sman bcos thob cha 'don sprod byas pa las gzhan/ da dung ngal rtsol par sman bcos gron dngul gyi755dang mnyam pa'i kha gsab gron dngul sprod dgos/ ba'i ni bud med las bzo pa dang lo na ma son pa'i las bzo pa'i lus phung bde thang la gnod 'tsho bzos tshe/ rgyal khab kyi gtan 'bebs ltar nad bcos dus skabs kyi sman bcos thob cha sprod pa las gzhan/ da dung sman bcos gron dngul byi255dang mnyam pa'i kha gsab gron dngul sprod dgos/(nyer brgyad)nga tsho zhing pa spun zlas mi bkol sde tshan dang ngal rtsol 'brel ba med par btang rjes mi bkol sde tshan gyis bden dpang yig cha 'don spyod byed dgos che' ltar bya/〈〈ngal rtsol pu'u yi khe las kyis las bzo pa skor skyod byed pa'i gnad don 'ga'i skor gyi brda tho〉〉(ngal rtsol sde khag gis spel ba'i1996lo'i yig cha ang355ba)nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ mi bkol sde tshan dang las bzo pas ngal rtsol 'brel ba med par btang rjes/ las bzo par dus thog tu 'brel yod kyi bden dpang yig cha 'don sprod byed dgos/184

(nyer dgu)rgyal khab kyis zhing pa las mi'i thon skyed 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen legs bsgyur byed pa'i thad gtan 'bebs gang dag byas yod/rgyal khab kyis gtan 'bebs byas pa ste/(1)thon skyed kyi phyogs nas/ sa khul dang 'brel yod sde khag so sos zhing pa las mi'i thon skyed bde 'jags dang las rigs nad 'gog bcos bya ba'i gnad don la gtsigs mthong chen po byed dgos/ zhing pa las mi bkol ba'i sde tshan gyis nges par du rgyal khab kyi tshad gzhi dang las sgug gi blang bya ltar/ zhing pa las mir dgos nges kyi bde 'jags thon skyed kyi sgrig chas dang ngal rtsol 'gan srung gi cha rkyen/ las rigs nad 'gog bcos byed thabs bcas 'don sprod byed dgos/ gter ru dang ar las 'dzugs skrun dang nyen kha'i dngos rdzas bcas thon skyed gnyer skyong gi las kur zhugs mkhan gyi zhing pa las mis las gnas steng ma song ba'i sngon du khrims ltar gso sbyong dang len byed dgos/ bde 'jags thon skyed kyi sgrig srol lam lugs lag bstar nan mo byas pa dang / thon skyed bde 'jags thad lta skul byed tshad je cher btang ste/ thon skyed bde 'jags thad kyi byur rkyen 'byung ba sngon 'gog nan mo bya dgos/ zhing pa las mi las rmas 'gan bcol khyab khongs nang 'jog pa'i bya ba legs par bsgrub dgos/ thon skyed bde 'jags thad kyi byur rkyen byung bar byur rkyen 'gan 'khri mi sna'i bca' khrims kyi 'gan 'khri bda' 'ded nan mo bya dgos pa ma zad/ byur rkyen khrod gnod 'tshe thebs pa'i zhing sbya las mis khripas ltar lhas rmas 'gan bcol gyi thob cha sna tshogs longs su da pastu lta/ tsho py-i sh+lau zlogs na/ sa/ zhing pa las mi'i 'tsho bar thugs khur byas te/ kho tsho'i dka' khag dngos dngos gnas thag gcod dgos/ 'phrod bsten sde khag gis zhing pa las mi'i 'char gzhi'i sngon 'gog dang bas snang

slob gso'i bya ba legs par bsgrubs pa dang / zhing pa las mi 'dus sdod khul gyi khor yug gtsang sbra dang zas rigs bde 'jags la cod zhib byed pa'i lam lugs btsugs te/ tshogs pa rang bzhin gyi 'gos nad dang zas dug phog pa'i don rkyen 'byung ba nan 'gog bya dgos/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis zhing pa las mir bkod sgrig byas pa'i mal khang la nges par gtsang sbra'i cha rkyen nges can zhig tshang dgos pa ma zad/ zhing pa las mi'i mi lus bde 'jags khag theg bya dgos/ zhing pa las mi cung 'dus sdod byas yod khul du/ gnas de'i srid gzhung gis nges par du dgos nges kyi rmang gzhi'i sgrig bkod 'don sprod byas te/ spyi pa'i 'grim 'grul dang 'phrod bsten gnas bab legs bsgyur bya dgos/ cha rkyen yod pa'i sa gnas kyis zhing pa las mi sman bcos 'gan bcol nang zhugs pa sogs bye brag gi byed thabs spyad de/ kho tshor las kur zhugs pa'i skabs kyi sman bcos sogs khyad par can gyi dka' khag sel rogs byas chog(sum cu) nga cho zhing pa las mis las rmas 'gan bcol rgya thob cha longs su sprud thub bam/thub ste/ bya ba'i khrod don rkyen byung nas las rmas byung ba'am yang na las rigs nad phog pa'i las bzo par sman bcos rogs skyob dang dpal 'byor kha gsab thob par 'gan srung byed ched/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi〈las rmas 'gan bcol skor gyi srol yig〉de7003lo'i zla/ba'i tshes16nyin khyab bsgrags byas shing / 2004lo'i zla1pa'i tshes1nyin nas bzung lag bstar byas/ 〈las rmas 'gan bcol skor gyi srol yiganyinang / rang rgyal mnga' khongs nang gi khe las so so dang gla ba glas yod pa'i sger gnyer bzo tshong dud khyim so pos(spyi ming la mi bkol sde tshan zer)nges par du〈las rmas 'di/ /col skor gyi srol yiganyinang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar/ las rmas

'gan bcol nang zhugs te/ rang sde tshan gyi las bzo pa yongs dang yang na gla ba yongs la dus ltar las rmas 'gan bcol gron dngul sprod dgos pa dang /las bzo pa mi sger gyis las rmas 'gan bcol gron dngul sprod mi dgos/rang rgyal mnga' khongs nang gi 'brel yod khe las kyi las bzo pa dang mi sger gyi bzo tshong dud khyim gyi gla pa tshang mar〈las rmas 'gan bcol skor gyi srol yiganyinang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar las rmas 'gan bcol gyi thob cha longs su spyod pa'i khe dbang yod pa bcas gtan la phab yod/ rgyal khab gzhung las khang gis spel ba'i2003lo'i yig cha ang dang po'i nang / 'ing pa las mi las rmas 'gan bcol gyi khyab khongs nang 'jog pa'i bya ba legs par bsgrub dgos pa'iblang bya gsal bo bton yod/(so gcig) gnas tshul gang dag ni las mes byung bar ngos 'dzin dgos/〈〈las rma/sa 'gan bcol skor gyi srol yig〉〉nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ las bzo par gsham gyi gnas tshul nang gi gcig yod tshe/ nges par la sa rmas byung bar ngos 'dzin dgos/ (1)las ma'i dus tshod dang las ka sgrub khang du/ bya ba'i dbang gis don rkyen byung nas rmas skyon byang ba dang /(2)las ku'i dus tshojo kyi snga gzhug tu las ka sgrub khang nas las kur 'brel yod kyi gra sgrig rang bzhin nam yang na las ka bsdu gsog rgyag pa'i skabs der don rkyen byung nas rmas skyon byung ba/(3)las ga'i dus tshod dang las ka sgrub khang du/ bya ba'i las 'gan lag bstar byed skabs drag shugs sogs bsam yul las 'das pa'i rmas skyon phog pa (4)las rigs nad phog pa/187

(5)bya ba'i ched du phyi rol du song ba'i skabs der/ bya ba'i dbang gis rmas skyon phog pa'am yang na don rkyen byung nas gar song cha med du gyur ba/(6)las kur 'gro ba dang phyir log pa'i khrod/ 'phrul sgul rlangs 'khor la don rkyen byung nas rmas skyon phog pa/(7)bca' khrims dang srid 'dzin khrims srol nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i nges par las rmas la ngos 'dzin dgos pa'i gnas tshul gzhan dgago (so gnyis)gnas tshul gang dag ni las rmas byung dang 'dra bar brtsi da sa/las bzo par gsham gyi gnas tshul las gcig yod tshe nges par las rmas byung bar brtsi dgos pa ste/(1)las ka las pa'i dus tshod dang las ga'i las gnas stong / glo bur ngang nad byung ste dbang bo skyon can du gyur ba'am yang na chu tshod48nang myur skyob byas kyang go ma chod par dbang bo skyon can du gyur ba/(2)nyen 'gog rgud skyob sogs rgyal khab kyi khe phan dang spyi pa'i khe phan srung skyong byed pa'i bya 'gul khrod rmas skyon phog pa/ gong gi gnas tshul gnyis sdus gcig yod tshe las bzo pas las rmas 'gan bcol thob cha longs su spyad ga (3)las bzo pa sngar dmag dpung nang phyir log pa dang / spyi pa'i ched du rmas skyon byung ste dbang bo skyon can du gyur ba/ gsar brje rmas skyon dmag mi'i dpang yig blangs yod pa dang / mi bkol sde tshan du song rjes nad rnying phyir 'phar na/ thengs gcig rang bzhin gyis rmas skyon kha gsab rogs dngul longs su spyod pa las gzhan las rmas 'gan bcol thob cha'ang longs su spyad chog cu188

(so gsum)gnas tshul gang dag ni las mas la ngos 'dzin mi chog pa'am yang na las mas dang 'dra bar brtsis mi chog pa yin/las bzo par gsham gyi gnas tshul las gcig yod tshe/ las rmas la ngos 'dzin mi chog pa'am yang na las rmas la brtsis mi chog ste/(1)nag nyes bzos pa'am yang na bde skyong do dam dang 'gal te shi rmas byung ba/(2)chang 'thung ba las shi rmas byung ba/(3)rang rmas byas pa'am yang na rang srog bcad pa/(so bzhinang cho zhing pa las mis las mas la ngos 'dzin pa'i re 'dun ji ltar zhu dgos/〈〈las rmas 'gan bcol skor gyi srol yig〉〉gi don tshan bcu bdun pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ las bzo par don rkyen byung nas rmas skyon phog pa'am yang na las rigs nad 'gog bcos skor gyi bca' khrims kyi gtan 'bebs ltar nad brtag byas pa brgyud las rigs nad la ngos bzung tshe/ las bzo pa de sdod pa'i sde tshan gyis nges par du don rkyen byung nas rmas skyon phog pa'i nyin de nas sam yang na las rigs nad la ngos bzung ba'i nyin de nas bzung ste nyin30yi nang tshun du/ gcig gyur 'char 'god sa khul gyi ngal rtsol 'gan srung srid 'dzin sde khag la las rmas la ngos 'dzin pa'i re 'dun zhu dgos/ khyad par can gyi gnas tshul la 'phrad tshe/ ngal rtsol 'gan srung srid 'dzin sde khag la yar zhu byas te 'thad pa byung ba brgyud/ re 'dun zhu ba'i dus yun 'os 'tsham sgos bsrings chog mi bkol sde tshan gyis gong gi gtan 'bebs ltar las rmas la ngos 'dzin pa'i re 'dun ma zhus na/ las rmas las bzo pa'am yang na de'i thad ga'i gnyen tshan/ bzo tshogs rtsa 'dzugs bcas kyis don rkyen byung nas rmas skyon phog pa'i nyin de nastu snam

yang na nad gzhir brtag dpyad byas pa brgyud las rigs nad la ngos bzung ba'i nyin de nas bzung ste lo1nang tshun du/ thad kur mi bkol sde tshan gnas sa'i gcig gyur 'char 'god sa khul gyi ngal rtsol 'gan srung srid 'dzin sde khag la las rmas la ngos 'dzin pa'i re 'dun zhus chog(solnga)nga cho zhing pa las mis las zas la ngos 'dzin pa'i re 'dun zhus na rgyu cha gang dag 'don spyod dgos sam/las rmas la ngos 'dzin pa'i re 'dun zhu na gsham gyi rgyu cha sprod dgos te/(1)las rmas la ngos 'dzin pa'i re zhu re'u mig ste/ las rmas la ngos 'dzin pa'i re zhu re'u mig la don rkyen byung ba'i dus tshod dang sa gnas/ rgyu rkye/ dang las bzo par rmas skyon phog tshad sogs gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul 'dus da sa/(2)mi bkol sde tshan dang ngal rtsol 'brel ba yod pa'i (ngal rtsol 'brel ba dngos 'dus)bden dpang rgyu cha/(3)sman bcos brtag dpyad byas pa'i bden dpang ngam yang na las rigs nad la ngos bzung ba'i nad brtag dpang yig yod dgos/ (yang na las rigs nad la ngos bzung ba'i gsal 'byed yi ge)(so drugan nga tsho zhing pa las mis las rmas byung bar snyam na'ang mi bkol sde tshan rgyas khas mi len na dzi ltar bya/〈〈las rmas 'gan bcol skor gyi srol yig〉〉nang / las bzo pa'am yang na thad ga'i gnyen tshan gyis las rmas byung bar snyam na'ang / mi bkol sde tshan gyis las rmas byung bar khas mi len na/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis bden dpang 'don sprod byed pa'i 'gan 'khur dgos/ ngal rtsole 'gan srung srid 'dzin sde khag gis las rmas la ngos 'dzin pa'i re 'dun dang len byas rjes/zhidi 1sher gyi dgos mkho ltar don rkyen byung nas rmas skyon phog par rtog zhib
