dang zhib bsdur byas chog pa dang / mi bkol sde tshan dang las bzo pa/ bzo tshogs rtsa 'dzugs/ sman bcos las khungs bcas dang 'brel yod sde khag gis mthun sbyor rogs res bya rgyu/ khrims ltar las rigs nad la ngos bzung ba'i nad brtag dpang yig gam yang na las rigs nad la ngos bzung ba'i nad brtag gsal 'byed yi ge blangs rjes/ ngal rtsol 'gan srung srid 'dzin sdekhag gis rtog zhib dang zhib bsdur byed mi dgos/ ngal rtsol 'gan srung srid 'dzin sde khag gis las rmas ngos 'dzin re 'dun 'byor ba'i nyin nas bzung ste nyin60nang nges par du las rmas ngos 'dzin thag gcod dgos pa ma zad/ yig thog nas las rmas ngos 'dzin gyi re 'dun zhu mkhan gyi las bzo pa'am yang na thad ga'i gnyen tshan dang las bzo pa de sdod pa'i sde tshan la brda tho gtong rgyu/ ngal rtsol 'gan srung srid 'dzin sde khag gi las byed mi sna dang las rmas ngos 'dzin re 'dun zhu mkhan gyi bar la phan gnod 'brel ba yod tshe/ nges par re 'dun de dang g.yol dgos/ (so bdun) nga cho zhing pa las mir las rmas byung rjes las mtshams bzhag nas sman bcos byed pa'i dus yun nang gla phogs yod dam/〈〈las rmas 'gan bcol skor gyi srol yig〉〉gi don tshan so gcig pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ las bzo par bya ba sgrub skabs don rkyen byung nas rmas skyon phog pa'am yang na las rigs nad byung ste re zhig bya ba las mtshams bzhag nas sman bcos byed dgos na/ las bzhag phogs sprod gyi dus yun nang / sngar gla phogs kyi thob cha mi 'gyur bas/ las bzo pa de sdod pa'i sde tshan gyis zla ltar gtong sprod bya dgos/ las bzhag phogs bskyur gyi dus yun spyir btang du zla12las mi brgal/ rmas skyon phog tshad tshabs chen yin pa'am yang na gnas tshul khyad par can yin pa dang / chus btsugs pa'i grong khyer rim pa'i ngal rtsol nus pa'i gsal 'byed u yon lhan kha~X spyas

khas blangs pa brgyud/ 'os 'tshams sgos rgyun bsrings chog yin na'ang rgyun sring dus yun de zla12las brgal mi chog las rmas byung ba'i las bzo pa'i rmas skyon phog rim dpyad bsdur gtan 'bebs byas rjes/ sngar gyi thob cha'i mtshams bzhag ste/ gtan 'bebs ltar rmas skyon phog pa'i thob cha longs su spyod dgos/ las rmas sdong ba'i las bzo par las bzhag phogs sprod gyi dus yun longs rjes spyod dung sman bcos byed dgos na/ las rmas sman bcos kyi thob cha mu mthud du longs su spyad chog 'tsho ba rang skyong mi thub pa'i las rmas las bzo par las bzhag phogs sprod gyi dus yun nang bdag skyong byed dgos na/ de sdod pa'i sde tshan gyis 'gan 'khur dgos/(so brgyad)nga cho zhing pa las mir las mas byung ste dbang bo skyon can du gyur ba de rim pa dang po nas rim pa bzhi ba'i bar gyi mas skyon byung bar gsal 'byed byas che thob cha gang dag longs su rgyud chog〈〈las rmas 'gan bcol skor gyi srol yig〉〉gi don tshan so gsum pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ las bzo par las rmas byung ste dbang bo skyon can du gyur ba de rim pa dang po nas rim pa bzhi ba'i bar gyi rmas skyon la gsal 'byed byas tshe/ ngal rtsol 'brel ba sor bzhag byas te/ bya ba'i las gnas nas phyir 'bud pa dang / gsham gyi thob cha longs su spyod pa ste/(1)las rmas 'gan bcol ma dngul las rmas skyon phog rim ltar reb thengs gcig gis las rmas kha gsab rogs dngul sprod dgos pa dang / tshad gzhi ni/ rim pa dang po'i rmas skyon phog par zla ba24ring gi rang nyid kyi gla phogs sprod dgos/ rim pa gnyis pa'i rmas skyon phog par zla ba22ring gi rang nyid kyi gla phogs sprod dgos/ rim pa gsum pa'i rmas skyon phog par zla ba20ring gi rang nyid kyi gla phogs sprod dgos/ rim pa bzhi ba'i rmas skyon phog pa/ /2 ba18ring gi rang nyid kyi gla phogs sprod dgos/

(2)las rmas nyen bcol ma dngul las zla ltar rmas skyon phogs snon sprod dgos/ tshad gzhi ni/ rim pa dang po'i rmas skyon phog par rang nyid kyi gla phogs 3905yin pa dang / rim pa gnyis pa'i rmas skyon phog par rang nyid kyi gla phogs kyiḥ55rim pa gsum pa'i rmas skyon phogs par rang nyid kyi gla phogs ཿ805rim pa bzhi ba'i rmas skyon phog par rang nyid kyi gla phogs kyi755bcas yin la/ rmas skyon phogs snon gyi ma dngul de gnas de'i gla phogs kyi tsha/ gzhi las dma' na/ las rmas thebs rtsa las chad dngul kha gsab /shā da/)/ nga cho zhing pa las mir las zas byung ste dbang bo skyon can du gyur ba de rim pa lnga pa dang drug pa'i zas skyon la gsal 'byed byas che thob cha gang dag longs su zad chog〈〈las rmas 'gan bcol skor gyi srol yig〉〉gi don tshan so bzhi pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ las bzo par las rmas byung ste dbang bo skyon can du gyur ba de rim pa lnga pa dang drug pa'i rmas skyon la gsal 'byed byas tshe/ gsham gyi thob cha longs su spyad chog ste/(1)las rmas nyen bcol thebs rtsa las rmas skyon phog rim ltar reb thengs gcig gis rmas skyon kha gsab rogs dngul sprod dgos pa dang / tshad gzhi ni/ rim pa lnga pa'i rmas skyon phog par zla ba16ring gi rang nyid kyi gla rdzogs sprod dgos/ rim pa drug pa'i rmas skyon phog par zla ba14ring gi rang nyid kyi gla phogs sprod dgos/(2)mi bkol sde tshan dang ngal rtsol gyi 'brel ba mu mthun du 'jog pa dang / mi bkol sde tshan gyis 'os 'tsham gyi bya ba bkod sgrig bya dgos/ bya ba bkod sgrig byed dka' na/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis zla ltar rmas skyon phogs snon sprod dgos pa dang / tshad gzhi ni/ rim pa lnga pa'i rmas skyon phog pa~X /nga

nyid kyi gla phogs kyi108spyod dgos la/ rim pa drug pa'i rmas skyon phog par rang nyid kyi gla phogs 060lkothod dgos pa ma zad/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis gtan 'bebs ltar de'i nges par sprod dgos pa'i spyi tshogs 'gan bcol sna tshogs sprod dgos/ rmas skyon phogs snon gyi ma dngul de gnas de'i ma mtha'i gla phogs kyi tshad gzhi las dma' na/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis chad dngul kha gsab bya dgos/ 〈las rmas 'gan bcol skor gyi srol yig〉nang dus mtshungs su/ las rmas las bzo pa rang gis mi bkol sde tshan dang ngal rtsol 'brel ba'i mtshams 'jog pa'i re ba bton tshe/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis reb thengs gcig gis las rmas sman bcos kyi kha gsab rogs dngul dang rmas skyon las zhugs kyi kha gsab rogs dngul sprod dgos pa dang / bye brag gi tshad gzhi de zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyi mi dmangs srid gzhung gis gtan 'bebs byed pa bcas gtan la phab yod/(bzhi cu)nga cho zhing pa las mir las zas byung ste dbang be+e skyon can du gyur ba de rim pa bdun pa nas rim pa bcu ba'i bar gyi rmas skyon la gsal 'byed byas par thob cha gang dag longs su spyad chog〈〈las rmas 'gan bcol skor gyi srol yig〉〉gi don tshan so lnga pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ las bzo par las rmas byung ste dbang bo skyon can du gyur ba de rim pa bdun pa nas rim pa bcu ba'i bar gyi rmas skyon la gsal 'byed byas tshe/ gsham gyi thob cha longs su spyad chog ste/(1)las rmas 'gan bcol thebs rtsa las rmas skyon phog rim ltar reb thengs gcig gis rmas skyon kha gsab rogs dngul sprod dgos pa dang / tshad gzhi ni/ rim pa bdun pa'i rmas skyon phog par rang nyid kyi zla bcu gnyis ring gi gla phogs sprod dgos pa dang / rim pa brgyad pa'i rmas skyon phog par radi ༵༵ kyi zla ba10ring gi gla phogs sprod dgos/ rim pa dgu ba'i rmas skyon

phog par zla8ring gi rang nyid kyi gla phogs sprod dgos/ rim pa bcu ba'i rmas skyon phog par zla ba6ring gi rang nyid kyi gla phogs sprod dgos/(2)ngal rtsol gan rgya'i dus yun longs pa'am yang na las bzo pa rang gis ngal rtsol gan rgya med par gtong ba'i re ba bton na/ mi bkol sde tshan gyis reb thengs gcig gis las rmas sman bcos kyi kha gsab rogs dngul dang rmas skyon las zhugs kyi kha gsaze rogs dngul sprod dgos/ bye brag gi tshad gzhi de zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyis gtan 'bebs bya rgyu/(zhe gciganang cho zhing pa grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu song ba'i skabs der mi ngan pa'i gnod 'che thebs na las rmas la brtsi 'am/'di ni blo yid las 'gongs pa'i don rkyen la gtogs pa dang / khrims 'gal nag nyes bya spyod kyis bzos pa'i gnod 'tshe yin pas/ las rmas la mi brtsi/ nag nyes bya spyod kyis gnod 'tshe bzos pa las byung ba'i mjug 'bras de nag nyes bzo mkhan gyis dam ngas don dang nyes don gyi 'gan 'khur dgos/ mi bkol sde tshan gyi gzigs skyong ma dngul de rang steng gis gtan khel byas pa las/ khrims bkod ltar sprod ba'i grangs ku'i tshad ga'i med/(zhe gnyis) nga tsho zhing pa rang nyid kyis bkol thabs dang 'gal te bkol spyod byas nas phog pa'i zas skyon la'ang skyin gsab thob bam/thob ste/ 〈〈r+shan tung zhing chen ches mtho'i mi dmangs khrims khang gi mi lus la gnod 'tshe btang ba'i gun gsab gyod don dang len byed pa'i gnad don 'ga'i skor gyi bsam 'char〉gyi don tshan so bzhi pa'i nang / 66gla pas gla spyod gan rgya ltar gla spyod bya 'gul la zhugs pa'i khrod rang lus la gnod 'tshe bzos na/ gla bdag gis gun gsab sprod pa'i 'gan 'khur dgos pa dang /gla par nor 'khrul yod na/ nor 'khrul gyi tshad la bltas te/ gla bsdu/ gi

gun gsab 'gan 'khri je yang du btang chog pa gtan la phab yod/(zhe gsum)nga cho zhing pa las mi gzhi rtsa'i gan gso 'gan bcol gron dngul bsdu len byed pa'i khyab khongs nang 'jog dgos sam/rgyal khab kyis spyi tshogs 'gan bcol bya gzhag gong du spel ba dang / spyi tshogs 'gan bcol lam lugs lag bstar byed pa/ spyi tshogs 'gan bcol thebs rtsa 'dzugs pa bcas byas te/ ngal rtsol par lo lon pa dang nad byung ba/ las rmas byung ba/ las ka shor ba/ btsa' skye sogs gnas tshul 'og rogs ram dang kha gsab thob par byas pa red/ spyi tshogs 'gan bcol de rgyal khab kyis khrims btsugs te gtan khel byas pas/ btsan thabs rang bzhin yod pa red/ mi bkol sde tshan dang ngal rtsol pa nges par du khrims ltar spyi tshogs 'gan bcol nang zhugs dgos/ khrims ltar 'gan bcol gron dngul mi sprod pa'am yang na 'gor 'gyangs byed pa'i mi bkol sde tshan la/ngal rtsol srid 'dzin sde khag gis dus bcad ltar sprod pa'i bka' rgya phab chog pa dang / dus yun las brgal te mi sprod na/ dus 'gyangs chad dngul bsnan te bsdus chog 'gan bcol thob cha'i ngo bo ltar/ spyi tshogs 'gan bcol de btsa' skye 'gan bcol dang nad rigs 'gan bcol/ rgan gso 'gan bcol/ dbang bo skyon can dang tshe 'das 'gan bcol bcas rigs bzhir bgos chog spyi tshogs 'gan bcol gron dngul bsdu len skor gyi skabs spyod srol yigazhungal rtsol pu'u yis spel ba'i1999lo'i yig cha ang9ba)nang / gzhi rtsa'i rgan gso 'gan bcol gyi gron dngul bsdu len khyab khongs la rgyal dbang khe las dang mkhar grong thun mong khe las/ phyi tshong dngul gtong khe las/ mkhar grong sger gnyer khe las dang mkhar grong khe las dang las bzo pa gzhan dag bcas 'dus shing / khe las do dam gyi don las sde tshan dang de'i ladi sdubo par lag bstar byed pa gtan la phab yod/ 'dir bshad pa'i

tsa las bzo par mi bkol sde tshan dang ngal rtsol 'brel ba btsugs yod pa'i mi sger yod do cog 'dus pa ste/ las bzo pa ngo ma 'dus pa ma zad skabs 'phral las bzo pa'ang 'dus la/ dud tho'i 'brel ba rang sa gnas na yod pa'i las bzo pa 'dus pa ma zad dud tho'i 'brel ba sa cha gzhan na yod pa'i la sa bzo pa'ang 'dus/ mkhar grong las bzo pa 'dus pa ma zad zhing pa las mi'ang 'dus/ krung go'i dud tho'i las bzo pa 'dus pa ma zad/ phyi rgyal gyi dud tho'i las bzo pa'ang 'dus/ der brten/ nga tsho 'ing pa las mi nges par du gzhi rtsa'i rgan gso gron dngul bsdu sprod byed pa'i khyab khongs nang 'jog dgos pa ma zad/ khrims ltar gzhi rtsa'i rgan gso'i 'gan bcol gyi thob cha longs su spyad chog(zhe bzhinang tsho zhing pa las mi'i rgan gso'i 'gan bcol rgyun mthud ji ltar bya dgos/khe las su las ka las bzhin pa'i zhing pa'i gan rgya'i lam lugs kyi las bzo pas gtan 'bebs ltar na nges par du rgan gso'i 'gan bcol gyi 'gro lugs bsgrub dgos mod/ 'on kyang khe las dang ngal rtsol 'brel ba med par bzos rjes/ 'gan bcol 'di ji ltar rgyun mthud dang len par bya zhe na/rgyal khab ngal rtsol dang spyi tshogs 'gan srung pu'u yi mkhar grong las bzo pa'i gzhi rtsa'i rgan gso'i 'gan bcol gyi 'brel yod gnad don skor gyi brda tho ltar na/ rgan gso'i 'gan bcol nang zhugs pa'i zhing pa las mis khe las dang ngal rtsol 'brel ba'i mtshams bzhag pa'am yang na med par bzos rjes/'ing chen rim pa'i srid gzhung gi gtan 'bebs ltar dang / zhing pa'i gan rgya'i lam lugs kyi las bzo pa rang gi re zhu ltar/ mi sger gyi dngul 'dzin steng mi sger gyis sprad pa'i cha shas de reb thengs gcig gis rang nyid la sprod pa'i mtshungs su/ rgan gso'i 'gan bcol 'brel ba mtshams bzhag zlok+ta pa

dang / yang bskyar las zhugs byas pa zhig yin tshe/ nges par du yang bskyar rgan gso'i 'gan bcol nang zhugs dgos/ skyes pa las bzo pa lo60la son pa dang / skyes ma las bzo pa lo35la son zhing / bsdoms pas gron dngul sprad pa'i lo15longs tshe/ gtan 'bebs ltar gzhi rtsa'i rgan gso'i gron dngul blangs chog pa dang / bsdoms pas gron dngul sprad pa'i lo15mi longs na/ mi sger gyi dngul 'dzin steng gi ma dngul yod tshad reb thengs gcig gis mi rang nyid la sprod dgos/(zhe lnga)glas spyod byas pa'i bzo pa shi rmas byung na mi bkol sde tshan rgyas skyin gsab ji ltar spyod dgos/〈〈las rmas 'gan bcol skor gyi srol yig〉〉nang / mi bkol sde tshan gyis bzo phrug glas mi chog pa dang / mi bkol sde tshan gyis bzo phug glas te rmas skyon dang shi ba'i don rkyen byung tshe/ sde tshan 'dis bzo phrug gam yang na bzo phrug gi thad kwa'i gnyen tshan la reb thengs gcig gis skyin gsab sprod dgos pa dang / skyin gsab kyi tshad gzhi de〈las rmas 'gan bcol skor gyi srol yig〉nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i las rmas 'gan bcol gyi thob cha las dma' mi chog pa gtan la phab yod/(zhedruganang tsho zhing pa las mis mi bkol sde tshan dang ngal rtsol rtsod gleng byung che thag gcod ji ltar byed dgos/nga tsho zhing pa spun zlas gal te ngal rtsol khe dbang mngon 'gyur dang ngal rtsol 'os 'gan lag bstar byed ched mi bkol sde tshan dang rtsod gleng byung tshe/nges par du gsham gyi rtsa don la brtsi 'jog sgos thag gcod dgos te/(1)don dngos la ga'igs pa dang khrims ltar thag gcod pa'i rtsa don/thog mar rang nyid kyi langs phyogs dang re zhur bden dpang gang legs 'ardo/ spyad byed pa'i mtshungs su/ khrims ltar go rim dam 'dzin byed dgos

te/ bca' khrims yod na bca' khrims la brten pa dang / bca' khrims med na khrims srol la brten pa/ khrims srol med na sgrig srol la brten pa dang /sgrig srol med na srid jus la brten pa bcas byas te/ mi bkol sde tshan dang khrims ltar gros mol byed pa dang / khrims ltar thag gcod bya dgos/(2)'dum sgrig la gtsigs mthong byed pa'i rtsa don/ 'dum sgrig ni ngal rtsol rtsod gleng thag gcod pa'i ched dmigs go rim zhig yin/ phyogs gnyis ka gros mol byed par mi 'thad pa'am yang na gros mol byas te gcig mthun yo nga thabs med na/ 'dum sgrig byed pa'i re 'dun zhus chog 'dum sgrig gtsigs su bzung tshe rang dang mi bkol sde tshan bar phan tshun rgyus lonathub tshad je zab du 'gro bar phan pas/ rjes phyogs kyi bya ba'i khrod phan tshun rgyab skyor dang ram 'degs bya nges red/(3)dus thog tu thag gcod pa'i rtsa don/ ngal rtsol rtsod gleng byung rjes/'dum sgrig byed par mi 'thad pa'am yang na 'dum sgrig byed thabs med na/'gor 'gyangs mi byed par dus thog tu bar 'dum las khungs la re 'dun zhu dgos/ bar 'dum las khungs kyis thag bcad pa blor mi 'bab na/ dus thog tu mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug byed dgos pa dang / bar 'dum mam yang na zhu gtug re zhu'i dus yun las brgal te/ bar 'dum mam yang na zhu gtug gi khe dbang shor du 'jug mi nyan/ nges par sems la gsal bo 'dzin rgyu ni/ ngal rtsol rtsod gleng byung ba'i nyin nas bzung ste nyin60nang tshun du ngal rtsol rtsod gleng bar 'dum u yon lhan khang la yig thog gi re 'dun zhu dgos/ bar 'dum u yon lhan khang gis 'dum gcod byas rjes/'dum gcod byas pa blor mi 'bab na/ bar 'dum gyi 'dum gcod yi ge 'byor ba'i nyin nas bzung ste nyin15nang tshun du mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug bya dgos/ 199

(zhe bdun)gnas tshul gang dag 'og mi bkol sde tshan rgyas las bzo pa phyir phud chog gam/rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 〈〈khe las las bzo pa'i bya dga' dang chad pa skor gyi srol yig〉〉(rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis spel ba'i1982lo'i yig cha yang59pa)ltar na/ phyir phud pa ni nor 'khrul bzos pa'i las bzo par srid 'dzin chad gcod byas pa ches tshabs ba'i rnam pa zhig yin la/ de ni khrims 'gal sgrig 'gal tshabs chen bzos pa'i las bzo par spyod na 'tsham pa dang /gtso bor gsham gyi gnas tshul 'ga' 'dus te/(1)khrims chad bcad pa ma zad btson khang nang khrims chad 'khur mkhan/(2)ngal rtsol slob gcun thengs gnyis la byas te grong khyer dud tho'i tho khongs stu shārnyi snab/ byed pa'i dus skabs nang spyod tshal sngar bzhin mi legs pa/(4)〈khe las las bzo pa'i bya dga' dang sdud pa skor gyi srol yig〉gi don tshan bcu gcig pa'i nang gi nor 'khrul bdun las gcig la 'gal mkhan/gzhan/ phyir phud pa'i thag gcod dus tshad ni/ las bzo pas nor 'khrul bzos pa ra sprod byas pa'i nyin nas bzung ste/ zla8yi nang tshun du chog mchan 'god tshar dgos/(zhe brgyad)gnas tshul gang dag 'og mi bkol sde tshan rgyas las bzo par ming tho sub pa'i thag bcad chog gam/ming tho nas sub pa ni khe las kyis tshul mthun gyi rgyu rkyen med par las kur chag pa'i las bzo pa dang ngal rtsol 'brel ba mtshams 'jog pa'i re ba brdo/ zlo'i srid 'dzin thag gcod kyi byed stangs shig red/ de ni srid 'dzin

chad gcod la mi gtogs par/ las bzo pas tshul mthun gyi rgyu rkyen med par las ka chag pa'i dus tshad nges can las brgal bas/ sde tshan gyis khrims ltar las bzo pa'i ming tho lag deb khrod las bzo pa de'i ming sub par bstan pa yin/ ming sub pa'i cha rkyen ni/(1)las bzo par tshul mthun gyi rgyu rkyen med pa'i sgo nas rgyun du las byol byastu ༵/skyon brjod slob gso btang yang go mi chod pa/ ( skyon brjod slob gso ni las bzo par ming tho nas sub pa'i thag gcod stangs kyi khrims bkod go rim lag bstar byas par zer)(3)gtan 'bebs byas pa'i las byol gyi nyin grangs longs pa ste/bstud mar las byol byas pa'i dus tshod nyin15las brgal ba'am yang na lo1nang rim rtsis byas na las byol byas pa'i dus tshod nyin30las brgal ba/bstud mar las byol byas pa'i dus tshod rtsi skabs/ las byol skabs kyi dus chen dang ngal gso nyin mo'i nyin grangs bcags te rtsis brgyab chogalas byol byas pa'i dus tshod rim rtsis byed skabs/ rang byung lo 'khor mo ltar rtsis brgyag dgos/ ming tho nas sub par dus tshad gtan 'bebs byas med/(zhe dag)gnas tshul gang dag 'og mi bkol sde tshan gyis las bzo parasmyo gla khongs nas phud pa'i thag bcad chog gam/1986lo'i zla7par rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis khyab bsgrags byas pa'i〈rgyal gnyer khe las kyi sgrig 'gal las bzo pa las khongs nas phyir phud pa'i skabs spyod gtan 'bebasaltar na/ las khongs nas phyir phud par gnas tshul rigs gnyis yod de/ gcig ni sgrig lam dang 'gal te las khongs nas phyir phud pa dang / gcig ni rgyun ldan ngang las khongs su phyir phud pa gnyis yin/ sgrig lam dang 'gal te las khongs su phyir phud pa ni rang rgyal ༵ /ga

sngar spyir btang du mi bkol sde tshan gyis ngal rtsol sgrig lam dang 'gal ba tshabs chen nam yang na nor 'khrul tshabs chen bzos na'ang / phyir phud pa dang ming tho nas sub pa'i cha rkyen mi 'dang na/ slob gso gtong ba'am yang nasrid 'dzin chad gcod byas pa brgyud sngar bzhin go mi chod pa'i las bzo par/ de'i bya ba med par bzos te ngal rtsol 'brel ba mtshams bzhag pa'i lam lugs la bstan pa yin/ las khongs su phyir phud pa ni srid 'dzin chad gcod min pa dang / de ni srid 'dzin thag gcod cig yin pas/ thag gcod dus tshad gtan 'bebs byas med/ sgrig lam dang 'gal bar chad gcod byed pa'i cha rkyen ni/ (1)las bzo pa gtan 'bebs byas pa'i sgrig lam dang 'gal ba'am yang na nor 'khrul gyi bya spyod yod pa/go /2)slob gso btang ba'am srid 'dzin chad gcod byas kyang sngar bzhin ma /kā /phyi/ra phud pa'am yang na ming tho nas sub pa'i cha rkyen mi 'dang ba/yo (lnga bcu)rgyal khab kyis sman bcos las bon la rim pa dzi ltar bgos da/ sman bcos byur rkyen thag gcod yang dag byed pa dang / nad pa dang sman bcos las khungs dang sman bcos mi sna bcas kyi lugs mthun khe dbang srung skyob bya ched/ 2002lo'i zla/pa'i tshes nyin/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis〈sman bcos byur rkyen thag gcod pa'i skor gyi srol yig〉khyab bsgrags byas/srol yig 'di'i don tshan bzhi ba'i nang / nad pa'i lus phung la bzos pa'i gnod 'tshe'i tshad ltar/ sman bcos byur rkyen de rim pa bzhir bgos yod de/rim pa dang po'i sman bcos byur rkyen ni nad pa dbang bo skyon can du bzos tshanā rdihu ba/ rim pa gnyis pa'i sman bcos byur rkyen ni nad pa dbang bo skyon

can du bzos tshad 'bring tsam yin pa dang / dbang bo'i grub char gnod skyon bzos pa las byed nus la 'gog rkyen tshabs chen bzos pa/ rim pa gsum pa'i sman bcos byur rkyen ni nad pa dbang bo skyon can du bzos tshad yang mo'i rigs dang / dbang bo'i grub char gnod 'tshe bzos pa las spyir btang gi byed nus la 'gog rkyen bzos pa/ rim pa bzhi ba'i sman bcos byur rkyen ni/nad pa'i mi lus la mngon gas la gyi gnod 'tshe bzos pa'i mjug 'bras gzhan dag bye brag gi rim pa dbye ba'i tshad ga'i de rgyal srid spyi khyab khang 'phrod bsten srid 'dzin sde khag gis bzo rgyu/ rgyal khab 'phrod bsten pu'u yis2002lo'i zla7pa'i tshes31nyinasman bcos byur rkyen gyi rim pa dbye ba'i tshad gzhi(tshod spyod)khyab bsgrags byas/(nga gcig) gnas tshul gang dag ni sman bcos byur rkyen la mi gtogs pa yin/〈〈sman bcos byur rkyen thag gcod pa'i skor gyi srol yig〉〉gi don tshan so gsum pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ gsham gyi gnas tshul yod tshe/ sman bcos byur rkyen nang mi gtogs pa yin/(1)brel myur gyi gnas tshul 'og srog shor la nye ba'i nad pa myur skyob byed ched brel myur gyi gso rig byed thabs spyad de mjug 'bras ngan pa bzos pa/ (2)sman bcos bya 'gul khrod nad pa'i nad tshul rgyun ldan min pa'am yang na nad pa'i gzugs gzhi khyad par can yin pa las sman bcos byur rkyen byang ba/ga (3)da yod kyi gso rig tshan rig lag rtsal gyi cha rkyen 'og sngon dpag byed thabs med pa'am yang na 'gog thabs med pa'i mjug 'bras ngan pa byung ba/ 203

(4)khrag blug pa las 'gos pa'i nor 'khrul ma byung bar bzos pa'i mjug shā/sna sdo nā spra /phyogs kyis nad brtag byed par 'gor 'gyangs byas pa las bzos pa'i mjug 'bras ngan pa/(6)'gog thabs med pa'i rkyen ngan las bzos pa'i mjug 'bras ngan pa/go (nga gnyis)sman bcos byur rkyen gyi skyin gsab gron dngul dzi ltar brtsi da sa/〈〈sman bcos byur rkyen thag gcod pa'i skor gyi srol yig〉〉gi don tshan lnga bcu pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ sman bcos byur rkyen gyi skyin gsab de gsham gyi rnam grangs dang tshad gzhi ltar rtsis rgyag dgos te/(1)sman bcos gron dngul/ sman bcos byur rkyen las nad par bzos pa'i lus phung gi gnod 'tshe ltar sman bcos byas pa'i sman yon rtsis rgyag dgos pa ste/ sman yon sprad pa'i 'dzin yig ltar sprod dgos/ yin na'ang sngar byung ba'i nad kyi sman yon mi 'dus/ gyod thag bcad rjes dngos gar+shas sman bcos byed dgos na/ gzhi rtsa'i sman bcos gron dngul ltar sprod da sa/(2)las thebs chag pa'i gron dngul/ nad par gtan 'jags kyi yong sgo yod na/ rang nyid las thebs chag pa las gtan 'jags kyi yong sgo je nyung du song ba ltar brtsi dgos/ yong sgo de sman bcos byur rkyen byung sa'i las bzo pa'i lo sngon ma'i lo 'khor mo'i cha snyoms kyi gla phogs las ldab3yan gyis mtho tshe/ ldab3ltar rtsis rgyag dgos/ gtan 'jags kyi yong sgo med na/sman bcos byur rkyen byung sa'i lo sngon ma'i lo 'khor mo'i las bzo pa'i cha snyoXsdu ༵ gla phogs ltar rtsis brgyag dgos/

(3)sman khang du sdod pa'i za ma'i kha gsab gron dngul/ sman bcos byur rkyen byung sa'i rgyal khab las khungs kyi spyir btang gi las byed mi sna gzhung do/ du phyir 'gro ba'i za ma'i kha gsab gron dngul gyi tshad gzhi ltar rtsis brgyag da sa/(4)nad g.yog gron dngul/ nad pa sman khang du sdod skabs nad g.yog byed mkhan zhig dgos tshe/ byur rkyen byung sa'i sngon lo'i lo 'khor mo'i las bzo pa'i lo'i cha snyoms kyi gla phogs ltar rtsis rgyag dgos/(5)dbang bo skyon can gyi 'tsho ba'i kha gsab rogs dngul/ rmas skyon phog pa'i rim pa ltar/ sman bcos byur rkyen byung sa'i sdod dmangs kyi lo'i cha snyoms kyi 'tsho ba'i gron dngul ltar rtsis rgyag dgos la/ dbang bo skyon can la gtan khel byase pa'i nyin nas bzung ste ches ring na lo30la skyin gsab sprod dgos/ yin na'ang lo60yan zhig yin tshe/ lo15las mi brgal ba dang / lo70yan zhig yin tshe/ lo8las mi brgal ba yin/(6)dbang bo skyon can gyi mkho chas gron dngul/ dbang bo skyon can la byed nus mkho chas kha gsab byed dgos tshe/ sman bcos las khungs kyi bden dasnang la brten nas/ yongs khyab can gyi mkho chas ltar gron dngul rtsis rgyag da sa/(7)dur 'jug gron dngul/ sman bcos byur rkyen byung sas gtan 'bebs byas pa'i dur 'jug gron dngul gyi tshad gzhi ltar rtsis rgyag dgos/(8)gso skyong bya yul gyi 'tsho ba'i gron dngul/ shi bo gson thog tu yod pa'am yang na dbang bo skyon can pa'i ngal rtsol nus pa ma shor ba'i sngon du don dngos kyis gso skyong byed pa ma zad ngal rtsol nus pa med pa dag la/de'i dud tho yod sa'am yang na de sdod sa'i sdod dmangs kyi ma mtha'i 'tsho ba'i 'gan srung gi tshad gzhi ltar rtsis rgyag dgos/ lo16la son med pa //sna lo

16la son rag bar gso skyong bya rgyu dang/ lo16la son na'ang ngal rtsol nus pa med na/ lo20la gso skyong bya rgyu/ yin na'ang lo60yan son tshe lo15las mi bzal ba dang / lo70yan son tshe lodulas mi brgal/(9)'grim 'grul gron dngul/ nad par don dngos kyis dgos pa'i lhagrim 'grul gron dngul ltar rtsis brgyab pa dang / 'dzin byang ltar gtong da bya( //0)sdod khang gi gron dngul/ sman bcos gyur rkyen byung sa'i rgyal khab las khungs kyi spyir btang gi las byed mi sna gzhung don du phyir 'gro ba'i sdod khang gi k+ta gazlob gron dngul gyi tshad gzhi ltar rtsis rgyag pa dang / 'dzin byang lta/ 1)dro sa tsho'i rgyu yu/la khams la gnod 'tshe btang ba'i gzigs skyong gron dngul/ sman bcos byur rkyen byung sa'i sdod dmangs kyi lo'i cha sto mas kyi 'tsho ba'i gron dngul ltar rtsis rgyag rgyu/ nad par shi rkyen byung tshe/ gun gsab byed pa'i lo tshad ches ring na lo6las mi brgal ba dang / dbang bo skyon can du bzos tshe/ kun gsab lo tshad ches ring na lo3las mi brgal/〈〈sman bcos byur rkyen thag gcod pa'i skor gyi srol yig〉〉gi don tshan nga gcig pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ sman bcos byur rkyen thag gcod pa'i nang zhugs pa'i nad pa'i thad ga'i gnyen tshan la mkho ba'i 'grim 'grul gron dngul dang las thebs chag pa'i gron dngul/ sdod khang gi gron dngul bcas ni/ sro/la yig 'di'i don tshan lnga bcu pa'i 'brel yod gtan 'bebs ltar rtsis rgyag rgyu dang / gron dngul rtsis rgyag pa'i mi grangasaskyalas brgal mi chog sman bcos byur rkyen las nad par shi rkyen byung tshe/ dur 'jug bya 'gul nang zhugs pa'i nad pa'i bza' zla dang thad ku'i gnyen tshan la pa/6 ba'i 'grim 'grul gron dngul dang las thebs chag pa'i gron dngul/

sdod khang gi gron dngul bcas ni/ srol yig 'di'i don tshan lnga bcu pa'i 'brel yod gtan 'bebs ltar rtsis rgyag rgyu dang / gron dngul rtsis rgyag pa'i mi grangs2las brgal mi chog pa bcas gtan la phab yod/ srol yig 'di'i nang spyod dung sman bcos byur rkyen byung ba'i gun gsab gron dngul de reb thengs gcig gis rtsis rgyag pa dang / sman bcos byur rkyen gyi 'gan khur ba'i sman bcos las khungs kyis gtong sprod bya rgyu gtan la phab yod/(nga gsum)sman bcos byur rkyen thag gcod pa'i re 'dun zhu bar dus tshod kyi tshad bkag gtan 'bebs byas yod dam/yod de/ sman bcos byur rkyen bad kyi rtsod gleng byung ste/ do bdag gis 'phrod bston srid 'dzin sde khag la thag gcod pa'i re 'dun zhu na/ nges par du yig thog rnam pa'i re 'dun zhu dgos/ do bdag rang gis de'i lus phung bde thang la gnod 'tshe thebs pa shes pa'am yang na nges par shes dgos pa'i nyin nas bzung ste lo1nang tshun du/ 'phrod bsten srid 'dzin sde khag la sman bcos byur rkyen gyi rtsod gleng thag gcod pa'i re 'dun zhus chog de 'dun zhu yig khrod re 'dun zhu mkhan gyi ga'i rtsa'i gnas tshul dang 'brel yod don dngos/ bye brag gi re ba dang rgyu rkyen sogs gsal bo 'bri dgos/(nga bzhin nga cho zhing pa grong khyer ru gla rgyug tu song rjes 'cho bar brten sa med na phyogs gang dag gi rogs skyob thob chog〈〈grong khyer gyi brten sa med pa'i 'khyar 'grims pa dang slong mo bar rogs skyob do dam byed thabs〉〉kyi don tshan bdun pa'i nang / rogs skyob sa tshigs kyis nges par du rogs skyor bya yul gyi mi sna'i dgos mkho ltar gsham gyi rogs skyob 'don sprod bya dgos te/(1)zas rigs 'phrod bsten gyi blang bya dang mthun pa'i zas rigs 'don sprod bya rgyu/ 207

(2)gzhi rtsa'i cha rkyen dang mthun pa'i sdod khang 'don sprod bya rgyu/(3)sa tshigs su glo bur nad byung tshe/ dus thog tu sman khang nang bskyal // (4)de'i gnyen tshan nam yang na sdod sa'i sde tshan la 'brel gtug byed gas shā /'a/grim 'grul gyi gla med par rang sdod sa'i sa gnas dang yang na las khungs la 'gro mi thub pa yod na/ rlangs 'khor sdod pa'i 'dzin yig 'don sprod bya rgyu/208

le'u drug pa/ gnyen bsgrigs dang khyim tshang gi skor/(/zlog)gnyen bsgrigs khrim tshang srung skyong byed par bca' khrims gang dpa nga py-i /spun zla tsho/ gnyen sgrig ni khyim tshang gi rmang gzhi yin la/ khyim tshang ni spyi tshogs kyi grub cha yin/ gnyen sgrig phun sum tshogs shing bde skyid ldan pa dang / spyi tshogs bde 'jags yin pa bcas yong ched/ khyed kyis rang rgyal la gnyen bsgrigs khyim tshang srung skyong byed pa'i bca' khrims gang dag yod pa nges par shes dgos/ rang rgyal gyis deng skabs spyod pa'i khrims 'dzugs ma lag dang bca' khrims tshad ldan gyi nus pa ltar na/ gnyen zlosdigs khyim tshangayo srungade skyong byed pa'i thad kyi bca' khrims la che sa nas gsham ma( di lta/ k+ta mas rtsa/ khrims nang gnyen sgrig khyim tshang gi ga'i rtsa'i rtsa don gtan shāka hāsdu ༵ /ma/ sa/ rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen nam yang na de'i rgyun las u yon lhan khang gis bzos pa'i dmangs khrims dang gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims/ nyar gso'i skor gyi bca' khrims/ 'char ldan btsa' skye'iskor gyi bca' khrims/ bud med kyi khe dbang srung skyong skor gyi bca' khrims/ lo na ma son par srung skyong byed pa'i skor gyi bca' khrims dang nyes khrims sogs yin/(3)srid 'dzin khrims srol/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang dang de'i khongs gtogs sde khag gis bzos pa'i srol yig dang /da don/ gtan ༵༵༵sa

sogs te/ dper na〈gnyen sgrig tho 'god do dam srol yig〉sogs/(4)sa gnas rang bzhin gyi khrims srol/ de ni zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyis bzos pa'i sgrig srol zhig yin/dper na(hran tung zhing chen gyi 'char ldan bu btsa'i skor gyi srol yig〉sogs/gzhan yang / da dung rang rgyal nang du zhugs nas ba'ag pa'i gnyen sgrig khyim tshang gi bca' khrims srung skyong dang 'brel ba'i rgyal spyi'i srol yigaganyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims ni gnyen sgog khyim tshang dang 'brel ba'i gzhi rtsa'i tshad gzhi yin pas/ spyi dmangs re dire dang khyim tshang re re'i bde rtsar thug pa'i khe dbang dang 'brel ba yod la/ gnyen sgrig khyim tshang gi tshad lda na ma lag tshang ma'i khrod kyi srog shing yin pas/ sne khrid kyi nus pa thon yod/ rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa'i tshun du/ rang rgyal gyis snga gzhug tu gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims thengs gsum la bkram myong ste/ 1950lo'i zla8ba'i tshes1nyin 'grems spel lag bstar byas pa'i gnyen sgrig bca' khrims/1980lo'i zla)ba'i tshes10nyin bkram pa dang / 1981lo'i zla1pa'i tshes1nas bzung lag bstar byas pa'i gnyen sgrig bca' khrims/ deng skabs spyod pa'i〈gnyen sgrig bca' khrims〉ni1980lo'i gnyen sgrig bca' khrims la bzo bcos brgyab pa ma zad/ 2001lo'i zla8ba'i tshes28nyin 'grem spel lag bstar byas shing / bsdoms pas le'u(dang don tshan51yod la/ 1980lo'i gnyen sgrig bca' khrims la kha gsab dang bzo bcos gal chen brgyab pas/bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi gnas bab gsar pa dang mi rnams kyi bsam blo'i 'du shes kyi 'gyur ldog gsar bar 'tsham pa dang / zhing pa spun zla tsho'i dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi gnad don mi nyung ba zhig thag gcod par dge mtshan chen po ldan/210

(gnyis)gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims gsar bas bya spyod gang dag gtan 'gog byas yod/(1)btsan shed dang nyo 'tshong sgos gnyen sgrig pa dang gnyen sgrig rang dbang la the gtogs byed pa'i bya spyod gzhan rigs gtan 'gog bya rgyu/ rang rgyal gyis gnyen sgrig rang dbang lag bstar byas pa dang / gnyen sgrig rang dbang ni spyi dmangs(rang byung mi)kyis bca' khrims las gtan 'bebs byas pa'i khyab khongs nang / rang bdag rang mos sgos rang nyid kyi gnyen sgrig gnad don thag gcod dbang yod pa dang / mi su zhig gis btsan thabs dang the gtogs byas mi chog par bstan pa yin/ gnyen sgrig rang dbang la phyogs gnyis 'dus te/ gnyen sgrig rang dbang dang bza' tshang kha bral rang dbang gnyis yin/ btsan shed kyis gnyen bsgrigs pa zhes pa ni bar mi gsum pas gnyen sgrig rang dbang gi rtsa don dang 'gal te/ gzhan mir btsan thabs kyis gnyen sgrig byed du bcug par bstan pa yin/ nyo tshong gnyen sgrig zhes pa ni bar mi gsum pas rgyu nor 'bor chen len pa dmigs yul byas te/ gzhan der btsan thabs kyis gnyen sgrig byed du 'jug par bstan pa yin/ chung gsos mna' ma dang chung rtags brgyab pa'i gnyen sgrig dang go brje'i gnyen nye sogs goms srol ngan pa 'dus pa dang / spyir btang du tshang mar btsan shed kyi gnyen sgrig gam yang na nyo tshong gnyen sgrig gi ngo bo ldan pa red/(2)gnyen sgrig la kha g.yar te rgyu dngos len pa gtan 'gog bya rgyu/'di ni nyo tshong gnyen sgrig phud pa'i gzhan pa'i gnyen sgrig la kha g.yar te rgyu dngos len pa'i bya spyod cig yin/ ngo bo'i steng nas nyo tshong gnyen sgrig dang mi 'dra na'ang / de'i mi'i bsam blo nag nog tu gtong ba dang / spyi tshogs kyi goms srol gtor brlag gtong bzhin pas/ gnyen sgrig rang dbang gi nang don dang 'gal ba red/ 211

(3)zla yod gnyen sgrig gtan 'gog bya rgyu/ rang rgyal gyis khyo shug gcig lam lugs lag bstar byed bzhin yod/ zla yod gnyen sgrig zhes pa ni bza' zla yod bzhin du gzhan par gnyen bsgrigs pa'i bya spyod la bstan pa yin/ rang rgyal(nyes khrims〉nang / bza' zla yod bzhin du gnyen sgrig byas pa'am/ yang na der bza' zla yod pa shes bzhin du de dang gnyen sgrig byas tshe/ lo2man gyi dus bkag btson 'jug gam yang na btsan nyar las skul bya rgyu/ (4)bza' zla yod bzhin du gzhan mir 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byed pagatan 'gog bya rgyu/ bza' zla yod bzhin du yang gzhan par gnyen sgrig byed pa ni bca' khrims steng gi zla yod gnyen sgrig yin la/ gnyen sgrig tho 'god ma byas na'ang gzhan par bza' zla'i ming thog gam yang na bza' zla'i ming thog min pa nas rgyun mthud dang gtan 'jags ngang 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byas na/ nges par du zla yod gnyen sgrig ltar thag gcod rgyu/66lhar btsal chung ma sogs bya spyod kyang khrims ltar gtan 'gog bya rgyu'i nang ga ga/5 k+ta khyi/ /tshang gi gtum spyod gtan 'gog bya rgyu/ khyim tshang gi gtum spyod zhes pa ni gtum spyod mkhan gyis gcar rdung dang bsdams pa/ gnod 'tshe bzo ba/ btsan thabs kyis mi lus rang dbang tshod 'dzin byed pa bcas dang yang na byed thabs gzhan rigs la brten nas/ de'i khyim mi gang bo'i lus phung dang bsam pa sogs phyogs la gnod 'tshe'i mjug 'bras nges can bzos pa'i bya spyod la bstan pa yin/ rgyun mthud rang bzhin dang dus rgyun rang bzhin gyi khyim tshang gi gtum spyod des mnar gcod byas nyes grub pa yin/(6)khyim mi phan tshun bar mnar gcod gtong rigs dang dor rigs gardo/ zlogog bya rgyu/ mnar gcod gtong ba ni bsam bzhin du'am bsam

bzhin du ma yin pa'i sgo nas/ khyim mir snang chung dang mnar sdug gtong ba/nyams nyes su gtong ba bcas byas te/ bsam pa'i steng dang lus khams stong gnod 'tshe bzos pa'i khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod la bstan pa yin/ dor ba ni khyim mi'i khrod gso skyong dang skyong rogs/ gzigs skyong bcas kyi 'os 'gan yod pa'i phyogs des/ gso skyong dang skyong rogs/ gzigs skyong bcas mkho ba'i phyogs gzhan par gso skyong dang skyong rogs/ gzigs skyong bcas kyi 'os 'gan lag bstar mi byed pa'i bya spyod la bstan pa yin/(gsum)gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims gsar pa'i nang gnyen sgrig bad gtan 'bebasaji ltar byas yod/phan tshun la dga' ba ni khe dbang zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang brtse dung yod pa'i mi tshang ma gnyen sgrig gi tshoms khang nang gom pa spo ba zhig min/gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims gsar pa'i nang gnyen sgrig thad gsham gyi bye brag gi gtan 'bebs 'ga' yod de/(1)gnyen sgrig byed skabs skyes pa dang bud med phyogs gnyis ka cis kyang rang mos yin dgos pa las/ sus kyang cig shos la btsan shed byas mi chog la skye bo gzhan pas the gtogs kyang byas mi chog ()skyes pa dang bud med phyogs gnyis la gnyen sgrig gi 'dod blo bshad pa'i nus pa yod dgos/duskyes pa dang bud med phyogs gnyis kyis bshad pa'i gnyen sgrig par 'thad tshul bton pa de nges par bden pa yin dgos/ duskyes pa dang bud med phyogs gnyis kyis gnyen sgrig par 'thad pa'i 'dod tshul de nges par du mi dngos 〉lta r+shalha/ //sa bye/da par nges par du khrims bkod lo tshad lon dgos pa ste/ skyes pa rang lo22la ma son bar dang bud med rang lo20la ma son bar du gnyen sgrig byas mi chog gnyen sgrig phyi 'byangs dang phru gu phyi ri~X'

byed pastu /sna lha py-i spyang /sno/sa tshal las gcig yod tshe/ gnyen sgrig gtan 'gog bya rgyu/ dusha rus gasdug pa'i gnyen tshan dang mi rabs gsum nang tshun gyi rgyud 'brel gnyen tshan yin pa dang / ()gso rig gi thog nas gnyen sgrig byed mi rung bar 'dod pa'i nad phog mkhan gras/(4)gnyen sgrig bya rgyu'i re 'dun zhu mkhan gyi skyes pa dang bud med gnyis ka nges par du gnyen sgrig tho 'god las khungs su song nas gnyen sgrig bya rgyu'i tho 'god dgos/ de min gnyen sgrig la bca' khrims kyi byed nus med pa yin/ gnyen sgrig tho 'god byed sa'i las khungs de zhing sde ru rdzong srid gzhung hā dmangs srid sde khag gam yang na zhang(grong rnal)mi dmangs srid gzhung (5//gnyen sgrig tho 'god byas rjes skyes pa dang bud med phyogs gnyis kyis kha chad byas pa ltar bud med de skyes pa'i phyogs kyi khyim mi byas chog la/skyes pa'ang bud med phyogs kyi khyim mi byas chog(6)gsham gsal gnas tshul gras kyi gcigayod na gnyen sgrig rtsis 'gro med pa ste/ dubaza' zla yod bzhin du gnyen sgrig byed rigs dang / duganyen sgrig byas mi chog pa'i spun mched kyi 'brel ba yod pa'i rigs/ (byeganyen sgrig ma byas gong la gso rig gi thog nas gnyen sgrig byed mi rung ba'i nad phog pa dang / gnyen sgrig byas pa'i rjes la'ang drag skyed ma byung ba'i gras/ ()khrims bkod kyi gnyen sgrig lo tshad ma lon pa'i gras bcas yin/(7)btsan shed la ma bzod par gnyen sgrig byas pa yin na/ btsan shed myong mkhan phyogs kyis gnyen sgrig tho 'god las khungs sam mi dmangs khrims khang la gnyen sgrig de phyir 'then bya rgyu'i re 'dun zhus chog btsan sheX stung mkhan phyogs nas gnyen sgrig phyir 'then bya rgyu'i re 'dun zhu na/

gnyen sgrig tho 'god byas nyin nas lo gcig gi nang tshun du zhu dgos/ mi lus kyi rang dbang la khrims 'gal gyi tshod 'dzin thebs mkhan do bdag gis gnyen sgrig phyir 'then bya rgyu'i re 'dun zhu na/ mi lus kyi rang dbang slar gso byung nyin nas lo gcig gi nang tshun du zhu dgos/ bca' khrims stong gibatsan shedazhes pa ni btsan shed gtong mkhan gyis phyogs gzhan pa'i do bdag gam yang na de'i gnyen tshan gyi tshe srog dang lus phung gi bde thang /mtshan snyan dang rgyu nor sogs kyi phyogs la gnod 'tshe gtong rgyu'i 'jigs skrag skul bas/ phyogs ga'an des btsan shed ma bzod par mi 'dod ba'in du der gnyen sgrig byed pa'i gnas tshul la bstan pa yin/(8)gnyen sgrig rtsis 'gro med pa'am phyir 'then byas rigs ni thog ma nyid nas rtsis 'gro med/ do bdag la khyo shug gi khe dbang dang 'os 'gan med/ 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byas ring thob pa'i rgyu nor ni do bdag gnyis po gros mol byas pa brgyud thag gcod rgyu/ gros mol ma mthun na/ mi dmangs khrims khang gis byas 'dzol med mkhan phyogs la lta rtog byed pa'i rtsa don la ga'igs nas dpyad mtshams gtong rgyu/ bza' zla yod bzhin du gnyen bsgrigs pa'i dbang gis rtsis med gnyen sgrig tu gyur pa'i rgyu nor thag gcod byed skabs/ khrims mthun ltar gnyen sgrig byed mkhan do bdag gi rgyu nor khe dbang la gnod 'tshe btang mi chog do bdag gnyis por skyes pa'i phru gu'i skor la〈gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi 'brel yod pha ma bu phrug skor gyi gtan 'bebs spyad 'thus/ bca' khrims steng gi thog ma nyid nas rtsis 'gro med pa zhes pa ni gnyen sgrig rtsis 'gro med pa'am phyir 'then chog pa'i gnyen sgrig de khrims ltar gnyen sgrig rtsis 'gro med pa'am phyir 'then byas pa khyab bsgrags byed skabs/ da gzod gnyen sgrig 'dir thog ma nyid nas bca' khrims kyis srung skyong gnang med pa gtan khel byed par bstan ༵ byin/

(bzhi) gnyen gan bzhag rjes khro shug tu gyur ram/gnyen gan 'jog pa de grong gseb tu cung dar khyab che ba yin/ na gzhon lo chung gis phan tshun dga' rogs bsgrigs nas dus tshod nges can 'ig 'gor ba'am yang na bar bas miphan tshun ngo sprod byas pa brgyud/ tsa lag ras brjes nas gnyen rtags brgyag pa yin la/ 6 lag ras brje bar yang bshadasrol yod/ pho mo phyogs gnyis kyis phan tshun bar lag ras brje ba'i mtshungs su/ skyes pa'i phyogs nas spyod dung bud med phyogs la sgor101can dang1 001can nam yang na10 001can byin te bud med phyogs la brtse dung mtshon pa yin te/ bud med phyogs kyi brgya yi nang gi gcig bdams pa dang66stong gi nang nas gcig bdams pa yang na khri yi nang nas gcig bdams pa de len bzhin yod ces pa'i don yin/ gnyen gan bzhag rjes khyo shug tu gyur ram zhe na/ ma gyur te/ der rgyu rkyen gnyis yod/ gcig ni gnyen gan la bca' khrims kyis srung skyong mi byed pa yin/ gnyen gan zhes pa de pho mo phyogs gnyis kyis gnyen sgrig byed pa dmigs yul du byas nas sngon la bzhag pa'i kha dan zhig yin pa'i cha nas/ gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims nang de rigs gtan 'gog bya rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas med mod/ 'on kyang khrims bkod kyi sgrig lam la brtsis te srung skyong yang byas med/ 1950lo'i gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims 'grem spel lag bstar byas rjes/ zla6pa'i tshes26nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung bca' khrims u yon lhan khang gis spyi bsgrags byas pa'i 'brel yod gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims lag bstar byed pa'i gnad don dang dris lan 'ga' zhes pa'i khrod/ 6 gnyen gan ni gnyen sgrig la nges par dgos pa'i 'gro lugs min zhes gtan 'bebs gsal bo byas yod pa dang / 1980lo'i gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims dang20༷/sbyar bzo bcos brgyab pa'i gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims nang gan

rgya'i thad nas bshad tshul ci yang mi 'dug gnyis ni nges par du gnyen sgrig tho 'god las khungs la song nas gnyen sgrig tho 'god byed dgos pa ma zad gnyen sgrig dpang yig blangs rjes/ pho mo phyogs gnyis ka spyod gzod dngos gnas khyo shug gi 'brel bar gyur pa yin/ rang rgyal gyiganyen sgrig tho 'god do dam srol yigagi don tshan bcu gcig pa'i nang / gnyen sgrig tho 'god las khungs kyis do bdag gi gnyen sgrig re zhur zhib bsher byas te/ gnyen sgrig byed pa'i cha rkyen dang mthun na/ dus thog tu tho 'god byas te gnyen sgrig dpang yig sprod dgos/ bza' 'thor brgyab myong bar nges par du de'i bza' 'thor yi ge med par bzo dgos/ do bdag gis gnyen sgrig dpang yig blangs pa'i nyin nas khyo shug gi 'brel ba gtan khel byas pa yin zhes gtan la phab yod/ dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod/ gnyen gan bzhag rjes yang 'gyod pa skyes pa dang / gnyen gan bzhag par kha g.yar nas rgyu nor len pa'am yang na pho mo phan tshun bar g.yo khral byed pa/ gnyen gan ba'ag par kha g.yar nas gnyen sgrig rang mos la the gtogs byed pa sogs snang tshul rgyun du byung dang 'byung bzhin yod/ de las shes thub pa ni/ bca' khrims steng gnyen gan lam lugs ma btsugs pa dang / gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims nangaganyen gan 'jog pa de nges par brgyud dgos pa'i sgrig lam zhig tu ma bzhag pa ni gnyen sgrig rang mos la 'gan srung byed par phan pa yod pa red/(lnga) skyes pa'i phyogs nas gnyen sgrig phyir 'then byas na/ bud med phyogs kyis bsam pa'i gnod 'che'i skyin gsab blangs chog gam/dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod rgyun du gnas tshul 'di dag la phrad pa ste/ pho mo phyogs gnyis gas rang re'i pha yul gyi yul srol goms gshes ltar gnyen gan bzhag pa'am/ yang na dga' rogs bsgrigs nas dus tshod nges can zhig 'gor rjes/ skyes pa'i phyogs nas rang 'gul gyis gnyen gan phyir+sha /ga

pa'am yang na dga' rogs kyi 'brel ba mtshams 'jog pa'i re ba bton pa dang / skabs 'dir bud med phyogs kyis bsam pa'i gnod 'tshe'i skyin tshab sprod pa'i gnad don 'don pa yin/ bud med phyogs kyis bsam pa'i gnod 'tshe'i skyin tshab sprod pa'i re ba 'don par gnas tshul rigs gnyis las ma 'das te/ gcig ni phyogs gnyis ka gnyen gan bzhag pa'am yang na dga' rogs kyi 'brel ba btsugs nas dus tshod cung ring bo 'gor ba dang / mtha' skor gyi sde ba tshang mas shes pa/ spyi tshogs steng shugs rkyen cung che bas/ bud med phyogs kyis bsam pa'i gnod tshe'i gun gsab sprod dgos pa'i re ba bton pa/ gnyis ni phyogs gnyis kur gnyen gan bzhag pa'i skabs sam yang na dga' rogs yin pa'i skabs su lus 'brel byung bas/ bud med phyogasakyis lang tsho'i mtshan snyan la gyong gud thebs pa rgyu rkyen byas te bsam pa'i gnod 'tshe'i gun gsab sprod dgos pa'i re ba bton pa red/ gnas tshul 'di rigs ngos 'dzin dang thag gcod byed skabs/ gsham gyi phyogs 'ga' nges par gsal bo byed dgos te/ gcig ni gnyen gan 'jog pa'am yang na dga' rogs kyi 'brel ba yod pa'i skabs su bca' khrims kyi tshod 'dzin nus pa med pas/ dus tshod ci 'dra'i ring ba dang shugs rkyen ci 'dra'i che yang rung / do bdag phyogs gang la'ang gnyen gan med par gtong ba'i re zhu 'don dbang yod la/ bca' khrims kyis the gtogs mi byed/ 〈dmangs khrims srol yig〉nang gnyen sgrig phyir 'then pa'am yang na dga' rogs kyi 'brel ba mtshams 'jog pa'i thad kyi bsam pa'i gnod 'tshe'i gun gsab dang lang tsho'i gun gsab skor gyi gtan 'bebs med/ gnyis ni gnyen gan bzhag pa'i skabs sam yang na dga' rogs yin pa'i skabs kyi lus 'brel byung ba'i bya spyod de khrims 'gal dang tshul min gyi kun spyod yin pas/ spyir ba/rdo 8gi gnas tshul 'og phyogs gnyis kur nor 'chug yod stabs/

phyogs gcig la pha rol por gun gsab sprod pa'i re ba zhu dbang med/ yin na'ang gal te phyogs gcig gis mgo bskor dang btsan thabs/ 'jigs skul sogs byed thabs la brten nas/ btsan shed kyis bud med phyogs kyis mi 'dod bzhin du lus 'brel byung du bcug na/ bsam pa'i steng dang sems khams steng / brtse dung phyogs bcas la rma kha tshabs chen bzos pa ma zad/nor 'khrul yod phyogs kyis gnyen gan phyir slog pa'am yang na dga' rogs kyi 'brel ba mtshams 'jog pa'i re ba bton na/ dmangs khrims kyi nus med dang byas 'dzol 'gan khur gyi rtsa don ltar/ byas 'dzol phyogs kyis de 'brel gyi bca' khrims mjug 'bras dang spyod drang 'gan khur 'khur dgos/gsum ni gnyen gan ba'ag pa'i skabs sam yang na dga' rogs kyi 'brel ba yod pa'i skabs su tshul min gyi lus 'brel byung ste bud med la mngal chags pa btsan len byas pa las lus phung gi bde thang la gnod 'tshe bzos tshe/ bud med phyogs kyis skyes pa'i phyogs la sman bcos gron dngul dang 'tsho bcud kyi gron dngul sogs kyi 'gan 'khur pa'i re 'dun zhus chog(drug)bud med phyogs kyis gnyen gan phyir slog na/ skyes pa'i phyogs kyis slongarten phyir spyod ba'i de 'dun zhus chog gam/pho mos gnyen gan bzhag rjes tag tag rgyu nor rtsod gleng kha shas byung ba yin/ nga tsho grong gseb la bltas nas bshad na/ gtso bor gsham gyi phyogs 'ga' yod de/ gcig ni gnyen srol ltar skyes pa'i phyogs kyis bud med phyogs la byin pa'i slong rten yin pa dang / gnyis ni skyes pa'i phyogs kyis brtse dung je zab tu 'gro ched rang mos sgos bud med phyogs la byin pa'i legs skyes yin/ gsum ni bud med phyogs kyis gnyen gan 'jog par khag bzhag nas skyes pa'i phyogs kyi rgyu nor blangs pa de yin/ bzhi ni gnyen gan 'jog pa'am gnyen gan 'jog ched skyes pa'i phyogs kyis 'gro song btang ༵༵ rgyu

nor yin/ deng skabs spyod pa'i bca' khrims ltar na/ gnyen gan 'jog par khag ba'ag nas rgyu nor len pa de cis kyang yo bsrang bya dgos pas/ de las thob pa'i rgyu nor tshang ma khrims ltar gzhung bsdu bya rgyu ma zad/ 'brel yod do bdag la chad gcod bya rgyu/ gnas de'i gnyen srol ltar skyes pa'i phyogs kyis bud med phyogs la byin pa'i slong rten /de gal te 'bor chen zhig yin tshe/ rtsa don steng nas bud med phyogs kyis nges par phyir slog dgos/de ni bud med phyogs kyis slong rten blangs pa las gnyen gan phyir slog mi thub pa dang / yang na slong rten phyir mi slog pa las gnyen gan phyir slog mi thub par dmigs pa yin/ bca' khrims nang bud med phyogs kyis gnyen gan phyir slog chog na/ slong rtenaphyir slog pa'i 'gan khur yang los 'khur/gal te skyes pa'i phyogs kyis rang mos sgos legs skyes su phul ba yin na/bud med phyogs la phyir sprod dgos pa'i re ba bton mi chog de ni skyes pa'i phyogs kyis legs skyes kyi tshab tu bud med la byin pa ni rang nyid rang mos yin pa'i cha rkyen 'og bud med phyogs kyis legs skyes de dang len byas pa yin/ de bas legs skyes kyi bdag dbang dang thag gcod khe dbang de bud med phyogs la bsgyur spo byas pa yin pas/ skyes pa'i phyogs la legs skyes su phul zin pa'i dngos po de'i bdag dbang dang thag gcod khe dbang longs spyod byed dbang med/ der brten bud med phyogs la rgyu dngos de rigs phyir slog pa'i re 'dun yang zhu mi 'os/ gnyen gan bzhag pa dang gnyen gan bzhag sdu/ 'brel ba las rgyu nor gyi 'gro song btang bar/ rtsa don steng skyin gsab ( ba/na/ ) gnyen sgrig chod lta'i gros mthun yi ger bca' khrims kyi nus pa yod dam/22/ga sngar/ grong gseb kha shas su na gzhon lo chung grong khyer ru gla rgyug

tu song ste/ slob dgos pa ma slob par slob mi dgos pa'irgyal stongabaslabs zin pas/ phyir rang yul la thon rjes dus rabs kyi rjes chod par byas te/gzhan par lad zlos sgos tshong gnyer gan rgya ste/ gnyen sgrig tshod lta'i gros mthun yi ge'ajog pa ste/ pho mo phyogs gnyis gas rang 'dod sgos gtan khel byas te/ sngon la 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byas nas 'tsho bar rol ba dang /'gab mthun mnyam sdod byed skabs rgyu nor so so yin pa'i lam lugs lag bstar bya rgyu/ 'gab mthun mnyam sdod kyi dus yun longs rjes/ phyogs gnyis gas 'grig po yong bar snyam tshe gnyen sgrig tho 'god byed pa dang /'grig po mi yong snyam tshe rang rang sar log pa dang / sus kyang sur sun po mi bzo ba'i gtan khel byas pa red/ cis kyang do bdag la ha cang gsal po'i sgos bslab bya gnang dgos pa ni/ 'di ni khrims 'gal gyi 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byed pa'i bya spyod la gtogs pas/ kho tsho'i gnyen sgrig chod lta'i gros mthun mil bca' khrims kyis srung skyong mi byed pa dang / bca' khrims kyi nus pa mi ldan pa yin/ rang rgyal gyi gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims nang /gnyen sgrig byed na nges par du gnyen sgrig tho 'god byed dgos pa dang /gnyen sgrig tho 'god byas nyin nas khyo shug gi khe dbang dang 'os 'gan 'brel ba gtan khel byas pa yin zhes gtan la phab yod/ gnyen sgrig tho 'god kyi 'gro lugs gang yang ma brgyud par mnyam du khyo shug 'brel ba'i 'tsho bar rol ༵'i bya spyad tshang ma bca' khrims dang 'gal yod phyir/ phugs skyon rdzogs da pa (/rgya/da) tshar las bcos bral gyi gnyen sgrig la bca' khrims kyi srung skyong thob bam/64tshar las bcos bral gyi gnyen sgrig la rigs gnyis yod de/ gcig ni pho mo phyogs gnyis gar gnyen sgrig pa'i cha rkyen mi ldan na'ang khyo sbyo/ gi

ming thog nas 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byas te 'tsho bar rol ba yin/ 'di lta bu'i gnyen sgrig ni tshar las bcos bral gyi gnyen sgrig yin pa'i dbang du btang na'ang / thog ma nyid nas rtsis 'gro med pa yin/ gzhan zhig ni pho mo phyogs gnyis gas gnyen sgrig tho 'god kyi 'gro lugs ma brgyud par spyi bsgrags sgos khyo shug gi ming thog nas 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byas pa dang /mang tshogs kyis kyang kho tsho khyo shug yin par ngos 'dzin pa de yin te/ bca' khrims steng nas bshad na 'di ni don dngos gnyen sgrig yin/ don dngos gnyen sgrig gi pho mos gnyen sgrig tho 'god kyi 'gro lugs ma brgyud pas/ don snying nan mo steng nas bshad na khrims 'gal gyi gnyen sgrig zhig kyang yin/'on kyang don dngos gnyen sgrig byas pa'i rgyu rkyen mang po yod pa ste/ la la ni lo rgyus steng grub pa dang / la la ni gnyen srol gyi shugs rkyen thebs pa las grub pa/ yang la la ni gnyen sgrig tho 'god byed pa'i 'du shes mi brtan pa las grub pa red/ der brten/ bca' khrims steng don dngos gnyen sgrig la khyad du kha gtad byas pa ste/ ches mtho'i mi dmangs khrims khang gis1989lo'i zla11pa'i tshes21nyin bkram pa'i〈mi dmangs khrims khang gi gnyen sgrig tho 'god ma brgyud par khyo shug gi ming thog nas 'gab mthun mnyam sdod kyis 'tsho bar rol ba'i gyod gzhi zhib gcod byed pa'i skor gyi bsam 'char 'ga'azhes pa dang1994lo'i zla1pa'i tshes1nyin dmangs srid pu'u yis bkram pa'iganyen sgrig tho 'god do dam skor gyi srol yigasnyanang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar/ spyi'i rtsa don ni/ gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims kyi gtan 'bebs dang 'gal te/ gnyen sgrig tho 'god ma byas par khyo shug gi ming thog nas 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byas nas 'tsho bar rol ba zhig yin tshe/ de ni gnyen sgrig gi don dngos blang bya dang mthun min gang yin rung / de'i ngo bo tshang ma khriX zlogal yin pas/ do bdag la skyon brjod dang slob gso nan mo btang

ste/ de'i bya spyod kyi khrims 'gal rang bzhin bstan dgos/ yin na'ang don dngos nas 'go brtsams te/ dus skabs nges can zhig nang cha rkyen yod pa'i sgo nas don dngos gnyen sgrig gi 'brel ba yin par khas len du 'jug dgos/(1)1986lo'i zla3pa'i tshes15nyin bkram pa'i〈〈gnyen sgrig tho 'god byed thabs〉〉lag bstar ma byas pa'i sngon du/ pho mo phyogs gnyis gas gnyen sgrig tho 'god 'gro lugs ma bsgrubs par khyo shug gi ming thog nas 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byas pa dang / mang tshogs kyis kyang khyo shug gi 'brel bar ngos bzung ba de'i phyogs gcig gis khrims khang la bza' 'thor mibya rgyu'i zhu gtug byas na/ zhu gtug byed skabs phyogs gnyis ka gnyen sgrig byed pa'i khrims bkod kyi cha rkyen dang mthun pa'am yang na don dngos gnyen sgrig la gtan khel byas pa yin dgos/ de min khrims 'gal gyis 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byas par ngos 'dzin rgyu/(2)1986lo'i zla3pa'i tshes15nyin bkram pa'i〈gnyen sgrig tho 'god byed thabs〉lag bstar byas rjes/ gnyen sgrig tho 'god 'gro lugs ma bsgrubs par khyo shug gi ming thog nas 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byas te 'tsho bar rol ba dang / mang tshogs kyis kyang khyo shug gi 'brel bar ngos bzung ba de'i phyogs gcig gis mi dmangs khrims labaza' 'thorabya rgyu'i zhu gtug byas pa dang / gal te 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byed skabs phyogs gnyis ka gnyen sgrig byed pa'i khrims bkod kyi cha rkyen dang mthun na/ don dngos gnyen sgrig gi 'brel bar ngos 'dzin chog de min khrims 'gal gyi 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byas par ngos 'dzin rgyu/(3)1994lo'i zla1pa'i tshes1nyin dmangs srid pu'u yis〈gnyen sgrig tho 'god do dam skor gyi srol yig〉gsar ba lag bstar byas nyin nas bzung /bza' zla med pa'i pho mos gnyen sgrig tho 'god ma bsgrubs par bza~X sdu'i

ming thog nas 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byas te 'tsho bar rol tshe/ zhu gtug gam yang na 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byed skabs gnyen sgrig gi don dngos cha rkyen dang mthun min gang yin rung / tshang ma khrims 'gal gyi 'gab mthun mnyam sdod ltar thag gcod rgyu/ gong gsal las shes thub pa ni/ 1994lo'i zla1pa'i tshes1nyin gyi sngon gyi tshar las bcos bral gyi don dngos gnyen sgrig 'brel ba de cha rkyen yod par ngos 'dzin min dang / 1994lo'i zla1pa'i tshes1nyin rjes kyi tshar las bcos bral migyi don dngos gnyen sgrig 'brel ba de byed thabs gang zhig spyad de gnyen sgrig byas pa yin rung / gnyen sgrig tho 'god ma brgyud na/ tshang ma khrims 'gal gyi 'gab mthun mnyam sdod 'brel bar gtogs pas/ bca' khrims kyi srung skyong mi thob/(dgu) 6chung mar nyes zung gtong ba ni khrim tshang gi don dag yin pas/ gzhan pas kha ya byed mi chog gam /ngatsho zhing sde ru spyod lta yang skyes pa kha shas kyis skyes pa pho yi ring lugs mibartsis te/ chung mar gnyes rdung byas dang byed bzhin yod la/skabs 'gar chung mar gcar rdung byas nas rig pa'ang nyab nyob du btang 'dug kho tshos spyod dung 'di ni khyim tshang gi don dag yin pas/ gzhan pas kha ya byed mi dgos zer ba dang / dus rgyun du chung mar gcar rdung byed pa ni khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod cig yin pa gtan nas shes kyin med/ pho mo 'dra mnyam yin la/ bud med kyi lugs mthun khe dbang srung skyong byed pa ni rang re'i rgyal khab kyi gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims kyi gzhi rtsa'i rtsa don yin/khyo shug gnyis gas gnyen sgrig khyim tshang gi 'tsho bar rol ba'i khrod/ dpal 'byor go gnas yin na'ang 'dra mi'i rtsis thang yin na'ang 'dra tshang ma 'dra mnyam yin pas/ phan tshun la brtsi 'jog bya dgos/ bca' khrims nang spyod duX sdum mi'i bar gyi mnar gcod dang gtum spyod gtan 'gog bya rgyu/

mnar gcod gtong ba ni bsam bzhin du'am bsam ba'in du ma yin pa'i sgo nas khyim mi'i lus lung dang bsam pa'i steng la sdug myong du 'jug par bstan pa dang / khyim tshang gi gtum spyod ni khyim mi phan tshun bar gtum spyod dam yang na gtum spyod la brten nas phan tshuna'ajigs skul byas te pha rol po'i lus sems gnyis kur gnod 'tshe bzo ba dang sdug bsngal bskyed du 'jug pa'i khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod cig yin la/ gtum spyod de rigs thengs gcig la spel bas kyang byas nyes su grub pa yin/ dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod/ mi la las skabs 'gar khyim mir drag shugs bkol ba des mnar gcod kyi byas nyes grub mi thub mod/ 'on kyang gnod 'tshe phog mkhan gyi sems khams steng dang lus po'i steng gnod 'tshe tshabs chen bzos pas/ rang rgyal bca' khrims nang khyim tshang gi mnar gcod gtan 'gog byed pa gtan 'bebs byas pa'i mtshungs su khyim tshang gi gtum spyod kyang gtan 'gog byas te/gnod 'tshe phog mkhan la khyon yongs kyi srung skyong byed pa'i bca' khrims gtan 'bebs byas pa red/ khyim tshang gi gtum spyod las byung ba'i bza' 'thor gyod gzhi de 'dum sgrig byas pa brgyud 'grig thabs ma byung na/ nges par du bza' 'thor byed du 'jug dgos mod/ 'on kyang nor 'dzol med pa'i phyogs la gnod 'tshe bzos pa'i gun gsab 'jal rgyu'i re 'dun zhu dbang yod/ khyim tshang gi gtum spyod gtan 'gog bya ched/ bca' khrims nang spyod dung de 'brel gyi rogs skyob byed thabs gtan la phab yod/〈gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan zhe gsum pa'i nang / khyim tshang gi gtum spyod spel ba'am yang na khyim mir mnar gcod btang na/gnod 'tshe phog mkhan gyis grong mi u yon lhan khang dang sde dmangs u yon lhan khang / ciyang na de nyid sdod pa'i sde tshan bcas la bkag sdom bslab bya gtong ba dang 'dum sgrig byed pa'i re 'dun zhu dbang yod la/ spyi ba~X snas

khungs kyis nges par du gtan 'gog bya dgos pa ma zad/ bde skyong do dam gyi 'brel yod gtan 'bebs ltar srid 'dzin chad gcod bya dgos/ byas nyes tshabs chen bzos rigs la spyi bde las khungs kyis nges par du khrims ltar rtsad zhib byed pa dang / zhib dpyod khang gis nges par du khrims ltar zhu gtug byed dgos/ gal te khyim tshang gi gtum spyod spel ba byas nyes su grub tshe/ gnod 'tshe phog mkhan gyis thad kur mi dmangs khrims khang la nyes don zhu gtug zhus chog pagatan la phab yod pas/ sus chung mar gcar rdung byed pa ni khyim tshang gi don dag yin pas gzhan pas kha ya byed mi dgos zer ba yin nam/(bcu)byis par gang byung du nyes rngung btang chog gam/byis par yang gang byung du gcar rdung byas mi chog phal cher pha ma tshang ma'i 'dod tshul gcig yin te/ byis pa ni rang nyid kyi yin/ skad cha 'dir nyan nas yong na nor 'khrul med mod/ 'on kyang bca' khrims kyi lta phyogs las bltas na/ byis pa'i sger tshugs kyi mi gshis dang mi tshe'i khe dbang snang med du bzhag pa red/ byis pa ni mi su zhig gi zur gtogs dngos po gtan nas min pas/ byis pa'i lus sems bde thang la bca' khrims kyi srung skyong thob yod/ gang byung du byis par gcar rdung byas te/ byis pa'i lus sems bde thang la gnod 'tshe bzos tshe/ bca' khrims kyi chad gcod 'khur dgos/(bcu gcig)chung mar nad sbyi mo phog na ma khrim la btang nas bdag skyong byed du bcug chog gam/mi chog ste/ nad lci mo phog pa'i chung ma ma khyim la ded de bdag skyong byed du 'jug pa ni lugs mthun zhig min la khrims mthun zhig kyang min pa red/ 〈gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims〉nang / 2 khyo shug phan tshun bar gso skyoX snro/ pa'i 'os 'gan yod pas/ phyogs gcig gis gso skyong 'os 'gan

dang len mi byas na/ gso skyong mkho ba'i phyogs kyis/ pha rol por gso skyong gron dngul ster ba'i re 'dun zhu dbang yod pa migatan la phab yod/ sanyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims kyi gtan 'bebs 'dir gsham gyi khyad chos yo da de/gcig ni khyo shug bar gyi phan tshun gso skyong byed par zur sngon gyi cha rkyen ci yang med/ gnyis rmi khyo shug bar gyi phan tshun gso skyong byed pa ni btsan thabs rang bzhin yin/ gsum ni khyo shug bar gyi phan tshun gso skyong dang gnyen sgrig 'brel ba de gnyen sgrig byas pa'i nyin nas bzung ste gnyen sgrig gi 'brel ba mtshams 'jog bar mnyam gnas byas yod/ bzhi ni khyo shug bar gyi phan tshun gso skyong ni ngos gnyis rang ba'in yin te/ dpal 'byor steng gi phan tshun gso skyong 'dus la 'tsho ba'i steng gi phan tshun rogs skyor yang 'dus/saso skyong gi rnam pa ni mnyam du 'tsho bar rol ba gtso byas te/ thad thar gso skyong byed pa de yin/ der brten/ chung ma ra nad lci mo phog pa'am yang na 'tsho ba rang bdag rang skyong mi thub pa/ yang na ngal rtsol nus pa shor ba(khyim la sa las pa'i ngal rtsol nus pa yang 'dus)bcas yin na/ pho skyes kyis ma khyim la ded de bdag skyong byed du 'jug mi rung / de ba'in du pho skyes gnas tshul 'di rigs la 'phrad tshe'ang / chung ma sa pho skyes bskyur te 'gro mi rung /gal te phyogs gcig gis gso skyong 'os 'gan lag bstar mi byed pa'i skabs su/ gso skyong mkho ba'i phyogs der pha rol por gso skyong gron dngul sprod ba'i re 'dun zhu dbang yo da/ khyo shug bar gso skyong 'os 'gan la ga bstar byed pa'i thad nas rtsod gleng byung tshe/ gso skyong ma kho ba'i phyogs kyis sde dmangs u yo na lhan khang dang zhang(grong rdal)srid gzhung la 'dum sgrig byed pa'i re 'dun zhus chog pa dang / mi dmangs khrims khang la gso skyong gron dngul bda' len byed pa'i dmangs don zhu gtug yang byas chog la/ khrims 'dzin rogs skyob kyi byed thabs spyad de rang nyid kyi khe dbang srung skyong byas cho~Xg

(bcu gnyis) slob grwa chen mo bas pha mar gso skyong 'os 'gan dang len bya rgya'i re 'dun zhu dbang yod dam/ gal te pha mar gso skyong nus pa med na/ slob grwa chen mor 'grims pa'i na gzhon gyis pha mar gso skyong gron dngul slong na/ rang rgyal gyis deng skabs spyod pa'i bca' khrims nang rgyab skyor mi byed pa yin/ 〈gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan nyer gcig pa'i nang / pha mar bu bu mor gso skyong dang slob gso gtong ba'i 'os 'gan yod la/ bu bu mor pha mar sri zhu sgrub pa dang rogs skyor byed pa'i 'os 'gan yod/ pha mas gso skyong 'os 'gan lag bsta ra mi byed na/ lo na ma smin pa'am yang na 'tsho ba rang rkya mi thub pa'i bu bu mos/ pha ma ra gso skyong gron dngul ster ba'i re 'dun zhu dbang yod pagatan la phab yod/ bca' khrims steng bshad pa'ilo na ma smin pazhes pa ni rang lo bco brgyad la ma son par bstan pa yin/ dmangs khrims spyi srolagyi don tshan bcu gcig pa'i nang / rang lo bco brgyad yan gyi spyi dmangs ni lo na smin pa'i spyi dmangs yin pas/ dmangs don bya spyod kyi nus pa yongs su ldan la/rang rkya 'pher ba'i ngang dmangs don bya 'gul spel thub pas/ dmangs don bya spyod kyi nus pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i mi yin pagatan la phab yod/ chen tshan slob grwa chen mo'i yan gyi slob ma spyir btang du tshang ma rang lo bco brgyad yan yin/ bca' khrims stong bshad pa'i'atsho ba rang rkya mi thub pa'i bu bu mozhes par ches mtho'i mi dmangs khrims khang gis 'di ltar 'grel bshad byas pa ste/ slob grwa nas mtho 'bring dang yang na de'i man gyi slob rim gyi slob gso myangs pa dang / yang na ngal rtsol gyi nus pa shor ba'am yang na ngal rtsol nus pa shor yag min pa sogs thad mthong gi rgyu rkyen min pa las rgyun ldan gyi 'tsho ba rgyun 'khyongs byed mi thub pa'i lo na smin pa'i bu bu mor bstan pa yin/de 118 shes thub pa ni/ ched tshan slob grwa chen mo yan gyi slob ma spyir btang du

〈'tsho ba rang rkya thub pa'i bu bu mo〉yin pas/ bca' khrims steng bshad pa'i〈gso skyong gron dngul〉te/ bu bu mo'i 'tsho ba'i gron dngul dang slob gso 'i gron dngul/ sman bcos gron dngul sogs gron dngul 'dus pa yin/ gong gi bca' khrims kyi gtan 'bebs ltar/ slo ba grwa chen mo ba'i pha mar de'i gso skyong gron dngul ster ba'i 'os 'gan med la/ slob grwa chen mo bas kyang pha mar gso skyong gron dngul ster ba'i re 'dun zhu dbang med/ yin yang pha mas rang mos sgos dpal 'byor rogs skyor nges can zhig byas tshe/ bca' khrims kyis kyang the gtogs mi byas/ slob grwa chen mor 'grims pa'i zhing sde'i na gzhin spun zla tsho/ bca' khrims la gdug rtsub che mod/ 'on kyang rang nyid kyi 'tshar longs 'du shes dang 'gan 'khri 'du shes la skul spel byed pa'i thad nas bltas na der yang ha cang don snying ldan pa zhig red/ de bas nges par du yang dag pa'i sgo nas kha gtad pa dang rang stobs rang spel bya dgos/(bcu gsum)khrim tshang logs dgar byas kyang rgyu nor ma bgos pa'i pha mar gso skyong byed pa'i 'os 'gan yod dam/pha mas khyim tshang logs dgar byas kyang rgyu nor ma bgos pa'am/ yang na pha ma'i khyim nor ma thob pa'i bu bu mo ra pha ma gso skyong byed pa'i 'os 'gan yo da dam zhe na/ de'i lan ni thag gis chod de/ bu bu rngo sa pha ma gso skyong byed pa'i 'os 'gan de bca' khrims nang gtan 'bebs byas pa dang / yang gcig bshad na/ bu bu mos pha ma gso skyong byed par cha rkyen ci yang med pas/zur gtogs kyi cha rkyen gzhan pa ci yang yo da mi chog pa dang / lhag par du khyim tshang logs dgar byed pa'i gnad don thad nas pha mar rtsod gleng 'dra byung ba dang / pha ma'i lag nas brtson len byed pa sogs gtan nas byas mi rung la/ rgyu nor bgos pa'i bzang ngan dang mang nyung de pha ma gso skyong byed pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen la brtsi mi rung / 'di ltar byas na ni gnas 2〉sdus

༵༵ / ༵༵/ pa cig yin pa ma zad/ bca' khrims steng nas kyang gtan nas zo (bcu bzhin mag pas sgrug po dang sgru mo'i shul rdzas rgyun 'dzin byas —ga gazlo ga/ pa dang sgyug ngo sgyu ga mo 'i bar rmi gnyen nye'i 'brel ba yin pas/spyir btang gi gnas tshul 'og kho tsho'i bar rgyun 'dzin khe dbang med mod/'on kyang rang rgyal gyi srol rgyun khyim tshang gi 'gro lugs 'og bu rabs tsha rgyud med pa'i lo lo na rgan gon tshang mas rgyun du bu mo 'am ma ga pa ma nyam du 'tsho bar rol ba'in yo da pas/ bu mo dang mag pas sri zhu'i 'os 'gan gtso bo 'khur yod/ rgan pa tshe las 'das rjes/ bu mo de rgyun 'dzin mkhan dang po'i rgyun 'dzin dbang cha 'dzin ma khan yin pa ra khrims bkod byas yod phyir/'dir mang po bshad mi dgos/ 'on kyang gal te bu mo yang ma/ga pa'i sngon la tshe la sa 'das pa'i gnas tshul 'og bza' zla chad pa'i mag pas spyod dung ches mtha' mar tshe las pa'i sgyug po'am yang na sgyug mo'i shul rdzas rgyun 'dzin byas chog gam zer na/ lan ni gsal thag chod de/ rang rgyal gyi〈rgyun 'dzin skor gyi bca' khrim/sa〉nang / smyo bza' zla tshe 'a sa 'das pa'i mna' mas sgyug mo dang / bza' zla tshe las 'das pa'i mag pas sgyug por sri zhu bsgrubs pa'i 'os 'gan dang blangs byas tshe/ rgyun 'dzin mkhan dang por brtsi rgyu zhes gtan la phab yod/ rgyun 'dzin bca' khrims kyi gtan 'bebs 'di ni bon par sri zhu sgrub pa dang / rgan par srung skyong byed pa/ bza' zla tshe las 'das pa'i phyogs gnyis ga'i khe phan/ khyim tshang gi 'brel ba sra brtan du gtong gospyi tshogs sgrig lam gtan 'jags yong ba bcas la don snying gal chen ldan/(bco lnga)pha yi bu lon nges par du bu yis 'jal dgos sam/233 pa'i gson thog gi bu lon de bu bu mos 'jal dgos min gyi thad nas/

don dngos kyi gnas tshul la gzhigs nas/ so sor kha gtad bya dgos/ rang rgyal gyi〈〈rgyun 'dzin skor gyi bca' khrim sa〉〉kyi don tshan so gsum/ pa'i nang /6 rgyu nor shul 'dzin byed par nges par du shul 'dzin bya yul gyis khrim/sa ltar 'jal dgos pa'i dpya khral dang bu lon gtsang 'jal byed pa dang / dbya khral dang bu lon gtsang 'jal byed par kho'i shul ba'ag rgyu nor gyi don dngos rin thang de tshad 'dzin sar brtsi dgos/ shul ba'ag rgyu nor gyi don dngos rin thang las brgal ba'i cha de/ shul 'dzin mkhan gyis rang mos sgos sprad na de ni tshad b.las 'di'i nang mi gtogs/ shul 'dzin ma khan gyis shul 'dzin mi byed na/ shul 'dzin bya yul gyi khral dngul dang dngul bun satsang 'jal byed pa'i 'gan khur mi dgos pa migatan la phab yod/ gtan 'bebs 'dir dmigs nas/ pha yi bu lon bu yis 'jal ba'i gnad don thag gcod par rtsa don 'di dag yod de/(1)bu bu mos pha yi bu lon gtsang 'jal byed par shul 'dzin bya yu la gyi shul 'dzin rgyu nor gyi don dngos rin thang ltar 'jal dgos/ rgyu nor shul 'dzin mi byed na/ 'asan mi khur ba dang /(2)gal te pha ma 'i bu lon de don dngos su khyim tshang gi thun mong 'tsho ba'i thad bkol tshe/ de thun mong gi bu lon la brtsis te/ khyim mi gang bos ma/nyam du 'gan 'khur dgos pa las/ bu bu mos pha ma'i shul rdzas tshad bkag byas te/ gtsang 'jal mi byed pa sogs byas mi chog(3)sal te bu bu mos 'bas tog zhu ba'i 'os 'gan dang len ma byas par/ pha rmi sa thabs zad de dngul bun bskyis nas 'tsho bar rol tshe/ bu bu mo sa bu lon gtsang 'jal bya dgos/231

(bcu drug)khrims khang gis brtse dung rtsa ba nas brlags par ngos 'dzin pa'i khungs lung ci yin/khyo shug gi brtse dung zhes pa ni khyo shug phyogs gnyis kyis phan tshun la sems khur dang brtsi 'jog blo sems dkar ba/ dga' gces bcas byed pa'i brtse ba der bstan pa yin/ khyo shug bar rtsod gleng dang 'gal ba tsam byung ba las brtse dung mi bzang zhes ngos 'dzin mi rung ste/ khyim tshang gcig nang 'tsho bar rol sa rtsod gzhi tsam yang med pa 'ig yod mi srid/ de bas/6 khyo shug gi brtse dung la dngos gnas chag grum shor ba :zhes pa ni ha cang rnyog 'dzing gi gnad don 'ig red/ mi dmangs khrims khang gis bza' 'thor byed pa'i gyod ga'i re rer lo rgyus rang bzhin dang khyon yongs rang ba'in/gong spel dang bye brag bcas kyi sgo nas dbye 'ib dang 'ib 'jug byas te/snang tshul brgal te de'i ngo bor blta dgos pa'i re ba bton yod/ gcig ni gnyen sgrig gi rmang gzhir blta dgos/ gnyis ni gnyen bsgrigs rjes kyi brtse dung la blta dgos/ gsum ni bza' 'thor byung rkyen la blta dgos/ bzhi ni phyir 'grig pa'i re ba yod med sogs la bltas te phyogs bsdus sgos dbye zhib bya dgos pa bcas so/ 〈gnyen sgrig skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi gtan 'bebs dang 'brel yod khrims 'dzin las 'grel bshad byas pa ste/ gsham gsal gadris tshul las gcig yod tshe/ lha brtse dung la chag grum shor zin par brtsi rgyu na(/1)bza' zla yo da bzhin du ga'an dang 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byas rigs/ dper na 'gab mthun mnyam sdod dang zur btsal chung ma sogs/(2)khyim tshang du gtum/ spyod spel ba'am yang na khyim mir mnar gcod gtong ba dang dor rigs/ phyogs gcig rang mos sgos khyim mi dang bral nas phyiX bying ba de dor rigs su mi gtogs/

(3)rgyan skug pa dang dug 'then pa sogs goms srol yod par slob gso btang yang mi bsgyur ba/(4)brtse dung kyi rkyen pas las lo gnyis la logs dgar bsdad pa/khyim tshang gcig tu yod kyang / khyo shug gnyis kyis logs dgar byas nas 'tsho bar rol na/ logs dgar bsdad par brtsi ba yin/(5)khyo shug gi brtse dung la chag grum bzo ba'i gnas tshul gzhan rigs/dper na/ phyogs gcig la khrims bkod kyi gnyen sgrig nad byung ba'am/yang na phyogs gcig la lus khams kyi steng skyon yod pa dang rgyu rkyen gzhan pas lus 'brel byung mi thub pa ma zad/ drag skyed byung dka' ba(gnyen sgrig byas nas lo mang po 'gor mkhan gyis bza' 'thor bya rgyu'i re 'dun zhu mkhan la nges par du phan tshun brtsi 'jog byed pa gtso byas te kha ta slob ston bya dgos)/ gnyen sgrig ma byas gong rgyus lon yag po ma byas par gnyen bsgrigs pa dang / gnyen bsgrigs rjes khyo shug gi brtse dung gtan nas ma chags par mnyam du 'tsho bar rol dka' ba/ phyogs gcig gis pha rol por mgo skor btang ba'am yang na gnyen sgrig tho 'god byed skabs mgo skor btang ste gnyen sgrig dpang yig blangs pa/ btsan shed dang nyo tshong gi gnyen sgrig byas rjes/ phyosas gcig gis dus thog tu bza' 'thor bya rgyu'i re ba bton pa'am yang na lo mang po ring mnyam du 'tsho bar rol yang / khyo shug gi brtse dung ma chags pa/ phyogs gcig dus yun ring bor btson 'jug byed pa'am yang na khrim sa 'gal dang nag nyes bya spyod bzos pa las khyo shug gi brtse dung la gnod 'tshe btang ba/ phyogs gcig gar song cha med du gyur nas lo gnyis 'gor ba dang / cig shos kyis bza' 'thor bya rgyu'i zhu gtug byas shing / khyab brda spel ba brgyud btsal yang ma rnyed pa/ gong gi gnas tshul 'og khrims khang gis tshang ma khyo shug gi brtse dung la chag grum shor zi/ sdur

ngos 'dzin rgyu dang / phyogs gcig gis mtha' gcig tu bza' 'thor bya rgyu'i re ba bton par 'dum 'grig byas pa brgyud 'grig thabs ma byung na/khrims ltar bza' 'thor bya ba'i chog mchan 'god dgos/de (bcu bdun) brgal skyes byis pa dud tho nang 'jog tu mi 'jug pa ba na ṭ+wāṃ trī/den te/ 1998lo 'i zla10ba'i tshes25nyin/ spyi bde pu'u dang 'char ldan bu btsa' u yon lhan khang gi(bu skye tho 'god bya bar shugs snon pa'i skor gyi brda tho〉nang / sa gnas gang du'ang 'char ldan bu skye las brgal te skyes pa 'i byis pa dmar 'byar dud thor 'god pa'i thad nas khrims srol btsugs mi chog pa gtan la phab yod/ bu bu mo kher skyes kyi dpang yig ma blangs pa dang / btsa' 'gog gshag bcos lag bstar ma byas pa/ 'char ldan bu skye las brgal te skyes pa'i byis pa dmar 'byar bcas dang / gnyen sgrig snga po byas pa dang / gnyen sgrig ma byas par skyes pa'i byis pa dmar 'byar bcas la skyon brjod dang slob gso gtong ba nas srid 'dzin khrims 'brel gyi chad gcod dang dpal 'byor chad gcod byed dgos mod/ 'on kyang byis pa dmar 'byar tshang ma dud thor 'god du 'jug dgos/(bco brgyad)'char ldan bu btsa'i khrims bstar khrod rgyun srung byed dgos pa'i byas mi chog pa bdun ni gang dag yin/'char ldan bu btsa'i khrims bstar khrod kyi tshul min gyi bya spyod yo bsrang bya ched/ 1995lo'i zla7par/ rgyal khab 'char ldan bu btsa' u yon lhan khang gis〈〈'char ldan bu btsa'i khrims bstar khrod rgyun srung bya dgos pa'i/byas mi sdog pa bdun par skrun byed pa'i skor gyi brda tho〉〉'grem spel byas ༷/sa )/cha/ ra ldan bu btsa'i gtan 'bebs dang 'gal ba'i mi sna dang

de'i khyim mir khrims 'gal sgos sdom bkyig dang gcar rdung / dma' 'bebs bcas byas mi chog(2)'char ldan bu btsa'i gtan 'bebs dang 'gal ba'i mi sna dang khyim tshang gi rgyu nor dang lo tog khang pa bcas med brlag tu btang mi chog(3)khrims bkod sogs go rim mi brgyud par 'char ldan bu btsa'i gtan 'bebs dang 'gal ba'i mi sna'i rgyu nor de 'char ldan bu btsa'i phyi skyes gron dngul gyi tshab tu sprad mi chog(da lta 8 spyi tshogs gso skyong gron dngul la bsgyur stustan/ byung du las gzhi 'dzugs pa dang dngul chad bcad mi chog(5)do bdag 'char ldan bu btsa'i gtan 'bebs dang 'gal ba las de'i gnyen tshan grogs po dang khyim mtshes/ mang tshogs ga'an pa bcas la nyes med zhor 'drud byas mi chog(6)mi 'bor dang 'char ldan bu btsa'i las 'asan legs sgrub byed sbyar kha g.yar te lugs mthun gyi btsa' skye byed du mi 'jug pa gtan nas mi ga (7)gnyen sgrig ma byas pa'i bu mo na gzhon rtsa 'dzugs byas te mngal chags min la brtag dpyad byas mi chog(bcu dgu)zhing sde'irgan rabasaspyi khe dbang srung skyong byed par gtan 'bebs gang dag yod/lo lon rgan pas rgyal khab dang spyi tshogs la byas rjes ba'ag yod pas/spyi tshogs yongs nas nges par du brtsi bkur dang sems khur byed dgos/rgan pa'i lugs mthun khe dbang srung skyong byed pa dang / krung hwa mi rigs kyi rgan bkur chan skyong gi srol rgyun bzang po dar spel gtong ched/ 1996lo'i zla8pa'i tshes29nyin/ rang rgyal gyis〈lo lon rgan pa'i khe dbang srur+sha snang

byed pa'i skor gyi bca' khrims〉'grem spel byas shing / zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer so sos kyang snga gzhug tu 'brel yod kyi khrims srol bzos pa dang / 'brel yod bca' khrims dang khrims srol ltar na/ lo re'i lugs rnying gi zla)ba'i tshes9nyin(dgu gnyis dus chen)ni khrims bkod kyi rgan pa'i dus chen yin/ lo 'o na rgan pas khrims ltar longs su spyod pa'i khe dbang sna tshogs la bca' khrims kyis srung skyong gnang rgyu yin la/ lo lon rgan par mthong chung dang dma' 'bebs/ mnar gcod dang 'dor ba bcas byed pa gtan 'gog bya rgyu/ lo lon rgan par rang bdag sgos gso skyong rnam pa gdam gses byed pa'i khe dbang yod/ lo lon rgan pa rang la yod pa'am yang na bogs glas kyi sdod khang la mi su zhig gis kyang btsan 'dzul byas mi chog pa dang / thon dbang dang bogs gtong 'brel ba rang 'dod sgos bsgyur mi chog sri zhu sgrub mkhan dang khyim mi spyod dung gnyen tshan ga'an pa sus kyang lo lon rgan pa bza' 'thor byed pa dang yang bskyar gnyen sgrig byed pa/ gnyen bsgrigs rjes kyi 'tsho ba bcas la the gtogs byas mi chog lo lon rgan pas gsham gyi gzigs skyong longs su spyad chog ste/ ()gtan 'bebs ltar longs su spyod pa'i rgan gso ma dngul dang thob cha gzhan par sngon la 'gan srung bya dgos/ du'os 'gan las ka dang dka' spyad ngal dub kyi las ku spyi tshogs kyi ma dngul rub bsdus sna tshogs kyi 'os 'gan bcas mi 'khur ba/ zhing sde'i rang lo70yan gyi lo lon rgan par sde bar sor 'jogabyed pa dang zhang(grong rdal)gcig gyur 'char 'god byed pa'i gron dngul mi bsdu ba dang / zhing sde'i dpya khral bcos bsgyur gyi 'ing las khral med par skubatang ba dang gsar du 'phar bar ma dngul gtong ba'i 'os 'gan mi khur gzhang dang sde ba'i spyi phan bya gzhag ma dngul mi sprod pa bcas bya rgyu/ dulugs maḥ/ ṭā dbang la gnod 'tshe thebs te zhu gtug byed pa dang / zhu gtug

gron dngul sprod par dka' khag yod na/ sprod yun bsrings pa'am/ yang na mi sprod pa bya rgyu/ bca' khrims kyi rogs skyor byed pa'i cha rkyen dang mthun tshe/sngo na la bca' khrims kyi rogs skyor thob dgos/ (nyelo brgya yan gyi lo lon rgan pa ra rdzong rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis dus bcad ltar tshe ring kha gsab rogs dngul sprod rgyu/ dugatan 'bebs ltar dud tho bza' zla yod sar dang yang na sri zhu sgrub mkhan sdod sar spo bar/ grong khyer yag la sa kyi gron dngul mi bsdu ba/ dubaca' khrims dang khrims srol nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i gzhan pa'i gzigs skyong ste/ 'dir ched du bshad dgos pa zhig ni/gongagi lo lo na rgan pa'i khe dbang yod tshad bca' khrims su bkod yod pas/༵ su 'ig gis rgyu rkyen gang la brten nas the gtogs dang dgag rkyen bzo mi ga (nyi shu)byis pa slob gyur 'gro ru ma bcug pa de khrims 'gal yin nam/byis pa lo drug nas lo bdun la son dus/ kho(kho mo)slob grwar 'gro ru ma bcug pa der yang bca' khrims kyis kha ya byed ba'in yod/ byis pa dang gzhon nas slob gso myong ba'i khe dbang la 'gan srung bya ched/ rang rgyal gyi〈slob gso skoragyi bca' khrimasanyidang1986lo'i zla/ba'i tshes24nyin bkram pa'i〈'os 'gan slob gso'i skor gyi bca' khrims〉nang / rgyal khab kyis lo dgu'i 'os 'gan slob gso lam lugs lag bstar bya rgyu ste/ slob chung lo rim dang po nas slob 'bring lo rim gsum pa'i bar gyi slob gso yin/ lo drug nas lo bdun la son pa'i byis pa 'ig yin phyin/ cha rkyen mi 'dang ba'i sa khul gyis lo bdun la bzhag chog tshang ma nges par du slob grwar song nas gta na 'bebs lo'i 'os 'gan slob gso myong dgos/ slob lo ran pa'i byis pa dang na gzhon la slob yo na mi len pa dang slob yon sprod yun bsring dgos na/ de'i pha ma'am yang na lta skyong pa gzhan pas re 'dun zhus rjes/23snang

rim pa yan gyi slob gso gtso skyong sde khag gam yang na 'ang rim pa'i mi dmangs srid sazhung bi chog mchan thob dgos/ yun sring dus yun longs rjes spyod dung sprod mi thub na/ yang bskyar slob yon spyod yun bsring ba'i re 'dun zhu dgos/ pha ma'am ya nga na lta skyong pa gzhan pas slob lo ran pa'i bu bu mo slob grwar mi bskyal ba'am yang na lta skyong bya yul la slob mtshams 'jog du bcus tshe/ 'ang rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gis byed thabs spyad de/skyon brjod slob gso gnang ba dang / de'i bu bu mo 'am yang na lta skyong bya yul slob grwar mngag tu 'jug dgos/ slob gso btang yang spyod dung bu bu mo'am yang na lta skyong pa slob grwar mi ma ngags na/ gnas tshul gyi lci yang ltar chad pa gcod dgos pa dang / thad kur mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug byas kyang chog rgyal khab kyis 'os 'gan slob gso dang du len pa'i slob ma ra slob yon rtsag rtsig sdud kyi med pa dang / 'os 'gan slob saso la ga bstar gyi slob grwas slob ma'i dpe rin dang 'bri deb kyi rin pa/ mal khang gi rin pa sogs bsdus chog khyim tshang la dka' ngal yod rkyen gyis byis pa slob grwar 'grims mi thub na/ thabs lam dngos spyod pa ste/ dper na re ba'i bzo 'god dam yang na slob zhugs rogs dngul gyi rogs skyor 'og slob grwar 'grims dgos/rgyal khab kyis byis pa tshang ma slob grwar 'gro ba'i thad la 'di lta bu'i do snang byas na/ nga tsho pha ma'am yang na byis pa'i lta skyong pa yin pa'i cha nas/ byis pa tsho'i 'os 'gan slob gso dang len byed pa'i khe dbang srung skyong bya dgos/238

le'u bdun pa/ gong rim la gtug zhu dang khrims gtug byed pa'i skor/(gcig)nga cho zhing pas yig bskur ngo gtug byed par bca' khrims dang khrims srol gyi lungs lung gtso bo gang dag yod mi ser gyis gong rim la zhu gtug byed pa ni gna' nas bzung yod pa cig yin/ krung go gsar bas mi dam ngas yo da tshad kyi bdag po yin pa 'i bo gnas shig gtan khel byas pas/ mang tshogs kyis yig bsku ra ngo gtug byed pa'i bya 'gul gyi nus pa gol chen sngar bas gsal bor byas shing / nga tsho zhing pa ra khrims ltar yig bskur ngo gtug byed pa'i bya 'gul spel ba'i khe dbang dang 'os 'gan gnang ba red/ nga tsho tang gi rabs sasum po'i 'go khrid thun rngo nga gis mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis yi ge bskur te gong gtug zhu bar satsigs mthong byas pa red/ blo mthun ma 'o tse tung gis mi dam ngas kyi 'phrin skyel la nges par du gtsigs ma/thong chen po byed pa dang / mi dmangs kyis yi ge bskur yong bar thag gcod 'os 'tsham byas te/ ma nga tshogs kyi tshul mthun re ba bskang rgyu dang / las don 'di gung khran tang dang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis mi dmangs dang 'brel gtug byed par shugs snon pa'i byed thabs shig tu brtsi ba las/ snang med lho da g.yeng du 'jog pa dang ltos med rgyab skyur byed pa'i dpon nyams ring lugs kyi rnam 'gyur spyad mi chog zhes bton yod/ blo mthun ting zha'o phen gyis gnad la 'khel ba'i sgo nas bstan don/ 6 da lta byung dang 'byung ba'in pa'i gnad don mang po ni mang 2rdo/sa
