mang pos gong rim la gtug zhu byed pa de red la/ de ni tag tag nga tsho'i bya ba don 'khyol ma yong ba dang legs par ma bsgrubs pa las byung ba red mices gsungs pa dang / khong gis sngar bas nan gtan gyis bstan don/ 2 mang tshogs kyi bsam 'char la mnyan pa dang / mang tshogs dang gros mol byas te bya ba bsgrub dgos zer/ khong gis spyod dung sku ngo ma sa mang tshogs kyis ming byang mnyam 'god byas te gong rim la gtug zhu byed pa'i 'phrin yig cig la66dmangs kyi 'dod blor brtsi 'jog byos zhes bton yod/ blo ma thun cang tse min gyis tang yongs la bslab bya gnang ste/ 6 yig bskur ngo gtug gi bya ba ni nga tsho tang dang srid gzhung gis dmangs gtso dar spel du gtong ba dang dam/ngas kyi sanas tshul la zhib dpyad byed pa/ mang tshogs dang 'brel ba byed pa bcang kyi thabs lam gal chen yin zer/ hu'u cin tha'o spyi khyab hru'u ci yin pa'i tang krung dbyang gis mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi yig bskur ngo gtug byed pa'i byed sgo la sngar bas gtsigs mthong chen po byas shing / nga tsho zhing pa spun zla tshos yig bskur ngo gtug byed pa'i bya 'gul spel bar bca' khrims dang khrims srol gyi khungs lu nga gtso bo 'di dag yod de/(1)〈rtsa khrims〉yin/ 〈co khrim sa〉nang / rang rgyal spyi dmangs kyis gtam bshad rang dbang longs su spyad chog pa gtan la phab yod/ bca' khrims steng bshad pa'i gtam bshad rang dbang ni spyi dmangs kyis ngag thog gam yang na yig thog gi rnam pa brgyud de/ rgyal khab dang spyi tshogs kyi gnad don sna tshogs la dmigs nas/ rang dbang sgos rang nyid kyi bsam tshul dang lta tshul brjod pa'i khe dbang der bstan pa yin/ 〈co khrims〉kyi don tshan zhe gcig pa'i nang spyod dung ched du rang rgyal spyi dmangs la rgyal khab kyi las khungs gang zhig dang rgyal khab kyi las byed mi sna su zhig la skyon brjod dang bdī/ /char 'don pa'i khe dbang yo da pa gtan la phab yod pa dang / da

dung kho tsho'i khrims 'gal dang 'gan 'dzol byung ba'i bya spyod zhu 'bul dang zhu gtug dang ther 'don bcas byed dbang yod pa'ang gtan la phab yod/ spyi dmangs kyi zhu 'bul dang zhu gtug ther 'don bcas kyi khe dbang 'gan srung bya ched/ rim pa so so'i rgyal khab las khungs so sos ga sa gang du yig bskur ngo gtug byed sa'i las khungs btsugs te/ ched du mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis yig bskur ngo gtug byed par sne len byed kyin yod/ 〈co khrims〉nang spyi dmangs kyi khe dbang 'di dag thad gtan 'bebs bzos rjes/ yang don tshan nga gcig pa'i nang krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi spyi dmangs kyis rang dbang dang khe dbang longs su spyod skabs/ rgyal khab dang spyi tshogs dang thun mong bcas kyi khe phan dang yang na spyi dmangs ga'an pa'i khrims mthun gyi rang dbang dang khe dbang la gnod 'tshe btang mi chog pagatan la phab yod/ yang gcig bshad na/ nga tsho zhing pa spun zla tshos gtam bshad rang dbang longs su spyod skabs/ rgyal khab kyi bde 'jags la gnod pa'i sgo nas gzhan par ngan skul dang dma' 'bebs/ skur 'debs sogs byed pa'i bya spyod yod mi chog ces pa'o/(2) 2001lo'i slababa'i tshes26nyin te tang gi skabs bco lnga pa'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs drug pa'i steng 'thad pa byung ba'i〈krung gung krung dbyang gi tang gi spyod tshul 'dzugs skrun la shugs snon pa dang bsgyur bcos byed pa'i skor gyi chod don〉las tang yongs la mig sngar dang deng phyin gyi dus skabs shig nang / gcig bsdus sgos tang gi bsam blo'i spyod tshul dang slob srol/ bya ba'i spyod tshul dang mgo khrid pa'i spyod tshul/ las byed pa'i 'tsho ba'i spyod tshul bcas phyogs kyi gnad don 'bur don thag gcod pa dang /smyo rgyun srung brgyad dang ngo rgol brgyad sgo kun nas lag len mthar phyin bya dgos pa'i blang bya bton yod/ mang tshogs dang 'brel ba byed pa~X sdum

lugs 'thus tshang du gtong ba ni gnas tshul gsar ba'i 'og tang gi mang tshogs lam phyogs rgyun srung byed pa'i gnad don sal chen zhig yin pas/ spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul dang dmangs kyi 'dod blo tshur snang byed sa'i thabs lam rgya bskyed dgos pa dang / tang srid 'go khrid las khungs kyis mang tshogs sne len nyin mo'i lam lugs rgyun srung byas te/ 'go khrid las byed pas rang byengos kyis byig bskur ngo gtug du yong ba thag gcod bya dgos :zhes nan sa ba/ k+ta mid da/ma ngas mang tshogs kyis yig bskur ngo gtug byed pa'i lugs mthun khe dbang dngos gnas srung skyong bya ba dang / yig bskur ngo gtug gi sgrig la ma la srung skyong bya ched/ 1996lo'i zla1pa'i tshes1nyin/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi bka' rgya a/nga185nang〈yig bskur ngo gtug byed pa'i skor gyi srol yig〉bkram pa dang / yig bskur ngo gtug byed pa 'i srol yigal bsdoms pas le'u ba'i dang don tshan bzhi cu zhi ba'i yod la/ yig bskur ngo gtus byed mkhan gyi khe dbang dang 'os 'gan gtan 'bebs byas pa dang /yig bskur ngo gtug bya ba'i rtsa don dang mi dmangs mang tshogs zhu gtug byed du yong ba dang len dang bskur yong ba'i yi ge thas gcod pa/ yig bskur ngo gtug bya ba'i las khungs dang mi snar bya dga' dang chad gcod byed pa bcas gsal bor byas yod/(4) rgyal khab kyi las khungs dang srid gzhung gi sgrig srol te/ dper na/ rgyal khab cing las pu'u yi〈ling las thad kyi yig bskur ngo gtug skor gyi gtan 'bebs〉dang rgyal khab khor yug srung skyong cu'u yi〈khor yug skor gyi yig bskur ngo gtug byed thabs〉 rgyal khongs thon khungs pu'u yi〈rgyal khongs thon khungs skor gyi yig bskur ngo gtug gtan 'bebs〉dang hran tung zhing che/ snro/yig bskur ngo satug skor gyi gtan 'bebs〉〉sogs/

(gnyis)nga cho zhing pas yig bskur ngo gtug gi khe dbang gang dag longs su spyad chog gam/〈〈rtsa khrims〉〉dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi〈yig bskur ngo gtug srol byig/snar na/ nga tsho zhing par yig bskur ngo gtug thad kyi khe dbang 'di dag da (/1)srid 'dzin las khungs dang de'i las byed mi snar skyon brjod dang bsam shā/rnyi lda do/rjordo/ las khungs kyi las byed mi sna'i khrims 'gal dang 'gan 'dzol byung ba'i bya spyod ther 'don dang mtshang 'byin byed pa/(3)rang nyid kyi lugs mthun khe dbang la gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i bya spyod zhu gtug byed pa/(4)yig bskur ngo gtug thad gtan la phab pa'i sgrig lam ltar thag gcod las khungs kyis yig bskur ngo gtug bya ba thag gcod pa dang lan skyel ba/ bskyar bsher byed pa bcas bya dgos/(5)bca' khrims dang khrims srol las gnang ba'i khe dbang ga'an dag(gsum)nga cho zhing pas yig bskur ngo gtug sge 'os 'gan gang dag lag bstar bya dgos/yig bskur ngo gtug byed par gsham gsal 'os 'gan 'ga' yod de/(1)rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims dang bca' khrims / khrims srol dang sgrig sro la bcas brtsi srung bya rgyu dang /(2)gnas tshul ngo ma tshur snang byas pa las/ don dngos 'khyog bzo dang 'khyog brjod byas mi rung ba dang / ga'an par ston 'dzugs dang gnod 'tshe gtong mi rung /(3)yig bskur ngo gtug gi sgrig la ma brtsi srung byed pa dang /24/da

'dzin las khungs kyis bca' khrims dang khrims srol/ sgrig srol dang srid jus bcas dang mthun pa'i sgo nas thag gcod par brtsi 'jog bya rgyu/(bzhinang tsho zhing pas yig bskur ngo gtug byed pa'i bya 'gul spel ba'i khrod gtan 'bebs gang dag brtsi srung bya dgos/nga tsho zhing pa spun zla tshos yig bskur ngo gtug byed pa'i bya 'gul spel k+ta'i khrod nges par du gsham gsal gtan 'bebs 'ga' brtsi srung bya dgos (1)tshang ma mnyam du 'dzoms te zing cha slong ba dang las khungs la phog thug gtong ba/ rlangs 'khor bkag 'gog byed pa dang 'grim 'grul 'gog pa bcas byed mi rung /(2)las khungs kyi sgo nang nas 'jam sdod dang byang bu ston pa/ 'phred 'gel sbyar tshig 'gel pa/ bsgrags yig gtor ba/ yig chen tshags par sogs sbyar ba'am 'ding mi rung /(3)nyen yod dngos rdzas dang 'gas rdzas/ rtsis sprod do dam byas pa'i 'phrul sgul sogs 'khyer nas sne len khang du yong mi rung /(4)rgan pa dang nad pa/ dbang po skyon can dang byis pa dmar 'byar sne len byed sa'i las khungs su bskyur bzhag byas mi chogasgo (5)spya zin byed sa nas nam slong ba dang las khungs kyi sgo nang du nam nga ba( gā| sne le/ byed mis gzhung don lag bstar byed par 'gog rkyen bzo ba dang / sne len byed mir rtog dra slong ba dang dma' 'bebs byed pa/'jigs skrag skul ba dang gcar rdung byed pa bcas byas mi chog(7)sne len byas tshar rjes/ gzhung las khang du 'dug pa dang yang na sne le/ ༵༵ gi gzhung sger gyi rgyu dngos chag grum tu btang mi chog

(lnga)nga tsho zhing pas khrims ltar gong rim la gtug zhu byed par phyogs gang dag nas srung skyong thob bam/yig bskur ngo gtug byed pa'i lugs mthun khe dbang srung skyong bya ched/rgyalasrid spyi khyab khang gi〈yig bskur ngo gtug skor gyi srol yig〉las yig bsdir ༵ ga/ga pa'i khe dbang srung skyong thad gsham gsal gtan 'bebs ba sa (13 rim/ pa so so'i srid 'dzin las khungs kyis nges par du yig bskur ngo gtug bya ba legs par bsgrub pa dang / yi ge yong ba dang ngo gtug tu yong bar thag gcod nan mo bya ba/ mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi bsam 'char dang 'os gros dang re bar nyan pa dang / mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi lta skul dang len bcas byas te/ hur thag gis mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs gang legs zhu rgyu/(2)rim pa so so'i srid 'dzin las khungs kyi 'gan khur mi snas yig bskur gal chen 'don klog dang ngo gtug tu yong ba gal chen sne len byed pa dang / yig bskur ngo gtug bya ba'i khrod kyi gnad don zhib 'jug byas te ljag gcod pa/ yig bskur ngo gtug byed pa'i bya bar zhib bsher dang khrid na bstulha ṣ+ṭṛ sna ri/ ma pa yan gyi mi dam ngas srid gzhung so so dang de'i khongs gtogs kyi sde khag so sos bya bar phan pa dang yig bskur ngo gtug par bde ba'i rtsa don ltar/ yig bskur ngo gtug bya bar 'gan khur ba'i las khungs sam mi sna gtan khel byas te/ bye brag gi yig bskur ngo gtug bya ba thag gcod shāka (3 nā spyu raso sbyi/ srid 'dzin las khungs dang de'i las byed mi snas yig bskur ngo gtug bya ba bsgrubs na/ nges par du las 'gan brtsi srung dang bya ba drang ga'ag gis sgrub pa/ 'gan 'khri gsal 'byed byed pa/ ༵ /da

yang dag byed pa bcas dang / dus thog dang 'os 'tsham dang yang dag bcas kyi sgo nas thag gcod pa las/ rang 'gan gzhan dkri dang sla bcos byed pa/'gor 'gyangs byed pa bcas byas mi chog(5)yig bskur ngo gtug thag gcod ma khan gyi la sa byed mi sna dang yig bskur ngo gtug bya ba'i rnam grangs sam yang na yig bskur ngo gtug pa'i bar la thad kur gnod phan gyi 'brel ba yo da na/ don bya de la sa g.yol dgos/(6)srid 'dzin las khungs dang de'i la sa byed mi snas yig bskur ngo gtug bya ba thag gcod pa'i go rim khrod/ ther 'don dang mtshang 'byin dang zhu gtug bcas byas pa'i yig cha dang 'brel yo da kyi gnas tshul phyir bsgrags pa'am yang na ther 'don dang mtshang 'byin dang zhu gtug bcas bya yul gyi mi sna dang sde tshan la brgyud sprod byas mi chog(7)rtsa 'dzugs gang zhig dang mi sger su zhig yin rung yig bskur ngo gtug par btsan gnon dang rdung rjes byed pa dang / gnod 'tshe gtong ba bcas byas mi chog(8)yig bskur ngo gtug pas bton pa'i 'os gros dang bsam 'char ram yang na khrims 'gal bya spyod ther 'don dang mtshang 'byin byas pa des rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas sam yang na rgyal khab las khungs kyi bya ba bsgyur bcos dang spyi tshogs kyi spyi pa'i khe phan srung skyong bcas byed par dge mtshan ldan na/ 'brel yod srid 'dzin las khungs sam yang na sde tshan gyis bya dga' gnang dgos/(drug)nga cho zhing pa srun zla cho zhang srid gzhung gis btsan thabs rang bzhin gyis ma dngul rub bsdus dang cha gses rgyag par mi 'thad na ji ltar bya/zhang srid gzhung gis btsan thabs rang bzhin gyis ma dngul rub bsdus daX ༵ gses rgyag pa'i bya spyod la mi 'thad na/ nga tsho cing pa spun zla chos sngon

la rdzong rim pa yan gyi srid 'dzin las khungs la srid 'dzin bskyar gros bya rgyu'i re ba bton chog gal te rdzong rim pa yan gyi srid 'dzin las khungs kyis srid 'dzin bskyar gros byas te thas bcad par spyod dung yang mi 'thad na/ mi dmangs khrim/sa khang la zhu gtug byed pa dang / mi dmangs khrims khang gis nges par dang len bya dgos/(bdun)ci zhig la srid 'dzin bskyar gros zer ram/srid 'dzin bskyar gros zhes pa ri spyi dmangs dang khrims mi dang rtsa 'dzugs gzhan gli bcas kyis srid 'dzin las khungs kyi bye brag gi srid 'dzin khrims 'brel bya spyod kyis kho tsho'i 'u gas mthun khe dbang la gnod 'tshe btang bar 'dod de/ bca' khrims dang khrims srol gtan 'bebs byas pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs la yang bskyar gros 'ib byed pa'i re 'dun zhus shing / re zhu 'di thag gcod pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs kyis khrims ltar rtsad zhib byed pa ma zad thag gcod pa'i bya 'gul der bstan pa yin/ bskyar gros las khungs kyis 'og rim srid 'dzin las khungs kyi bye brag gi srid 'dzin khrims 'brel bya spyod kyi don dngos mi gsal ba dang bca' khrims kyi ga'i 'dzin sa nor ba/ khrims bkod 'gan 'khri lag bstar ma byas pa/ 'gan nus gang byung du spyad pa/ khrims bkod sgrig lam dang 'gal ba/ ma ngon gsal gyis tshul dang mi mthun pa sogs spyi dmangs dang khrims mi/ rtsa 'dzugs gzhan pa bcas la shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs yod pa shes tshe/ de'i bye brag gi srid 'dzin khrims 'brel bya spyod med par bzo ba dang bsgyur bcos byed pa'am yang na yang bskyar bzo ba dang / khrims ltar yo bsrang byed dgos pa bcas kyi bka' phab chog gal te bskyar gros zhib bsher byed pa'i khrod bye brag gi srid 'dzin khrim sa 'brel bya spyod kyis gzhir bzung ba'i gtan 'bebs de khrims 'gal lam yang na tshul dang mi mthun na/ khrims ltar med par2 /spyang

ba'am yang na dbang ldan las khungs la brgyud sprod byas te yo bsrang ngam yang na thag gcod byed du bcug ste/ spyi dmangs dang khrims mi/ rtsa 'dzugs ga'an pa bcas kyi 'u gas mthun khe dbang srung skyong byas chog srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi bya spyod tshad ldan du gtong ba dang / srid 'dzin bskyar gros lag bsta ra byed par 'gan srung bya ched/ 1994lo'i zla10ba'i tshes1nyin nas bzung / rang rgyal gyi〈srid 'dzin bskyar gros skor gyi bca' khrims〉lag bstar byas pa red/(brgyad)nga cho zhing pa spun zla chos srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhus pa de khrims gtug byas pa yin nam/srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhus pa ni khrims gtug byas pa min te/ de ni srid 'dzin bskyar gros de srid 'dzin zhu gtug dang khyad par yod pa'isrid 'dzin rgud skyob kyi lam lugs shig yin pas so/ spyi dmangs dang khrims mi/ rtsa 'dzugs gzhan pa bcas kyis srid 'dzin las khungs dang srid 'dzin las khungs kyi las byed mi sna'i bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod des kho tsho'i lugs mthun khe dbang la gnod pa thebs par 'dod de/ gong rim gyi srid 'dzin las khungs la re 'dun zhus pa dang / gong rim gyi srid 'dzin las khungs kyis dang len byed pa dang thag gcod pa'i bya 'gul zhig yin/gong rim srid 'dzin las khungs kyis gnas tshul mi 'dra bar gzhigs nas/so so thag gcod mi 'dra ba byas pa ste/ dper na bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod kyi don dngos gsal zhing bden dpang yang dag pa/ spyad pa'i khungs lung yang dag pa/ sgrig lam lugs dang mthun pa/ nang don 'os 'tsham yin pa bcas yin tshe/ gong rim srid 'dzin las khungs kyis thag gcod par srung skyong byed pa dang / yang dper na bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod de srid 'dzin ladī ༵༵sa kyis khrims bkod 'gan 'khri lag bstar ma byas pa'i khongs su

gtogs na/ gong rim srid 'dzin las khungs kyis thag gcod pa dang / der dus yun nges can zhig nang khrims bkod 'gan 'khri lag bstar byed pa'i bka' phab rgyu/ dper na bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod 'di don dngos mi gsal ba dang bden dpang gis mi 'dang ba/ spyad pa'i khungs lung nor 'khrul can yin pa/ khrims bkod sgris lam dang 'gal ba bcas kyi khongs su gtogs pa dang / yang tshad las brgal te 'gan dbang spyad pa dang 'gan dbang gang byung du spyad pa/ bye brag gi srid 'dzin lag bstar byas pa'i bya spyod mngon gsal gyis tshul dang mi mthun pa bcas kyi khongs su gtogs tshe/gong rim gyis bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod med par bzo ba dang bsgyur bcos byed pa'i thag gcod rgyu/ gal te spyi dmangs dang khrims mi/ rtsa 'dzugs gzhan pa bcas kyis srid 'dzin bskyar gros byas te thag bcad pa'ang nor 'khrul red 'dod na/ khrims ltar mi dmangs khrims khang la srid 'dzin zhu gtug byas chog la/ mtshams 'dir bslebs tshe spyod gzod khrims gtug byed par brtsi ba yin/(dgu)zhang grong srid gzhung la srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi dbang cha yod dam/ 〈srid 'dzin bskyar gros skor gyi bca' khrims〉nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs ni khrims ltar srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi 'gan 'khri lag bstar byed pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs yin pa dang / srid 'dzin ma la ga nang khul gyi lta skul lam lugs shig yin pas/srid 'dzin las khungs kho nas spyod gzod bskyar gros kyi 'gan 'khur dgos/rdzong rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung nas rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi sde khag tshang mar bskyar gros dbang cha yod pa'i bskyar gros las khungs yod pas/ khrims ltar rim pa so so dang rigs sna tshogs kyi srid 'dzin las khungs kyi srid2 ༵༵na

bya spyod lag bstar dang khyab gdal du gtong bar 'gan srung dang lta skul byas chog gzhan pa'i dbang cha'i las khungs dang srid tang / sde tshogs rtsa 'dzugs/ khe don las khungs sogs ni bskyar gros la sa khungs su gyur mi thub/'ang grong srid gzhung ni ga'i rim rim pa'i srid gzhung mas yin pa'i cha nas/bskyar gros 'gan nus med/(bcu)ci zhig la zhib phra'i gi srid 'dzin bya spyod zer/'ib phra'i gi srid 'dzin bya spyod ni rgyal khab srid 'dzin la sa khungs dang bca' khrims/ khrims sro la bcas las dbang gnang ba'i rtsa 'dzugs kyis srid 'dzin do dam dbang cha lag bstar byed pa'i go rim khrod/ ched dmigs mi dang ched dmigs bya bar kha gtad de sgrub pa'i bya spyod la zer/ bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod ni srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re ba bton chog min tshad 'jal byed kyi tshad gzhi zhig yin la/ gal te rgyal lab srid 'dzin las khungs dang bca' khrims/ khrims srol bcas la sa dbang gnang ba'i rtsa 'dzugs kyis bton pa'i srid 'dzin bya spyod de bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod yin te/do bdag mi 'thad na/ srid 'dzin bskyar gros byed pa'i re 'dun zhus chogagal te bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod min tshe/ do bdag mi 'thad na'ang srid 'dzin bskyar gros byed pa'i re 'dun zhus mi chog(bcu gcig)nga cho zhing pas bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod gang dag la srid 'dzin bskyar gros byed pa'i de 'dun zhus chog gam/〈〈srid 'dzin bskyar gros skor gyi bca' khrim/sa〉〉kyi don tshan drug pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ gsham gsal gnas tshul gras kyi gcig yod tshe/ spyi dmangs dang khrims mi/ rtsa 'dzugs gzhan pa bcas kyis srid 'dzin bskyar gros byed pa'i re 'dun zhus chog25/1)srid 'dzin las khungs kyis tha tshig bsgrags pa dang chad pa bcad

pa/ khrims 'gal sgos thob bya gzhung bzhes byas pa dang khrims dang mi mthun pa'i rgyu dngos gzhung bzhes byas pa/ thon skyed dang thon snyelas kyi mtshams 'jog pa'i bka' phab pa/ chog 'thus dpa nga yig gnas skabs len pa'am yang na phyir bsdus pa/ lag khyer gnas skabs len pa'am phyir bsdus pa/srid 'dzin bzung nyar byas pa sogs srid 'dzin chad gcod kyi thag bcad riblor mi 'bab pa dang /(2)srid 'dzin las khungs kyis mi lus rang dbang la chod 'dzin byas pa'am yang na rgyu nor la rgya btab pa dang bkag nyar byas pa/ bsdams bcad byas pa sogs srid 'dzin gyi btsan thabs rang bzhin gyi byed thabs dang thag bcad blor mi 'bab pa/(3)srid 'dzin las khungs kyis 'brel yod chog 'thus dpang yig dang lag khyer/ rig pa'i dpang yig thob thang dpang yig sogs dpang yig bsgyur ba dang bar mtshams 'jog pa/ rtsis med du gtong ba bcas kyi thag bcad blor mi 'bab pa/(4)srid 'dzin las khungs kyis sa zhing dang gter khungs/ chu rgyun/nags tshal/ ri bo/ rtsa thang / sa rgod/ gram stong / rme tsho khongs sogs rang byung thon khungs kyi bdag dbang ngam yang na bkol dbang ngos 'dzin thad thag gcod byas pa blor mi 'bab pa/(5)srid 'dzin las khungs kyis lugs mthun gyi gnyer skyong bdag dbang la btsan gnod thebs par 'dod pa/(6)srid 'dzin las khungs kyis zhing las 'gan len gan rgya bsgyur bcos dang rtsis med du btang bas/ de'i lugs mthun khe dbang la btsan gnod thebs par 'dod pa/(7)srid 'dzin las khungs kyis khrims 'gal sgrig 'gal dang ga~X sbyong

du ma dngul rub bsdus dang rgyu dngos bsdu len byed pa/ gron dngul cha gses rgyag pa'am yang na khrims 'gal sgos 'os 'gan gzhan pa lag bstar byed pa'i re ba bton par 'dod pa/(8)khrims bkod kyi cha rkyen dang mthun par 'dod de/ srid 'dzin las khungs la chog 'thus dpang yig dang lag khyer dpang yig rig pa'i dpang yig thob thang dpang yig sogs dpa nga yig sprod ba'i re 'dun zhus pa dang / yang na srid 'dzin las khungs la 'brel yod don byar chog mchan 'god pa dang tho 'god byed pa'i re 'dun zhus par/ srid 'dzin las khungs kyis khrims ltar ma bsgrubs pa/(9)srid 'dzin las khungs la mi lus khe dbang dang rgyu nor khe dbang /slob gso thob pa'i khe dbang srung skyong byed pa'i khrims bkod 'gan 'khri lag bstar byed pa'i re 'dun zhus kyang / srid 'dzin las khungs kyis khrims ltar lag bstar ma byas pa/(10)gzigs skyong gron dngul dang spyi tshogs 'gan bcol ma dngul lam yang na ma mtha'i 'tsho ba'i 'gan srung gron dngul bcas sprod ba'i re 'dun zhus kyang / srid 'dzin las khungs kyis khrims ltar gtong sprod ma byas pa/ (11)srid 'dzin las khungs kyi bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod gzhan pas lugs mthun khe dbang la btsan gnod thebs par 'dod rigs/(bcu gnyis) srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhu ba'i dus tshad gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/〈〈srid 'dzin bskyar gros skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ gal te nga tsho zhing pa spun zla tshos bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod kyiX ༵nga nyid kyi lugs mthun khe dbang la btsan gnod thebs par 'dod na/

rang nyid kyis bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod 'di shes pa'i nyin nas bzung ste nyin60yi nang tshun du srid 'dzin bskyar gros byed pa'i re 'dun zhu dgos/gal te bca' khrims dang khrims srol gzhan pas gtan 'bebs byas pa'i re zhu dus tshad nyin60las thung na/ tshang ma nyin60ltar lag bstar bya dgos/gal te bca' khrims gzhan pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa'i re zhu dus tshad de nyin60las ring na/ bca' khrims de'i gtan 'bebs ltar lag bstar bya dgos/ dper na ched khe skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan zhe gsum nang /ru re 'dun zhu mkhan gyis ched khe cu'u yis re zhu phyir slog pa'i thag bcad blor mi 'bab na/ rang nyid la brda tho 'byor ba'i nyin nas nyin gsum nang tshun du/ ched khe bskyar bsher u yon lhan khang la bskyar bsher byed pa'i re 'dun zhus chog pa gtan la phab yod/ gnas tshul 'di lta bu'i 'og bskyar gros re zhu'i dus tshad de zla gsum nang yin pa las/ nyin60min/ gsham gsal dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul la thug tshe/ re zhu'i dus tshad de rgyun bsring chog pa ste/ gcig ni 'gog thabs bral ba'i rkyen ngan te/ dper na sa yom dang chu log byung ba sogs rang byung gnod 'tshe'i bgegs rkyen la thug ste/ khrims bkod kyi re zhu dus chad 'gor 'gyangs byas pa/ gnyis ni tshul mthun gyi gnas lugs yod pa ste/ dper na do bdag la nad lci mo phog pa'am yang na 'grim 'grul gyi bar chad sogs rgyu rkyen gyi dbang gis/ do bdag gis bskyar gros byed pa'i re zhu 'don thabs bral bas/ khrims bkod kyi re zhu dus yun 'gor 'gyangs byas pa/ gong gi gnas tshul la/ re 'dun zhu ma khan gyis 'gor 'byangs byas zin pa'i dus yun kha gsab byas chog pa ste/ rang nyid kyi bgegs rkyen med par bzos pa'i nyin nas mu mthud du khrims bkod kyi re zhu dus yun rtsis rgyag rgyu/253

mi (bcu gsum)srid 'dzin bskyar gros nang zhugs pa'i mi ni gang dag na/ srid 'dzin bskyar gros nang zhugs pa'i mi zhes pa ni srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyi rtsa 'dzugs 'og khrims ltar srid 'dzin bskyar gros bya 'gul nang zhugs pa'i re 'dun zhu mkhan dang re 'dun zhu yul/ gang zas gsum pa dang las tshab pa bcas la bstan pa yin/(1)re 'dun zhu mkhan/ srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhus pa'i spyi dmangs dang khrims mi/ rtsa 'dzugs gzhan pa bcas ni re 'dun zhu ma/khan yin/ srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhu dbang yod pa'i spyi dmangs tshe las 'das tshe/ de'i gnyen tshan gyis srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhus chog srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhu dbang yo da pa'i spyi dam ngas la dam ngas don 'gul skyod kyi nus pa med mkhan(dper na rang lo 10la ma son pa'i mi'am yang na spyo nad byung mi)nam/ yang na dmangs don 'gul skyod kyi nus pa tshod 'dzin byas yod mkhan 'ig yin tshe/ de'i khrims bkod kyi la sa tshab pas de'i tshab byas te srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhus chog srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhu dbang yod pa'i khrims mi'am yang na rtsa 'dzugs gzhan pas mtshams ba'ag tshe/ de'i khe dbang dang len byed pa'i khrim sa mi'abyi yang na rtsa 'dzugs gzhan pas srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun shāka ba/ mi gsum pa/ de ni srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhus pa'i bye brag gi srid 'dzin spyod tshul dang phan gnod kyi 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin pas/ rang nyid kyi lugs mthun khe dbang la srung skyong bya ched bskyar gros nang zhugs pa'i spyi dmangs dang khrims mi/ rtsa 'dzugs gzhan pa bcas la brdo/ ༵ yin/ bar mi gsum pa bskyar gros nang zhugs na/ srid 'dzin las

khungs kyis phyogs so so'i bsam 'char la khyon yongs nas mnyan thub par phan pa yod pas/ srid 'dzin rtsod gleng yang dag sgos thag gcod pa yin/(3)re 'dun zhu yul/ de ni bye brag gi srid 'dzin spyod tshul bton pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs 'a bstan pa yin/(4)las tshab pa/ de ni srid 'dzin bskyar gros skor gyi bca' khrims nang re 'dun zhu mkhan dang bar mi gsum pas las tshab par mngag bcol byas chog pa gtan la phab yod/(bcu bzhi)srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhu stangs thad gtan 'bebs gang dag yod/nga tsho zhing pa spun zla tshos srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhu ba'i khe dbang longs su spyod na/ yig thog nas re 'dun zhus chog la/ ngag thog nas re 'dun zhus kyang chog re 'dun zhu stangs 'di gnyis la 'dra mnyam gyi bca' khrims nus pa yod/ ga' te yig thog rnam pas re 'dun zhus tshe/nges par du gsham gyi nang don gtso bo 'dus dgos te/(1)re 'dun zhu mkhan gyi gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul/ dper na re 'dun zhu ma/khan gyi ming dang lo tshod/ sdod gnas sogs /(2)re 'dun bya yul gyi ming dang sdod gnas sogs kyi gnas tshul/(3)bskyar gros byed pa'i 'dod blo zhu ba ste/ re 'dun zhu mkhan gyi re bar bskyar gros byas pa brgyud dmigs yul gang dag 'grub dgos pa de yin la/cho dbyer na bye brag gi srid 'dzin spyod tshul rtsis med du gtong ba'am bsgyu ra ba sa (4/ rnyi/da 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhu ba'i don dngos dang rgyu rkyen dang dus tshod bcas te/ dper na bye brag gi srid 'dzin spyod tshul gyi dus tshod dang sa gnas dang don dngos bcas dang / bye brag gi srid 'dzi~X spyad

tshul gyi bca' khrims khungs lung rtsis med du gtong ba dang bsgyur bcos byed pa'i re ba 'don pa/ re 'dun zhu mkhan gyis bye brag gi srid 'dzin spyod tshul gyi dus tshod dang bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhus pa'i dus tshod shes dgos/ gal te ngag thog nas re 'dun zhu na/ srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs la song nas ngag thog rnam pas re 'dun zhu dgos pa dang / ngag thog gi re zhu de srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyi las byed mi snas yul dngos nas zin thor 'god rgyu/ bskyar gros re zhu zin thor bkod pa'i nang don gtso bo de yig thog rnam pa'i re zhu dang 'dra mtshungs yin dgos/(bco lnga)srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi las khungs spyir btang sa gnas gang du 'dzugs dgos sam/srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs de srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs su khrims srol bya ba 'gan khur mkhan gyi las khungs (dper na rdzong srid gzhung khrims srol cu'u)kyis tshab byed dgos pa'am yang na khrims srol bya ba 'gan khur ma khan gyi las khungs kyis bye brag gis bskyar gros bya ba'i 'gan 'khur dgos/ bskyar gros las khungs kyis bye brag gis bskyar gros bya ba sgrub mkhan khur te/ bskyar gros gyod don la zhib bsher bya rgyu/ bskyar gros las khungs ni nang khul bya ba'i las khungs yin pas/ rang rkya thub pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs kyi khrims mi'i go gnas med pa dang / rang nyid kyi ming thog nas srid 'dzin spyod tshul 'dzin mi thub la/ des gtan khel byas pa'i bskyar gros zhib bsher bsam 'char de srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyi 'gan khur mi sna 'thad pa byung ba'am yang na thun mong gi gros bsdur las 'thad pa byung ba brgyud/ srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyi ming thog nas bskyar gros thag gcod bya rgyu/256

(bcu drug)nga cho zhing pas srid 'dzin bskyar gros byed pa'i re 'dun zhu bar gron dngul spyod dgos sam/srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyis srid 'dzin bskyar gros re 'dun dang len byed skabs/ re 'dun zhu mkhan gyi lag nas gron dngul ci yang bsdu mi chog srid 'dzin bskyar gros bya 'gul thad mkho ba'i 'gro gron tshang ma rang re'i las khungs kyi srid 'dzin 'gro gron nang ba'ag ste/ rang rim pa'i nor srid kyis 'gan srung bya rgyu/(bcu bdun) rdzong srid gzhung gi bye brag gi srid 'dzin spyod tshul de blor mi 'bab na gang la song nas srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi de 'dun zhu dgos/sa gnas kyi rim pa so so'i mi dmangs srid gzhung gi bye brag gi srid 'dzin spyod tshul de blor mi 'bab na/ gong rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung la srid 'dzin bskyar gros byed pa'i re 'dun zhu dgos/ 'dir bshad pa ni/gal te nga tsho 'ing pa spun zla tshos srid gzhung gi bye brag gi srid 'dzin spyod tshul blor mi 'bab na/ nges par grong khyer(tis) mi dmangs srid gzhung gi bye brag gi srid 'dzin bskyar gros bya ba sgrub pa'i khrims lugs cu'u la srid 'dzin bskyar gros byed pa'i re 'dun zhu dgos/(bco brgyad)srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhu ba dang srid 'dzin zhu gtuḥ sbyod pa gnyis mnyam gcig tu sgrub chog gam/( 1)spyi dmangs dang khrims mi/ rtsa 'dzugs gzhan pa bcas kyis srid 'dzin bskyar gros byed pa'i re 'dun zhus pa dang / srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyis khrims ltar dang len byas zin tshe/ khrims bkod kyi srid 1dzin bskyar gros dus yun nang mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug byas mi ga 257

(2)spyi dmangs dang khrims mi/ rtsa 'dzugs gzhan pa bcas kyis mi dmangs khrims khang la srid 'dzin zhu gtug byas pa dang / mi dmangs khrims khang gis khrims ltar dang len byas zin tshe/ srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhus mi chog(3)spyi dmangs dang khrims mi/ rtsa 'dzugs gzhan pa bcas kyis srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyi dang len mi byed pa'i thag gcod yi ge 'byor nyin nam yang na srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi dus yun longs pa'i nyin nas nyin15na~X tshun du/ khrim sa ltar mi dmangs khrims khang la srid 'dzin zhu gtug byas /bcu dgu)srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhus rjes srid 'dzin bsgyur gros las khungs kyis dang len byed min thag gcod pa'i dus yun nyin du nazlo sna 'a/ dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyis srid 'dzin bskyar gros byed pa'i re 'dun 'byor rjes/ nges par du nyin5nang zhib bsher byas te/ 〈srid 'dzin bskyar gros skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi gtan 'bebs dang mi mthun pa'i re 'dun yin na/ gtan nas dang len mi byed pa ma zad/ yig thog nas re 'dun zhu mkhan la brda rgyag pa dang / 〈srid 'dzin bskyar gros skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi gtan 'bebs dang mthun mod/ 'on kyang rang re'i las khungs kyis dang len byed pa'i khongs su mi gtogs pa'i srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun yin na/ re 'dun zhu mkhan la brda brgyab te 'brel yod srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs la re 'dun zhu ru 'jug dgos/(nyi shu) nga tsho zhing pa'i srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun de srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyis dang len mi byed na dzi ltar bya/25sbyi dmangs dang khrims mi/ rtsa 'dzugs gzhan pa bcas kyis khrims

ltar srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhus pa dang / srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyis tshul mthun gyi rgyu rkyen ci yang med pa'i sgo nas dang len ma byas na/ gong rim srid 'dzin las khungs kyis nges par du dang len byed pa'i bka' phab pa dang / dgos gal la thug tshe/ gong rim srid 'dzin las khungs kyis kyang thad kur dang len byas chog(nyer gcig)nga cho zhing pas zhang srid gzhung gis gron dngul gang byung du bsdus pa blor ma babs par srid 'dzin bskyar gros byed pa'i re 'dun zhus rjes zhang srid gzhung gis gtan 'bebs ltar khungs lung mi spyod na ji ltar bya/〈〈srid 'dzin bskyar gros skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉kyi don tshan nyer brgyad pa'i nang / 66de 'dun zhu yul gyis gtan 'bebs ltar yig thog gi dris lan mi 'don pa dang / dang thog bton pa'i bye brag gi srid 'dzin spyod tshul gyi bden dpang dang khungs lung / 'brel yod kyi rgyu cha gzhan pa bcas 'don sprod mi byed na/ bye brag gi srid 'dzin spyod tshul 'dir bden dpang dang khungs lung med par brtsis te/ bye brag gi srid 'dzin spyod tshul 'di rtsis med du gtong ba'i thag gcod rgyu zhes gtan la phab yod/ gtan 'bebs 'dir ga'igs na/ gal te nga tsho 'ing pas 'ang srid gzhung gis gron dngul gang byung du bsdu ba'i srid 'dzin spyod tshul de blor ma babs par/ srid 'dzin bskyar gros byed pa'i re 'dun zhus rjes/ zhang srid gzhung gis gtan 'bebs ltar dang thog gron dngul bsdu ba'i thad bton pa'i srid 'dzin spyod tshul gyi khungs lung 'don sprod mi byed na/ zhang srid gzhung gi gron bsdu bya spyod de khungs lung med par brtsis te/ zhang srid gzhung gi gron bsdu spyod tshul rtsis med du gtong ba'i thag gcod rgyu/259

(nyer gnyis)nga cho zhing pas srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhu ba dang dus mtshungs su srid 'dzin skyin tshab spyod pa'i re ba brtan na thag gcod ji ltar bya dgos/〈〈srid 'dzin bskyar gros skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉kyi don tshan nyer dgu pa'i nang / re 'dun zhu mkhan gyis srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhu skabs/ srid 'dzin skyin tshab sprod pa'i re ba'ang zhus chog pa dang / srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyis rgyal khab kyi skyin tshab sprod pa'i bca' khrims kyi 'brel yod gtan 'bebs dang mthun pa'i sgos nges par skyin tshab sprod dgos pa dang / bye brag gi srid 'dzin spyod tshul rtsis med du gtong ba dang bsgyur bcos byed pa'am yang na bye brag gi srid 'dzin spyod tshul de khrims dang 'gal bar gtan khel byed skabs/ nges par du re 'dun zhu yul gyis khrims ltar skyin tshab sprod dgos pa thag gcod dgos/ re 'dun zhu mkhan gyis srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi re 'dun zhu skabs srid 'dzin gyi skyin tshab sprod pa'i re 'dun zhus med na/ srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyis khrims ltar dngul chad rtsis med du gtong ba'am yang na bsgyur bcos byed pa'i thag mi gcod pa dang / khrims dang 'gal nas ma dngul rub bsdu dang rgyu dngos gzhung bzhes byed pa/ gron dngul cha gses rgyag pa dang rgyu nor bkag sdom dang 'phri gcog bsdams bcad sogs bye brag gi spyod tshul rtsis med du gtong skabs/ re 'dun zhu yul gyis rgyu nor phyir sprod pa dang / rgyu nor bkag sdom dang 'phri gcog bsdams bcad bcas byed pa'i byed thabs med par bzo ba'am yang na de 'brel gyi rin 'bab gyi skyin tshab sprod pa bcas kyi bka' phab rgyu/(nyer gsum) srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyis srid 'dzin bsdushā /sa byed pa'i dus yun gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/

(srid 'dzin bskyar gros skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan so gcig pa'i nang / srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyis nges par du re 'dun dang len byas pa'i nyin nas nyin60nang tshun du srid 'dzin bskyar gros byas te thag sacod dgos mod/ 'on kyang bca' khrims nang srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi dus yun de nyin60las nyung ba gtan la phab pa phud/ gnas tshul rnyog 'dzin yin te/ gtan la phab pa'i dus yun nang srid 'dzin bskyar gros byas nas thag gcod mi thub na/ srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyi 'gan khur mi snas chog mchan bkod pa brgyud/ 'os 'tshams sgos yun bsring chog pa ma zad/ re 'dun zhu mkhan dang re 'dun zhu yul la brda rgyag dgos/ yin na'ang yun sring dus yun de ches ring na'ang nyin30las bzal mi chog(nyer bzhi)srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyis srid 'dzin bskyar gros thag gcod par gtan 'bebs ji ltar byas yod/srid 'dzin bskyar gros las khungs kyis srid 'dzin bskyar gros thag gcod par nges par du srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi thas gcod yig cha bzo ba ma zad/ tham ka yang brgyag dgos/ srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi thag gcod yig cha thon rjes bca' khrims kyi nus pa thon pa yin/ re 'dun zhu yul gyis srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyi thag bcad lag bstar mi byed pa 'am yang na tshul mthun gyi rgyu rkyen ci yang med par lag bstar 'gor 'gyangs byas na/ srid 'dzin bskyar gros la sa khungs sam yang na 'brel yod kyi gong rim srid 'dzin las khungs kyis dus yun nang lag bstar byed dgos pa'i bka' phab dgos/(nyer lnga)khrims gtug byed par gzhi rtsa'i gnad don gang dag gsal bor rtogs dgos/khrims gtug byed pa zhes pa ni don dngos su khrims 'dzin las khungs btsal du 'gro ba de yin la/ de'i nang spyi bde las khungs dang mi kāswāzlos

zhib dpyod khang / mi dmangs khrims khang sogs 'dus shing / snyesari cu dag la skyabs bcol nas khrims ltar gnad don thag bcad de rang gi lugs mthun khe dbang srung skyong byed pa de yin/ khrims lugs steng nas der khrims sasku gh+ri ga zer/ khrims gtug ni rgyal khab kyi srid 'dzin las khungs kyis do bdag dang khrims gtug la zhugs mkhan dag zab zhugs byas pa'i 'ogazhis don dang dmangs don/ srid 'dzin gyod don bcas thag gcod byed / ci gh+ri 'gul la zer/ gna' nas bzung 'bangs mi ser la shi dgos rung ngong la khrims gtug mi byed mices pa'i bshad tshul yo da/ spyi tshogs rnying nge / nga gi'u rdzong gi yā mon sger gyi tshogs ra'i zur gnyis la cha yig 'di ba khri sa yod de/ 6 nyin gcig khom yang khyod kyis rang gi las la brtson//na 9gel lci mo min na yā mon nang la mi yong rogs//’ zhes 'bangs mir ra brda btang yod cing / de niyu mon sger gyi them skas ma thon po der//nga ci ( ṭ+wā yod nor dbul 'bangs rnams ma yong cig mices pa'i spyi tshogs rnying ba bas red/ da lta/ nga tsho ni mi dmangs yod tshad kyi bdag po yin pa'i khrimasasrol rgyal khab tu yod pas/ khrims gtug byed par khrims ltar gnad don thas gcod pa ni dbang drags dang rtsis 'gro yod pa'i byed thabs gal chen zhig yin/ 6 zhing chen dang rdzong thog tu 'gro ba las khrims khang du song na bzang mibashad srol yod mod/ 'on kyang zhing pa spun zla tshos khrims gtug byas pa brgyud rang nyid kyi lugs mthun khe dbang srung skyong byed 'dod na/thog mar nga tsho zhing par don dngos su lugs mthun khe dbang gang dag yod pa shes dgos shing / da dung bya ba gang dag dang tshad ga 'drar bslebs na spyod gzod khrims gtug byed 'os pa dang / khrims gtug ji ltar byed na spyod gzod rgyal kha thob pa dang sgor mo med na khrims gtug la rgyal kha thob min so/sdu shes dgos/ gsham nas gnad don 'di dag re rer lan gsal bo re

'debs par bya/cho (nyer druganang cho zhing pas gzhi rtsa'i dbang cha gang dag longs spyad ga ga~X/03lo'i zla1par bsdus pa'i krung dbyang zhing sde'i bya ba'i gros tshogs steng / krung dbyang 'go khrid pas zhing par 'dra mnyam gyi lta stangs 'dzin dgos zhes yang yang bstan/ krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi spyi dmangs kyis longs spyad chog pa'i dbang cha nga tsho zhing pas kyang longs spyad chog rang rgyal gyi gzhi rtsa'i bca' khrims te〈rtsa khrims〉ltar na/ nga tsho zhing pas spyad chog pa'i dbang cha ni/(1)'dra mnyam gyi dbang cha/ (2)chab srid kyi dbang cha/(3)chab srid rang dbang gi dbang cha/(4)bsam blo'i rang dbang gi dbang cha/(5)mi lus rang dbang gi dbang cha/(6)spyi tshogs dpal 'byor dang rig gnas kyi dbang cha bcas so/(nyer bdun)nga cho zhing par 'dra mnyam khe dbang gang dag yod/(1)〈co khrims〉kyi don tshan lnga ba dang so gnyis pa'i nang gtan la phab pa ltar na bca' khrims kyi mdun du mi rnams 'dra mnyam yin/(2)〈〈rtsa khrims〉〉kyi don tshan drug pa'i nang gtan la phab pa ltar na mi'i thob thang 'dra mnyam yin/(3)〈〈co khrims〉〉kyi don tshan zhe brgyad pa'i nang gtan la phab pa ltar na pho mo 'dra mnyam yin/(4)〈〈co khrims〉〉kyi sngon 'gro'i gtam dang don tshan bzhi ba'i nang gtan la phab pa ltar na mi rigs 'dra mnyam yin/263

(nyer brgyad)nga tsho zhing par chab srid khe dbang gang dag yod/(1)〈〈co khrims〉〉kyi don tshan so bzhi pa'i nang gtan la phab pa ltar na 'dems bsko dang rang nyid 'dem bsko byed pa'i dbang cha yod/(2)〈〈co khrims〉〉kyi don tshan zhe gcig dang nyer bdun/ nga lnga bcas kyi nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na zhu gtug dang skyon rjod/bsam 'char/gtug bsher/ ther 'don/ skyin tshab len pa bcas kyi dbang cha yod/(3)〈〈rtsa khrims〉〉kyi don tshan so bdun pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na grangs nyung mi rigs rang skyong dang sde dmangs rang skyong byed pa'i dbang cha yod/o (nyer dgu)nga cho zhing par chab srid rang dbang gi khe dbang gang dag da/ 〈〈co khrims〉〉kyi don tshan so lnga pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/(1)smra brjod la rang dbang yod pa/(2)par skrun byed par rang dbang yod pa/(3)'du tshogs dang skong bsdu byed par rang dbang yo da pa/(rgyal khab kyi bde 'jags dang spyi pa'i bde 'jags la gnod pa'i rtsa 'dzugs 'dzugs mi chog cing der zhugs kyang mi chog)(4)khrom skor dang rngam ston byed pa'i dbang cha yod pa/(sngon la chog mchan thob dgos pa dang )dus tshod dang sa gnas dang lam thig gtan 'khel byas pa ltar du 'gro dgos/ ()rgyal khab dang thun mong / spyi tshogs dang spyi dmangs ga'an pa'i khe dbang la gnod pa bzos mi chog ()drag chas dang gri chas/ 'gad rdzas 'dzin mi chog la/ drag shugs spyad mi chog (kyergyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus tshogs u yon lhan khang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab kha~X 6/4krung dbyang dmag u/ ches mtho'i mi dmangs khrims khang / ches

mtho'i mi dmangs zhib dpyod khang / phyi rgyal gyi mgron po bzhugs sa/ gal che'i dmag don sgrig chas yod sa dang / mkha' skyod sa tshigs dang gru kha/ me 'khor 'bab tshigs sogs dang bar thag mi300yi tshun du yong mi chog)po (sum cu)nga cho zhing par bsam blo rang dbang gi dbang cha gang dag cad/ (1)〈rtsa khrims〉kyi don tshan so drug nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na chos lugs dad mos rang dbang yin/o (so gcig)nga cho zhing par mi lus rang dbang gi dbang cha gang dag da/ (1)〈〈co khrims〉〉kyi don tshan so brgyad pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na mi'i thob thang dang la rgya brtsi srung byas chog(2)〈〈co khrims〉〉kyi don tshan so bdun pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na mi lus rang dbang yin pa/(3)〈〈rtsa khrims〉〉kyi don tshan zhe dgu pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na gnyen sgrig rang dbang yin pa/(4)〈〈co khrims〉〉kyi don tshan so dgu pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na sdod gnas bde 'jags yin pa/(5)〈〈rtsa khrims〉〉kyi don tshan bzhi bcu pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na yig bskur rang dbang yin/(6)〈〈rtsa khrims〉〉kyi don tshan lnga bcu pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na phyir sdod rang mi la dmigs bsal gyis srung skyong byed pa/(so gnyis)nga tsho zhing pa'i mi lus dbang char phyogs gang dag 'dus sam/mi lus dbang char mi'i thob thang dbang cha dang thob thang dbang cha 265

gnyis shāḥtrī/'i thob thang dbang cha'i nang du 'dus pa gsham ltar/ metshe srog dbang cha ste/ tshe srog dbang cha ni spyi dmangs kyis rang gi tshe srog rgyun bsrings pa dang / mi ga'an pas khrims 'gal sgos 'phrog len byed du mi 'jug pa'i dbang cha yod/ ()bde thang dbang cha/ bde thang ni spyi dmangs kyis rang lus kyi cha shas su grub pa'i dbang bo'i byed nus 'thus tshang dang sems khams bde thang rgyun 'khyongs byed pa'i dbang cha yod/ ()rus ming dbang cha/ rus ming dbang cha'i nang rus ming 'dogs pa'i dbang cha dang /rus ming bed spyod pa'i dbang cha/ rus ming brje ba'i dbang cha bcas yod/rus ming la gnod 'tshe thebs pa'i bya spyod ni gtso bo bar chad bzo ba dang /rku spyod byed pa/ rdzun bzo byed pa sogs yin/ du'adra par gyi dbang cha/ spyi dmangs kyi 'dra par dbang char phyogs gsum 'dus te/ gcig ni spyi dmangs kyis rang gi 'dra par sgrig bzo dang bed spyod pa'i dbang cha yod/gnyis ni spyi dmangs kyis mi gzhan pas rang gi 'dra par la khrims 'gal sgos dma' 'bebs byed par bkag 'gog byed pa'i dbang cha yo da/ gsum ni 'dra par dbang cha yod mkhan gyis chog mchan thob pa'i 'og mi gzhan pas sgrig bzo dang bed spyad chog bca' khrims kyi gzhi 'dzin sa med pa dang /rang nyid 'thad pa min par rang dgar gzhan gyis 'dra par sgrig bzo byed pa dang bed spyod pa'i bya spyod ni 'dra par dbang char btsan gnod byed pa'i bya spyod yin/ 'on kyang bca' khrims dang spyi tshogs kyi spyi pa'i khe phan gyi dgos mkho ltar sgrig bzo byed pa'am bed spyod btang ba de ni 'dra par la btsan gnod byas pa'i bya spyod min/ ()ming grags thob dbang / ming grags thob dbang ni spyi dmangs kyis rang nyid la thob pa'i drang bden gyi spyi tshogs gdeng 'ardokā ༵ srung skyong byed pa'i dbang char go ba yin/ ming grags thob dbang la

btsan gnod byas pa'i bya spyod gtso bor dma' 'bebs dang skur 'debs byed pa'i rnam pa gnyis yod/ ()gsang don dbang cha/ gsang don dbang cha ni spyi dmangs kyis rang gi 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi gsang ba gzhan la shes su mi 'jug pa'i dbang char go ba yin/ rang rgyal gyis gsang don dbang char dngos gzhi'i khas len byas med mod/ 'on kyang yig ngos dang smra rjod kyi sgo nas ga'an pa'i gsang don sgrog pa dang / shugs rkyen tshad nges can thebs par ming grags thob dbang la gnod 'tshe btang ba'i bya spyod du ngos 'dzin pa yina~X dkā / ming grags thob dbang la srung skyong byed pa'i thabs brgyud de srung ༵ )tā pro bsdu /dbang cha'i nang 'dus pa gsham gsal ltar/ dumatshan bstod thob dbang ste/ mtshan bstod thob dbang ni spyi dam ngas dang khrims mir thob pa'i 'brel yod rtsa 'dzugs kyis gnang ba'i mtshan bstod longs su spyod pa'i dmangs don dbang cha yod par bstan pa red/ khrims 'gal sgos spyi dmangs dang khrims mi'i mtshan bstod dbang cha len pa ni mtshan bstod dbang char gnod 'tshe btang ba'i bya spyod yin/ ()gnyen sgrig khyim tshang 'brel ba'i khrod kyi thob thang dbang cha gnyis 'dus/(so gsum)nga tsho zhing par sbyi chogs dpal 'byor rig gnas gang dag longs su spyod pa'i dbang cha yod/(1)〈〈co khrims〉〉kyi don tshan zhe gsum pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na ngal gso ba'i dbang cha yod/(2)〈〈rtsa khrims〉〉kyi don tshan zhe bzhi'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na las 'khyur ngal gso byas mis 'tsho bar 'gan srung byed pa'i dbang cha yod/(3)〈〈co khrims〉〉kyi don tshan bcu gsum pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na mi sger gyi rgyu nor bdag skyong byed pa'i dbang cha yod/ 267

no(9tsha chams〉〉ཿ tre/na tshan tshe bdun pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na rig ba/shu dang gsar gtod rang dbang gi dbang cha yod/(5)〈〈rtsa khrims〉〉kyi don tshan zhe lnga pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na dngos po'i rogs ram thob pa'i dbang cha yod/(6)〈〈rtsa khrims〉〉kyi don tshan zhe brgyad dang zhe dgu'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na bud med dang rgan pa/ nar ma son pa'i mi la dmigs bsal srung skyong byed pa'i dbang cha yod/(7)〈〈rtsa khrims〉〉kyi don tshan zhe bzhi pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na ngal rtsol byed pa'i dbang cha yod/(8)〈〈rtsa khrims〉〉kyi don tshan zhe drug pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na slob gso myong ba'i dbang cha yod/(so bzhinang cho zhing par rgyu nor dbang cha gang dag yod/rgyu nor dbang cha zhes pa ni khrims ltar rang gi rgyu nor bdag 'dzin byed pad dang / bod spyod gtong ba/ khe gnyer dang bgo bsha' rgyag pa bcas kyi /bang cha la go ba yin/ spyi dmangs kyi rgyu nor de phyogs gsum nas 'dus/(1)mi sger gyi rgyu nor bdag dbang / (kyekhrims mthun yong 'bab/khrims mthun yong 'bab ni spyi dmangs kyis khrims mthun khyab khongs nang rang gi ngal rtsol dang thabs gzhan la brten nas thob pa'i yong 'bab la zer ba yin/ dper na gla phogs dang / bya dga'i dngul/ rtsom yon/ bogs dngul/ ma rkang la zhugs pa'i bgos dngul/ legs skyes sogs sa yin/()khang pa/ de gtso bo spyi dmangs kyis 'tsho bar spyod pa'i sdod khang la go ba yin/ ()'tsho ba'i yo chas/ dper na/ 'bru rigs dang / gyon chas/ thab chaswā/68'grim 'grul yo chas sogs yin/ ()gsog dngul/ de ni spyi

dmangs kyis dngul khang dang yid rton khang du bcol ba'i dngul lor la go ba —yin/ spyi dmangs kyi gsog dngul khrims 'dzin las khungs kyis khrims don gyi dgos mkho la dmigs nas 'dri gcod byed pa phud/ gzhan pa'i sde tshan dang mi sger gang rung nas 'dri gcod byas mi chog dngul khang dang yid rton khang la gsang nyar byed pa'i 'gan khur yod/ burig rdzas/ dper na/yig gzugs dang / ri mo/ rdza chas/ gna' rdzas sogs rin thang nges can ldan pa'i dngos rdzas la go ba yin/ rjodape cha dang yig cha/ dper na/ dpe cha sna tshogs dang / dus deb dang tshags par/ ri mo dang re'u mig sogs la go ba yin/ (kyesdong po dang phyugs zog sogs khrims kyis spyi dmangs la dbang chog par gtan khel byas pa'i thon skyed rgyu cha dang de min khrims mthun rgyu nor yongs la go ba yin/ dpere na/ 'drud 'then 'khor lo dang / rkang gsum 'khor lo sogs yin/(2)sa zhing 'gan len bdag gnyer dbang cha/ zhing sde'i thun mong dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyi khongs mis khrims ltar thun mong rang gi dpal 'byor rtsa 'dzugs kyis 'gan gnang ba'i grong gseb kyi sa zhing 'gan len byas chog rgyal khab kyis 'gan len pas sa zhing 'gan len bdag gnyer byed chog pa'i dbang char srung skyong byed pa yin pas/ rtsa 'dzugs dang mi kha shas kyis btsan gnod byas mi chog zhing par khrims ltar 'gan len sa zhing ben spyod pa dang khe spogs gnyer ba/ sa zhing 'gan len bdag gnyer dbang cha bsgyur spo byed pa bcas kyi dbang cha yod la/ rang bdag gis rtsa 'dzugs byas nas thon skyed bdag gnyer thon rdzas thag gcod pa'i dbang cha yod pa dang / 'gan len sa zhing khrims ltar bsdu spyod dang bed spyod btang bar khrims ltar dgos nges kyi kha gsab len pa'i dbang cha yod/(3)rgyu nor rgyun 'dzin gyi dbang cha/ mi sger gyi rgyu nor rgyun 'dzi~X ཿsa

rdo/ pa ma zad sa zhing 'gan len bdag skyong dbang cha yang rgyun 'dzin byas (so lnga)nga tsho zhing pa spun zlar don dag gang dag 'phrad na khrims ngor gtug chog gam/nga tsho zhing pa spun zlar don dag gang dag 'phrad na khrims la gtug chog ce na/ 'di la phyogs gnyis nas dpyad zhib byas chog thog mar 'gal ba dang rtsod gleng byung rjes/ sngon la 'dum sgrig byas thag gcod pa dang /'dum sgrig byed mi 'dod pa'am 'dum sgrig byed mi thub tshe 'dum gcod las khungs brgyud de 'dum gcod byed dgos shing / 'dum gcod byas par mi 'thad na spyod gzod khrims la gtug chog don dag kha shas te/ dper na/'angasrid gzhung gis dpya khral gang 'dod du bsdu ba lta bu ni srid 'dzin bya spyod yin pas/ nges par du sngon la srid 'dzin bskyar gros byed pa'i re 'dun zhu dgos/ srid 'dzin bskyar gros la mi 'thad tshe spyod gzod srid 'dzin gtug bsher byas chog steci cide la khrims gtug zer ba yin/ yin na'ang don dag tshang ma thad kur khrims ngor gtug kyang chog de nas/ 'gal ba dang rtsod gleng la 'phrad rjes/ 'dum sgrig dang 'dum gcod yang na khrims ngor gtug nas thag gcod byed min la bsam blo gtong ba'i dus mtshungs su/khrims ngor gtug nas rtsod 'dod pa'i drang bden ni ci yin par dbye zhib nan mo byed dgos te/ de yang do bdag pas 'khur dgos pa'i bca' khrims kyi cod gcod 'gan khur gang yin pa/ de ni nyes don 'gan 'khri yin nam dmangs don 'gan khur yin/ yang na srid 'dzin 'gan 'khri yin pa/ da dung 'gan 'khri de gsum rkya 'thab nas yod pa/ do bdag pa'i bca' khrims 'gan 'khri 'di dag cod gcod dgos na khrims khang du spobs pa chen pos zhu gtug byas chog270

(so drug)khrims ngor gtug che gra sgrig gang dag bya dgos/khrims ngor gtug rgyu dka' mo zhig min la skrag dgos pa zhig kyang ma yin mod/ 'on kyang don dag ha cang sla mo zhig kyang ma yin te/ khrims ngor zhu gtug byed pa de ni dgra bor 'thab pa dang 'dra ste gra sgrig yod tshe dka' las med/ khrims khang gis gyod don khrims thag gcod dus don dngos gzhir 'dzin pa dang / bca' khrims tshad thig tu 'dzin pa yin der brten/khrims ngor gtug pa'i gra sgrig bya ba de don dngos la gsal cha yod pa dang /bden dpang khungs btsan yod pa/ khrim sa kyi gzhi 'dzin sa yod pa bcas kyi dum tshan gsum po dam du 'dzin dgos / phyogs 'di gsum nas gra sgrig gang legs byed dgos pa yin/(so bdun)khrims ngor gtug che don dngos kyi phyogs gang thad nas gsal bor shes dgos/khrim sa ngo ra gtug pa 'i dmigs yul ni rang steng gi khrims mthun khe dbang srung skyong byed ched yin/ der brten/ don dngos gsal bor rtogs tshe zhu sbyor phyi ma 'i dbang char sanod pa thebs pa'i don dngos kyang gsal bor rtogs thub te/ dper na/ mi'i nus ming dang pho rngo/'i dbye ba/ lo tshod/sdod gnas/ las khungs bcas la gnod pa thebs pa dang / gnod skyon bya spyod byung ba'i dus chod dang sa gnas/ gnod skyon gtong mkhan gyi byas nyes bzo thabs dang go rim/ de min spyod dung gnod skyon bya spyod bzo ba'i rgyu rkyen dang bzos pa'i mjug 'bras sogs nges dgos/ gal te ngal rtsol dang rgyu nor rtsod gleng skor gyi don dag yin na/ sgos su phan tshun rtsod gleng yod pa'i don dngos kyi brgyud rim gsal bor rtogs dgos/ 271

(so brgyad) khrims ngor gtug che phyogs gang gi bden dpang khungs btsan po khong du chud dgos/'thab 'khrug rgyag par rno lcags dgos pa dang / khrim sa ngor gtug pa ra bden dpa nga dgos pa red/ bden dpang khungs btsan pa yin min des gtug bsher gyi rgyal pham thag gcod pa yin/ bca' khrim sa kyi gtan 'bebs ltar na/ bden dpang gi rigs la gsham gsal ltar/(1)dngos po'i bden dpang / de ni phyi'i dbyibs dang khyad chos/spus ga byed nus sogs kyis gyon don gyi khyad chos dngos lda na pa bden dpang byed dgos/ de la dngos po dngos dang yang na bskyar dpar brgyab pa'ang shāstasna/pe cha'i bden dpang / de ni yi ge dang brda rtags/ ri mo sogs ma tshon pa'i nang don gyis gyod don gyi khyad chos dngos ldan pa bden dpang byed pa yi ger 'khod pa'i yig cha la zer/ dper na/ 'phrin yig dang / btsongs 'dzin/ dpya khral bsdus pa'i brda tho yi ge dngul chad dang dngos chad pa sprad pa'i yi ge gan rgya'i yi ge gros mthun yi ge kha chems yi ge sogs yin/(3)dpang mi'i dpang tshig de ni do bdag pa las ga'an pa'i mis gyod don gyi 'brel yod gnas tshul shes mkhan yod na mi dmangs khrims khang la rang gis shes pa'i gyod don gyi don dngos zhu 'bul byed pa la zer/(4)blta bya nyan bya'i dpyad gzhi/ de ni skad dang 'dra ris dang de min gzhan pa'i nyan bya'i brda 'phrin gyis gyon don gyi khyad chos bden dpang byed pa'i don dngos kyi brnyan thag dang / sgra thag rtsis 'khor gyi mnyen chas sogs la zer/ dper na/ brnyan phab dang sgra phab/ 'dra par/ zin bris soXk+ta sbyan/

(5)do bdag pa'i zhu 'bul/ de ni do bdag pa'i yi ge dang kha bshad sogs phyogs nas gyod don gyi don dngos la zhu 'bul byas par zer/(6)gsal 'byed kyi sdom tshig de ni gsal 'byed pas rang gi ched las shes byas do bdag pa dang mi dmangs khrims khang la bton pa'i gyod don dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gnad don la brdar sha bcad de sdom tshig bkod pa la zer/ dper na/ las rmas kyi gsal 'byed yi ge sman bcos kyi gsal 'byed yi ge 'grim 'grul byar rkyen gyi gsal 'byed yi ge sogs yin/(7)bskor zhib zin jos/ de ni bskor zhib pas sa gnas sa thog dang dngos rdzas la bskor zhib byed pa'am bkod pa'i zin tho la zer/ 'dir zhing pa spun zlar dmigs bsal du bshad dgos pa zhig ni/ bden dpang bde srung byed par mnyam/ 'jog bya dgos/(so dag) bca' khrims kyis bden dpang bde srung byed par gtan 'bebs gang dag yod/bden dpang bde srung byed pa/ de ni bden dpang med brlag tu btang ba dang rtsa ba nas nyams pa/ yang na rnyed thabs bral ba'i gnas tshul 'og mi dmangs khrims khang gis bden dpang la srung skyong byas nas bden dpang gi nus par srung skyong byed thabs la zer/ dper na/ dpang mi kha shas lo bgres rkyen 'chi ba'i nyen kha yod tshe/ yang na dpang dngos kha shas rul sla ba dang ngo bo 'gyur sla ba'i gnas tshul 'og bden dpang la bde srung byed pa'i byed thabs spyod dgos te/ dper na/ yi ge'i bden dpang yin tshe sngon la bskyar dpar rgyag pa dang par du len pa/ dngos po'i bden dpang yin tshe sngon la brnyan du phab pa dang / sgra ru phab pa sogs bden dpang la bdesang byed par do bdag pas mi dmangs khrims khang la yar zhu byas chog kyang / khrims khang gis kyang bde srung byed thabs spyad chog mi kāswāzlos

khrims khang gis bden dpang bde srung byed na bye brag gi gnas tshul la dmigs nas rgya gdab pa dang / bkag nyar byed pa/ par du len pa/ sgra ru phab pa/ brnyan du phab pa/ bskyar dpar rgyag pa/ gsal 'byed byed pa/zin bris su 'god pa sogs kyi byed thabs spyad chog mi dmangs khrims khang gis bde srung bden dpang byed na do bdag pa'am yang na gtug bsher las tshab pa yul dngos la yong dgos pa'i blang bya bton chog do bdag pas bden dpang bde 'jags bde srung byed par yar zhu byas tshe/ mi dmangs ljims khang gis de 'brel gyi 'gan len 'don sprod byed pa'i blang bya bton ga (bzhi bcu)nga cho zhing pas khrims ngor gtug na bden dbang rang gis 'don dgos sam/khrims gtug gi rgyal pham de gtso bo bden dpang la rag las pa yin/su yis rang gis bton pa'i zhu gtug langs phyogs la ra sprod thub pa'i bden dpang 'don sprod thub tshe/ gang de'i zhu gtug rgyal bar re ba yod pa red/'on kyang nga tsho zhing pas khrims gtug ci zhig byas kyang bden dpang 'don pa'i 'gan tshang ma rang gis khur dgos pa min/ gal te nyes don khrims gtug byed na/ su zhu sbyor snga ma yin tshe sus bden dpang 'don sprod bya dgos/ dper na/ khyed kyis khyim mtshes che ge mos rang la ma nyes kha g.yog byas song zer nas khrims gtug byas kyang / bden dpang cha tshang bas ma nyes kha g.yog byas pa ra sprod bya mi thub tshe/ khrims khang gis khyed kyi sger phyogs zhu sbyor phyir slog nges/ sger phyogs zhu sbyor gyod don khrod zhu sbyor phyi mas bden dpang 'don sprod byed pa'i 'gan khur mi dgos te/ zhu sbyor phyi mas ba de na dpang 'don sprod byas nas rang nyid la nyes pa med pa'i ra sprod byed mi bgos/gdī nā dmangs don khrims gtug byed na/ spyir btang dusu yis langs

phyogs bton na/ su yis bden dpang 'don sprod byed dgos/zhu sbyor snga mas rang gis bton pa'i re zhu la bden dpang 'don pa'i 'gan khur dgos la/zhu sbyor phyi mas kyang zhu sbyor snga mas bton pa'i re zhu phyir slog pa dang khas mi len tshe bden dpang 'don pa'i 'gan khur dgos/ 'on kyang gnas tshul kha shas 'og zhu sbyor snga mas bton pa'i re zhu don dngos dang mthun na'ang / zhu sbyor zhu mas khas mi len tshe zhu sbyor zhu mas bden dpang 'don pa'i 'gan khur dgos(gnad don 'di'i skor rjes nas gleng bar bya)gal te nga tsho zhing pas srid 'dzin khrims gtug byed na bden dpang 'don sprod byed pa'i 'gan de zhu sbyor phyi mas khur dgos te/ de ni zhu sbyor phyi ma ste rgyal khab srid 'dzin las khungs kyis bden dpang 'don pa'i 'gan khur dgos/ srid 'dzin khrims gtugani nga tsho zhing pas dmangs kyis dpon gtug pa zer ba de yin la/dpon ni khrims skyong mkhan te dbang btsan sar yod/ nga tsho zhing pa mang tshogs ni khrims kyis skyong yul te gnyom chung gi tshogs pa yin/ bca' khrims ni drang bden skyong mkhan yin pas dbang btsan sar yod pa'i khrims skyong mkhan gyis kyang bden dpang 'don pa'i 'gan khur dgos pa yin/ gal te nga tsho zhing pas ngal rtsol rtsod gleng dang sman bcos byur rkyen skor gyi skyin tshab sprod pa'i khrims gtug byed na'ang / mi bkol las khungs dang sman bcos sde tshan gyis bden dpang 'don pa'i 'gan khur dgos pa yin/(zhe gcig) gan rgya'i rtsod gleng gyod don der su yis bden dpang 'don pa'i 'gan khur dgos/gan rgya'i rtsod gleng gyod don khrod/ gan rgya'i 'brel ba 'dzugs mkhan phyogs kyi do bdag pas gan rgya 'dzugs pa dang go chod pa'i don dngos la bden dpang 'don pa'i 'gan khur dgos/ gan rgya'i 'brel ba brje spor byed pa dang phyir 'thon pa/ mtshams 'jog pa/ med par bzo mkhan 2rdo/sa

kyi do bdag pas gan rgya'i 'brel ba brje spor byed pa'i don dngos la bden dpang 'don pa'i 'gan khur dgos/ dper na/ nga tsho zhing pa spun zlas sde dmangs u yon lhan khang dang sa zhing 'gan gtsang len gyi gan rgya bzhag cing /sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis gan rgya de phyir 'then tshe/ sde dmangs u yon lhan khang gis gan rgya ci'i phyir phyir 'then pa'i don dngos la bden dpang 'don pa'i 'gan khur dgos/(zhe gnyis) dmangs don khrims gtug gang dag la bden dpang 'don spyod byed mi dgos/ches mtho'i mi dmangs khrims khang gikrung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi dmangs don zhu 'bul bca' khrimasabed spyod skor gyi gnad don 'ga'i bsam 'charagyi don tshan don lnga'i gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ do bdag pas bden dpang 'don sprod byed mi dgos pa'i gnas tshul rigs bdun yod pa gsham ltar/(1)tshang mas shes pa'i don dngos/(2)rang byung chos nyid dang gtan srol/(3)bca' khrims kyi gtan 'bebs dang / yang na shes zin pa'i don /ngos dang dus rgyun gyi 'tsho ba'i nyams myong las shes thub pa'i don dngos kyi gas/(4)mi dmangs khrims khang gis bca' khrims nus pas brdar sha bcad de gtan khel byung ba'i don dngos/ (5)'dum gcod las khungs kyi nus pa thon pa'i khrun thag bcad don gyis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i don dngos/(6)nus ldan gyi gzhung dpang yi gis ra sprad pa'i don dngos/27/7)phyogs gcig gi do bdag pas phyogs gzhan pa'i do bdag par

zhib zhu byas pa'i gyod gzhi'i don dngos khrod mngon gsal sgos khas blangs zin pa/ yin na'ang thob thang dang 'brel ba mi gtogs/go (zhe gsum) rtsod gling gang dag la dmangs don khrims gtug byed da sa/〈dmangs don zhu gtug bca' khrims〉ltar/ mi dmangs khrims khang gis spyi dmangs kyi bar dang / khrims mi'i bar/ gzhan pa'i rtsa 'dzugs bar dang de min kho tsho phan tshun bar rgyu nor 'brel ba dang mi lus 'brel ba'i dbang gis dmangs don zhu gtug bdag sprod byed na/ nga tsho grong gseb tu rgyun mthong gi dmangs don 'brel ba gtso bo gsham gyi phyogs 'ga' yod de/(1)gnyen sgrig khyim tshang gi rtsod gleng / de gtso bo gnyen 'thor byung rjes rgyu nor bgo bsha' rgyag pa dang / 'tsho skyong gron dngul/ stor gso/gso skyong sogs las byung ba'i rtsod gleng /(2)sa zhing 'gan gtsang len dang / dpal 'byor gan rgya/ grong khyer du las kur song nas ngal rtsol rtsod gleng byung ba/ khyim mtshes bar du rtsod gleng byung ba sogs/(3)rgyu nor bdag 'dzin dang bed spyod btang ba/ yong 'bab chad pa sogs ra btsan gnod thebs pa ste/ dper na/ bde thang dbang cha/rus ming dbang cha/ mtshan snyan dbang cha/ 'dra par dbang cha sogs la btsan gnod thebs te byung ba'i rtsod gleng lta bu/(6)lugs mthun min par thob pa'i khe phan dang bdag gnyer byed mkhan med pa'i thon rdzas kyi bu lon rtsod gleng dang rgyu nor gtor brlag thebs pa las byung ba'i skyin tshab sprod pa'i rtsod gleng / dper na/ rgyu nor rnyed rjes mi sprod ba dang / mi ga'an gyi tshab tu srog chags 'tsho skyong byas rjes bor brlag thebs pa sogs dang / gzhan yang gsar gtod dbang cha dang /27snam

gyi bdag dbang thad nas byung ba'i rtsod gleng dang bca' khrims/ khrims srol gyis gtan la phab pa'i dmangs don gyod gzhi gzhan pa sogs lta bu/ nga tsho zhing pa spun zla gong gi gnas tshul dag dang 'phrad rjes tshang ma dmangs don khrims gtug byas chog(zhe bzhi)khrims ngor gtug par dus chod kyi tshad bkag yod dam/de ni yod de/ khrims ngor gtug tshe dus tshod gtan khel yod pa red/nam zhig khrims khang du 'gro 'dod na de dus song na mi chog la/ 'gro 'dod na song chog cing / 'gro mi 'dod na mi 'gro bas kyang mi chog rgyu mtshan ni bca' khrims nang khrims ngor gtug par dus tshod kyi gtan 'bebs yod pa red/ gal te do bdag pas shes bzhin dang ma shes pa'i sgo nas bca' khrims kyi gtan 'bebs dus tshod yol rjes/ spyir na rang gis spyad chog pa'i khrims gtug dbang cha de shor 'gro ba'i nyen kha yod pa ma zad/ mi dmangs khrims khang gis khrims ltar srung skyong byed par zhu 'bul byed pa'i dbang cha gtan du shor 'gro ba red/ zhing pa spun slar khrims ngor gtug dgos pa'i don dag ci zhig yod tshe nges par du dus tshod kyi 'du shes zab mo zhig yod dgos pa red/(zhe lnga)dmangs don khrims gtug byed na su zhig zhu sbyor snga ma yin che des gron dngul spyod dgos pa yin nam/ de la nges gtan med/ spyir btang du dmangs don zhu gtug gron dngul de zhu sbyor snga mas sngon la sprod dgos la/ zhu sbyor phyi ma'i phyir gtug na des sngon la sprod dgos pa yin/ 'on kyang 'tsho skyong gron dngul/ gso skyong gron dngul/ stor gso gron dngul/ 'chi god gyong gsab rogs dngul/ngal rtsol thob cha bcas bda' 'ded tshur len byed pa'i gyod ga'i yin na/ zhu sbyor snga mas bdag sprod gron dngul sprod mi dgos/ gyod gzhi 'dri zhib mjug sgriX /zlos gyod pham pas sprod dgos/ do bdag par dngos gnas dka'

khag yod tshe khrims khang la yar zhu byas nas rjes sprod dang nyung sprod/ sprod mi /gos sna bcas byas chog lag bstar gron dngul de yar zhu zhu mkhan gyis ged da(sna dru/ ga)gan rabs kyis 'tsho skyong gron dngul bad kyi khrims gtug ji ltar byed dgos/byis pas byams skyong mi byed pa dang / rgan par bsten sa med pa der thabs yag shos ga'an med tshe/ kho tsho'i ngo so la 'dang rgyag mi dgos par 'tsho skyong gron dngul gyi khrims gtug byed dgos/ 'tsho skyong gron dngul gyi khrims gtug de ni dmigs bsal gyi dmangs don khrims gtug cig yin/zhu sbyor snga mar dmigs bsal ster ched zhu gtug byed skabs gyod gzhi bdag sprod gron dngul de sngon sprod byed mi dgos/ gyod gzhi 'dri zhib mjug sgril skabs gyod pham pas sprod dgos/ zhu gtug byed skabs/ zhu sbyor phyi ma'i sdod gnas kyi khrims khang du gtug dgos/ gal te zhu sbyor phyi ma'i sdod gnas dang rgyun sdod byed sa gnyis gcig mthun min tshe/ zhu sbyor phyi ma'i rgyun sdod byed sa'i khrims khang du gtug dgos/ gtug mkhan lo rgas te 'gul skyod stabs bde min tshe mi gzhan par mngag bcol byas te khrims gtug byas chog gal te gso skyong byed mkhan kha shas yod kyang gcig gis kyang gso skyong gi 'os 'gan mi khur tshe/ mi de tshang ma dus gcig tu zhu sbyor phyi ma'i gras bkod chog la so sor dbye nas khrims gtug byas kyang chog gal te mi de rnams sa khul gcig tu med tshe/ mi de dag sdod sa'i khrims khang du gtug dgos/ gso skyong byed yul de rgan rgon gnyis ka yin tshe zhu gtug byed skabs mnyam du zhu sbyor snga ma'i gras su 'jog dgos pa las gcig bzhag pas mi chog zhu sbyor gyi gras su bzhag pa'i mi gcig shi song tshe zhu gtug gsar ba 'byung nges/ gso skyong gron dngul gyod don khrod kyi zhu sbyo phyi ma dag gi sdod gnas khongs kā/sdus

sa khul gcig tu med tshe zhu sbyor snga ma'i sdod gnas kyi khrims khang gi khongs gtogs su gtug nas bda' 'ded tshur len byas chog der brten/ zhu sbyor snga mas rang nyid sdod sa'i khrims khang la gtug chog pa red/ dpe bzhag na/ byams skyong mi byed mkhan gcigs grong du sdod pa dang / cig shos de2grong du sdod cing / rgan rgon gnyi ga grong gseb tu sdod pa yin na/ rgan rgon gnyi gsagrong dang yang na2grong gang du yang 'gro mi dgos par rang nyid sdod sa'i khrims khang du gtug pas chogago (zhe bdun)nga cho zhing pas bu lon thad kyi khrims gtug dzi ltar byed da sa/dus rgyun gyi 'tsho ba'i khrod du/ nga tsho zhing pa spun zla dang ga'an pa'i bar bu lon thad kyi rtsod gleng byung rjes/ mi la gcar rdung mi byed par khrims ngor gtug dgos/ bu lon thad nas rtsod gleng byung rjes/ gzhi rim gyi 'dum sgrig u yon lhan khang dang yang na 'brel yod rtsa 'dzugs la yar zhu byed pa phud/ da dung thad gar mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug byas chog zhu gtug byed na gsham gyi nang don 'ga' gsal po 'god dgos/(1)bu lon 'brel ba byung ba'i dus tshod dang sa gnas/ dngos po dang kha grangs/ de min skyed ka sogs kyi gnas tshul/(2) 'brel yod kyi bden dpang ste/ dngos po'i bden dpang dang /yi ge'am dpang mi/ dpang tshig sogs 'don sprod byed dgos/(3)phyogs gnyi gar rtsod gleng byung ba'i gtso gnad de gang yin pa dang /gros gleng byas pa'i gnas tshul dang 'phel rim ga 'dra yin pa/(4)zhu gtug byed pa'i bye brag gi re ba ci yin pa/ dper na/ bu lon 'jal mkhan phyi rol tu song nas phyir mi log pa ma zad bu lon mi 'jal tshe/bu /spya) sprod mkhan gyis khongs gtogs dbang cha ldan pa'i mi dmangs khrims

khang la zhu gtug byas chog khrims khang gis ji ltar bdag sprod byed pa de gnas tshul der bltas nas gtan 'bebs byed dgos/ gal te bu lon 'jal mkhan bor nas gar song 'dir song mi shes par lo2longs tshe mi dmangs khrims khang la bor song ba'i yar zhu byas chog gcig ni mi dmangs khrimasakhang gis bor song ba bsgrags rjes bor song ba'i mi'i rgyu nor do dam tshab zhus 'brel ba gtan khel byed dgos/ bor song ba'i mi'i rgyu nor kho'i bza' zla dang pha ma/ nar son pa'i bu bu mo'am 'brel ba zab mo yod pa'i gnyen nye yis do dam tshab zhus byed dgos/ gnyis ni bor song ba'i mis bu lon chad pa 'jal ba'i gnad don thag gcod dgos/ bor song ba'i mis chad pa'i khral dngul dang bu lon/ gzhan pa'i 'gro gron yod tshad do dam tshab zhus pas bor song ba'i mi'i rgyu nor khrod nas blangs te sprod dgos/ gal te bu lon 'jal mkhan shi song na/ shi bo'i bu lon de shul bzhag dngos rdzas las blangs te 'jal dgos/ bu lon 'jal rjes spyod dung 'phro ma yod na de zhul 'dzin pas zhul 'dzin byed dgos/zhul 'dzin par gzhan gyi tshab byas nas bu lon 'jal ba'i 'os 'gan med/ gtan 'bebs 'di las bltas na/ pha'i bu lon tshang ma bu yis 'jal dgos pa'i nges pa med/ yin na'ang / zhul 'dzin pas rang 'dod kyis shi bo'i shul bzhag dngos rdzas kyis don dngos kyi bu lon 'jal bar mi 'dang ba'i cha de 'jal 'dod na bca' khrims las rung ba yin/ze nizhe brgyad) nga tsho zhing pas zhul 'dzin thad kyi khrims gtug ji ltar da dazhusdu /'dzin ni spyi dmangs kyis shi bo'i bskyur ba'i khrims mthun rgyu nor zhul 'dzin byed pa'i dbang cha la zer/ shul nor zhul 'dzin rtsod gleng sdus kyi

khrims gtug byed na/ zhu sbyor byed yul gyi mi shi dus kyi gnas sa dang yang na shul nor gtso bo yod sa'i mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug byas chog zhu gtug byed mkhan gyi mi ni nges par du rigs gnyis yin dgos te/ gcig ni shi bos kha chems bzhag yod pa'i mi dang / cig shos ni khrims bkod kyi zhul 'dzin pa yin dgos/ gal te zhu gtug byed mkhan de zhul 'dzin dbang cha ldan pa'i nar ma son pa'i mi yin tshe/ der khrims bkod ngo tshab dang yang na mngag bcol ngo tshab kyis zhu gtug ngo tshab byas te zhu gtug nang zhugs chogakhyo shug gnyis las phyogs gcig la zhul 'dzin dbang cha ldan tshe/ gal te zhul 'dzin zhu gtug byed na zhul 'dzin dbang cha yod pa'i mi de zhu sbyo ra snga ma byed dgos pa dang / phyogs ga'an pa de zhu gtug nang zhugs na mngag bcol ngo tshab ltar zhugs dgos/ zhul 'dzin khrims gtug byed pa dang / zhul 'dzin zhu gtug byed na thog mar zhu gtug yi ge 'bri dgos pa dang / dus mtshungs su zhu gtug gi dus yun la mnyam 'jog dgos te/ gsham nas re re bzhin 'grel bar bya/(zhe dgu)zhul 'dzin khrims gtug gi zhu gtug yi ge'i nang nang don gang dag 'dus dgos/dmangs don khrims gtug gi zhu gtug yi ge 'bri na gsham gyi nang don 'ga' gsal bor 'bri bar mnyam 'jog dgos te/(1)zhu sbyor phyi ma'i bar gyi 'brel ba/(2)rang nyid dang zhu sbyor phyi ma dang zhul 'dzin pa'i bar gyi 'brel ba/(3)shul nor gyi rigs dang grangs ka/ rin thang /(4)zhu sbyor phyi ma'i shul bzhag rgyu rdzas khrod kyi 'gal ba/(5)rang nyid kyis rgyu dngos shul 'dzin byed pa'i gnas lugs dang /blaX ཿ2 la khrims ltar gzhir bzung ba/

ma (lnga bstu)zhul 'dzin khrims gtug byed pa'i yun tshad ci ltar gtan 'a ba/ /sdu 'a /na/ bca' khrims〉nang gi don tshan brgyad pa'i gtan 'bebs ltar na/ zhul 'dzin byed dbang thad la rtsod gleng byung nas gtug bsher byed pa'i dus bcad ni lo gnyis yin pa dang / zhul 'dzin pa'i dbang cha de gnod pa thebs pa'i nyin mo nas brtsi dgos pa nges par du shes dgos/ gal te zhul 'dzin byed pa'i nyin mo nas bzung lo20las brgal na gtug bsher byas mi chog zhul 'dzin pa shi rmas byung ba'i nyin nas bzung lo20yi ring la zhul 'dzin dbang cha yod pa'i mi yis mi dmangs khrims khang la re 'dun zhus nas 'gan khur mi snar btsan gyis 'gan khur du 'jug dgos/ lo20longs rjes zhul 'dzin pa'i dbang cha shor ba ma zad khrims khangal zhu sbyor byas mi chogagal te lo20yi ring la zhul 'dzin pas rang nyid kyi zhul 'dzin dbang char gnod pa thebs pa shes tshe dus de nas bzung lo gnyis kyi ring la/ mi dmangs khrims khang la re 'dun zhus nas 'gan khur mi snar btsan shed kyis 'gan 'khur du 'jug pa'i dbang cha yod/ lo gnyis longs rjes zhul 'dzin dbang char gnod skyon thebs pa'i mi de'i dbang cha shor song bas slar mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu sbyor byas mi chog 'dir gsal bshad byed rgyu ni/zhul 'dzin khrims gtug byed skabs gtug bsher dus bcad las brgal nas mi dmangs khrims khang gis bdag sprod mi byed tshe/ de ni khrims khang brgyud nas thag gcod mi thub pa tsam las zhul 'dzin mi snas rgyu nor shul 'dzin byed mi chog pa zhig min par/ da dung byed thabs gzhan pa brgyud de phan tshun gros mol byed pa sogs la brten nas thag gcod byas chog gzhanayang ches mtho'i mi dmangs khrims khang gi gtan 'bebs ltar na/ zhul 'dzin mi snas rang nyid kyi dbang char gnod pa thebs pa shes pa'i nyin mo nas lo ga~X kyi

ring ni/ rgyu nor shul 'dzin gyi rtsod gzhi mi dmangs 'dum sgrig u yon lhan khang gis 'dum sgrig byed pa'i dus yun yin pas/ gtug bsher mtshams bzhag nas zhu sbyor gyi yun tshad thag gcod byed dgos/ 'di lta bu'i gnas tshul 'og lo gnyis 'gor rjes mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu sbyor byas chogagal te zhul 'dzin mi snas rgyu nor shul 'dzin gyi rtsod gzhi de zhu sbyor yun tshad nang mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu sbyor byas tshe zhu sbyor gyi yun tshad mtshams 'jog dgos/ khrims khang gis zhib gcod byed pa'i skabs su zhu sbyor yun tshad las brgal na'ang zhul 'dzin mi snar 'brel ba med/(nga gcig) kha chems bzhag pa de bca' khrims gtan 'bebs gang dag da/ ༵༵༵ /ni kha chems 'jog mkhan gyis shul rdzas rgyu nor thag gcod dang 'chi khar las bcol byas pa'i khrims nas thon pa'i bya spyod cig la zer/kha chems 'jog mkhan der nges par du dmangs don bya spyod spel nus ldan dgos pa dang / bya spyod spel nas mi ldan pa'i mi yis bzhag pa'i kha chems de rjesaphyogs bya spyod spel nus ldan pa'i dbang du btang na'ang kha chems tu mi brtsi/ kha chems kyis kha chems mi sna'i don dngos mtshon gyi yod/ kha chems kyi nang don bca' khrims dang 'gal mi rung ba dang / rgyal khab dang thun mong gi khe phan la gnod pa thebs su 'jug mi rung / kha chems de ngal rtsol gyi nus pa zhan pa dang 'tsho ba'i yong khungs med pa'i zhul 'dzin par bzhag pa'i shul rdzas rgyu dngos kyi bgo skal de yin/ kha chems nang rgyal khab dang thun mong / mi sger la gtogs la rgyu nor thag gcod byed dbang med/ spyi dmangs kyis kha chems 'jog skabs mi sger gyi rgyu nor de khrims bkod shul 'dzin gyi mi gcig dang yang na mi 'ga' la zhul 'dzin byed du 'jug pa dang /kha ༵༵༵ 'jog mkhan gyis rang nyid kyi rgyu nor de rgyal khab dang thun mong /

ya ga na khrims bkod shul 'dzin mi sna phud mi gzhan la gnang chog kha chems 'jog skabs gzhung dpang yod pa'i kha chems 'jog stangs spyad nas kha chems 'jog mkhan gzhung dpang las khungs brgyud nas thag gcod byas chogakha chems yi ge'i rnam pa spyad nas kha chems mi sna dngos kyi yi ge 'bri ba dang /ming dang lo zla tshes sogs gsal bor 'bri dgos/ zhu don tshab 'bri'i kha chems rnam pa spyad nas las yul dngos su dpang mi gnyis yan yod pa'i skabs su/ de'i nang gi mi gcig gis zhu don tshab 'bri byas kyang chog lo dang zla tshes sogs la gsal bor bltas rjes zhu don tshab 'bri byed mkhan dang dpang mi/ kha chems 'jog mkhan bcas kyis ming 'god dgos/ zi len kha chems byed stangs spyad nas dpang mi gnyis yan 'dzoms pa'i las yul dngos kyi gnas tshul 'og tu sgra len gyi byed stangs spyad nas kha chems kyi nang don phab len byas kyang chog de las gzhan ngag thog gi kha chems byed stangs spyad kyang chog yin yang / ngag thog gi kha chems byed stangs kyi rnam par mnyam 'jog byed tshul gsum ste/ gcig ni nyen kha che ba'i gnas tshul 'og tu ngag thog gi kha chems rnam pa spyod par mnyam 'jog pa/ gnyis ni nges par du dpang mi gnyis yan yod pa'i las yul du bden dpang byed pa/ gsum ni nyen kha tshabs chen gyi gnas tshul dogs sel byas rjes/ kha chems mi sna'i yi ge dang rnam pa gzhan spyad nas kha chems 'jog pa'i skabs su sngon gyi ngag thog gi kha chems med par gtong dgos/ 'dir nan gyis bshad rgyu ni kha chems la nus pa ldan pa'i nges pa med/ kha chems mi sna'i rang nyid kyi rgyu nor thag gcod byed dbang gang byung du spyad mi chog kha chems 'jog mkhan dang 'os babs 'gan 'khur ba'i bar la 'gal ba byung tshe drang ba'ag yong ched/bca' khrims ltar kha chems rang dbang lam lugs gtan 'bebs byas yod/ngal rtsol nus shugs zhan pa dang 'tsho ba'i yong khungs med pa'i zhul 2/rdzun

par bzhag pa'i shul bzhag rgyu dngos bgo skal de yin/ de ltar min na/zhul 'dzin pas mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu sbyor byas chog pa dang mi dmangs //sdu khang gis bca' khrims ltar khrims mthun khe dbang srung skyong byed (nga gnyis)rgyan bzhag pa'i bu lon la bca' khrims kyis 'gan srung mi byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/rgyan bzhag bu lon la bca' khrims kyis 'gan srung mi byed pas 'ing pa mang tshogs kyis mnyam 'jog byed dgos/ rgyu mtshan ni rang rgyal gyi bca' khrims gtan 'bebs nang rgyan 'dzugs gtan 'gog byas yod/ nam rgyun 'ing pa tshos rang khyim nas shog 'phen dang ma cang brgyab nas nyi ma bskyal thabs tsam byas na mi chog pa med par 'dod kyang / gal te ma cang brgyab nas rgyan btsugs na/ der dngul bun chad nas rtsod gleng byung yang mi dmangs khrims khang gis de'i phyogs la gtan nas rgyab skyor mi byed pa dang bca' khrims kyis kyang der srung skyong mi byed/(nga gsum)spus ka tshad ldan min pa'i thon rdzas kyis gnod pa thobs na ci ltar bya dgos/gal te 'ing pa spun zla zhig la spus ka tshad ldan min pa'i thon rdzas kyis rgyu /ra skying mi lus la gnod pa thebs tshe khrims ltar bu lon 'jal ba'i re zhu ba na (1)〈〈dmangasakhrims spyi srol〉〉gyi don tshan brgya dang nyer gnyis nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ 6 thon rdzas kyi spus ka tshad dang mi mthun par gzhan gyi rgyu nor dang mi lus la gnod pa thebs tshe/ tshong pas khrims ltar dmangs don 'gan khur phrag tu len dgos/ 28/2)〈〈'dzad spyod pa'i khe phan srung skyong skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don

tshan zhe gcig pa'i nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ 2 tshong gnyer mkhan(thon skyed mkhan dang tshong pa gnyi ga 'dus)gyis 'don sprod byas pa'i tshong rdzas dang zhabs zhus 'dzad spyod pa dang yang na gzhan pa'i gnod thebs mkhan gyi mi lus la gnod pa thebs tshe/ sman yon dang sman bcos skabs kyi nad g.yog gron dngul/ las kur 'gor 'gyangs byas nas yong sgo je nyung du song ba sogs kyi gron dngul ster dgos/ dbang bor skyon byung tshe dbang bo skyon can gyi 'tsho ba'i rogs dngul dang gsab dngul ster dgos pa dang /dbang bo skyon can gyi skyin tshab dngul de gso skyong byed yul la nges par du mkho ba'i 'tsho ba'i gron dngul sogs sprod dgos/(3)〈〈'dzad spyod pa'i khe phan srung skyong skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan zhe bzhi nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ 66tshong gnyer mkhan(thon skyed malan dang tshong pa gnyi ga 'dus)gyis 'don sprod byas pa'i tshong rdzas dang zhabs zhus 'dzad spyod pa'i rgyu nor la gnod pa thebs tshe/'dzad spyod pa'i re ba ltar/ zhig gso dang / bskyar bzo/ brje spor/ tshong rdzas phyir slog pa/tshong rdzas kha grangs longs su 'jug pa/ dngos po'i rin pa phyir slog pa dang zhabs zhu'i gron dngul dang gyong gun 'jal ba sogs rnam pa'i dmangs don 'gan khur khur dgos/(nga bzhin nga cho zhing pa srun zlas gnod thebs skyin tshab kyi khrims gtug ji ltar byed dgos/gnod thebs skyin tshab ni phyogs gcig gi gnod pa bzos pa'i bya spyod kyis mi gzhan pa'i mi lus dang rgyu nor la gyod gun bzos pa la zer/ der dmangs don bca' khrims kyi 'gan khur khur dgos/ gal te nga tsho 'ing pa spun zla'i mi lus dang rgyu nor la gzhan gyis gnod pa bzos tshe/ thog mar pha rol por skyin tshab 'jal ba'i 'gan khur yod med gtan 'khel byed lhahā/sa

te/ gcig nas gnod pa thebs pa'i don dngos/ gnyis nas gnod pa 'di'i rigs ni khrims 'gal yin pa/ gsum nas khrims 'gal bya spyod dang gnod pa thebs pa'i don dngos bar rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel ba yod pa/ bzhi nas khrims 'gal bya spyod pa rang ngos nas nor 'khrul yod pa/ pha rol pos skyin tshab 'gan khur khur dgos pa gtan 'khel byas rjes/ gal te khrims gtug byed 'dod na gsham gyi bden dpang 'ga' 'don sprod byed dgos te/(1)btsan gnod thebs pa'i don dngos kyi bden dpang / dper na/kāpang mi'i dpang tshig dang / su ni gnod pa bzo mkhan yin pa ra sprod pa gas/(2)btsan gnod thebs pa'i mjug 'bras kyi bden dpang / dper na/ brtag dpyad bden dpang / gsal 'byed mjug 'bras sogs/(3)skyin tshab khyab khongs kyi bden dpang / dper na/ las kur 'gor 'gyangs byas pa'i gyong gud(las khungs kyi gla phogs bden dpang)dang sman yon/ nad g.yog gron dngul/ de dang 'brel yod kyi 'grim 'grul gla cha/ zhig gso'i gla cha/ de min zhig gso byed thabs bral ba'i rgyu nor gyi rin thang sogs kyis/ gnod pa bzos te gyong kun thebs tshad kyi gnas tshul bden dpang byed dgos/(nga lnga) nga cho zhing pa spun zlas mi lus gnod thebs kyis las gar 'gor 'gyangs byas pa'i gron dngul de ji ltar gtan 'khel byed dgos/ches mtho'i mi dmangs khrims khang gi〈krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi dmangs khrims spyi srol〉lag len mthar phyin byed pa'i skor gyi gnad don 'ga'i bsam 'char(chod spyod〉〉gyi don tshan brgya dang zhe gsum nang gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ mi lus gnod thebs skyin tshab gyod gzhi khrod gswāhā /bas mi'i las kur 'gor 'gyangs byas pa'i dus yun de/ gnod

skyon thebs pa'i tshad gzhi dngos dang / drag skyed byung ba'i gnas tshul/ de min sman bcos byed sa'i sman khang gis 'don sprod byas pa'i bden dpang dang khrims dpyad sman pas gsal 'byed byas pa sogs kyi gtan khel la zur lta byed dgos/ las kur 'gor 'byangs byas pa'i gtan khel de las khungs nang zla rer nges gtan gyi gla phogs yod tshe/ las khungs kyis bden dpang 'don sprod byed dgos shing / gla phogs tshad gzhi ltar rtsis rgyag dgos/ gal te gnod thebs mkhan la nges gtan gyi gla phogs tshad gzhi med tshe mi de'i dus skabs nges can zhig gi nang gi yong sgo'i dngul grangs ltar rtsis rgyag dgos/gtan 'bebs 'di gzhir bzung ste/ gal te nga tsho zhing pa spun zla de ni sa zhing 'gan len khyim tshang zhig gam yang na sger gnyer bzo tshong khyim tshang zhig yin tshe/ las kur 'gor 'gyangs byas pa'i tshad gzhi de kho'i dus skabs nges can zhig gi nang gi cha snyoms yong sgor zur lta byed dgos/ gal te gnod thebs zhing pa des 'debs 'dzugs dang gso spel las rigs 'gan len byas yod tshe/ der thebs pa'i gyong gud la gnod thebs mkhan rang gis byed thabs spyad de gyong gud je cher 'gro ba 'gog pa phud/ mi dmangs khrims khang gisabatsan gnod mkhan gyis byed thabs spyad nas gyong gud je cher 'gro ba 'gog par bka' bcad btang chog (nga drug)nga cho zhing pa spun zla'i rgyu nor dbang char gnod pa thebs che phyogs gang thadaspyi skyin tshab 'jal dgos/spyi dmangs dang khrims mi/ gzhan pa'i rtsa 'dzugs kyi rgyu nor dbang k+tar gnod pa bzos tshe gsham gyi gtan 'bebs ltar thag gcod byed dgos (1)chad gcod dngul dang / nyes dngul/ brkus dngul phyir slog pa/rgyu nor gzhung bzhes dang yang na rgyal khab kyi gtan 'bebs dang 'gasdu /sa
