balhas pa'i rgyu rdzas dang / bgo 'grem gron dngul bcas rgyu dngos phyir slog da sa/(2)sgo rgya sdom pa/ bsdams bcad/ rgyu nor bkag nyar bcas byas pa yin na rgyu nor gyi sgo rgya bsdams pa/ bsdams bcad/ rgyu nor bkag nyar bcas byas pa med par byed dgos/ rgyu nor la gyong gun thebs pa dang med brlag tu shor ba yin na gsham gyi tshan pa/ (3)pa dang(4)bar gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar skyin tshab 'jal dgos/(3)phyir slog dgos pa'i rgyu nor la gnod skyon thebs tshe/ sngon gyi rnam pa slar gso byed thub par slar gso byed pa dang / byed mi thub par gnod skyon phog pa'i tshad ltar ltos bcas kyis skyin tshab 'jal dgos/(4)phyir slog pa'i rgyu nor med brlag tu shor tshe ltos bcas kyis skyin tshab 'astulha ༵ /dri/ btsongs zin tshe btsongs ba'i rin pa sprod dgos/(6)chog mchan dpang yig dang lag khyer phyir bsdus pa dang / bka' phab nas thon skyed byed mtshams bzhag pa dang tshong las gnas skabs mtshams bzhag pa yin na/ thon skyed byed mtshams bzhag pa dang tshong las gnas skabs mtshams bzhag pa'i ring gi dgos nges kyi rgyun spyod gron dngul dang skyin tshab 'jal dgos/ spyir btang du khe las dang mi sgor gyi tshong gnyer dang yang na thon skyed thad bkol ba'i khang pa'i gla cha/ chu glog gi rin pa/las bzo pa'i gla phogs/ mdzod nyar gla cha sogs 'jal dgos/(7)rgyu nor bdag dbang la gzhan pa'i gnod skyon thebs tshe thad kur gyong kun thebs tshad ltar skyin tshab 'jal dgos/(nga bdun) dmangasaspyis dpon gtug na zhu sbyor bya ma ji ltar gtan khedī spyad dgos/

nga tsho zhing pa spun zlas dmangs kyis dpon gtug pa ཿzer ba de la bca' khrims steng du srid 'dzin zhu gtug ces zer/ srid 'dzin zhu gtug gi zhu sbyor phyi ma ni zhu sbyor snga mas bltas na bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod khrims dang 'gal ba ma zad zhu sbyor snga ma'i khrims mthun khe dbang la btsan gnod thebs te mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug byed pa dang / mi dmangs khrims khang gis bdag sprod byas rjes zhu gtug nang zhugs nas zhu lan slog pa'i brda sbyor btang ba ma zad/ mi dmangs khrims khang gis khrims 'dum tshod 'dzin byas pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs dang yang na bca' khrims dang khrims srol gyis dbang cha gnang yod pa'i dbang shugs rtsa 'dzugs la zer ba red/ zhu sbyor snga ma ni gsham gyi gnas tshul 'ga' la bltas nas srid 'dzin las khungs gang ni zhu sbyor snga ma yin pa gtan khel byed dgos te/(1)thad mar zhu gtug byas pa'i gyod gzhi yin tshe/ bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod phyir 'then byas pa'i las khungs ni zhu sbyor phyi ma yin/(2)bskyar gros brgyud bskyar gros las khungs kyis sngon gyi bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod bsgyur tshe/ bskyar gros las khungs ni zhu sbyor phyi ma yin/(3)bskyar gros byas kyang bskyar gros las khungs kyis sngon gyi bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod srung 'dzin byas tshe/ bya spyod de 'dzin mkhan gyi srid 'dzin las khungs ni zhu sbyor phyi ma yin/(4)srid 'dzin las khungs gnyis yan gyis mnyam du bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod 'dra mtshungs bsgrubs tshe/ gnyi ga zhu sbyor phyi ma yin/(5)bca' khrims dang khrims srol gyis dbang cha gnang yod pa'i dbang sdopas tsasto 'ardo/sa sdis bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod bsgrubs tshe/ rtsa 'dzugs lha 6/sri da kāḥ// las khungs kyis mngag bcol byas pa'i rtsa 'dzugasdu sas

bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod bsgrubs tshe/ mngag bcol byas pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs ni zhu sbyor phyi ma yin/(7)srid 'dzin las khungs de gzhan dbang gis med par bzos pa yin tshe/ mu mthud du 'gan dbang spyod pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs ni zhu sbyor phyi ma yin/ srid 'dzin zhu gtug bca' khrimasanang dmigs bsal gnas tshupa 'og gi zhu sbyor phyi ma gtan khel byed par yang gtan 'bebs bzos yod pa skud/(nga brgyad) nga tsho zhing pa spun zla khrims khang gi dpyad mtshams la 'thad pa ma byung che' ltar bya dgos/nga tsho zhing pa spun zla khrims khang gi dpyad mtshams la 'thad pa min tshe/thog mar khrims khang gi dpyad mtshams de dpyad mtshams risas gang yin pa gsal bor nges dgos/ spyir btang du bshad na/ khrims khang gi dpyad mtshams de 'dri gcod dang po'i dpyad mtshams dang 'dri gcod gnyis pa'i dpyad mtshams gnyis su dbye ba yin/ gal te 'dri gcod dang po'i dpyad mtshams la mi 'thad tshe/ bcad khra sprad nyin nas nyin15nang tshun du gong rim mi dmangs khrims khang du zhu gtug byas chog pa dang / rim pa gong ma'i mi dmangs khrims khang gis zhib gcod byed pa'i re ba zhus chog rim pa gong ma'i khrims khang gis zhib gcod byas rjes dpyad mtshams bsgyur srid la/'dri gcod dang po'i dpyad mtshams srung 'dzin byed kyang srid pas 'dri gcod gnyis pa'i dpyad mtshams kyis nus pa thon pa red/ gal te bca' khrims nus pa thon pa'i 'dri gcod gnyis pa'i dpyad mtshams dang bka' bcad la mi 'thad tshe/ 'dri gcod byas pa'i mi dmangs khrims khang dang yang na rim pa gong ma'i mi dmangs khrims khang la bskyar du 'dri gcod byed pa'i yakā 32 byas chog 'on kyang dpyad mtshams dang bka' bcad kyi lag bstar

mtshams 'jog mi chog 'di nas zhing pa spun zlar gsal 'debs byed rgyu zhig ni/ bskyar du 'dri gcod byed par yar zhu byed na dpyad mtshams dang bka' bcad la bca' khrims nus pa thon rjes kyi lo gnyis nang yar zhu byed dgos la/ khrims bkod dus yun de las gda' mi rung / gzhan yang bca' khrims kyi nus pa thon pa'i gnyen sgrig 'brel ba med par gyur pa ste bza' 'thor dpyad mtshams de bskyar du 'dri gcod byed pa'i re 'dun zhus mi chogakhrimasakhang gis bskyar du 'dri gcod byas pa dang yang na rgyu mtshan zhu 'bul byas rjes/ der zhib bsher byed dgos/ gal te dpyad mtshams sngon mar dngos gnas nor 'chug yod tshe dpyad mtshams sngon ma med par bzos nas bskyar du gyod don zhib dpyad byed dgos/ gal te khrims khang gis zhib bsher byas rjes dpyad mtshams sngon mar nor 'chug med tshe rgyu mtshan zhu 'bul phyir slog pa las thabs med/(nga dgu)rdzong spyi bde cus bde srung tshan khag la chad pa gtsod pa'i dbang cha yod dam/rang rgyal gyis spyod da bca' khrims dang khrims srol gyi gtan 'bebs ltar na/ srid 'dzin bdag po nyid kyis spyod gzod rang gi ming thog nas rgyal khab kyi 'gan nus spyad de bye brag gi srid 'dzin bya spyod sgrub pa ma zad/ rang sger gyis de las byung ba'i bca' khrims 'gan 'khri khur dgos/ der brten/bde srung srid 'dzin chad gcod gdul ba'i dbang cha de khrims ltar rdzong dang grong khyer spyi bde cu'u dang yang na rdzong rim pa'i spyi bde las khungs kyis chad pa bcad chog bde srung tshan khag ni spyi bde cu'u nang khul du btsugs pa'i las khungs yin pas sger tshugs kyi bca' khrims mi gzhi med la/ srid 'dzin bdag po min na rang gi ming thog nas bde srung do dam chad gcod dbang cha spyad mi chog 293

(drug cu)spyi bde mngags gtong khang gis chad pa gcod pa'i dbang tshad ga 'dra yin nam/〈〈bde srung do dam chad gcod srol yig〉〉gi don tshan so gsum pa'i khod tshan gnyis par gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ ra tha tshig sgrog pa dang /sgor50man gyi chad pa gcod na spyi bde mngags gtong khang gis khrun thag bcad chog gtan 'bebs 'di ltar na/ spyi bde mngags gtong khang gis chad pa gcod pa'i dbang tshad ni ches mang na sgor50yin/ sgor50yan gyi chad pa gcod na spyi bde mngags gtong khang gis rang 'dod ltar byas mi chog par rdzong rim pa yan gyi spyi bde las khungs kyis gcod dgos/(re gcig)zhang srid gzhung la bde srung chad gcod kyi dbang cha yod dam/ 〈〈bde srung do dam chad gcod srol yig〉〉gi gtan 'bebs ltar na/bde srung do dam bya spyod dang 'gal ba'i chad gcod de/ spyi bde las khungs kyis gcod pa la sa/ gzhan pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs te zhang mi dmangs srid gzhung 'dus pa'i las khungs gang gis kyang rang 'dod ltar spyi dmangs la bde srung chad gcod byas mi chog 'on kyang bde srung do dam chad gcod srol yig〉gi don tshan so gsum pa'i khod tshan gnyis par gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ grong gseb te spyi bde mngags gtong khang med pa'i sa char tha tshig sgrog pa dang / sgor50man gyi chad pa gcod na spyi bde mngags gtong khang gas zhang(grong rdal)srid gzhung la mngag bcol byas te khrun thag bcad chog gnas tshul 'di 'dra'i 'og tu zhang(grong rdal)mi dmangs srid gzhung gis bde srung chad gcod kyi khrun thag gcod dbang kha shas dngos su lag bstar byas te mngag bcol rtsa 'dzugs byas chog de ni gsham ltar/29/1)zhang(grong rdal)mi dmangs srid gzhung la bde srung chad gcod kyi

khrun thag gcod pa'i dbang cha med/(2)zhang(grong rdal)mi dmangs srid gzhung la rdzong rim pa yan gyi spyi bde las khungs kyis mngags bcol byas pa'i gnas tshul 'og spyod gzod bde srung chad gcod kyi khrun thag gcod dbang kha shas lag bstar byas chog(3)spyi bde las khungs kyis zhang(grong rdal)mi dmangs srid gzhung la mngags bcol byas te bde srung chad gcod kyi khrun thag gcod dbang kha shas lag bstar byed par nges par du khrims bkod cha rkyen dang mthun dgos pa dang / grong gseb te spyi bde mngags gtong khang med pa'i sa char spyod gzod spyi bde las khungs kyis zhang(grong rdal)mi dmangs srid gzhung la mngags bcol byas te bde srung chad gcod kyi khrun thag gcod dbang kha shas lag bstar byas chog gal te grong gseb min pa dang / grong gseb tu spyi bde mngags gtong khang med pa'i sa cha yin na mangs bcol byas mi chog(4)khrims bkod cha rkyen dang mthun pa'i zhang(grong rdal)mi dmangs srid gzhung gis bde srung chad gcod kyi khrun thag gcod dbang kha shas lag bstar byed skabs nges par du mngag bcol byas pa'i las khungs kyi ming thog nas khrun thag gcod pa las rang gi ming thog nas mi chog de la sa byung ba'i bca' khrims 'gan khur yod tshad mngags bcol byed mkhan gyi spyi bde las khungs kyis khur dgos/(spya gnyis)las khungs gang dag la bde srung do dam chad gcod kyi dbang shā de dasru/nga do dam chad gcod srol yig〉gi don tshan so gnyis pa'i gtan 'bebs ltar na/ bde sgang do dam chad gcod kyi dbang cha yod ༵ spya/

(1)rdzong dang grong khyer spyi bde cu'u/ yang na rdzong rim pa dang 'dra ba'ispyi bde las khungs la dbang cha yod/ las khungs de dag la sgor50yan gyi dngul chad dang srid 'dzin bkag bskyil byed pa'i dbang cha yod pa yin/(2)spyi bde las khungs la tha tshig sgrog pa dang / sgor50man gyi dngul chad gcod pa sogs chad pa yang mo gcod pa'i dbang cha yod/(3)grong gseb te spyi bde mngags gtong khang med pa'i sa char tha tshig sgrog pa dang sgor50man gyi chad pa gcod na/ spyi bde las khungs(rdzong rim pa yan gyi spyi bde las khungs)kyis zhang (grong rdal)mi dmangs srid gzhung la /hā/ sdu/la byas te bde srung do dam gyi chad gcod gyod gzhi ltar khrun thag (re gsum)nga cho zhing pa srun zlas gnas tshul gang dag gi 'og tu srid 'dzin chad gtsod dang len ma byas na chog〈〈srid 'dzin chad gcod bca' khrims〉〉kyi don tshan zhe dgu pa'i gtan 'bebs ltar na/ srid 'dzin las khungs dang khrims skyong pas bca' khrims kyi gtan 'bebs 'og skabs thog tu dngul chad gcod pa yin na/ nges par du do bdag par zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad skyong grong khyer bcas kyi nor srid sde khag gi gcig gyur gyi dngul chad gcod pa'i 'phrod 'dzin ster dgos/ nor srid sde khag gi gcig gyur gyi dngul chad gcod pa'i 'phrod 'dzin ma byin na do bdag par dang len mi byed pa'i dbang cha yod/ srid 'dzin chad gcod skor gyi bca' khrimasakyi don tshan nga drug pa'i gtan 'bebs ltar na/ srid 'dzin las khungs kyis do bdag par chad —pa gcod dus dngul chad bcad pa'i 'phrod yig dang rgyu nor gzhung bzhes kyi 'dzin yig mi sprod pa'am/ yang na khrims bkod sde khag ma yin pas bzos pa'i da~X /da bcad pa'i 'phrod yig dang rgyu nor gzhung bzhes kyi 'dzin yig

sprod tshe/ do bdag pas dang len mi byed pa'i dbang cha yod pa ma zad nyes 'don byas chog rim pa gong ma'i srid 'dzin las khungs dang yang na 'brel yod sde khag gis khrims 'gal 'dzin yig phyir bsdus nas med par gtong ba dang / thad kur 'gan khur pa'i gtso bdag pa dang yang na gzhan pa'i 'gan khur par khrims ltar srid 'dzin chad pa gcod dgos/(de bzhi) nga cho zhing pa srun zla spyi bde las khungs kyis srid 'dzin bkag bskyil byed par mi 'thad na ji ltar bya/〈srid 'dzin do dam chad gcod skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan so dgu par gtan 'bebs ltar na/ spyi bde las khungs kyis srid 'dzin bkag bskyil dang dngul chad bcad par do bdag pa yid 'thad min na/ brda tho 'byor rjes kyi nyin5nang tshun du rim pa gong ma'i spyi bde las khungs la srid 'dzin bskyar gros zhus chog do bdag pas rim pa gong ma'i srid 'dzin bskyar gros kyis khrun thag bcad par spyod dung mi 'thad na/ brda tho 'byor rjesakyi nyinadunang tshun du yang bskyar sa de ga'i mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug byas chog de ni nga tsho zhing pa spun zlas gal te spyi bde las khungs kyis srid 'dzin bkag bskyil dang dngul chad bcad par mi 'thad kyang / thad kur mi dmangs khrims khang la srid 'dzin srid 'dzin zhu gtug byed mi chog tshe/nges par du sngon la rim pa gong ma'i spyi bde las khungs la srid 'dzin bskyar gros zhus chog srid 'dzin bskyar gros la spyod dung 'thad pa min na/ mi dmangs khrims khang la srid 'dzin zhu gtug byas chog pa dang / dus mtshungs su mnyam 'jog dgos pa ni khrims bkod dus yun las brgal mi chog(de lnga) nga cho zhing pa spun zla 'grim 'grul byur rkyen gyi 'gan 'khri gtan khel byas par mi 'thad na ji ltar bya/nga tsho zhing pa spun zlar gal te 'grim 'grul byur rkyen byung ste/ ༵ |de

'grim 'grul nyen rtog sde khag gis 'grim 'grul byur rkyen gyi 'gan 'khri gtan khel byas par 'thad pa min na/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi〈bgrod lam 'grim 'grul byur rkyen thag gcod byed thabs〉dang don tshan nyer gnyis pa'i nang / 6 do bdag pa 'grim 'grul byur rkyen gyi 'gan 'khri gtan khel byas par 'thad pa min na/ 'grim 'grul byur rkyen gyi 'gan 'khri gtan khel byas pa'i yi ge 'byor ba'i nyin15nang tshun du/ rim pa gong ma'i spyi bde las khungs la bskyar du gtan khel byed pa'i re 'dun zhus chog rim pa gong ma'i spyi bde las khungs kyis bskyar du gtan khel byas pa'i yi ge 'byor ba'i nyin30nangatshun du / gtan khel yi ge rgyun 'khyongs dang spo sgyur/ yang na phyir 'then bcas byed dgos pa gtan la phab yod/ 'di nas zhing pa spun zlar gsal 'debs zhu rgyu zhig la/ spyi bde pu'u yi〈bgrod lam 'grim 'grul byur rkyen thag gcod bya rim gyi gtan 'bebs〉kyi don tshan so lnga par gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar na/ 'grim 'grul byur rkyen gyi 'gan 'khri bskyar du gtan khel byas pa de mtha' mjug gi gtan khel yin/ yang gcig bshad na/do bdag pa rim pa gong ma'i spyi bde las khungs kyis 'grim 'gril don rkyen gyi 'gan khur la bskyar du gtan khel byas par mi 'thad kyang / yang bskyar zhu gtug bya mi chog(de drug)nga tsho zhing pa srid 'dzin sde khag gis chad gcod byed par mi 'thad naji ltar bya/srid 'dzin chad gcod ni phyogs mang por 'brel yod pa zhig red/dper na/ spyi bde dang bzo tshong / khral don/ khor yug srung skyong / bza' btung 'phrod bston/ rtsis bsher/ nor srid/ dngul rtsa/ sa zhing sogs red/ nga tsho zhing pa tsho 'phrad pa ni phal cher gsham gyi rigs bzhir gtogs te/2〉cig ni mi'i rang dbang tshod 'dzin gyi chad gcod de gtso bo ni bkag

nyar byas pa de red/ gnyis ni 'gro 'dug gi nus pa tshod 'dzin byed pa'i chad gcod de/ dper na tshong gnyer lag khyer dang 'phrod bston chog mchan dpang yig kha lo ba'i dpang yig sogs phyir bsdu ba/ gsum ni sgor mo'i chad pa sprod pa'i chad gcod de/ dper na/ sgor mo'i chad pa bcad pa/byis pa btsas pa tshad las brgal ba'i chad pa bsdu ba sogs lta bu/ bzhi ni srid 'dzin chad gcod gzhan pa ste/ dper na rgyu nor gzhung bzhes gtong ba/thon skyed kyi las mtshams 'jog tu 'jug pa/ khral dngul 'gor 'gyangs byas pa'i chad pa bsdu ba sogs lta bu red/ gal te nga tsho zhing pa tshang ma gong gi srid 'dzin sde khag gi chad gcod de la 'thad pa med na/ rim pa gong ma'i srid 'dzin sde khag la bskyar du gros zhib byed pa'i re 'dun zhus chog la/bskyur du gros zhib byas par 'thad pa med na mi dmangs khrims khang la zhu gtug byed kyang chog mi dmangs khrims khang gis bdag sprod byed pa'i khyab khongs kyi srid 'dzin gyod don la gtogs na thad kur du mi dmangs khrims khang la srid 'dzin zhu gtug byed kyang chog pa red/(de bdun)nyes don rgyad gzhi gang dag la mi dmangs khrims khang gis thad kur bdag sprod bya nges/nga tsho 'ing pa tshang mas khrims gtug byed skabs/ khrims 'dzin sde khag gang gis bdag sprod byed pa de shes rgyu yang ha cang gal che/ 〈nyes don zhu gtug bca' khrims〉kyi thag gcod ltar na/ mi dmangs khrims khang gis thad kur rang gis zhu gtug byed pa'i gyod don la bdag sprod byed dgos/ gcig ni yar zhu byas rjes spyod gzod thag bcad pa'i gyod gzhi/dper na brnyas bcos kyi nyes pa deng skyon 'dogs kyi nyes pa/ mnar gcod btang ba'i nyes pa/ drag shugs kyis gnyen sgrig rang dbang la the gtogs byas pa'i nyes pa sogs lta bu/ yang gcig bshad na nga tsho mang tshogs kyis bshad pa~X/ga

bsher dang 'dri rtsad mi byedapa'i gyod don dag gnyis ni gnod 'tshe phog mkhan la bden dpang yod pas bden dpang byas pa'i nyes don gyod gzhi chung nga'i rigs/ gsum ni gnod 'tshe phog mkhan la bden dpang yod pas bden dpang byas pa'i do bdag gis rang nyid dang rang gi rgyu nor bdag dbang la gnod 'tshe bzos pa'i bya spyod la khrims ltar de'i nyes don 'os 'gan 'dri cod bya 'os/(re brgyad)nyes don rgyad gzhi gang dag la mi dmangs zhib dpyod khang gis thad gar bdag spyod bya nges/〈〈nyes don zhu gtug bca' khrims〉〉kyi don tshan bco brgyad pa'i tshan pa gnyis pa'i gtan 'bebs ltar na/ mi dmangs zhib dpyod khang gis thad kurabadag sprod byed pa'i gyod gzhi la/ rgyu za rngam sprod kyi nyes pa dang rgyal khab kyi las byed pa'i 'gan 'dzol gyi nyes pa/ rgyal khab kyi las khungs gtso bo'i las byed pas dbang cha bkol nas khrims 'gal bkag bskyil byas pa'am nyes don btsan gyis khas len du 'jug pa/ 'khon lan slog ste gzhan la skyon 'dzugs pa bcas 'dus/ rgyal khab kyi las byed pas dbang cha bkol nas bzos pa'i nyes bzos gyod don tshabs che'i rigs la mi dmangs zhib dpyod khang gis thad kur bdag sprod byed dgos la/ zhing chen rim pa yan gyi mi dmangs zhib dpyod khang gis gtan 'bebs brgyud mi dmangs zhib dpyod khang gis gyod don tho 'god byas nas myul zhib byas chog(re dgu)nga cho zhing pa rnams la gnas tshul ji 'dra'i 'og rgyal khab la skyin tshab spyod dgos pa'i re 'dun zhu dbang yod/ d+ngha 〈〈rgyal khab kyi skyin tshab sprod pa'i skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉kyi don tshan gardiswā zlo'i gtan 'bebs ltar na/ srid 'dzin sde khag dang de'i las byed

pas srid 'dzin dbang cha lag bstar byed skabs gsham gyi mi lus dbang cha la gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i gnas tshul gcig yod na/ gnod 'tshe phog mkhan la sbin tshab thob pa'i dbang cha yod/sgo (1)khrims 'gal bkag nyar byas pa'am khrims dang 'gal te spyi dbyingarnyi kyi byi lus rang dbang la tshod 'dzin byas pa'i srid 'dzin byed thabs ba na (23 khrigā ༵/ 'gal bkag skyil lam byed thabs ga'an par brten nas spyi dmangs kyi mi lus rang dbang 'phrog pa/(3)gcar rdung sogs kyi drag shugs bya spyod dam mi gzhan la rdung deg sogs drag shugs bkol bar skul te bzos pa'i spyi dmangs kyi lus phung la rmas skyon bslad pa dang yang na bsad pa/(4)khrims dang 'gal te mtshon cha spyod pa'am/ nyen rtog pas lag chas spyi dmangs kyi lus phung la rmas skyon bslad pa'am bsad pa/(5)spyi dam ngas kyi lus phung la rmas skyon bzos pa'am bsad pa'i khrims /zlos /ba spyo bye sdu/ 〉bye byed pa'i skor gyi bca' khrims〉kyi don tshan bzhi ba ltar na/ srid 'dzin sde khag dang de'i las byed pas srid 'dzin dbang cha spyod skabs gsham gyi rgyu nor la gnod skyon bzos pa'i gnas tshul las gcig yod na/ gnod 'tshe phog mkhan la skyin tshab thob pa'i dbang cha yod pa/(1)khrims dang 'gal te dngul chad gcod pa/ chog mchan dpang yig dang lag 'khyer phyir bsdu ba/ thon skyed byed mtshams 'jog dgos par skul ba/ rgyu nor gzhung bzhes byas pa sogs kyi srid 'dzin thag gcod/(2)khrims dang 'gal te rgyu nor sgor thel rgyag pa dang bkag nyar byas pa sogs srid 'dzin byed thabs btsan gyis spyod pa/ 301

le (3)rgyal khab kyi thag gcod las 'gal te rgyu nor dang bgo 'grem rin pa na( ༵/)rgyu nor la gnod 'tshe bzos pa'i khrims 'gal bya spyod gzhan pa/(bdun cu)rgyal khab kyi skyin tshab spyod pa'i tshad gzhi ni ga chod yin/rgyal khab kyi skyin tshab sprod par mi lus rmas skyon gyi skyin tshab dang rgyu nor gnod 'tshe'i skyin tshab gnyis yod/(1)spyi dmangs kyi mi lus rang dbang la gnod 'tshe btang ba/ nyin re'i skyin tshab ma dngul rgyal khab kyi lo sngon ma'i las bzo ba'i nyin re'i zla phogs ltar brtsi ba dang / nyin ga tshod 'gor na sgor mo yang ga tshod 'jal dgos/ spyi dmangs kyi tshe srog dang bde thang dbang cha la gnod 'tshe btang bar/ mjug 'bras kyi che chung ltar skyin tshab 'jal dgos te/ lus phung la rmas skyon bzos na sman yon dang las thebs chags pa'i gla phogs sogs rtsis sprod byed pa/ ngal rtsol nus pa cha shas dang yang na yongs rdzogs shor ba'i mi snar sman yon dang dbang bo skyon can la skyin tshab ma dngul nges par du sprod dgos/ ngal rtsol nus pa cha shas shor ba'i dbang bo skyon can la skyin tshab sprod pa'i ches mtho'i ma dngul ni rgyal khab kyi lo sngon ma'i las bzo ba'i cha snyoms kyi lo re'i gla phogs kyi ldab10yin/ ngal rtsol nus pa yongs rdzogs shor ba'i dbang bo skyon can la skyin tshab sprod pa'i ches mtho'i ma dngul ni rgyal khab kyi lo sngon ma'i las bzo ba'i cha snyoms kyi lo re'i gla phogs kyi ldab20yin/shi rmas byung ba la shi rmas byung ba'i skyin tshab ma dngul dang dur 'jug gron dngul sogs sprod dgos pa dang / shi bo tshe las ma 'das pa'i sngon la stor skyong gnang ba'i ngal rtsol nus pa med pa'i mi la 'tsho ba'i ma dngul sprod dgos/(2)rgyu nor la gtor brlag byung nas skyin tshab 'jal na gnas tshul mi 'di chos sazhigs nas rgyu dngos phyir sprod pa dang gyong kun thebs par skyin

tshab 'jal ba sogs kyi byed thabs spyad nas skyin tshab 'jal dgos/(don gcig) zhing pa spun zla chos gnas tshul ji 'dra'i 'og khrims 'dzin gyi gan gsab 'jal ba'i re ba brtan chog〈rgyal khab kyi skyin tshab sprod pa'i skor gyi bca' khrims〉nang gi don tshan bco lnga dang bcu drug bcu bdun pa bcas nang gtan 'bebs byas par gzhigs na/ spyi bde dang spyi bde las khungs/ zhib dpyod las khungs/khrims khang / btson khang bdag gnyer las khungs bcas dang de'i las byed mi snas 'gan bab dbang cha spyod pa'i skabs su/ gsham gyi mi lus dbang char gnod pa thebs pa'i gnas tshul las gcig yod na/ gnod thebs mkhan la skyin tshab len pa'i khe dbang yod pa ste/ skyin tshab sprod pa'i re ba bton chog(1)nag nyes bzos pa'i don dngos dang yang na bden dpang med par nag nyes tshabs chen du brtsis shing dogs gzhi nyes can du 'khrul nas bkag stu/ /sna snas/ bzos pa'i don dngos med par dogs gzhi nyes can du 'khrul nas 'dzin bzung byas pa/(3)'dri gcod lta skul go rim ltar slar 'dri gcod byas nas nyes pa med par bzos pa dang / sngar khrims chad bcad zin pa/(4)tsha 'dri byas nas ngos len zhu ru 'jug pa sogs drag shugs kyi bya spyod dang mi gzhan la gcar rdung sogs kyi bya spyod kyis spyi dmangs kyi lus por rmas skyon byung ba dang shi rmas byung ba/(5)khrims 'gal gyi mtshon cha dang nyen zon dbyug pa sogs bkol /sa spyi dmangs kyi lus phung la gnod skyon bzos pa dang yang na shi rmas byung gsham gyi rgyu nor dbang char gnod pa thebs pa'i gnas tshu10 sdus

gcig yod na/ gnod thebs mkhan la skyin tshab len pa'i dbang cha yod/(1)khrims 'gal sgos rgyu nor la sgo thel rgyag pa dang / btsan nyar byed pa/ bsdam/ bcad dang khral dngul bda' 'ded byed pa sogs kyi byed thabs rnyi/ 'a/sa ga/cod lta skul go rim ltar slar 'dri gcod byas nas nyes pa med par btang ba dang / sngar dngul chad bcad pa dang rgyu nor gzhung bzhes byas /rdo /kyang gsham gyi gnas tshul 'di rigs gnas pa la rgyal khab kyis skyin tshab sprod 'gan mi khur/(1)spyi dmangs rang nyid kyis bsam bzas nas g.yo rdzus byas te zhu 'bul byed pa dang / yang na nag nyes gzhan pa'i bden dpang rdzun bzo byas te bkaskyi nyar bye/ du bcug pa'am yang na nyes don gyi byas nyes bsags par thag ga(23 ༵ sna 1sdu/sa ma/ son pa'i byis pa dang yang na lo na14la son yang lo na16la ma son pas mi bsad pa dang / rmas tshabs chen bzos pa/ 'phrog bcom dang mer bsregs pa/ rku 'phrog byas nyes sam gzhan spyi tshogs kyi sgrig lam la gtor brlag btang ba'i nyes bsags las gzhan/ da dung smyo nad byung yod mis ngos bzung dang rang nyid kyi bya spyod tshod 'dzin byed ma thub par gnod skyon bzos pa'i mjug 'bras te/nyes don gyi 'gan 'khri dang len mi byed pa'i mi 'di dag bkag nyar byas pa/(3)〈nyes don gtug bsher skor gyi bca' khrims〉〉kyi don tshan bco lnga ba'i gtan 'bebs la gzhigs na/ gnas tshul drug po'i gras kyi gcig la gtogs tshe/ nyes 'gan khur mi bkag nyar byed pa bda' 'ded byed mi rung /30/4)rgyal khyab kyi myul zhib dang zhib dpyod/ 'dri gcod/ btson ra'i

do dam bcas kyi 'gan dbang spyod pa'i las khungs kyi las byed mi sna dang 'gan dbang spyod par 'brel ba med pa'i mi sger gyi bya da/(5)spyi dmangs kyis bsam bzhin du rang steng la rmas bton pa dang rang nyid dbang bo skyon can du bzos pa/(6)bca' khrims kyis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i gnas tshul gzhan dag305
